tei:div.tei:p: (97)then:rerjes 'i stuno shoste /nyekrung da rag pa ba 'jug gnas bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

gzungs 'dus/ sgroslo (97)0852 spyan 'dren rgyud gsum pa/ 3bsdur mchan/(8) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(9)0859 'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 10rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(123) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(131)0860 'phags pa ye shes ta la la zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'gro ba thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/ 132bsdur mchan/(136) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(137)

0861 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 138bsdur mchan/(150) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(153)0862 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 154rgya gar gyi mkhan po pu rgya sam+bha wa dang / lots+tsha ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(159) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(160)0863 'phags pa yon tan bsngags pa dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 161bsdur mchan/(162) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(163)0864 'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 164bsdur mchan/(174) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(176)0865 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 177rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes 2

sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(185) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(186)0866 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs/ 187rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(193) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(194)0867 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 195rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(199) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(200)0868 'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 201rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(205) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(206)0869 'phags pa tsan+dan gyi yan lag ces bya ba'i gzungs/ 2073

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(212) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(213)0870 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal po sgron ma mchog gi gzungs/ 214bsdur mchan/(227) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(228)0871 'phags pa dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 229rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(233) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(234)0872 'phags pa shākya thub pa'i snying po'i gzungs/ 235bsdur mchan/(236) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(236)0873 'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs / 237bsdur mchan/(238) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(238)0874 de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla'i snying po'i gzungs/ 2394

bsdur mchan/(240) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(240)0875 'phags pa rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs/ 241bsdur mchan/(242) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(242)0876 bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas kyi gzungs sngags/ 243bsdur mchan/(244) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(245)0877 'od dpag med mthong bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 246bsdur mchan/(247) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(247)0878 'phags pa pad+ma'i spyan zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 248bsdur mchan/(249) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(250)0879 snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa/ 251bsdur mchan/(252) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(252)0880 zla ba'i 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ 253bsdur mchan/(254) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(254)5

0881 de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying po rjes su dran pa/ 255bsdur mchan/(256) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(256)0882 sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ 257bsdur mchan/(258) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(258)0883 'phags pa dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 259rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(268) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(269)0884 'phags pa khyad par can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 270rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(277) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(279)0885 sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 280bsdur mchan/(290) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(291)6

0886 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 292bsdur mchan/(298) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(299)0887 'phags pa byams pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 300bsdur mchan/(304) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(305)0888 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 306bsdur mchan/(313) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(314)0889 'phags pa kun du bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 315bsdur mchan/(324) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(325)0890 'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 326bsdur mchan/(332) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(333)7

0891 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 334bsdur mchan/(342) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(343)0892 'phags pa sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 344bsdur mchan/(349) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(350)0893 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 351bsdur mchan/(356) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(357)0894 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 358rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(361) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(361)0895 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi snying po gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog 8

ces bya ba'i gzungs theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 362rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibya ka ra pra bha dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje gtsang de ben dra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(376) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(378)0896 shes pas thams cad mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 379bsdur mchan/(394) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(397)0897 'phags pa nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba dam pa'i gsang ba'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 398cho ga dang po/ bskul ba'i le'u/ 398cho ga gnyis pa/ rig sngags rgyas par sgrub pa'i le'u/ 427cho ga gsum pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sgrub pa'i le'u/ 439cho ga bzhi pa/ rgyas pa'i le'u/ 442cho ga lnga pa/ sku gzugs rgyas pa chen po'i le'u/ 443cho ga drug pa/ sbyin sreg grub pa rgyas pa'i le'u/ 447cho ga bdun pa'i le'u/ 4gargya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā gar+bha pra bha dang /lots+tsha ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab/

bsdur mchan/(453) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(460)0898 'phags pa me tog brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 461bsdur mchan/(467) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(468)0899 'phags pa sa'i dbang po chen po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 469rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(473) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(474)0900 'phags pa gzungs chen po/ 475rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(481) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(482)0901 bde ldan gyi snying po/ 483bsdur mchan/(484) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(484)0902 'phags pa byams pas dam bcas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 485rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/10

bsdur mchan/(487) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(487)0903 'phags pa sgrib pa rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 488bsdur mchan/(490) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(490)0904 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ ga1rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba brje klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shu sidha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje de ba tsan+d+ras gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(492) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(493)0905 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dmod btsugs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ ga4bsdur mchan/(496) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(496)0906 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan/ ga7bsdur mchan/(498) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(498)0907 rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi shes rab dang blo 'phel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ ga911

bsdur mchan/(500) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(501)0908 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sngags yi ge 'bru gcig pa'i ཿbye ba/ 502bsdur mchan/(503) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(503)0909 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sems rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 504zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(587) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(598)0910 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa'i yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 599dang po/ sdig pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi le'u/ 599gnyis pa/ thams cad byams shing mos par 'gyur ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 604gsum pa/ gzhan dag la byams shing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i sman a ka ta sbyar ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 607bzhi pa/ sman mur ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 608lnga pa/ mig gi sman gyi le'u/ 61012

drug pa/ sbyin sreg ho gyi cho ga sman sbyor ba'i le'u/ 614zhu chen gyi mkhan po dang lots+tsha ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa ban+de chos grub kyis /sbya dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la bsdur mchan/(618) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(620)0911 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 621rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(626) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(627)0912 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 628bsdur mchan/(633) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(634)0913 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 635rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badz+ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba ba ri rin chen grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(649) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(654)0914 sa bcu pa'i gzungs/ 65513

bsdur mchan/(662) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(663)0915 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 664paṇ+ḍi ta ma shrī warma dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/lots+tsha ba chos kyi shes rab kyis kyang bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(669) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(670)0916 'phags pa kun du bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 671rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(677) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(678)0917 'phags pa nī la kuṇ+ḍa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 679bsdur mchan/(683) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(685)0918 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ha ya spyi ba'i gzungs / 686bsdur mchan/(688) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(690)14

0919 'phags pa me kha la zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 691rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(704) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(707)0920 snying rjes mi bshol ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 708bsdur mchan/(710) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(711)0921 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 712rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(716) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(717)0922 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzungs zhes bya ba 718bsdur mchan/(720) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(720)0923 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po/ 721bsdur mchan/(722) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(722)15

0924 seng ge sgras dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ 723rgya gar gyi mkhan po ngag gi dbang phyug dang /lots+tsha ba klog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(724) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(724)0925 snying rje'i mchog ces bya ba'i gzungs/ 725bsdur mchan/(730) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(731)0926 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pas sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 732rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā bza dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes ṭī ka dang sbyar tsho te slad kyis zhus nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(754) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(758)0927 'phags pa sgo bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 759rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(771) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(774)0928 'phags pa sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 775bsdur mchan/(777) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(778)0929 'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags/ 77916

bsdur mchan/(781) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(782)0930 tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ 783bsdur mchan/(784) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(785)0931 'phags pa lus kyi dbyibs mdzes zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 786rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā bar ma dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(790) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(791)0932 byang chub kyi snying po'i rgyan 'bum gyi gzungs/ 792bsdur mchan/(794) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(795)0933 mchod rten gcig btab na bye ba btab par 'gyur ba'i gzungs / 796bsdur mchan/(798) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(798)0934 'phags pa gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 799rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(804) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(806)17

0935 'phags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ces bya ba'i gzungs/ 807rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(811) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(813)0936 'phags pa gser can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 814rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(819) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(821)0937 'phags pa thams cad la mi 'jigs pa rab tu sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 822rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(826) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(827)0938 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 828rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes 18

sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(831) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(832)0939 'phags pa 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po/ 833rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(838) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(839)0940 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba/ 840rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā bza dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(844) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(845)0941 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rin po che'i phreng ba cenis bya ba/ 846rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(850) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(851)0942 stong 'gyur zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 852bsdur mchan/(854) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(854)19

ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ji ltar rtogs par bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni dngos po med par rtogs par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa dang / spros pa med pa dang / ma spros pa dang / blang ba 6)med pa dang / dor ba med pa dang / dngos po med pa dang / gnas pa med pa ste de ltar rtogs ②par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chos kyi dbyings 'byung ba lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni 'byung ba med pa'o / /rigs kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni dngos po med par (5)rtogs pa ste/ dngos po gang du yang brjod par bya ba ma yin zhing bstan par bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub la rnam pa du mchis / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi rnam pa ni tshad med de de ni tshad dang ldan par bstan par mi nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par rtog 54)par bgyid dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni rnam par mi rtog go/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te chos kyi dbyings rnam par mi rtog pa lags na/ byis pa so so'i skye (5)bo rnams ci'i slad du rtog par bgyid/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byis pa so so'i skye bo thams cad ni (6)rtog pa dang / rnam par rtog pa dang / yongs 97—13

su rtog pa las byung ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub 'di 1)ni zab lags so / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ ci (miskad smras pa dbazhin no/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang chos thams cad spros pa med pa ni byang chub ces bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis cadakon mchog ta la la zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs bshad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po 55chos thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa la gnas pa 'di la dris shig dang / 'dis 'khyod la ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs te 'dug nas sor mo bcu'i 7thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis ci'i slad du mi bshad/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu gang na byang chub sems dpa' yon tan 'di lta bu dang ldan pa dag 'khod pa de na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams btang snyoms su bzhugs so/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni 8btang snyoms su bzhugs pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu nga ni sems can gyi khams yal bar 'dor ba ma yin te/ rigs kyi bu 'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bstan pa ni bstan pa tshad med cing bstan pa bsam gyis 97—14

mi khyab bo/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dkon mchog ta la la zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po 'di la dris shig dang /'dis (1)khyod la ston par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu skyes bu dam pa 'di ni ye shes kyi tshogs la gnas pa'o/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/gal te de bzhin gshegs pas rdzun)bdag la dgongs na bdag gis skyes bu dam pa 'di la dri bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal khyod kyis ting nge 'dzin rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed thob pa yin na nasade bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba gdab ci dgos/ rigs kyi bu khyod ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la skal ba dang ldan pa yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos gang dag kun du bsten pa dang /bsgoms pa dang mang du bgyis pa de thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthur rig (45par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis tshig 'di legs par smras te/ 'on kyang 'jam dpal nga khyod la gsol ba 'debs kyis khyod byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la dris shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po 'di ni shin tu zab mo ston pa ste/ theg pa chen po rtogs par khong du chud pa lags so/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyang chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po yin gyis bdag la ma 97—15

gsung 1shig /yang rigs kyi bu khyod ni stong pa nyid la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la sor mo bcu'i thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la 'di skad ces smras so//kye /5rgyal ba'i sras khyod kyis bdag la skabs phye na khyod la bdag yi ge 'bru gnyis shig 'dri'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de'i dus la da bab par 5)shes na dris shig /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas sangs rgyas zhes (4)bya ba'i gzhi'i don gang yin/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni gzhi med pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni dngos po med pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni spros pa med pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni ma spros pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni blang ba med pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni dor ba med pa'i don to / /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni bsnyad du med pa'i don te6)/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi rang bzhin ni de lta bu yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/kye rgyal ba'i sras gal te chos thams cad spros pa med pa yin na/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams shes ji skad bstan/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang 97—16

pos smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bstan pa 'di ni bstan du med pa'o/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bstan du med na ci zhig bstan/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa/ 'jam dpal bstan du med pa ni btags te bstan to/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras btags pas ci zhig 'dogs par byed/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa / 'jam dpal btags pas ni dngos po yang mi 'dogs/ dngos po med pa yang mi 'dogs so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras gal te btags pas dngos po yang mi 'dogs dngos po med pa yang mi 'dogs na theg pa gsum po dag ji ltar bstan/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa / 'jam dpal khyod chos kyi dbyings chags pa med pa la chags par ma byed/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'o zhes bstan pa'i phyir te/ gang dngos po med pa'i phyir zhe na/phung po lnga dmigs pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ byang chub spros pa dang bcas pa yin nam/ 'on te spros pa med pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub ni spros pa dang bcas pa yang ma yin/ spros pa med pa yang ma yin te/ 'di ltar byang chub dang ske/ spros pa dang bcas pa dang / spros pa med pa de (1)ni gnyis su med de gnyis su dbyer med do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la rigs kyi bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa 'di legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /gtam 'di brjod pas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di la rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol 97—17

pa / bcom ldan 'das chos bstan pa 'di lta bu ni rnam pa (1)'tshal bar mi rung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad btags pa 'dis btags pa rnalags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par dag pa'i sgo 'di ni mos par bgyi dka' ba lags so//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos rnam par dag pa'i sgo bstan pa 'di legs par smras lags so//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang 'di ni chos thams cad kyi rgyu mthun ( pa yin no/ /'di ni chos kyi char chen po yin no/ /de nas shing sā (4)la chen po lta bu'i bram ze mnyam pa nyid du gnas pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub ni mnyam 5pa nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa lags te/ de la yi ge mi dmigs/ tshig 'bru mi dmigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ chos kyi dbyings la tshig 'bru mi 6snang / don kyang mi snang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 97—18

stong pa nyid kyi rgyu mthun 0)pa gang lags/ rnam pa gang lags/ rtags gang lags / mtshan ma gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal stong pa nyid ni brjod du med pa/ bsnyad du med pa ste/ brjod du med pa'i chos nyid 'di la mos pa gang yin pa de stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /stong pa nyid de ni yi ge med pa ste/ de'i phyir stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /stong pa nyid de ni bsnyad du med pa ste/ de'i phyir stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos thams cad ni chos kyi ②ngo bo nyid kyis (8)stong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa sha ngasar dwa ti'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos la gnas pa rnams kyi rnam par 'phrul pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i shes pa ni mchog yin gyi dgra bcom pa'i shes pa ni de lta 5rim yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dgra bcom pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las ring du gnas la/byang chub sems dpa' de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don bdag gis 'tshal ba ltar na nyan thos kyis ni (6)nyan thos kyi chos rnams ma thob pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu nyan thos kyis nyan thos kyi chos rnams ma thob pa ni ma yin te/ 'on kyang nyan thos la byang chub sems dpa' dang lhan cig tu dris pa la lan gdab pa'am/ spyod pa'i 7 byin gyis brlab 8)97—19

par bya ba'i nus pa dang mthu ga la yod/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pas shes rab dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na bstan pa 'di gang la bstan pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal ngas gang bstan pa 'di ni bstan pa med pa'o / /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gnas brtan sha ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan gyis nyan thos kyi chos rnams thob bam / smras pa de ni ma yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ 'o na ci khyod so so'i skye bo'am/ smras pa de ni ma yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ 'o na ci khyod slob pa'am/ smras pa/ de ni ma yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/'o na khyod ci shes rab dang ldan pa'i mchog yin nam/ smras pa/ de ni ma yin no / /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ gal te btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu so so'i skye bo yang ma yin/ slob pa yang ma yin/ shes rab dang ldan pa'i mchog kyang ma yin na de nyid khyod dmigs pa can du 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa / rigs kyi bu kho bo ni skyes bu dam pa rgya mtsho ltar gting dpag dka' ba khyod dang 'gyed par mi byed do/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu khyod ni rgan rabs thu bo mchog yin gyis btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de skad ma zer cig /gnas brtan gyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu rgas pa'i dngos pos ni ci yang 'thob par mi 'gyur/ mngon par rtogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu don de nyid shes par bya ba'i phyir khyod la dpe bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na rdo rje ngan ngon gyis kyang ri brag chen po rnam par 'jig go/ /97—20

rigs kyi bu de bzhin du khyod kyi spu'i khung bu gcig na shes rab 'dug pa gang yin pa de ni kho bo lta bu'i sems can rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed rnams la med do/ /rigs kyi bu don de nyid shes par bya ba'i phyir yang khyod la dpe bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ ba lang glang po che shin tu mi bzad pa chen po de yang mi stobs dang ldan pas lcags kyu chung zhi)ngus dul bar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du khyod ni stobs dang ldan pa/ kho bo ni nyam chung ba ste/ glang po che chen po 'di lta bu dang kho bo 'gyed ga la nus/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la gnas brtan sha ra dwa ti'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste / dper na mi dmus long gis shul du mchi ba'am/ grong khyer mthong bar yang rngo mi thogs 95)na khyim nas khyim du mchi ba'i rngo lta ga la thogs tetsho ni/ de ni gnas ma mchis so/ /de bzhin du glang po che chen po lta bu 'di dag gi mdun 43na bdag ni dmus long dang mtshungs par mthong ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di dag ni de tsam du rgya che ba lags so/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi snod du ma gyur te/ da ci bgyir yang ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de skad ma zer cig(5) /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ dper na de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis sems can ji snyed cig la reg pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams thob pa yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin du khyod ni ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na/lha dang mi'i skye dgu las sems can dgu khri nyis stong gis chos mngon par rtogs par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros byang chub sems 97—21

dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dkon mchog ta la la sbyor ba mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba de la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re'i 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi pha rol nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyis zhal mngon par bstan te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyang mtshan rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya bar mthun 17pa sha stag go/ /phyogs gcig ji lta bar phyogs bcu rnams nas kyang de bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /chos kyi blo gros khyod de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sbyor ba mtha' yas pa la snyoms par zhugs pa legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad 'di nyid kyi sngon gyi smon lam dang / sngon gyi byin gyi rlabs 2dang / khyod nyid kyi dge ba'i rtsa bas nye bar 4brtan 5)pas 'di lta ste chos thams cad bstan par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam par sbyang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam par 'phel bar bya ba dang /chos kyi dbyings su 'jug par bya ba dang / sems can gyi khams rnam par dgrol 6ba dang / chags pa med pa'i ye shes la 'jug cing 7chud par bya ba dang / kun du sbyor bar bya ba dang / skad thams cad brjod par bya ba dang / 8thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'jug par bya ba dang / chos thams cad la sgrib pa med par bya ba dang / dus gsum thams cad yongs su shes pa'i chos bstan pa la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir phyogs bcu nas de bzhin gshegs pa 97—22

sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed thams cad kyang mtshan mthun 6)par rin 'di dag thams cad khyod la byin gyis rlob kyis rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa bcu las brtsams te/sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs ( rikyis chos bstan pa 'di la spobs pa skyed cig /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros la thogs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba dang / sgrib pa med pa dang / chod pa med pa dang / brjed pa med pa'i chos nyid dang /tha dad pa med pa'i 4rin shes dang / kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / zil gyis gemi non pa dang / zhum pa med pa dang / 'phrogs pa med pa'i chos nyid dang /brjod pa bzang po nye bar sgrub pa mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid kyi chos nyid thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros (6)kyi mgo la nyug pa mdzad de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros la reg ma thag tu/ de nas ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rigs 'di ni 'di lta ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa dang / nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pas 7rgya che ba'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs su skye ba yin / ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs su skye ba yin/da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs su skye ba yin no/ /97—23

de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gang dag 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs su skye ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni gang yin/ gang las bsams te de skad smra/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa bcu po de dag gang yin pa de shod cig /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa ni bcu po 'di dag ste/ de dag ni 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs so/ /gsung ngo / /gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa dang / las dang po pa dang /rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / skye bar skyes pa dang / sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa dang / gzhon nur gyur pa dang / rgyal tshab dang / dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa ni bcu po de dag ste/de dag ni 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs so/ /gsung ngo / /gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de 1la sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 97—24

rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mthong ma thag tu gzugs bzang ba'am/ mdzes pa'am/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa'am/rgya che ba'am/ gzi brjid che ba'am/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'am/kun rjod 1)pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'am/ rjes su bstan pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa mthong ngam/ sems can sdug bsngal ba dag mthong ngam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngags pa rgya cher thos na 'di lta ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'dod cing thog ma nyid du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /sems bskyed ma thag pa de nyid kyis bsnyen par dka' dunanoba'i gnas bcu yongs su bzung bar 'gyur te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/gnas dang gnas ma yin pa shes pa dang / 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i las dang zhu chos yang dag par blangs pa shes pa dang / thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam shes pa dang / khams du ma sna tshogs shes pa dang / mos pa dang rnam par grol ba du ma shes pa dang / dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa shes pa dang / bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang ldang ba thams cad shes pa dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i shes pa dang / lha'i mig gi shes pa dang / zag pa zad pa shes pa ste/ bsnyen par dka' ba'i gnas bcu po de dag yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems 97—25

dpa' sems dpa' chen po de sangs rgyas mchod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 1bde ba'i yo byad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /de la 'jig rten gyi bdag por 'gyur ba dang / mchog tu bya ba dang / zil gyis mi gnon pa dang / sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa dang / phrad pa dang / rab tu zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la rnal 'byor du bya ba dang / 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rnam par bzlog pa dang /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba dang / sems can sdug bsngal ba yongs su bskyab pa yang brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sems bskyed 2ma thag pa de nyid kyis ge shas cher sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la sbyor zhing gong du gnas gang dag thos 5gepa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi/ gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la las dang po (55pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can rnams la thog ma nyid du sems rnam pa bcu bskyed de/ rnam pa bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phan par bya ba'i sems dang / bde bar bya ba'i sems dang / snying brtse ba'i sems dang / mnyen pa'i sems dang / sdug pa'i sems dang / phan gdags pa'i sems dang /kun tu bsrung ba'i sems dang / snyoms pa'i sems dang / slob dpon gyi sems dang / ston pa'i sems te/ sems rnam pa bcu po 'di dag bskyed ('do//kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de lung mnod pa dang /97—26

kha ton la sbyar bar bya'o/ /mang du thos nas rab tu dben pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rab tu dben par gyur nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mngon par dga' ba la sbyar bar bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mngon par dga' nas bka' dzosna blo bde ba la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bka' 90blo bde bar gyur nas dus shes pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /dus shes par gyur nas mi 'jigs pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /mi 'jigs par gyur nas don shes pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /don shes par gyur nas chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba /ril sbyar bar bya'o/ /chos kyi rjes su 'brang bar gyur nas brjed pa med pa'i chos nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rmongs pa med par gyur nas chos rnam par dgod pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sems bskyed ma thag pa de nyid kyis shas casacher sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la mngon par brtson par byed cing gong du gnas gang dag thob pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la rnal 'byor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la rnal 'byor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni dmigs pa rnam pa bcus chos rnams rtogs par byed de/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad la mi rtag pa nyid du rtogs par byed pa dang / chos thams cad la sdug bsngal ba nyid dang /bdag med pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid dang / g.yo ba med pa nyid dang /dbugs 'byin pa med pa nyid dang / gnas med pa nyid dang / rnam par rtog pa med pa nyid dang / rtsol ba med pa nyid dang / mngon par 'du byed pa 97—27

med pa nyid du rtogs par byed de/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang bar gyur pa'i phyir sbyor bar mi byed/ mi sbyor bar yang mi byed de/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni rnal 'byor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag rnal 'byor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni sems can gyi khams brtag pa la sbyar bar bya'o / /chos kyi dbyings brtag pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams brtag pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /sa'i khams brtag pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams dang / nam mkha'i khams dang / gzugs kyi khams dang / gzugs med pa'i khams brtag pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de 1ni shas cher chos rnams la snang ba 'jug cing gong du gnas gang dag thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni rnal 'byor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag gepa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag skye bar skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la skye bar skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni yongs su sbyong ba byed pa bcus gsung rab 'phags par skyes pa yin te / bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos nyid las phyir mi zlogs 4pa dang /sangs rgyas la mi phyed pa'i dad pa mthar thug par 'gyur ba yongs su grub pa dang / chos nges par sems pa dang / sems can la rnam par dpyod pa dang /zhing la rnam par dpyod 5pa dang / 'jig rten la rnam par dpyod pa dang /las la rnam par dpyod pa dang / rnam par smin pa la rnam par dpyod pa dang /'khor ba la rnam par dpyod pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la rnam par dpyod 97—28

pa ste/ yongs su sbyong 17ba 2byed pa bcu po de dag gis gsung rab 'phags par skyes pa yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni skye ri bar skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag skye bar skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o / /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos mnyam pa nyid 4rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par 'grub pa rnam par dpyad 5pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par 'grub pa rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par 'grub pa rnam par dpyad 6pa la sbyar bar bya'o / /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos yang dag par 'grub pa rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su 'grub pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su 'grub pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su 'grub pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos yongs su 'grub pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni shas cher dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du 7rtogs par byed cing / gong du gnas gang dag thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni skye bar skyes pa'i byang 97—29

chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam 1par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni dge ba'i las gang ci rtsom yang de dag thams cad sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab pa dang / sems can thams cad la phan par 'dod par bya ba dang /sems can thams cad la bde bar sbyar ba dang / sems can thams cad la snying brtse bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad rab tu thar bar bya ba dang /sems can thams cad la gnod pa med par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad drang bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad dad par bya ba dang /sems can thams cad gdul bar bya 2ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir rtsom 3ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la gnas bcu yang dag par brjod par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can mtha' yas pa dang / sems can dpag tu med pa dang / sems can grangs med pa dang /sems can bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sems can mtshungs pa med pa dang /sems can gzhal du med pa dang / sems can stong pa nyid dang / sems can g.yo ba med pa nyid dang / sems can med pa nyid dang / sems can rang bzhin med pa nyid do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de shas cher mngon par zhen pa med pa la sems 'jog cing gong du gnas cagang dag thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i 97—30

phyir te1/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i 2dag de la bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni chos bcu thos na sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bsam pa nges pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa'am/ bsngags pa ma yin pa 'chad 5kyang rung sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bsam pa nges pa yin/ chos kyi bsngags pa'am/ bsngags pa ma yin pa 'chad kyang rung / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsngags pa'am/ bsngags pa ma yin pa 'chad kyang rung ste/sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bsam pa nges pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i bsngags pa'am/ bsngags pa ma yin pa 'chad kyang rung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bsam pa nges pa yin/ sems can gyi khams rgya chung zhes 'chad pa'am/ sems can gyi khams rgya che zhe'am/ sems can gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa can zhe'am/ sems can gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa can ma yin zhe'am/ sems can gyi khams gdul sla zhe'am/ sems can gyi khams gdul dka' zhe'am/ chos kyi dbyings rgya chung zhe'am/ chos kyi dbyings rgya che zhe'am/ 'jig rten gyi khams dag 'jig ce'am/ mi 'jig ce'am/chos kyi dbyings yod ce'am/ chos kyi dbyings med ces 'chad kyang rung ste sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bsam pa nges pa 4yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la chos kyi rjes 97—31

su 'jug pa bcu yang dag par brjod par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste / chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa nyid du yang dag par brjod par bya ba dang / chos thams cad mtshan nyid med pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa nyid dang / med pa nyid dang / brdzun pa nyid dang / dben pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid med pa nyid dang / sgyu ma lta bu nyid dang / rmi lam lta bu nyid dang /rnam par rtog pa med pa nyid du yang dag par brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / 'di ltar de mi 'phrogs pa'i phyir shas cher lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par 'phel ba'i chos can du gyur cing / gong du gnas gang dag thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /kye 1rgyal ba'i sras dag de la phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni dmigs pa bcu thos na/sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las phyir mi ldog ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sangs rgyas yod do zhe'am med do zhes thos kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las phyir mi ldog pa dang / chos yod do zhe'am med do zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' yod do zhe'am med do zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yod do zhe'am med do zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' nasabyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la nges par 'byung ngo zhe'am nges par mi 'byung ngo zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dag 'das so zhe'am ma 'das so zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dag byon to zhe'am byon pa ma yin no zhes bya ba 97—32

dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dag 1da ltar byung ba'o zhe'am/ da ltar byung ba ma yin no zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zad do zhe'am mi zad do zhes bya ba dang / dus gsum po dag mtshan nyid gcig ce'am mtshan nyid gcig pa ma yin no zhes thos kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las phyir mi ldog pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la chos kyi rgyun bcu yang dag par brjod par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad gcig pa nyid dang / tha dad pa nyid du yang dag par brjod par bya'o/ /mang ba dang gcig pa nyid dang / yi ge la don sgro btags pa dang / don la yi ge sgro btags pa dang /dzon dngos pos dngos po med pa sgro btags pa dang / dngos po med pas dngos po sgro btags pa dang / mtshan mas mtshan ma med pa sgro btags pa dang / mtshan ma med pas mtshan ma sgro btags pa dang / mtshan nyid kyis mtshan nyid med pa sgro btags pa dang / mtshan nyid med pas mtshan nyid sgro btags pa yang dag par brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de shas cher chos thams cad la mkhas pa yongs su smin pa'i tshul la nges par 'byung zhing gong du gnas gang dag thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni chos rtogs pa bcu dang ldan pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/97—33

'di lta ste/ lus kyi las 'bras bu yod pa dang ldan pa yin/ ngag gi las 'bras bu yod pa dang ldan pa yin/ yid kyi las 'bras bu yod pa dang ldan pa yin / sems bskyed pa tsam gyis skye ba mngon par sgrub 19pa yin/ sems can gzhan dag dang / gang zag gzhan rnams kyi bsam pa shes par byed cing mos pa la rtog 2pa yin/ sems can gyi khams tha dad pa rab tu shes pa yin/'dod pa'i khams tha dad pa rab tu shes pa yin/ gzugs kyi khams tha dad pa rab tu shes pa yin/ gzugs med pa'i khams tha dad pa rab tu shes pa yin/dus ji lta ba bzhin du 'gro ba'i phyir mngon par shes pa myur ba yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la chos mngon par sgrub pa bcu yang dag par brjod par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab tu g.yo bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing byin gyis brlab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dpyad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med par 'gro ba dang / dri ba grangs med pa 4dri ba dang /yid kyi lus mngon par sgrub 5pa dang / sgra skad la sbyor ba tshad med pa dang /sems bskyed pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa yongs su 'grub pa yang dag par brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de shas cher mngon par sgrub 6pa mkhas pa la sbyor zhing / gong du gnas gang dag thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob 7pa'i phyir te/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam 97—34

par gzhag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la rgyal tshab kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la 1rgyal tshab kyi byang chub sems dpa' ni chos rtogs par bya ba bcu la mkhas pa yin te/bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can gyi skye ba rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa yin / nyon mongs pa rgyu ba rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa yin/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa yin/ spyod yul la sbyor ba rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa yin/ chos nyid rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa yin/ nye bar spyad na pa rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dbye ba rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa yin/ sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' dang / da ltar byung ba shes pa rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa 3yin/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa la 4nges par rtogs 5pa rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa yin te/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni rgyal tshab kyi byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag rgyal tshab kyi byang chub sems dpa' de la gnas bcu yang dag par brjod par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor la mkhas pa yang dag par brjod par bya'o/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor kun du spyad pa dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du 'jug pa dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du rnam par dpyad 6pa dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i dbang bskur ba dang /chos kyi rgyal po'i byin gyi rlabs 7dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i pha rol gnon pa dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung yang dag par brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de'i sems shas cher chos thams cad la sgrib pa med par bsgrub pa la 'jug cing gong du gnas gang 97—35

dag thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sgrub kyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni rgyal tshab kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni shes pa mngon par sgrub pa bcu dang ldan pa yin te1/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa rab tu g.yo bar byed pa mang ba yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa byin gyis narlob pa mang ba yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa sems gcig gis 'da' bar byed pa mang ba yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa yongs su sbyong ba dbyed pa mang ba yin/ sems can grangs med pa'i sems gcig gis rnam par rig par byed pa mang ba yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa la rnam par lta ba mang ba yin/ sems can grangs med pa'i sems kyi spyod pa la sems gcig gis rnam par dpyod pa la mkhas pa yin/sems can grangs med pa'i dbang po sems gcig gis rtogs par byed pa la mkhas pa yin/ sems can grangs med pa 'dul ba la mkhas pa yin/ sems can grangs med pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems la 'dzud pa la mkhas pa yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag rgyal tshab kyi sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' man chad gang gis kyang dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de'i lus kyi las shes par mi nus/ ngag gi las shes par mi nus/ yid kyi las shes par mi nus/ rdzu 'phrul shes par mi nus/ rdzu 'phrul 5rnam par lta ba shes par mi nus/ 'das pa'i dus la rnam par lta ba shes par mi nus shing ne97—36

mngon par 'du byed pa shes par mi nus/ blos rnam par lta ba shes par mi nus/sems kyi yul shes par mi nus/ ye shes kyi spyod yul shes par mi nus te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de 1la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gnas bcu yang dag par brjod pa 2mdzad de/bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dus gsum shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos shes pa dang / chos kyi dbyings dbyer med pa shes pa dang / chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbung rimed pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par dgang ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byed pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad byin gyis brlab pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su shes pa dang / chos thams cad mngon par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mtha' yas pa brjod pa mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni shas cher thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la sems 'jug pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gos kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa bcu bshad ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcu'i 4phyogs re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yos so / /'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun du rab tu 'gul to/ /ldeg /rab tu ldeg /kun du rab tu ldeg go/ /'ur 'ur/ rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun du 97—37

rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun du rab tu chem chem mo/ /'khrugs/ rab tu 'khrugs/ kun du rab tu 'khrugs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / chos nyid thob pas lha'i me tog gi sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha'i bdug pa'i sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha'i spos kyi sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha'i phye ma'i sprin gyi char dang /lha'i phreng ba'i sprin 1gyi char dang / lha'i gos kyi sprin gyi char dang / lha'i rin po che'i sprin gyi char dang / lha'i pad+ma'i sprin gyi char dang / lha'i rgyan phreng gi sprin gyi char dang / lha'i rgyan gyi sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha'i sil snyan rnams kyang ma dgrol bar sgra byung ngo / /lha'i snang ba yang rab tu byung ngo / /lha'i nga ro yang grag go/ /gling bzhi pa 'dir ri rab kyi rtse mor lha'i dbang po'i khang par ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang chos bstan pa 'di khyab par gyur nas byung ste lhag chad med do/ /tshig 'bru 'di dag nyid kyis don 'di nyid ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams kyi pha rol nas byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed lhags te/ phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang nas 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar khyod byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid 'di ston pa legs so legs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bdag cag kyang ming chos kyi blo gros zhes bya ba sha stag ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi sprin ces bya ba dag nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan chos kyi blo gros bzang po zhes 2bya ba sha stag gi thad nas 'dir phyin to / /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs dkyis de dag thams cad du chos bstan pa 97—38

'di byung ste/ 'khor 'di lta bu dag gi nang du tshig 'bru 'di dag gis don 'di nyid ston te/ lhag chad med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bdag cag ni khyod kyi dbang du gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir phyin to/ /bdag cag ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir phyin pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa thams cad du ri rab kyi rtse mor lha'i dbang po'i khang pa rnams su yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed phyin par gyur to// // bam po gnyis pa/1 de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor dang / chos kyi dbyings la yang rnam par bltas nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rang byung shin tu rnam dag blo mnga' ba/ /mdzes shing gzugs kyi stobs dang ldan gyur pa/ /bsnyen dka' mtshan gyis brgyan pa mthong gyur nas/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /do zla med pa'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang / /kun brjod 2bzang dang rjes su bstan pa dang / /sdug bsngal bzod 3rlag 'jig rten 'gro mthong nas/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas de bzhin gshegs / /kun du bzang po'i yon tan thos gyur nas/ /nam mkha'i dbyings 'dra 'gyur ba med pa yi/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /gnas rnams ji snyed gang dag yod gyur dang / /rang bzhin gnas pa'i jiganas rnams gzhan dag kyang / /gzhan min dngos por rnam nga/ra rtogs bya'i 5phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan 6pa sems 'jog byed/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar 97—39

dus dag na/ /dge dang mi dge'i las rnams gang yod pa/ /de dag rgyu rnams rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /ting 'dzin bsam gtan rnam thar spyod pa dang / /de bzhin snyoms 'jug rnam dag mthar thug pa/ /de dag gnas skabs rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /'jig rten brtson 'grus stobs dang dbang po rnams/ /ci 'dra ci 'dra de yi de dang 51)der/ /rim pa de dag rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /'jig rten kun gyi mos pa ci 'dra dang / /lhag pa'i bsam pa tha dad rnam gsum nas/ /bstan bcos du ma rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan (na pa sems 'jog byed/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rnam pa du ma'i khams/ /gang dag 'jig rten gsum 'dir yod kun gyi/ /khams kyi rang bzhin rtogs par bya ba'i phyir / /byang chub don du brtan pa sems de 'jog /chos 'dir kun du 'gro bar gang gyur cing / /dge ba'i 'jug pa gang yang rab 'jug pa/ /yang dag rang bzhin rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed / /zhing rnams thams cad ji ltar 'byung ba dang / /sems can ji ltar sa las 'byung 'gyur zhes/ /chags med mig ni rab tu dbye ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /'das pa'i dus dang da ltar byung dus na / /sems can ris dngos mtshan nyid gang yod dang / /sngon gyi gnas rnams rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /ji ltar 'gro bar sems can 'ching byed pa/ /kun du sbyor ba 'jig rten gang yod pa'i/ /nyon mongs zad pa rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du 97—40

brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /'jig rten gsum na tha snyad gang btags dang / /ngag lam sngags tshul spyod pa gang yod pa/ /brda yi bden pa rtogs par bya ba'i phyir / /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /chos rnams thams cad brjod du med pa ste/ /stong pa mi g.yo rang bzhin ngo bo nyid/ /don dam bden pa rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /zhing rnams dag tu sa g.yo bstan pa dang / /rgya mtsho dag kyang rnam par 'khrugs pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs kyi rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan ri1)pa sems 'jog byedad/ /'od zer rtse mo re las 'od zer rnams/ /de bzhin phyogs bcu kun du rab tu 'gyed/ /de dag 'od gcig rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /zhing mang bsam gyis mi khyab gang yod pa/ /de dag rang gi lag tu mngon sprul te/ /sgyu ma'i tshul de rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /zhing rnams ji ltar de bzhin sems can kun/ /gnod pa med par lag pa'i mthil bzhag nas/ /chos rnams srog med rtogs par bya ba'i phyir / /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /rgya mtsho rnams na caji snyed chu yod pa/ /skra rtse'i thigs 5pa'i nang du 'jug par byed/ /ma lus mthar thug rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /zhing rnams kun na phra rab rdul gyi bag /gang yod de dag ma lus bgrang byed cing / /phra rab rdul grangs rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /'jig rten 'di na 'das dang de bzhin du / /ma 'ongs sreg pa'i bskal pas 'jigs pa rnams/ /bskal pa zad pa 97—4 1

rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /dus gsum dag gi de bzhin gshegs rnams dang / /ston pa rang rgyal thos las byung rnams kyi/ /chos kyi rang bzhin rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /brjod du med pa'i 'jig rten khams kyi 91)rnams/ /skra yis bcings nas ma lus srang la 'debs/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /khor (5)yug ri bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /skra yis bcings nas ma lus srang la 'debs/ /rags dang phra ba rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /lus pa med pa'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /skad cig gcig la dbyangs kyis dgo bar byed/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag dag pa bstan pa'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /'jig rten kun gyi sgra rnams ci 'dra ba/ /skad cig gcig la skad cig rjod byed cing / /zhi ba'i rang bzhin rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /'jig rten gsum po ma lus rtogs par byed/ /sems can kun gyis rab tu rnam par shes/ /lce yangs rgya 4chen rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /zhing rnams kun du brjod dang 'dra bar yang / /skad cig gcig la lta gyur sel bar byed/ /rnam rtog chos rnams rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /'dir ni zhing rnams thams cad ma lus par/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gang zhing rang byung gi/ /chos rnams skad cig gcig la rtogs bya'i 5phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /rdul phran tha dad lta bur 'jig rten khams/ /rnam pa kun

du mngon par sprul byed cing / /yid las byung ba de dag rtogs bya'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /'das dang de bzhin ma byon sangs rgyas rnams/ /ji snyed gang dag 'jig rten bzhugs so cog /sems kyi skad cig gcig la rtogs bya'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed / /tshig gcig tsho1brjod kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /bskal pa zad kyi de la nyams pa med/ /tshig rab dbye ba rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /phyogs bcu rnams kyi 'jig rten thams cad kyi//'gro ba ci 'dra ldog pa ci 'dra ba/ /sems kyi skad cig gcig la rtogs bya'i phyir / /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /phyogs rnams kun du 'gro yang lus kyis dzon sam/ /ngag gam yid kyis gang du'ang chags pa med/ /dus gsum stong pa nyid du rtogs bya'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /byang chub sems ni ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin/ /gzhal yas bskal par phyogs su rgyu byed cing / /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchod par bya'o zhes/ /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyi bstan pa yin/ /phyogs bcu dag gi 'jig rten tha dad par / /'jig rten bdag por rgyal ba'i sras 'gyur ba/ /gang yang rung ba 4dam pa sgrog 5par byed/ /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyi bstan pa yin/ /byang chub don du srid par spyad spyod tshe/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bde sbyor gang yin pa/ / de yi 6bsngags pa rtag tu rjod 7par byed/ /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyi bstan 8pa yin/ /chos mchog chos rab phul du phyin pa dang / /khyad par 'phags chos bla med gang yod pa/ /de dag byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ston/ /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyi bstan pa yin/ /yon tan kun ldan de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /97—43

tshe 1nyid 'di na yod kyi gzhan med pa/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sbyor bar byed / /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyi bstan pa yin/ /tshad med gzhal yas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang phrad gyur ci 'dra ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' de la ston par byed/ /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyi bstan pa yin/ /ting 'dzin gang dag ji snyed yod pa dang / /de bzhin ting 'dzin rgyud kyi rnam pa dag /de dag bde gshegs sras nal rjod par byed/ /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyi bstan pa yin/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo rnam par zlog pa dang / /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba/ /'jig rten kun gyis rtag tu ma bskor ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la de bstan bya/ / shin du sdug bsngal 'jig rten thams cad dang / /dngan song sa rnams dag tu gnod gyur pa'i/ /gnas dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen gyur pa de/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bstan par bya/ /gang zhig byang chub don du sems 'jog pa/ /de ni dang po'i byang chub sems dpar 4 bstan/ /bslab pa'i gdams ngag ji bzhin nges byas pa/ /ji bzhin rnam par gzhag 5'di de yi 0yin/ /nad bral rnams kyi bstan pa ji bzhin du/ /'jig rten kun la phan pa bya ba'i phyir/ /de ltar thog ma su zhig sems bskyed pa/ /'di ni 7gnyis te dang po'i las 8can no/ /phan pa thob byed sems dang rab dang bde/ /gnyen dang sdug dang de bzhin sdud sems dang / /kun du bsrung ba'i sems dang snyoms pa'i sems/ /slob 9nodapon sems dang snyoms par ston pa'i sems/ /de 'dra dag la sems gnas gyur pa de / /lung nod kha ton byed par sbyar bar bya/ /mang du thos nas dgon par gnas su gzhug /dben par gyur nas dge bshes sten ⑩du gzhug /dge 97—44

bshes rnams la bka' (1)blo bde bar bya/ /dus tshod shes la shes bzhin ldan par bya/ /dus shes gyur nas shin tu 'jigs med bya/ /'jigs pa med nas don la brtson par bya/ /don shes gyur nas de bzhin chos brjod bya/ /chos rnams kun la rmongs gyur med par bya/ /rmongs pa med par gyur nas rgyal ba'i sras / /legs par gsungs pa'i chos la gnas napar bya/ /'di ni dang po'i las can brjod pa ste/ /byang chub zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /'di ni gdams pa 'di ni bstan pa ste/ /'di la su slob de ni sangs rgyas sras/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsum pa gang yin pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i bstan la rab tu sbyor/ /mi rtag nyid dang sdug bsngal stong nyid dang / /bdag med pa dang g.yo ba med pa dang / /de bzhin chos 'di thams cad bdag min dang / /mngon par 'du byed med dang dben pa dang / /'di dag thams cad rtog pa med yin par no/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ltar rtog par byed/ /sems can khams dang chos kyi dbyings la yang / /brtag par bya phyir de ni gzengs 4yang bstod / /'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas mu med ces/ /de ltar de ni dpyod du gzhug par bya/ /'di na sa dang chu dang de bzhin me/ /rlung dang nam mkha' ji snyed yod pa dang / /phyogs na 'dod dang gzugs dang gzugs med pa/ /de dag rnams la de ni dpyod du gzhug /rgya chen chos rnams kun dang khams rnams kyi/ /rang bzhin ma lus mthar thug brtag bya ba/ /de ni sangs rgyas sras po sbyor byed la/ /phan par bya phyir rjes su bstan pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' skye bar gang skyes pa/ /bstan la skyes shing rab tu 'byung bar byed/ /blo ldan de ni dngos med dngos po rtogs/ /dam chos gnas su skyes te legs 97—45

par skyes1/ /de ni rang gi sa las yongs mi ldog /sangs rgyas mthar thug yin par 'dzin pa skye/ /rtag tu chos la nges par sems dang ldan/ /sems can rang bzhin ci 'drar rnam par dpyod/ /las dang 'jig rten dag dang zhing rnams dang / /rnam par smin dang 'khor dang mya ngan 'das/ /rnam par dbye ba rgyal ba'i sras kyis shes/ /de thugs skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpar brjod/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'das dang byung rnams dang / /ma byon dag kyang chos rnams rnam dpyad nas/ /grub dang gang yang legs skyes mthar thug dang / /rang byung rnams kyi grub pa ci 'dra ba/ /sangs rgyas dam pa de dag thams cad ni / /dus gsum mnyam nyid rjes su zhugs pa shes/ /nam yang mnyam nyid bye brag 'byed mi byed/ /de ni dus gsum tha dad med par 'jug /gang gi phan yon rnam pa na'adi 'dra ba/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' bzhi pa ste/ /'di dag rab bsgrubs byang chub sems dpa' de/ /byang chub don du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' lnga pa ste/ /sbyor ba phun sum tshogs par brjod pa yin/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i rjes su zhugs pa ste/ /bsod nams las dag brtsams pas mthar phyin byed/ /de ltar bsod nams rab tu ci byed kyang / /'jig rten kun gyi rten du 'gyur ba dang / /phan par 'dod dang bde ba thob byed dang / /snying brtse ba dang skye dgu dgrol 'gyur byed//'jig rten gnod gyur gdul bar bya ba'i phyir/ /'dren par byed cing rab tu dang bar byed/ /sems can mang po thams cad gdul 'dod dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'i sems kyis mthu yang che/ /'jig rten thams cad mtha' ma med pa dang / /de bzhin dpag tu med cing grangs med dang / /mtshungs med bsam 97—46

yas mnyam med gzhal yas dang / /stong pa mi g.yo med pa'i rang bzhin shes/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' lnga pa ste/ /sbyor ba phun tshogs phan dang snying brtse ldan / /de la rjes su bstan pa 'di 'dra ste/ /yon tan kun dang ldan pa rnams kyis bstan1/ /de ni sems can mtha' yas thams cad dang / /chos kyi ngo bo nyid la rmongs pa med/ /shin tu blo ldan rtog bral rnam rtog med/ /'jig rten lha dang bcas pas dbyer mi phyed/ /sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /spyod pa'i bsngags dang bsngags dpa ma yin dang / /sems can chung ngam yang na che'o zhes/ /thos par gyur kyang bsam las nur ba med/ /sems can nyon mongs can nam rnam dag gam/ /gdul sla zhe 'am gdul bar dka' zhe 'am/ /chos dbyings chung zhe'am yang na rgya che zhe'amar/ /'jig par 'gyur zhe'am 'chags 6par 'gyur zhe 'am/ /chos dbyings yod ce'am med ces thos gyur kyang / /dus gsum rtogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de/ /nges par sems shing thams cad rnam dpyod de/ /sangs rgyas chos 'dir bsam pa shin du nges / /mtshan ma med dang mtshan nyid med pa dang / /dngos med rang bzhin brdzun zhing dben pa dang / /sgyu snyama'i rang bzhin mig yor 'dra ba yi/ /chos mchog zhi ba 'di 'dra nyan par byed/ /de ltar mi ldog byang chub sems dpa' ni//sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /spyod pa yod dam med ces nges par dpyod/ /'byung ngam mi 'byung zhe na'ang phyir mi ldog /de bzhin gshegs pa 'das she'am ma 'das she'am/ /ma byon ce 'am ma byon ma yin zhe'am / /byung ngam ma byung zad dam mi zad dam/ /de bzhin mtshan nyid gcig gam mtshan nyid med/ /gcig dang tha dad rnam pa mang po dang / /don 97—47

dam 1tshig 'bru dngos dang dngos med pa/ /thams cad sgro btags/ rnam pa (gegazhan nyid du/ /mi ldog byang chub sems dpa' yid ches byed/ /mtshan ma med dang mtshan ma yod pa dang / /mtshan nyid med dang mtshan gyis mtshon pa dang / /rnam par phye ba phan tshun sbyar ba rnams/ /thos nas 'di la mthar thug 'jug par byed/ /gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /'bras bu yod pa'i las rnams byed 'gyur zhing / /ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'dir ni skye ba ston/ /pha rol rnams kyi bsam pa rtog byed cing / /de dag rnams kyi mos pa spyod par byed/ /sems can spyod dang rjes su mthun chos dang / /zhing rnams 'jig dang chags pa rnams kyang shes / /ji ltar 'dod sbyin myur du mngon shes thob/ /phyogs rnams kun du yid ni 'jug par byed/ /bde gshegs bsngags pa'i chos rnams thos nas kyang / /de la de ni nur bar 'gyur ba med/ /yongs su shes dang zhing g.yo byed pa dang / /de bzhin byin gyis brlab dang rnam dpyod dang / /ji ltar skad cig grangs med 'gro 'gyur ba/ /zhing du 'gro bar bya ba brjod par bya/ /de ni dri ba grangs med 'dre 4bar byed/ /lus rnams ci 'drar yid kyi lus kyang ston/ /de la sgra skad sbyor ba 'byam klas dang / /skad cig la yang sangs rgyas grangs med brjod / /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal tshab gang yin pa/ /sems can rnams kyi 'jug pa ji bzhin shes/ /de dag nyon mongs rgyud dang bag chags dang / /spyod yul gang yin sbyor ba gang yin dang / /tha dad chos dang rgyu ba ci 'dra dang //'jig rten rnam par phye dang sngon mtha' dang / /brda yi bden dang don dam bden pa dang 55/ /ma lus rtogs par bya la mkhas pa yin/ /pho brang 'khor la 97—48

mkhas pa tshang (1'byin te/ /der yang ji ltar kun du spyad pa dang / /gnas dang de bzhin 'jug par bya ba dang / /pho brang 'khor ni ci 'dra dpyad pa dang //dam chos rgyal po'i dbang bskur ci 'dra dang / /byin gyi rlabs nadang gzhan gnon ci 'dra dang / /chos la 'jug dang bka' /lung brjod bya ste/ /'di ni rgyal tshab sa la 'jug pa yin/ /de tsam gyis na de yi mthar thug ste/ /ji skad bstan bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba med/ /tshe yi 'du byed nam zhig 'dor ba na/ /tshul ldan rgyal tshab rgyal bar mngon du phyogs/ /dbang bskur gang yin bde gshegs sras gcig ste/ /thu bo khyad 'phags mthar phyin bdag nyid can/ /skra thigs gcig gis chu tshad gzung du rung / /'dir ni bsam pa bgrang bas rtogs ma yin/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa 'di 'dra ste/ /'di na casems can la las zhing rnams kun/ /phra rab rdul du rlags munas ma lus 'grang snyo/ /grangs med 'di snyed cig ces gcod byed pa/ /de kun 'dir 7ni byang chub sems dpas shes/ /'das dang de bzhin ma byon sangs rgyas dang / /gang dag phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa dang / /rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin nyan thos kyi/ /sa bon gyur pa byang chub sems de skye/ /thog mar byang chub sems shes gang brjod pa/ /de ni ji lta'i tshul du'ang grangs 8med de/ /'jig rten khams 'di kun kyang khyab gyur na/ /de las gong du brjod du 9ci zhig yod/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs bshad pa legs par smras so/ /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming thos 97—49

pa'i sems can de dag kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nye bar gyur pa yin na/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / de bzhin nyid du sgrub 1par byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/de dag ni nges par sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi blo gros kyis smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa bzhin te/ shes rab zab mo dang ldan pa de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas dbang bskur ba yin par rig par bya'o / /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gi rna lam du 'di lta bu'i nachos 'di dag grag par gyur pa'i skyes bu dam pa de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la lung bstan par rig par bya ba yin na / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gang dag gis lag tu thob pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzigs su gsol/ bdag gis 'di lta bu'i chos 'di dag ma 'tshal bas bdag ni dmus long dang 'dra 4lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gcig pu dmus long lta bur gyur par yang 5ma bas kyi/ bcom ldan 'das sems can gang dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ma thos pa de dag thams cad kyang dmus long lta bur gyur pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / gnas brtan de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bsam gyis mi khyab 6pa nyid bshad du gsol / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu song la brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad skul cig /de bzhin 97—50

gshegs pa'i bka' yang sgrogs shig /chos kyi phyag rgya dam pa dkon mchog ta la la zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di yang 'khor der sgrogs shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' thos nas dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs 'di'i don gyi phyir yongs su skam 1pas brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba de dag la don 'di'i skabs brjod de chos nyan pa thams cad 'du bar gyis 2shig /de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs 'chad cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid kyang ston par 'gyur gyis 'du bar gyis shig /khyed da phyis 'gyod par gyur ta re/ kye grogs po dag mdo sde rin po che 'di lta bu dag 'jig rten du 'byung ba ni shin tu rnyed par dka'o/ /de nas skad cig de nyid la brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad 'dus nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/bcom ldan 'das kyi 4spyan sngar 'khod nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dkon mchog ta la la 'i gzungs bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar gyur pas gnang ba mdzad do/ /brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis lan gnyis lan gsum du gsol ba btab na yang bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dkon mchog ta la la zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pas bshad du gsol / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe zhal nas ljags kyi dbang po phyung ste / rigs kyi bu gang la la dag dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs 'di'i don gyi 97—51
