sangs rgyas sras rnams yongs su bskul ba'i phyir/ /dbyangs dang ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /'jig rten gsum na sgra rgyud ji snyed pa/ /kun kyang de bzhin gshegs nga/'i gsung du thos/ /gsang bstod sgra yis drang srong che bstod de / /rgyal ba'i gsung sgra don du sil 1snyan dang / /sgra chen dril bu sbyin rnams 'gro kun la/ /rab tu bsgrags pas dbyangs ldan 'od grub bo/ /'chi med sbyin pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /bag med spyod pa thams cad rab spangs te/ /yon tan kun la brtson pa nyams su len/ /'dus byas rtag tu bde ba med pa ste/ /sdug bsngal 'tshe ba du mas yongs su gang / /'gog pa rtag tu bde zhing zhi skyid ces/ /brjod pas 'chi med sbyin pa de thob bo/ /khyad par ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi tshul khrims khyad par dang / /ting 'dzin khyad par shes rab khyad par thos/ /thub chen 2rgyal po'i 3khrims kyis mchog gyur cing / /ting 'dzin mchog dang shes rab mchog gyur ces/ /byang chub don du bstod cing bsngags brjod pas/ /des na khyad par ldan pa'i 'od grub bo/ /rin chen bkod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /rin chen mi zad gter rnams thob gyur nas/ /drang srong che la rin chen dam pas mchod/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten rin chen phul/ /4skye bo nyon mongs rin chen rnams kyis bsdus/ /rgyal ba rnams la rin chen rab phul bas/ /rin chen bkod pa'i 'od zer grub par 'gyur/ /spos rab snang ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /mi la med spos yid 97—102

'ong tshor gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams la nges par 'gyur/ /mi dang lha yi spos dang byug pa yis/ /mi yi gtso la mchod pa rab byas te/ /spos las rgyal ba'i gzugs dang mchod rten dag /byas pas spos rab snang ba de grub bo / /sna tshogs bkod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs mchog sna tshogs dang / /sil snyan bsgrags shing spos kyis bdugs 1pa yis / /pho brang dam pa mdzes byas me tog bkram/ /sil snyan dag gis rgyal ba rnams bsu (5)zhing / /me tog byug pa bdug spos phye ma dang / /rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs mchog rnams kyis mchod/ /des na sna tshogs bkod pa grub par gyur / /shin tu dang byed 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sa rnams lag 'thil nabazhin du gnas par byed/ /mchod rten drang srong gnas rnams sbyangs byas pas / /des na shin tu dang ba'i 'od grub bo/ /sprin dang ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /spos kyi char 'bebs sprin rnams kun tu gnas/ /mchod rten 'khor sar spos kyi chus btab pas/ /sprin dang ldan pa'i 'od de rab tu thob / /lhab lhub bkod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /gcer bu gos yod rgyan dang ldan par 'gyur/ /gos dang bgo ba rgyan phreng 5sna tshogs dag /sbyin pa byas pas lhab lhub bkod pa grub/ /ro mchog ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /bkres pa kha zas ro mchog thob par 'gyur/ /zas dang skom dang ro mchog sna tshogs rnams/ /byin pas ro mchog ldan pa'i 'od grub bo/ /nor rnams ston pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /dbul po dag gis rin chen gter rnams 'thob6/ /dkon mchog gsum la gter gzhi mi zad pa/ /dbul ba byas pas nor ston 'od thob bo/ /mig rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab 97—10 3

gtong —1zhing / /de tshe long bas sna tshogs gzugs rnams mthong / /rgyal ba dag dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /mar me phul bas mig sbyong 'od zer grub/ /rna ba rnam sbyong 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /rna ba nyams pas sgra mang thos par 'gyur / /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /sil snyan phul bas rna sbyong 'od zer grub/ /sna rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sngon chad ma tshor dri zhim tshor bar 'gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la(gyi/ /spos rab phul bas sna sbyong 'od zer grub/ /lce rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sgra snyan yid 'ong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bstod/ /mi snyan brlang bar smra ba rnam spangs te/ /'jam par smras pas lce sbyong 'od zer grub/ /lus rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /dbang po nyams pa dbang po ldan par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /lus btud byas pas lus rnam sbyong ba thob/ /sems rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /smyos pa thams cad sems dang ldan par 'gyur / /ting 'dzin dbang rjes sems 'gro byas pas na/ /sems rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer de grub bo/ /gzugs rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /mi dbang rnams kyi ri bsam yas sku mthong ste/ /sku gzugs ri mo sna tshogs mang po dang / /mchod rten brgyan byas gzugs sbyong 'od grub bo/ /sgra rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong 5zhing / /sgra ni sgra mi stong par rab tu shes/ /rkyen las byung bas brag ca phyi 'dra'o zhes / /sgra rnams bstan pas 'od zer de grub bo/ /dri rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /dri nga thams cad dri zhim mchog tu 'gyur/ /spos rab mchog chus rgyal ba'i mchod rten dag /khrus byas byang chub zhing gi 'od de yin/ /97—104

ro bro sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /dug can dug med ro yi 1skumachog tu 'gyur / /sangs rgyas nyan thos bcas dang pha ma la/ /ro mchog thams cad phul ba'i 'od de yin/ /reg rnam sbyong ponaraba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /reg na rtsub pa 'jam zhing bde bar 'gyur/ /mdung thung rtse gsum ral gri mda' chen char/ /phreng ba 'jam pa pad+ma ut+pal 'gyur/ /bcos bu'i ras mang 'jam zhing reg bde rnams/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gshegs shul bting bkram ste/ /me tog byug pa (4༄na bza' 'jam rnams dang / /phreng ba bla re phul ba'i 'od de yin / /chos rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /'jig rten phan mdzad rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /spu rnams kun nas chos rnams bsam mi khyab/ /byung ba thos nas mos pa thams cad tshim/ /rkyen las byung ba ma skyes ngo bo nyid / /rgyal ba rnams kyi sku ni chos sku ste/ /chos nyid mkha' bzhin rtag tu gnas so zhes/ /brjod pas chos rnams sbyong ba thob par 'gyur5/ /'od zer sgo mo de dag la sogs pa/ /drang srong rnams kyi spu yi sgo gcig nas/ /'od zer gang gā'i bye ma snyed 'byung 6ste/ /kun kyang las sbyor tha dad tshul can no/ /ji ltar de dag spu yi sgo gcig nas/ /'od zer gang gā'i 7bye ma snyed 'byung ba/ /ma lus spu rnams kun nas de bzhin te/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra'on / /yon tan gang gis 9'od zer gang grub pa'i/ /yon tan de grogs sngon chad gang gyur pa/ /de dag nyid las 'od zer rab 'byung 7ste/ /drang srong ye shes rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra'o11/ /de dag bsod nams sngon grogs gang yin la/ /rjes su yi 12rang gsol ba sus btab dang / /gang gis mthong ste dge ba bsags gyur pa/ /de dag kun gyis 'od zer de dag shes/ /gang dag 97—105

bsod nams byas shing dge bsags dang / /gang dag yang yang sangs rgyas rnams mchod cing / /sangs rgyas yon tan 'dun te don gnyer ba/ /de dag kun la 'od zer de dag bskul/ /dper na dmus long nyi ma mi mthong yang / /de med ma yin 'jig rten dag tu 'char/ /mig dang ldan pas shar bar shes gyur nas/ /kun kyang rang rang so so'i las la 'jug /de bzhin skyes chen 'od zer de dag kun/ /rab tu 'byung yang log pas nyen gyur cing / /mos nyams phal pa rnams kyis mi mthong ste/ / blo gros yangs tsho1pa rnams la de dag med / /dper rgyan 2nor bu bzhon dpa gzhal med khang / /bcud kyis len dang rin chen byug pa spos/ /de dag skye bo che la yod mod kyiri ri/ /phongs par gyur pa rnams la de dag med/ /de bzhin skyes chen 'od zer de dag modapar/ /de dag yod kyang log pas nyen gyur cing / /mos pa nyams pa rnams kyis mi mthong ste/ /blo gros yangs pa rnams la de dag mod/ /gang dag 'od zer dbye neb 'di thos nas/ /dad cing mos la dang ba 7skyes gyur na/ /bdag ni yon tan cher 'gyur mi 'gyur zhes/ /de dag dogs dang som nyi mi skyed do/ /de dag g.yog 'khor bkod pa rnam 'phrul ba/ /ting 'dzin dam pa mngon par grub byed cing / /phyogs bcu kun du do zla med rnams kyi/ /zham ring sangs rgyas sras rnams ston par byed/ /'od bkod de dag pad+ma sna tshogs pa/ /stong gsum tshad tsam byin gyis brlabs byas nas/ / skyil krung 8bcas pa'i lus kyis kun khyab ston/ /ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul 9pa 'di 'dra'o/ /de dag zhing bcu'i rdul snyed pad+ma gzhan/ /'khor dang bcas pa byin gyis brlabs byas shing / /sangs rgyas sras kyis thams cad yongs su bskor/ /de dag ting 97—106

'dzin ting 'dzin med par gnas/ /drang srong de yis sems can gang dag rnams / /yongs su smin byas sangs rgyas legs bsgrubs pa/ /de dag pad+ma chen po de bskor cing / /kun kyang thal mo sbyar nas lta zhing 'khod/ /gang dag ting 'dzin gnas par rab zhugs pa/ /skyes chen rnams kyi /1chos nyid 'di yin te/ /rang gi slob mas kun kyang yongs bskor nas/ /skar ma'i tshogs kyis zla ba bskor ba bzhin/ /de dag ji ltar phyogs gcig rab 'jug cing / / zhabs 'bring (misangs rgyas sras rnams ston byed pa/ /de bzhin phyogs rnams ma lus kun du ston/ /ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa 'di 'dra'o/ /de dag phyogs kyi dra ba khyab gnas pa'i/ /ting 'dzin dam pa mngon par sgrub byed cing / /kha cig snyemanyam gzhag 4kha cig ldang bar yang / /phyogs bcu kun du rang gi lus ston to/ /de dag shar gyi phyogs su mnyam bzhag 5cing / /nub kyi phyogs nas dpa' bo rnam par ldang / /nub kyi phyogs su mnyam par bzhag gyur cing 6/ /bdag nyid chen po shar gyi phyogs nas ldang / /de bzhin phyogs bcu rnams su rab tu 'jug /gzhan gyi phyogs su mnyam par bzhag gyur la/ /ye shes yon tan phyug po gzhan nas ldang / /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra'o/ /shar phyogs sangs rgyas zhing rnams gang yin pa/ /grangs med ma lus dag na rang byung ba/ /de dag spyan sngar zhabs drung de dag rnams/ /zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas par snang / /phyogs der mnyam par bzhag 7par bstan byas nas / /dpa' bo nub kyi zhing rnams ma lus par/ /rnam par ldang zhing mngon sum rgyal kun la/ /mchod pa du ma rab tu byed par snang / /nub phyogs sangs rgyas zhing rnams gang yin pa/ /grangs med ma lus dag na bzhugs sangs rgyas/ /97—107

de dag spyan sngar zhabs drung de dag rnams/ /zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas par snang / /phyogs der mnyam par bzhag par bstan byas nas/ /dpa' bo shar gyi zhing rnams ma lus par/ /rnam par ldang zhing mngon sum rgyal kun la/ /mchod pa du ma rab tu byed par snang / /de bzhin phyogs bcu dag gi zhing rnams su / /phyogs rnams ma lus kun du brtan pa 'jug /kha cig mnyam gzhag (1)kha cig langs gyur cing / /'jig rten sgron ma rnams la mchod byed snang / /de dag mig gi lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /gzugs kyi lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gzugs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab ston pa na/ /de la lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs par 'gyur/ /gzugs kyi lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur la/ /mig 2ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /mig gi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag rna ba'i lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /sgra yi lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gang la lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs 'gyur ba/ /sgra dang skad rnams kun la rab tu zhugs/ /sgra yi lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /rna ba ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /rna ba'i lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag sna yi lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /dri yi lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs 'gyur ba/ /dri mchog dam pa 'jug par rab tu zhugs/ /dri yi lam la mnyam par bzhag sa gyur cing //sna ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /sna yi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag lce yi lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /ro mchog kun gyi lam nas rnam par ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jig 97—108

rten rmongs 'gyur ba/ /bdag nyid chen po ro mchog rnams dang ldan/ /ro mchog rnams la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /lce ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te / /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /lce yi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag lus kyi lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /reg 1pa'i lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs 'gyur ba/ /'jig rten bde ba skyed pa'i reg la zhugs/ /reg pa'i lam la mnyam par bzhag (2gyur cing / /lus ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /lus kyi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag sems kyi lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /chos kyi lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs 'gyur ba/ /chos la gnas pa'i 'jug pa (gurab tu zhugs/ /chos lam rnams la mnyam par bzhag rgya gyur cing / /sems ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /sems kyi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag gyis pa'i lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /lang tsho shugs la gnas pa rnams las ldang / /lang tsho shugs gnas rnams la mnyam bzhag cing / /rgas shing 'khogs pa'i lus las rnam par ldang / /rgas shing 'khogs pa'i lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /dad pa'i dge bsnyen 5)ma yi lus las 6ldang / /dge bsnyen dad ma'i lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /dad pa'i dge bsnyen lus las rnam par ldang / /dad pa'i dge bsnyen lus la mnyam bzhag 7cing / /dge slong ma yi lus las rnam par ldang / /dge slong ma yi 8lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /dge slong mang du thos pa'i lus smyolas ldang / /dge slong mang thos lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /slob dang mi slob 97—109

lus las rnam par ldang / /slob dang mi slob lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /rkyen gyi sangs rgyas lus las rnam par ldang / /rkyen gyi sangs rgyas lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /sangs rgyas sku mchog rab las rnam par ldang / /sangs rgyas sku mchog rab la mnyam bzhag cing / /lha yi lus gzugs las ni rnam par ldang / /lha yi lus gzugs la ni mnyam bzhag cing / /rdzu 'phrul chen po klu yi lus las ldang / /rdzu 'phrul klu yi 1lus la mnyam bzhag nacing / /'phrul chen gnod sbyin lus las rnam par ldang / /'phrul chen gnod sbyin lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /'byung po kun gyi lus las rnam par ldang / /'byung po kun gyi lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /spu yi sgo gcig nas ni rnam par ldang / /spu sgo gcig la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /spu sgo thams cad nas ni rnam par ldang / /spu sgo kun la mnyam par bzhag 3gyur cing / /skra rtse gcig gi khyon las rnam par ldang / /skra rtse gcig gi khyon la mnyam bzhag cing / /skra rtse kun gyi khyon las rnam par ldang / /skra rtse kun gyi khyon la mnyam bzhag cing / /phra rab rdul gyi rdul las de dag ldang / /rdul gcig la ni mnyam par bzhag 4gyur cing / /ma lus rdul rnams kun las rnam par ldang / /rdul rnams ma lus kun la mnyam bzhag cing / /rgya mtsho'i rdo rje'i gzhi las rnam par ldang / /rgya mtsho'i rdo rje'i gzhi la mnyam bzhag cing / /nor bu'i shing tog 5dag las rnam par ldang / /shing tog rnams la mnyam 6par bzhag 7gyur nas/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi 'od zer sgo nas ldang / /rgyal ba'i 'od zer sgo la mnyam bzhag cing / /rgya mtsho'i chu yi chu klung rnams las ldang / /rgya mtsho'i chu klung rnams la mnyam bzhag cing / /bdag nyid chen po me yi lam nas ldang / /me yi lam la mnyam par bzhag 8gyur 97—110

cing / /rlung gi lam las dran ldan rnam par ldang / /rlung gi lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /bdag nyid chen po sa yi gzhi las ldang / /sa yi gzhi la mnyam par bzhag 1 gyur cing / /lha kun gzhal med khang las rnam par ldang //lha kun gzhal med khang la mnyam bzhag cing / /dran ldan de dag mkha' las rnam par ldang / /yon tan bsam yas bsags pa de dag gi/ /ting 'dzin rnam thar de dag bsam mi khyab/ /rgyal ba kun gyis bskal pa bsam yas su/ /bshad pa mdzad kyang zad par mdzad mi spyod/ /'gro las rnam smin bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /rgyal ba kun gyis de dag gsungs pa ni/ /klu yi rnam 'phrul sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul dang / /bsam byed bsam gtan rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /de dag la yang dpe bstan brjod par bya/ /de dag 'dra ba'i dpe zla cang med de / /mkhas shing rig pa'i skye bo dpe rnams kyis/ /bstan na myur du don rnams shes par 'gyur/ /rnam thar brgyad kyi dbang la gnas pa yi/ /nyan thos gcig tu gyur nas mang por 'gyur/ /mang por gyur nas phyir yang gcig gyur te/ /mkha' la bsam gtan 'cha' rinazhing 'bar bar byed/ /smad nas me 'bar stod nas chu yi rgyun/ /stod nas me 'bar smad nas chu yi rgyun/ /'gro dang 'greng dang nyal dang 'dug pa dang / /lus 'phrul skad cig gcig la bsam mi khyab/ /de ni snying rje che dang mi ldan zhing / /byang chub mi tshol 'jig rten yal 'dor yang / /lus kyi rnam 'phrul bsam yas ston byed na/ /'jig rten phan 'dod ci phyir ston mi byed/ /nyi zla mkha' la rnam par rgyu 'dong zhing / /phyogs rnams kun gyi chu yi dngo nadag dang / /mtsho mtshe'u mtsho bran snod dang rin chen dang / /rgya mtsho chu klung rnams su gzugs brnyan ston/ /de bzhin 97—111

gzugs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /skyes bu dpa' bo phyogs bcu kun du ston / /ting 'dzin rnam thar kun gyi tshul la mkhas/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa rang byung dbang / /dang ba'i mtsho la yan lag bzhi pa'i dmag /de dag so so rang gi gzugs brnyan mthong / /ral gri mda' chen gzhu dang mda' rnams dang / /go gyon bzhin 1dang theg par bcas su mthong / /gang gi gzugs gang gnas gang cha byad gang / /de dang de dag de ltar chu las mthong 'on kyang chu nal byams sdang rnam rtog med/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra'o / /rgya mtsho'i lha mo sgra ldan zhes bya ba/ /sems can rgya mtshor ji snyed skyes rnams kyi/ /sgra yi yan lag dbyangs kyi tshul mkhas te/ /rang gi skad kyis (miskad kun tshim par byed/ /sgra ldan chags sdang gti mug can de yang / /skad rnams kun gyi sgra yi tshul mkhas na/ /gzungs dang chos kyi 4)stobs la dbang thob rnams/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten ci phyir mgu mi byed/ /tum bu ru yi (gechung ma dbyangs ldan ma/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo yid las byung ba de/ /bden dang dam bcas mi 'tshe 6dga' rnams kyi/ /sems dang yid dang kha yi sgor 'jug ste / /dbyangs ldan chags can zhe sdang can de yang / /brtul zhugs grub ri rimathun 8dbyangs kyi yan lag gi9/ /yid 'ong skad kyis 'jig rten mgu byed na//ye shes yon tan phyug rnams 7cis mi byed/ /rig 11sngags tshul mkhas sgyu ma'i mkhan po ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs mang mtha' yas ston par byed/ /nyin mtshan yud dang zla ba lo brgya dang / /khyim bzang rgyas pa shin tu mdzes pa ston/ /'dod chags sdang ldan sgyu ma'i mkhan po yang / /sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyis 'jig rten mgu byed na/ /bsam gtan mngon shes rnam thar rab bslabs lha pa/ /spyod 97—112

tshul mkhas rnams ci phyir mgu mi byed/ /lha dang lha min dbang po 'thab pa'i tshe//rgyal ldan lha yis lha min pham byas na/ /de dag 'jigs pas gdugs 1bcas bzhin bcas shing / /theg bcas dmag bcas go gyon bzhin du 'byer/ /'dod chags sdang ldan lha dbang de dag kyang / /lus kyi rnam 'phrul bsam yas ston byed na/ /dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul dbang gnas dpa' bo rnams/ /lus kyi rnam 'phrul ci phyir ston mi byed/ /rdo rje 'chang ba'i glang po sa srung bu/ /dbang po'i 'khor gyur rdzu gu'aphrul chen po de/ /mgo bo sum cu dartsa gsum mngon sprul cing / /mgo rnams kun la'ang mche ba drug drug ste/ /mche ba de dag so so re re la'ang / /rdzing bu chus gang bdun bdun sprul pa byed/ /rdzing re la yang 4pad+ma sna tshogs pa/ /rnam par bkod pa bdun bdun sprul pa byed/ /pad+ma re re'ang lha yi bu mo dag /sgyu 5rtsal kun shes bdun bdun sprul pa byed/ /de dag rtsed mo glu gar tshul la mkhas/ /sum cu 6 rtsa gsum dbang po de dang rtse/ /glang po de yang lus ni bsgyur byas te/ /lha rnams kun dang 'grogs shing 'dre bar byed/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang longs spyod kun kyang mthun / /glang po mchog gi rnam 'phrul de ltar snang / /glang po chags sdang gti mug ldan de yang / /'di 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul rab tu ston byed na/ /shes rab thabs kyi stobs la sbyangs pa rnams/ /ting 'dzin brgya yis rnam 'phrul cis mi byed/ /sgra gcan ji ltar 'dod bzhin lus 'phrul te/ /rdo rje'i gzhi la rkang pa 'jog byed cing / /rgya mtsho lte bar phyin pa tsam du ston/ /ri rab rtse dang nyid kyi mgo yang snyoms / /sgra gcan chags sdang gti mug ldan de yang / /'di 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul rab tu ston byed na/ /'jig rten sgron ma bdud rnams rab 'joms pa/ /rdzu 'phrul mtha' 97—113

yas ci phyir ston mi byed/ /brgya byin rnam 'phrul bsam yas rab snang ste/ /lha dang lha min dbang po g.yul 'gyed tshe/ /lha min bye ba (1 'phyes pa ji snyed pa/ /de snyed brgya byin rang gi lus las sprul/ /lha min dbang dang lha min phal kun gyis / /brgya byin rang rang mdun na na 'dug par shes/ /de ni rdo rje 'chang bas bzung ngo zhes/ /lha min dbang po kun kyang mgo myos gyur/ /'jigs par byed pa'i mig stong rab bstan te/ /rdo rje me lce 'bar ba thogs byed cing / /lus la go bgos gzi brjid bsnyen dka' dba'i/ /brgya byin mthong nas (4lha min dbang po 'byer/ /de yang bsod nams phal pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /lha rgyal don du rnam par 'phrul byed na/ /'gro ba ma lus kun gyi skyabs gyur pa/ /bsod nams mi zad rnams lta cis mi 'phrul/ /lha la skul ma 'debs pa'i lha yi rnga / /lha las rnam par smin pas grub gyur pa/ /lha rnams bag med gnas par shes gyur nas/ /rnga de nam mkha' las ni sgra sgrogs te/ /'dod pa thams cad mi rtag ther zug min/ /tha shal mi brtan dbu ba'i 55)ngo bo nyid/ /sgyu ma smig (nerargyu chu zla mtshungs shing 'dra/ /srid pa thams cad rmi lam sprin dang mtshungs/ /bag med thams cad dgrar bcas mya ngan can/ ri /'chi ba'i lam yin mi 'chi lam ma yin/ /ji snyed su dag bag med gnas gyur pa/ /de dag 'chi bdag chu srin chen pos zin/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba yongs 'dzin thams cad yin/ /skye ba thams cad 'phags pa rnams kyis smad/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnams kyi yul la 7rmongs / /chos kyi stobs la rtag dga' gyis zhes 8bskul/ /rnga des bskul nas brgya byin lha rnams dang / /lha yi 'dun sa chos bzang 'dug nas su/ /gtam gang zhi zhing 'dod chags bral mthun 9pa/ /chos kyi gtam de lha rnams kun la 97—114

brjod / /rnga de gzugs med bstan du mi rung yang / /de ltar rnga sgras don chen rab byed na/ /bsam pa ji bzhin gzugs ni yongs ston rnams/ /'gro ba kun gyi don chen cis mi byed/ /lha dang lha min dbang po g.yul 'gyed tshe/ /lha yi bsod nams khyad par mthu stobs kyis/ /lha la skul ma 'debs pa'i rnga yi sgra 1) / /lha rnams ma 'jigs shig ces sgra 'byin te/ /rnga yis bskul nas lha rnams rab dga' zhing / /skrag pa med de stobs kyang skyes par gyuran/ /lha min dbang po skrag pas nyen pa rnams/ /'jigs nas dmag bcas de yi mod la 'byer/ /de ltar sgra skad 'byin pa'i rnga 'dra ba/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen po/ /nyon mongs bdud bcom snying rje che ldan rnams/ /zhi ba'i sgra bsgrags nyon mongs sel bar byed/ /dbang po'i lha yi bu mo dgu bcu gnyis / /dbang po'i sprul pas kun kyang dga' bar 'gyur/ /gcig kyang bdag dang brgya byin rtse bar shes/ /gcig ltar lha mo kun 4kyang de bzhin no/ /lha mo kun dang dga' bar gnas snang yang / /chos bzang 'dun sa na yang de bzhin 'dug /lha rnams kun la chos rab ston snang zhing / /brgya byin skad cig gcig la rnam par 'phrul/ /brgya byin chags sdang gti mug ldan pa yang /sprul pas rang gi 'khor rnams dga' byed na/ /'gro don mi skyo sbyor rnams ci yi phyir/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 5'jig rten mgu mi byed/ /bdud kyi dkrugs ma 'gro ba'i dbang sgyur ba/ /de yi dbang du sems can 'di kun 'dong / /las dang nyon mongs kun du zhugs pa yis/ /so so'i skye bo thams cad bdud des bcings/ /chags sdang gti mug ldan pa'i bdud de yang / /'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'gyur byed na/ /dbang bcu dbang thob rnams lta ( ci smos 97—115

te / /'gro ba thams cad rang gi phyogs mi 'jog /stong gsum gnas kyi bdag po tshangs pa yang / /stong gsum tshangs gnas ji snyed yod pa na/ /de dag kun na 'dug par rab snang zhing / /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs shin tu yid 'ong sgrogs/ /tshangs de 'jig rten pa yi tshangs lam gyi/ /bsam gtan mngon shes rnam par 'phrul byed na/ /'jig rten rab 'das bla na med pa yi/ /bsam gtan rnam thar gnas pa cis mi 'phrul/ /dbang phyug chen po'i shes pa'i rnam 'phrul ltos/ /rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis char thigs rab bkye ba/ /skad cig gcig la thams cad 'grang 1ba 2byed/ /thigs 'ga'i zer kyang ma shes de med na / /bslab pa bskal pa bsam yas rab bslabs te/ /byang chub bla med ye shes thob pa rnams/ /ci phyir skad cig gcig la sems kyis ni/ /'gro ba ma lus kun gyi sems mi shes/ /sems can las smin bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /'jig rten 'di kun rlung las yongs su byung / /rgya mtsho ri dang lha yi gzhal med khang / /rin chen rnam phye sa bon bkram pa'ang byung / /rlung las sprin byung char pa'ang kun du 'bab/ /rlung gis sprin kyang rab tu zhi bar byed/ /'jig rten lo tog 'phel ba'ang rlung byed de/ /rlung ni 'gro ba kun la phan pa skyed/ /rlung de pha rol phyin la ma bslabs shing / /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams la ma bslabs kyang / /'jig rten rnam smin bsam yas ston ri byed na/ /dam pa thob rnams ci phyir ston mi byed/ /rgya mtsho'i 'brug sgra'i sprin gyi chu tshogs ni/ /bya skad ri dgas skad dang skyes pa dang / /bud med bu mo khye'u skad ci 55snyed pa/ /kun gyi sgra snyan sems can rnams la sgrogs/ /de ltar sgra snyan rang bzhin med 6shes nas/ /sgrib pa med pa'i spobs dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /'gro ba kun la sgra 97—116

snyan brjod byas nas/ /yid 'ong sgra yis 'jig rten mgu bar byed/ /rgya mtsho 'di la ngo mtshar rmad 1)kyi chos/ /'gro kun rgya dang mtshungs pas rgya mtsho ste/ /chu dang 'byung po rin chen yong mi zad/ /chu rnams bzung bas ngoms par 'gyur ba med/ /de bzhin de dag 'gro kun rgya 'dra ste/ /bsod nams bsam gtan rnam par thar rnams dang / /shes rab ye shes yon tan kun mi zad/ /bsod nams yon tan sogs pas ngoms pa med/ /rgya ma31re klu ni rnam par rtse ba na/ /sa yi gzhi nas dbang sgyur naganas kyi bar/ /gling bzhi bcas par sprin chen rgyas 'gengs te/ /de dag kun kyang sna tshogs bkod pa mang / de ni dbang sgyur (4༄gnas su 'dzam gling gi/ /gser gyi mdog gi sprin rnams rnam par sgrub/ /'phrul dgar mu tig dmar po'i mdog lta bu/ /dga' ldan gnas su kha ba ba mo'i mdog /'thab bral gnas su mthon mthing rabe+e ḍūr+ya / /sum cu 97)rtsa gsum rdo yi snying po 'dra/ /skyong ba'i gnas su shel gyi namadog lta bu / /rgya mtshor rdo rje mi phyed mkhregs 'dra ba/ /mi ci gnas su spos mchog 'khrigs lta bu/ /klu yi gnas su pad+ma'i mdog 'dra ba/ /gsang ba'i gnas su dad pa bya 49)gar mdog /lha min gnas su ri brag mdog 'dra ba/ /byang du gser gyi 'od zer mdog ston te/ /gling rnams gzhan du sna tshogs bkod pa ston / /'dzam bu'i gling du ri sngon 'dra ba ste/ /gang na ci mtho sprin rnams de bzhin no/ /dbang sgyur gnas su gser sprin nges 7bstan nas/ /nyi ma'i mdog 'dra glog 11kyang rab tu 'gyed/ /'phrul dga'i 12gnas su zla 'od bzang 'dra dang 1ni/ /dga' ldan gnas su 'dzam bu'i gser mdog 'dra/ /'thab bral gnas su kha ba ba mo'i mdog /sum cu 7rtsa gsum gser gyi 'od zer 'dra/ /97—117

skyong 1ba'i gnas su dpal gyi snying po'i mdog /rgya mtshor mu tig dmar po'i mdo na'adra bkod/ /mi ci riganas su mthon mthing bai ḍūr+ya74ri/ /klu yi gnas su dpal gyi snying po'i mdog /gsang ba'i gnas su shel gyi mdog 'dra ba/ /lha min gnas su rdo yi snying po 'dra/ /byang du nor bu skar mdog kha dog 'dra/ /gling gzhan rnams su'ang bkod pa gzhan dang gzhan/ /'dzam bu'i gling du zla ba'i nor bu 'bar/ /sprin gyi mtshan nyid mthun (5)pa'i glog kyang 'gyed/ /de ni dbang sgyur gnas su tshangs sgra sgrogs/ /'phrul dga'i 6ciganas su rnga sgra sgrog 7ripar byed/ /dga' ldan gnas su sil snyan rol mo'i sgra/ /'thab bral gnas su lha yi bu mo'i sgra/ /sum cu nagasum du mi ci mang po'i skad/ /skyong ba'i gnas su dri za'i skad du ste/ /rgya mtshor ri 'thab sgra skad 'dra ba'o/ /mi ci 9riganas su gling bu ku nal sgra / /klu yi gnas su ka la ping ga'i sgra/ /gsang ba'i gnas su klu yi bu mo'i sgra/ /lha min gnas su lha yi rdza rnga'i sgra/ / mi yi nyu1gnas su rgya mtsho 1 gling bu'i sgra/ /de ni dbang sgyur gnas su lha spos zhim/ /me tog sna tshogs bkod pa'i char yang 'bebs/ /'phrul dgar zla ba zla bzangs 'dra ba yi / /me tog man dār 15phreng dang byug pa 'bebs/ /dga' ldan gnas su nor bu chen po'i mdog /rgyan gyi dam pa rin chen sna tshogs dang / /gtsug gi nor bu zla ba 'dra ba dang / /gser mdog 'dra ba'i dar la'i char yang 'bebs/ /rgyal mtshan gdugs dang ba dan sna tshogs dang / /phreng ba rnams dang rgyan dang byug pa dang / /mu tig dmar dang gser dang dar la dang / /sil snyan yid rā'ong 'thab bral gnas su 'bebs/ /sum cu skagasum du yid bzhin lanor bu mchog /skyong ba'i gnas su tsan+dan snying po'i mchog /gur gum sil ma lha shing 97—118

ta ma la/ /spos chu'i rgyun dang me tog rab tu 'bebs/ /skyong ba'i gnas su klu yi dbang po de/ /nyam 1stobs skye ba'i kha zas skom gyi rnams/ /kha dog dri zhim ro dang ldan pa dang / /de min rin chen bsam yas char yang 'bebs/ /de ni rgya mtsho chen por rgyun du yang / /char rgyun mi 'chad gnya' shing tsam dag dang / /rnam rgyal chen po mdzod rnams mi zad pa/ / rin chen bkod pa mtha' yas char yang 'bebs/ /dmi ci rmo gnas su rgyan phreng sna tshogs dang / /pad+ma ut+pal ras dang rin chen dang / /me tog bar sha ma li phye ma 4spos/ /pi bang gling bu sgra snyan rdza rnga 'bebs/ /klu yi gnas su mu tig dmar po ste/ /gsang bar nor bu rin chen skar mdog 'dra/ /lha min gnas su ral gri mda' chen dang / /dgrar 5'dul gzhu dang ste'u ku'i char pa 'bebs/ /byang du de ni rgyal phreng rin chen dang / /me tog bar sha ma li tsam pa'i phreng / /ku ran gtsang dang a ti mug ta 'bebs/ /gling gzhan rnams su'ang sna tshogs char pa 'bebs/ /'dzam bu'i gling du chu gsal dang ba yi/ /char rnams chos bzhin phra ba'i rgyun du 'bebs / /me tog 'bras bu sman dang spos dang shing / /lo tog bde byed 'jig rten rnams su skyed/ /de ltar sprin bkod bsam gyis mi khyab dang / /glog 'byin 'brug 7sgrogs bkod pa'i char 'bebs kyang / /gnas nas mi g.yo rnam par rtog pa med/ /klu yi rnam 'phrul de ltar bsam mi khyab/ /rgya mtsho'i chu na gnas pa de ltar yang / /klu yi rnam 'phrul bsam yas ston byed na/ /chos kyi rgya mtshor zhugs pa'i yon tan phyug /rnam 'phrul bsam yas ci phyir ston mi byed / /bag tsam smos pa'i dpe tshul 'di dag gis/ /skyes chen de dag rnams kyi brjod pa byas/ /dpa' bo de dag dpe rnams kun dang bral/ /de dag de 97—119

'dra'i rnam thar dbang bsgyur 1)ro/ /blo gros dam pa blo gros rgya chen ldan/ /ma nor blo gros mtha' yas blo gros can/ /ye shes mchog ldan khyad par blo can gyi/ /rnam thar mchog rnams 'di lta rnams kyis bshad/ /rnam thar dam pa 'di dag sus thos nas/ /yid ches 'dzin cing 'jig rten sgrog byed pa/ /de dag ngo mtshar rmad byung chos ldan te/ /de dag dga' byed mi yi 'jig rten na/ /'di 'dra'i chos 'dir gang dag dad gyur pa/ /sems can so so'i skye bo'i tshogs na dkon / /gang dag dge bsags bsod nams byas gyur pa/ /de dag rgyu yi 5)stobs kyis 'di la dad / /gang dag nyan thos theg pa'ang yid ches pa'i mi dag mi yi 'jig rten rnams na nyung / /de bas rkyen gyi theg par la/rab tu nyung / /theg pa chen por de dag de bas nyung / /theg pa che la zhugs pa de dkon te/ /gang dag chos 'dir dad pa'ang rab dkon na/ /'jug cing 55'dzin pa smos kyang ci dgos te/ /gang dag de bzhin sgrub 6pa smos ci dgos/ /gang dag stong gsum ri dang rgya mtshor bcas / /phyi ma'i bskal par mgo bos 'deg byed kyang / /chos 'dir dad pa'i bya dka' ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra 8de ni de la yod ma yin/ /la las stong gsum rdul snyed sems can la/ /bde ba kun gyis bskal par bsnyen bkur kyang / /chos 'dir dad pa'i bsod nams ci 'dra ba/ /bsod nams khyad par de 'dra de la med/ /la las 9zhing bcu ri dang rgya mtshor bcas / /lag pa'i mthil du bskal par mkhar 'dzin kyang / /chos 'dir dad pa'i bya dka' ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra de ni de la yod ma yin/ /la las zhing bcu'i 1 rdul snyed sems can la/ /dge ba kun gyis bskal par bsnyen bkur kyang / /chos 'dir dad pa'i bsod nams ci 'dra ba/ /bsod nams khyad 97—120

par de 'dra de la med/ /la las zhing bcu'i rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /bde ba kun gyis bskal par bsnyen bkur bas/ /gang gis chos kyi le'u 'di gzung 6)byas pa/ /bsod nams de ni de bas khyad par 'phags/ /rnam thar de dag rab tu bstan pa'i tshe/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams thams cad g.yos par gyur / /bdud kyi gnas rnams mog mog byas gyur cing / /sgra rab phyung bas ngan song rab tu zhi/ /phyogs bcu kun gyi mi yi seng ge rnams/ /de dag kun gyis mngon par zhal bstan te/ /phyag brkyang narimadzad nas yon tan mtha' yas pa / /bzang po dpal gyi mgo la bzhag par gyur/ /phyag gi mthil gyis mgo la byug mdzad de/ /rnam thar 'di dag legs par bshad pa legs/ /khyod kyis legs bstan rjes su nged ridagyes zhes tsho/ /sangs rgyas de dag kun gyis gsung brjod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa 'di dag bka' stsal nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na gang dag 'khod pa'i lha thams cad dang /mi dang mi ma (55yin pa de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pas 'di legs par bka' stsal to/ /kye ma de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba gnyis pa 'di mdzad do/ /chos bstan pa 'di sngo na ma thos so/ /sems can gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rnyed par 'gyur ba de dag ni shin tu dkon 6te/sems can de dag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba ngan ngon dang ldan pa ma yin no/ /sems can de dag ni sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa yin no/ /sems can de dag ni lha dang bcas pa bdud dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la mchod rten lta bur 'gyur te/ de dag ni bdud dam/ bdud kyi ris 97—121

kyi lha rnams sam/ /rab tu byung ba rnams sam/ khyim na gnas pa rnams sam/de bzhin du rgyal po rnams sam/ blon po chen po rnams sam/ khyim bdag rnams kyis gtse bar mi nus so zhes ca co dang ga zha'i sgra phyung 6)ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mdo sde dkon mchog 'di lta bu dag 'jig rten du 'byung ba ni rnyed 2par dka' ba lags te/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus chos 'di lta bu ni 'jig rten du byung zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu nyid kyis sems can de dag gis kyang thos lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ljags kyi dbang po phyung nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo khyod kyis chos kyi 4rnam grangs 'di zung 55shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gzung nelags te/ slan chad mi bskyud par bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas / thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa kun tu bzang po dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu dang / nyan thos chen po gzhan dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod don/ /'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs zhes 595bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs rdzogs sokho/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi 97—122

mtshan brjod (17rin/ /de ni de ru skye bar 'gyur/ /'chi ba'i dus su ston pa ni/ /dge slong dge 'dun bcas te mthong / /de na bud med yod ma yin/ /mngal na gnas pa yod ma yin/ /rin chen rnams kyi pad+mo las/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zas dang gos dang sman rnams dang / /chos gos mal cha lhung bzed rnams/ /sems kyis bsam ma (5)thag tu ni/ /de dag mod la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /bde ba can gyi bsngags pa brjod/ /de ltar sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas chos kyang bsam mi khyab/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun bsam mi khyab/ /bsam mi khyab la dad byas natshonas/ /rnam par smin pa bsam mi khyab/ /rnam dag zhing du skye bar 'gyur/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi pho brang 'khor dang bcas pa zhes bya ba rgyar dpag tshad khri yod pa zhig yod de/ rgyal rigs su skyes so/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi yab ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bzang po'i mchog ces bya bar gyur to/ /de'i yum ni gzi brjid can zhes bya bar gyur 4to//de'i btsun mo ni rgyal rigs bzang skyong ma zhes bya bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi sras ni zla ba'i 'od ces bya bar gyur to / /rim gro pa ni snyan pa dri ma med ces bya bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi shes rab can gyi mchog tu gyur pa ni bzang po'i tog ces bya bar gyur to/ /rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i mchog dang brtson 'grus chen po dang ldan pa'i mchog ni bkod pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /dge slong 97—155

dag de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi bdud ni mchod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya bar gyur (15to/ / lhas byin nagyi ming ni dang ba zhes bya bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi nyan thos 'dus pa chen po ni nyan thos chen po drug khri yod do/ /dge slong dag sems can thams cad kyis legs par bsams te/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi mtshan legs par bzung la/zhag bcur sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yid la ma yengs par sgom ( zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med rgyun du yid la bya'o/ /dpal 'chi med rnga sgra'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di yang rtag tu bzlas brjod bya'o/ /nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum yan lag lngas phyag byas la/ sems can thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med bsams na zhag bcu 'das pa'i dus su de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du yongs su bsngos na/ de 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med mdun na bzhugs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 'chi med rnga sgra'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i gzungs de gang zhe na/ tar+ya thā/sha ba le/ a ba le/ sa ma dza le/ nirde she ri/ nidzā te/ ni ruste / nirmu rmekhe / dz+wa la pa ri ts+tsha 7da ni/ su kha ba ti 85nirde 95she/ a mṛ 〉te11/ ā yurgarba 1rtanir+sā ni/ a mṛ 1 te k+ṣa ā yuḥpra sā dha nel/ nir budhi la.ā kāsha nirde she/ ā kā sha nidzā te / ā kā sha nir ku sha le/ ā kā sha nirdar+sha ne she/ ā kā sha a 97—156

༄ga /'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/(1ri༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sap+ta dbud+dha ri rka nā 4rim ma hā yā na sru 5ritra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ti se'i ri'i rtse mo lha'i gnas na drang srong gi spyod pa dang / ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na dge slong lnga brgya tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po dang / kun du bzang po dang / mtha' yas me tog dang / kun nas me tog dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' skye ba gcig gis thogs pa sha stag dang thabs cig 6tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ri'i rtse mo'i nags khrod 97—164

de nyid na dge slong zhig 'byung pos zin nas/ brdol zhing gcer bu gos med la lag pa bsgreng (1)ste ngu zhing 'dug pa gzigs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying pos bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te / pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de(ge/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i dkyil na kyi hud ces sgra 'byin pa 'di dang / dge slong gcer bu gos ma mchis la lag pa bstod mo pa cig 4shos 'di yang su zhig lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i snying po 'di ni nad kyis btab pa yin no/ /cig gshos 'di yang nad kyis btab pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog 6pa'i rig 7sngags bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol/ bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas bdun na sprul pa mdzad de/ de nas nam mkha' la de bzhin gshegs pa drug byung ngo / /bdun pa ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi 9gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ya / na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsi ghā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ ha la ha la/ hi la hi lā 97—165

ya / na mo dza ga na mi tsa nā ya1/ na mo na maḥswā hā/ de nas ( de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i snying po gang la la zhig rig sngags da'adi 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed na de'i lus la mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ chu dang me'i sdug bsngal ba'i nad kyis 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro ni/ /dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bas 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de dug zos kyang zas bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /zas dang skom la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te zos na pha rol gyi gnod pa mi 'byung ngo / /nad thams cad kyis btab par mi 'gyur ro/ /ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi gzugs mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshon 5btab pa'i rna bar bzlas brjod byas la sna ma'i mar sbyin no/ /mdze dang spangs tsind kyis btab pa rnams la sna ma'i mar dang /ut+pal sngon po dang / shu ti dang / nye'u shing pa rnams bsres pa'i mar byin na nad thams cad sos par 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug tor can steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi ri7rigazhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥn so bhā ya/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa pā tsa ya pā tsa 9ya/ sarba bhū tā 41 / sbyin 11ya/ tī la ya/ ba ra bit+yā māṃ 15swā hā/ nam mkha'i snying po sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / bsgom nyes pa dang / rmi 97—166

lam ngan pa thams cad bzlog pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dgag pa'i phyir sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas gsungs shing ngas kyang da ltar bshad pa'i snying po 'di zung 17shig /nam mkha'i snying po gang la la zhig nga'i snying po 'di nyin mtshan gsum yid la byed na/ de la pha rol gyi gnod pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam na de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gshis ngan 957du 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di nas shi 'phos nas de bzhin gshegs pa dang phrad par 'gyur zhing mnyes par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'di'i cho ga gzhan ni nad thams cad la skud pas bcing bar bya'o/ /'dus pa las gyur pa la sna snama'i mar la bzlas brjod byas te sbyin no/ /chus phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /skud pas bdag la bsrung ngo //byis pa rnams kyi gdon dag la skud pa sngon po gdags so/ /mtshon 4btab pa'i rna bar lan bdun bzlas brjod bya'o/ /gzhan dag la yang rang gi blos sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyob steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi 55gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya / na maḥso ghā ya/ oṃ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ku lor+sā dha nā ṭ+wāṃ 67ku ru sarba ga hā 7shā swā hā/ nam mkha'i snying po gsang sngags kyi nagazhi 'di dag ni bskal pa bzang po'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba thams cad kyis gsungs shing ngas kyang da ltar bshad pa ste/nam mkha'i snying po khyod kyis gsang sngags kyi 9gzhi 'di dag zung 1 shig /gang 97—167

la la zhig 'dzin tam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed na de'i lus la mtshon gyis mi tshugs0)/ dug gis mi tshugs/ dbyig dug gis mi tshugs/ rims nad kyis mi 'debs shing / chu dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang /gshis ngan du 'chi bar mi 'gyur te/ /sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa rnams (7ni ma gtogs so/ /dge slong ngam dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la zhig nang par langs nas mgo bkrus (5)te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar lan brgya rtsa brgyad brjod na de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro/ /de la sems can sdang ba gang dag rgyal po rnams thog mar smra bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad de'i dbang du 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa thams cad kyi nang du yid la bya'o/ /'thab pa dang 'thab 4)mo dang rtsod pa dang 'gyed pa thams cad du skud pa dkar po gdags so/ /mig 5)nad la shing 'o ma can las skud pa byas te rna ba la gdags so/ /dmag rengs par byed par 'dod pas zho dang sbrang rtsi la btags pa'i 'bras yos la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg 6bya'o/ /rā dzā māṃ 7'o dzā mā rinatra'i ba shī 59)ka ra tu kā me na/ bobadag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad dang / sdig pa sbyang zhing dpal chen po dang / nor gyi phung po chen po sgrub par 'dod na 'o ma can gyi shing gi sbar shing gis me bus 11la bsreg bya til dag lan stong sbyin sreg 12bya'o/ /sdig pa ji snyed pa thams cad sbyong bar 1 'dod pa dang / rig sngags thams cad grub 1 par 'dod pa dang / bdag bkru bar 'dod pas shu ti dang / na la dang / khre gedang / shi ri sha dang / rgya spos dang / gum kum yodang / gla sgang dang / in+d+ra ba ru ṇa 1 dang / byang chub kyi shing dang / a mra'i mgo 97—168

thogs dang 'di rnams kyis bkru bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar nyin zhag gcig smyung ba bya zhing bum pa sar pa bzhag ste/ zla ba nya (1)la sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi spyan sngar snying pos lan stong rtsa brgyad bsngags (gyel khrus bya'o/ /dug mi gdug par byed par 'dod pas sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar seng ldeng gi ri thur ma ba'i lci bar smyugs ge pa brgya (5)rtsa brgyad ming nas smos te sbyin sreg (6)byas na dug mi gdug par 'gyur ro/ /gdon dang srung tshurab dang 'byung po la sogs pa'i las thams cad la yang sbyar bar 98༄byas na bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa log par dad sel steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi (9)gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ⑩ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥkra kuts+tshan+da 11ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te sa 15myakle bud dhā 1 ya/oṃ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ka ṭha ka bras/ ki ṭi ki ṭi/ ki ṣ+ṭha ki khritsha/ ki ṭā tshab ya na maḥswā hā/ nam mkha'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas log par dad sel zhes bya ba gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag gis gsungs shing rjes su yi rang 1 tshoba'i snying po 'di khyod kyis zung 18shig /blangs shing bzung ste/ kun chub par byas na phyi ma'i tshe dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dag de'i tshe dkon mchog gsum la dad pa rnyed nas khrus byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog dang /bdug pa dang / spos dag gis mchod pa byas nas gsang sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad 'byong 19bar 'gyur te/ tshe rabs bdun du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur 97—169

ro / /lha rnams kyi nang du lha'i che ba nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /yang na mi rnams kyi nang du 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na cho ga bzhin du bsgrubs 17na de mir skye ba tha ma thob par 'gyur te/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe 'di la yang rtag tu brjod na nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur (5)ro thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /zas dang skom gyi rnam pa la lan bdun bsngags te zos 'thungs na nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste skom zhi bar 'dod na bza' 5)thams cad la lan stong rtsa brgyad kyis bkru bar bya'o/ /lhog (4)rgal bcad ldan zangs khab kyis bya'o/ /'thab pa dang / rtsod (6)pa dang /bcings pa ri thams cad las thar bar bya na lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na (8)rtag tu nor yang 'phel bar 'gyur/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad las kyang thar bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'dod na des phyogs gtsang mar 'jig rten gyi 'khor sar dkyil 'khor bskus la a ga rus bdugs te/ lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la/ de'i drung du sngas shar phyogs su bstan te nyal na de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /yid la ci smos pa de thams cad ston to/ /tshe 'am stobs sam pham rgyal thams cad kyang ston to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te9/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi 1 gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/na maḥsi ghā ya/ na maḥ11ka na ka mu na 12ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle nyu297—170

bud dhā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sa ra sa ra sa ra sa ra si ri si ri si ri si ri/si rā yahunye/ dha ma dha ma/ dha ma dha ma/ dhu ma dhu ma/ dhu ma dhu mā ya2/ na mo na maḥ(bka na ka mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta 54)te sa 55myakle bud dhā ya 6swā hā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub kyis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i snying po gang la la zhig snying po 'di 'dzin cing rtag tu bzlas brjod ri byed pa de la mtshon gyis 8'jigs pa mi 'byung / me dang chu dang lce 'babs pas 9 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur/ dug thams cad kyang zas dang 'dra bar thub par 'gyur/dus ma yin par 'chi bas 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur/ gshis ngan du 'chi bar mi 'gyur/ tshe ring bar 'gyur/ longs spyod che bar 'gyur/ rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa dang phrad par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs yopar 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum du bzlas brjod 11byas na sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro/ /ji 12ste pha rol nad las thar bar byed 'dod na ci nus su gtor ma gtong zhing pog gam/ a ga ru'i bdug pas bdugs la bza' 1 thams cad la khrus bya'o/ /mdze dang spangs nad dang mchin skran la shu dag 'jam po btags la sbrang rtsi dang bsres te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lan stong rtsa brgyad bsngags 1 la bskus na mdze nad thams cad sos par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bzhi 15pa la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar sna ma'i me tog gi phreng ba la lan stong rtsa brgyad bsngags 7te mi'i mgo la bcings na zhag bzhi pa'i rims sos par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan btab pa'i rna bar bzlas brjod byas na brjed 17byed las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /lus srul pos zin 97—171

pa rnams la sangs rgyas la phul ba'i me tog gis bdug 0)go/ /de la sogs pa'i las rnams byed de las thams cad pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi nasagazhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ya / na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsi bhā ya/ oṃ ha ra ha ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ha ha ha/na maḥkā sh+ya pā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle 5)bud dhā (4)ya/ sispyan zhinatu man+t+ra pā da swā hā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha' snying po dzisnying po 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung sum cu 7rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed dag gis gsungs pa ste(8)/ nam mkha'i snying po khyod kyis kyang snying po 'di zung 9 shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gang la la zhig 'dzin tam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed dam/ nyin mo'am/mtshan mo lan gsum gsum bzlas brjod byas khon mdor na rmi lam na yang de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang byang bar 'gyur 11te12/ sngon gyi las ni ma gtogs so/ /las thams cad la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /mdze dang sha ga ra la sogs pa la sangs rgyas la phul ba'i me tog la sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar lan stong rtsa brgyad bsngags nyu te/ bklags shing bkrus rlon sos par 'gyur ro/ /klad pa na ba la sangs rgyas la phul ba'i me tog sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar lan bdun bzlas brjod bya'o/ /thams cad du yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 97—172

de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don gyi phyir rig sngags 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥso bhā ya/ tabya thā/ ghu me ghu me1/ ma hā ghu me/ ta le ta le/ ma hā ta le/ tsa le tsa le/ ma hā tsa le/ dhu re dhu re/ma hā dhu re/ ti ri ti ri/ ma hā ti ri/ ki li ki li/ ma hā ki li/ tsu ru tsu ru / ma hā tsu ru/ mi li mi li/ ma hā mi li/ ti li ti li/ ma hā ti li/ dhu me dhu me/ ma hā dhu me/ tsa le tsa leXn/ ma hā tsa le/ khi ri khi ri/ ma hā khi ri / tsi li tsi li/ ma hā tsi li swā hā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i snying po klad pa'i nad bsal na mtshon dang lag mthil gyis bya'o/ /sprin bzlog na shing ka ra bī ra'i lcug mas bya'o/ /dug spo na chus bya'o/ /las gzhan rnams kyang bya'o/ /khrus kyi cho gas sbyar bar bya'o / /cho ga thams cad kyis thams cad du sbyar bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po yi carangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so'i// //97—173

bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/tsho1tshog /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dā da nasha bud+dha ri rka nā ma ma hā yā na sru tre(4ri / bod skad du/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 5dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod phung po'i ri la dge slong stong nyis 6brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig 7tu bzhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa' ma (8pham pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' khri nyis stong gi byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang yang thabs cig smyo go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la bka' stsal pa / byams pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brjod du med pa bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed 97—177

kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mu tig can zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nam mkha'i 1dpal dri med rdul sel rab mdzes yon tan gyi tog gi 'od me tog pad+ma bai ḍūr+ya'i 2'od zer rin po che'i gzugs lta bu'i sku dang ldan pa spos mchog dam pas mchod pa sku rnam ri par spras shing legs par brgyan pa gtsug tor gyi gtsug nas nyi ma'i 'od zer dpag med zla 'od smon lam gyis brgyan pa rab sprul bkod pa chen po chos kyi dbyings las mngon 'phags chags med rin chen rgyal po zhes bya ba da ltar yang bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to / /su rgyal ba de'i mtshan 'dzin pa de bskal pa chen po 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi bskal par 'khor ba las ldog go/ /des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'dra ba med ces bya ba lung bstan te/ de de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nam mkha'i 0 dpal dri med rdul sel rab mdzes yon tan gyi tog gi 'od me tog pad+ma be+e ḍūr+ya'i 5ci'od zer rin po che'i gzugs lta bu'i sku dang ldan pa spos mchog dam pas mchod pa sku rnam par spras shing legs par brgyan pa gtsug tor gyi gtsug nas nyi ma'i 'od zer dpag med zla 'od smon lam gyis brgyan pa rab sprul bkod pa chen po chos kyi dbyings las mngon 'phags chags med rin chen rgyal po de yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i dam pa'i chos nub ma thag tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 97—178

'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chu lha gzhon nu nyi ma'i sgron ma zla ba'i me tog pad+ma gser sdug nam mkha' lta bu'i sku ldan rnam par snang mdzad 'od zer rab brgyan thogs med 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor phyogs bcur 'od zer rab 'byin 'jig rten khams kun snang byed tog gi rgyal mtshan rgyal po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shar phyogs de nyid kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bkod pa thams cad dri med 'od ces bya ba'i mtshan yang gzung ngo / /tshig gdon (1)to/ /phyag bya'o/ /lho phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spobs pa'i rgyan tshonal dgongs pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan yang gzung ngo / /yid la bya'o/ /nub phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dri med zla ba'i tog gi rgyal po grags ldan zhes bya ba'i mtshan yang gzung ngo / /phyag bya'o/ /byang phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa me tog gi bkod pa snang bar mdzad pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan yang gzung ngo / /phyag bya'o / /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mdzad ces bya ba'i mtshan yang gzung ngo / /phyag cibya'o/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mchog gi tog grags ldan zhes bya ba'i mtshan yang gzung ngo //phyag ri4)bya'o/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs med rnam par gzigs zhes debya ba'i mtshan yang gzung ngo / /phyag bya'o/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs bral bag tsha mi mnga' spu zing mi byed ces bya dziba'i mtshan yang gzung ngo / /phyag bya'o/ /'og gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge bsgyings pa'i mid pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan yang gzung 97—179

ngo / /phyag bya'o/ /steng gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od gzi brjid 'jigs bral rgyal po zhes bya ba'i mtshan yang gzung ngo / /phyag bya'o/ /byams pa dad pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcu gnyis po 'di dag gi mtshan brjod la nyi ma bcur sdig pa thams cad kyi nyes pa bshags par bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang bar 1)bya/ sangs rgyas thams cad la bskul ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la gsol ba gdab pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad chos kyi dbyings su yongs su bsngo bas yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /'on kyang sdig pa thams cad zad par 'gyur ro/ /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par byang bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / mi 'jigs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / mtshan phun sum tshogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzungs phun sum tshogs pa yang 'thob bo/ /ting nge 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa yang 'thob bo/ /bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen phun sum tshogs pa yang myur du yongs su 'dzin to/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las nyams par mi 'gyur zhing yongs su nyams par yang 2 mi 'gyur ro/ /'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe yang kun du mdzes pa dang /de'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang / rigs phun sum tshogs pa dang /skye ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / rus phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dang / ris 'dra ba'i skye bo'i 'khor phun sum tshogs pa yang 97—180

yongs su 'dzin to/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa yi0) tshe rabs tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mthong na dga' zhing dga' byed dang / /'od byed pa dang mthu chen dang / /'byor pa chen por 'gyur ba yin/ /gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi rigazhi 'di rnams kyang brjod par bya'o/ /ta byathā/a khe ma khe/ sa man+ta mu khe/ sau ti lusteri / ni ruste547/ pra bhe/ sa ma yo ge/ tsit+ta tsiste/(5 a khe/ ma khe/ ma da ne/ bi brte/ sa man+ta gu ṇi / sa sgyur me/ luste 574pra luste87/ hi li mi li/ ma sa le/ sto/ na le/ tsa me/ a tsi ti59rwa/ tso tse a ra he/ ba hu:'i/ mā 17yu gra he/ he ma ba ti/ byo ti ba ti / dharma tsite/na/ tsū ta paṅge1 / a bi k+ṣe be/ ra dh+ri k+ṣa same15/ skan+dha bi bhasteyi / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs 1 kyis gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams grub par gyur cig /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gzungs 'di dag ni gzung byas na12/ /phyogs bcu dag na gang bzhugs pa'i19/ /bye ba drug cu'i na drang srong rnams/ /de dag de la dgongs par 'gyur/ /skye ba dag ni kun du yang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnyed par 'gyur/ /cung zad dge ba gang yin pa/ /don rnams thams cad 'byor par 'gyur/ /pad+ma'i snying por bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mngon sum mthong / /gzungs 'di dag ni 'dzin byed pa/ /mkhas pa dpal ldan rdzus te skye/ /dran dang blo gros rtogs pa dang / /mos dang shes rab rab tu 'phel/ /thos pa thams cad 'dzin par 'gyur/ /thos pa thams cad 'dzin mi 527nyams/ /'jig rten mgon po 'di dag gi/ /mtshan rnams su zhig rjod byed pa/ /ngan 'gro thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bzang 'gror myur 97—181

du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi mchog /de dag de la mngon par 'gyur/ /byang chub rab tu de 'tshang rgya/ /zhing ni bye ba phrag stong dag /gser gyis bkang ste sbyin byin pas/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs rnams kyi/ /mtshan rnams 'dzin par byed pa yi/ /bsod nams phung po de ches mang / /rtag tu tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe / /mi khom thams cad rnam spangs te/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba rab mdzes rnyed / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mnyes par byed/ /dad pa bla na med pa 'thob/ /sangs rgyas rnams la rab dad cing / /mchod pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'byung 1rab mnyes byed de/ /mthong nas ston la rab tu dad(ge/ /'jig rten sgron ma mthong nas ni/ /mchod pa bzang po byed par 'gyur/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag 'dzin byed pa/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med du/ /'khor ba rnam par spangs nas su/ /byang chub myur du 'tshang yang rgya/ /nyin zhag bdun du tshang bar ni/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag 'dzin byed na/ /gang gis 'dren rnams mthong 'gyur ba'i/ /rgya chen mig ni sbyangs par 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon po de dag gi/ /mtshan rnams mi gang 'dzin byed pa/ /skye ba gang dang gar skyes par/ /de ni phyag bya'i 'os su 'gyur/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag 'dzin byed pa/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /bkur sti ma yin thob mi 'gyur / /'jig rten dag na grags pa 'thob ri/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag 'dzin byed pa/ /de la bskal pa du mar ni/ /lha rnams bsti 45stang byed par 'gyur / /byang chub myur du mtshang 5yang rgya/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag 'dzin byed pa/ /mos med shes rab 'chal mi 'gyur/ /g.yo dang sgyu ni rnam par 97—182

spangs / /rtag tu sangs rgyas rnams kyang mthong / /mtshan rnams 'di dag 'dzin byed pa/ /lha dang dri za klu dbang dang / /mkha' lding lha min gsang ba pa / /rtag tu de la srung 1)bar byed/ /gzugs dang mtshan ni phun sum tshogs/ /nor chen khyim du skye bar 'gyur/ /sems can kun la sbyin par byed/ /dpa' zhid gtong phod ser sna med/ / bskal pa tsho bye ba brgya mang por/ /lha yi tsan+dan dmar po dang / /shin tu dri zhim spos kun gyi/ /spos (5)ngad sa)de yi kha nas 'byung (3)/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag 'dzin byed pa/ /bskal pa bye bar sgra skad ni / /tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rtag tu chos rgyal tshul dang ldan / /mtshan rnams 'di dag 'dzin byed pa/ /rin chen sna bdun pad+ma'i 6'dab / /bye ba stong phrag mang yod 7las/ /'byor chen de skye lha gzugs ldan/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag su 'dzin pa/ /de ni pha ma spun sdug dang / /skye bo dag gi tshogs rnams dang / /'bral bar 'gyur ba mi mthong ngo / /drang srong chen po rnams kyi mtshan/ /bud rin med kyis ni gzung byas na/ /bud med lus la ma chags nas/ /skyes pa blo gros ldan par 'gyur/ /mi yi lus ni thob gyur nas/ /bla med byang chub thob 'gyur 9te/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor nas/ /'dod pa zhi bzhin mya ngan 'da'/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag su 'dzin pa/ /de yi lus la mtshon dang ni/ /dug dang me dang rgyal po dang / /g.yon can rnams kyis mi tshugs so/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag su 'dzin pa/ /de yi sems la nams 1 kyang ni / /dpung dang bzhon 11par bcas pa yi/ /bdud kyis 1 glags rnyed mi 'gyur ro/ /'di dag gi ni mtshan gyi rnams/ /mi gang 'dzin par byed pa de/ /zhing ni bye ba bsam yas par/ /nam mkha' las ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sangs 97—183

rgyas bstan pa rnams mchod nas/ /'jigs pa med par zhu ba zhu/ /de dag de yi bsam mkhyen nas/ /rgyal ba de dag lung ston 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mgon po de dag las/ /lung bstan pa ni thob gyur nas/ /de ni shin tu yi hunyerangs te / /rgyal ba'i bstan la the tshom med/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag 'dzin byed pa/ /'jig rten mgon po rnams las ni/ /zab mo'i chos ni thos 'gyur te/ /thos nas thams cad 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de nas pha rol phyin sa dang / /mi 'jigs pa dang stobs rnams dang / /mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po rnams/ /ma lus par ni rdzogs par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas de dag rnams kyi ni/ /gang gi zhing du 'dod gyur pa/ /der ni bla med yang dag rdzogs/ /byang chub rtogs nas 'tshang rgyar 'gyur/ /skyes pa 'am ni bud med gang / /mtshan rnams 'di dag 'dzin pa yi/ /yon tan 'di dang gzhan dag kyang / /sangs rgyas bskal par rgyun du gsung / /bag yod ldan par gyur nas ni/ /yon tan phun sum 'di thos nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa/ /de dag mtshan rnams 'dzin par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'di dag dpal snying po/ /sprin gyi rgyal po mi yi mchog /'jig rten mgon po 'di dag gi/ /mtshan ni bskal par gang nyan 2dang / /gang dag 'di rnams mtshan nyan cing / /thos nas gus par byed 'gyur ba/ /de dang de dag shes rab che/ /rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog tu 'gyur / /drang srong chen po de dag gi/ /'di 'dra'i mtshan dag thos gyur nas / /bag yod ldan zhing mkhas gyur la/ /shes rab ldan pa su mi 'dzin/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang /97—184

༄ga /'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs/1༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bud+dha skṛ rind (da yo 4)nā ma dhā ra tī dharma bi 5par+sā ya/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 67dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul chos kyi g.ye 7dgon pa rin po che bkod pa'i 'khor gyi khyams/ ye shes kyi rnam par dpyad pa/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis 8byin gyis brlabs tshodapa/ sems can thams cad kyis mngon par bstod pa/byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i gnas rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su spyod pa/ kun nas 'od kyi khang bzangs kyi dbus na byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma thams cad kyang lung bstan pa/ thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams tha dad pa 97—187

nas 'dus pa/ thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal po'i sras/thams cad kyang gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs thob pa sha stag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas nas thabs cig (1)tu bzhugs (mite chos ston to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rgya chen po la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la thugs brtse (2)ba dang / lha dang mi'i skye bo phal po che'i don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis gsungs pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yod do/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ngam/ 'dzin tam/ klog gam/kun chub par byed dam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston tam / dad dam/ lhag pa'i bsam pas mos par byed na/ de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ chos thams cad 'dzin pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 45lta ba dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ chos nyan pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/dge 'dun la rim gro byed pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ bskal pa stong du 'khor ba'i srid pa'i rgya mtsho phyirno bsnyil bar 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu rimangon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang 97—188

chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ de la 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad srung bar 'gyur/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dga' bar 'gyur/ de'i lus la nad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ pha rol gyi gnod pas 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur/ chad pa spang ba dang / mtshon cha spang ba dang / dug gzhil 1nas 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur/ de la bdud sdig can gyis glags rnyed par mi 'gyur/ bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis skabs rnyed par mi 'gyur te/gang du yid la byas pa der bdud kyi ris (5)kyi lha de dag thams cad skrag cing dngangs la ( tshodangang bar 'gyur zhing phyogs bcur 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di dag ni (4nasangs rgyas kyi tshig go/ /sangs rgyas kyi tshig chen po'o/ /sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i tshig chen po'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshig go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshig yin no/ /tar+ya thā/ burnye 5su budhe/ ma hā budhe/ i ha phyi burnye/ ta tra budhe / burnye burnye/ bud+dha nam ti/ budhe/sarba budha(9/ a nu ma ti/ sarba bud+dhaḥ no/ a nu dz+nyā na te/ bud+dhaḥ1/ bud+dha/bud+dha / bud+dha/ bud+dha/ bud+dha/ bud+dha/ bud+dha/ bud+dha/ bud+dha/ sangs rgyas kyi yul mtha' yas te/ chos bstan pa yang mtha' yas mod kyi/ gcig tu yid la bya ba ni mdor na sgom sna pa'o/ /gzungs 'di ni sems can rnams la thugs brtse nyu ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa ste/ chos thams cad kyi phyag rgya yin no/ /tar+ya thā/ shurnye/ su shurnye/ su shurnye/ sho dha ni/ saṃ sho dha lani/ saṃ sho dha nilo/ nirma le/ ma la a pa ga te/ ga ti sa ma ti krarnyil/97—189

sangs rgyas la mngon par dang ba de dag gis lha'i me 1 tog man dā ra ba dang /man dā ra ba dzo chen pos bcom ldan 'das la gtor/ mngon par gtor nas/gang dag sangs rgyas la skyabs su dong ba de dag thams cad rab tu dga' ba skyes so / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ shākya seng ge yang dag rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas skyob pas skad cig yud gang la/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ni snying po yi/ /gzungs 'di dag ni rab tu bshad pa yi/ /skad cig yud der sa yang rnam ridrug (gegayos/ /rgya mtsho 'khrugs shing bdud kyi gnas kun kyang / rab tu g.yos nas bdud kyi ris rnams kyi/ /lha dag rab tu dngangs shing 'khrugs par 'gyur / /bdud yid mi bde sdug bsngal mya ngan non/ /de tshe lha rnams ngo mtshar stirab thos nas/ /'jig rten mgon la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ /nam mkhar gnas nas me tog man dā 'thor/ /gang dag sangs rgyas mngon dad gzhan rnams kyi/ /se mo do dang do shal spos rnams dang / /phye ma dag dang byug pa gos rnams dang / /rgyan dang dpung rgyan dag kyang rab tu 'bul/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni de'i yon tan gyi phan yon gyi rgyan du 'gyur ba'o/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i rgyan dang / thos pa thams cad yongs su tshol bas mi ngoms pa'i rgyan dang / chos zab mo rnam par nges pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i rgyan dang / sems can thams cad kyi dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa shes 6pa'i rgyan dang / ji ltar thos pa dang ji ltar khong du chud pa'i chos rnams la tshul bzhin so sor rtog cing dpyod pa'i rgyan dang / sems can thams cad 7yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir chos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i rgyan dang / rgyan de yang sangs rgyas kyis 8byin gyi 97—191

bzhin 'brang ba'o/ /rgyal po chen po dag de la 'jigs pa chen po gcig po de'i gnyen po ngas 'dir brjod par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis srog rab tu stsal bas/ skye dgu rjes su bzung ba 'di (1nyeni deng bdag cag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shar phyogs su mngon du phyogs te bzhugs nas/ se gol gyi sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bskul te 'di skad ces/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang su dag sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba'i slad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de dag bdag gi grogs mdzod na)cig /des na bdag 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs ri ri kyis byin gyis brlabs risanas sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin par 'chi ba rab tu bzlog par bgyi'o//sngon ma bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa yang bskor bar bgyi'o zhes gsung ngo / /de bzhin du lho dang nub dang byang dang steng dang 'og gi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bskul te/ 'di skad ces/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang su dag sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba'i don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de dag bdag gi grogs mdzod cig ces gsung ngo / /de bzhin du phyogs mtshams rnams su yang 'di skad ces gang gi phyir 'di dag tshe dang stobs dang kha dog dang ldan pa yongs su 'grub cing dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur bar sangs rgyas thams cad bdag gi grogs 97—202

ces bya ba'i gzungs/1༄tshon /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tsan+dan aṅga nā ma dhā ra tī/ bod skad du/'phags pa tsan+dan gyi yan lag ces bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dge slong khri nyis stong lnga brgya'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu mang po dang / gzhan yang lha khyad par can mang po dang thabs cig 5tu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa la de bzhin gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul gyis lham me/ lhan ne/lhang nger bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor der byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i 97—207

pha rol gyi yang ches pha rol 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag gang gā'i klung grangs med pa'i bye ma snyed 'das pa na/ tsan+dan gyi dpal zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tsan+dan gyi yan lag ces bya ba da ltar yang bzhugs te/ 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /gang 'jig rten gyi khams de'i sems can de dag thams cad ni phyir mi ldog par gyur pa sha stag ste(1)/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tsan+dan gyi yan lag des sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir tsan+dan gyi yan lag ces bya ba'i gzungs kyi rig pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshonagazhi gsungs pa 'di thos nas phyir mi ldog pa de dag sdig pa dang bral zhing byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral sa lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad dang / gzhan yang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang sngon chad gsungs te/ ngas kyang khyed rnams la bshad kyis/sems can thams cad rjes su gzung ba'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung 4shig dang 5/ phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya pa tha ma la dam pa'i chos rnam par 'jig pa'i tshe/ thams cad chos dang mi ldan pa/ mtshams med pa byed pa dang dam pa'i chos la smod pa dang / mchod rten 'dral ba/ dge 'dun gyi rdzas la rku 'phrog byed pa dang / dge sbyong ma yin par dge sbyong du khas 'che ba/slob dpon dang mkhan po spang 6ba dag 'byung ste/ de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir tsan+dan gyi yan lag gi gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi sangs rgyas thams cad 97—208

kyis byin gyis brlabs pa 'di bshad kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams nga la nyon cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang /zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bskul ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang /gzhan yang sems can bye ba 91khrag khrig phrag 'bum rnams la 5thugs brtse ba dang / sdig pa byang bar bgyi ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das bshad du gsol/bde bar gshegs pa bshad du gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa bshad du gsol/bdag cag gis kyang gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi tshonasade dag gzung bar bgyi ste/sems can thams cad kyi don du rgya cher yang dag par bshad par bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/tsi rā te/ ma rī ṭī ki/ durdo me/ dur rādher / du ra /6)nu pra biṣ+ṭi/ tsan+da nī ga dze/ sa man+ta pa ri sho dha ni/ bi shud+dha mashī 8le/ tsa ri 99sdo pa ti/ an tse r+ya pra ti bhā 7ne/ sarba bud+dha a rnyikhri te/ bha ga ba te17/ pā pak+ṣa ye/ ā 1 shā me pa ri pū ra 1 ya swā hā/ rigs kyi bu pho dang rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gzungs chen po'i gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag 'dzin tam/ klog 'gam/ ston tam / kun chub par byed na/ de tshe 'di nyid la mig rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /thos ma thag tu sdig pa las rab tu grol bar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dbyin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ zla ba phyed kyi bar du bzlas pa byas na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa mthong bar 'gyur/ mtshams med pa lnga'i sdig byas pa yang 'byang bar 'gyur/97—209

skye ba dran par 'gyur/ tshe brjes 1rinas kyang lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur/khyim bdag chen po skyid napa dag gi nang du skye bar 'gyur/ skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar sa chen po ma lus pa 'di ni grum par 'gyur yang srid/ rgya mtsho ni skams kyang srid/ de bzhin du ri'i rgyal po ri rab ni 'jig par 'gyur yang srid/ rlung ni zhags pas bcing du rung yang srid/zla ba dang nyi ma ni sa'i steng du lhung ri yang srid/ nam mkha' ni lag pa gnyis kyis mnan du rung yang srid/ me ni chur 'gyur yang srid/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi ni gzhan du 'gyur yang srid/ sems can thams cad kyi sems ni (4rigacig tu 'gyur yang srid kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs shing byin gyis brlabs pa ni gzhan du 'gyur mi srid de/ sus kyang bskyod pa'am/ bskul 5)bar mi nus so/ /'di la ni bdud sdig can gyis glags rnyed ri ripar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis / bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang gzungs 'di'i cho ga bshad par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i mchod rten ring bsrel dang bcas pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar tsan+dan dkar po'i dkyil 'khor bgyis te/ me tog sil ma gtor la tsan+dan gyi bdug pas bdugs 7te/ zla ba tshes pa (8nas brtsams nas tshes bcwa lnga'i bar du dus gsum du khrus bgyi zhing gos kyang lan gsum du brjes te/ kha zas bsreg 9bya 'tshal zhing gso sbyong dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pas zla ba nya'i nyin bar zhag gcig smyung ba bgyis te/ rtswa tshabam gyi steng na mchis shing rtswa 11bam bting ba'i steng du nyal nas sems rtse gcig tu 97—210

bzlas pa bgyid cing me tog dri zhim pos lan brgya stong du gtor na sa g.yo bar 'gyur / bdag nyid kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong bar 'gyur/ gzungs chen po thos ma thag tu ci 'dod pa de thob par 'gyur/ thos pa 'dzin par yang 'gyur/las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang byang bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa tsan+dan gyi yan lag ces bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so1// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā tsho na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de rinasaye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad 4kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa ra
