sgron ma mchog gi gzungs/71ri༄lda /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a gra pra dī pa dhā ra tsā bi t+yā rā dzā/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal po sgron ma mchog gi gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / lha dang mi 'bum phrag du ma dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag du ma dang thabs cig dzod tu bzhugs te/yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas nas chos ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya phrag stong 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams me tog mtha' yas zhes la bya ba de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgron ma mchog ces bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 97—214

'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston pa des byang chub sems dpa' 'od chen po dang /'od dpag med ces bya ba byang chub sems dpa' gnyis 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 0)'dir btang ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de gnyis rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas byang chub sems dpa' de gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag 'bum 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams me tog mtha' yas zhes bgyi ba de na bcom ldan 'das tsha de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgron ma mchog ces bgyi ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgron ma'i mchog des bdag cag gnyis 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir btang ste/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgron ma'i mchog des cabacom ldan 'das la gnod pa chung ngam/nyam nga ba nyung ngam/ bskyod pa yang ngam/ 'tsho 'am/ stobs dang bde ba dang kha na ma tho ba ma mchis pa la reg par gnas sam zhes snyun gsol lo/ /'di skad ces kyang gsung ngo / /'di na mi'am/ mi ma lags pa'am/ 'byung po'am / sha za'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/ grul bum mam/ grul 97—215

bum gyi sde dpon nam/ rgyal po'am/ blon po chen po'am/ chom rkun nam/sbrul lam/ srin bu'am/ srin bu lu ta'am(1)/ sbrang bu lcags phye'am/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa gang yang rung ba dag 'tshe bar bgyid pa 'ga' yang ma (gemachis sam zhes gsung ngo / /sems can rnams kyi don dang / sman pa dang /bde ba dang / mdangs dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / gzi brjid dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / grags pa dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / yon tan dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / stobs dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / mdog dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / bsrung ba dang / sba ba dang / bskyab pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgron ma'i mchog des gzungs na kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag kyang bskur te/'di lta ste/ dz+wa le dz+wa le/ dz+wa le ga te/ tulkug/ mu'i55ci/ saṃ ma te/ ma hā saṃ ma te/ ma hā dz+wa le/ dz+wa ba la me/ sa he sa he/ ma hā dz+wa le/ suk+ki muk+ki ni/sha me/ saṃ ma te/ ma hā saṃ ma te/ ma hā sha me swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag zung 7 shig /long 8)shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston cig /kun dga' bo sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed par dka'o/ /gzungs kyi gsang sngags 59gzhi 'di dag rnyed par dka'o/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'i dag 'dzin pa yang shin tu rnyed par dka'o/ /kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la 511gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag 'dzin pa dang /len pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang /97—216

gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston pa de ni tshe rabs bdun du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /tshe 'di nyid la yang sngon gyi las ma gtogs par gzhan gyi gnod pa thams cad las yang dag par 'da' ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad dang rjes su mthun 6)par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun cu ( rtsa bdun gyis gsungs (57te/gang gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag las 'da' bar byed pa de ni de dag thams cad la 'khus pa yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ma pham pa stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang sems can rnams kyi don dang / sman pa dang / bde ba dang / mdangs dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / gzi brjid dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / grags pa dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / yon tan dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / stobs dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / mdog dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / bsrung ba dang / sba ba dang / bskyab pa'i slad du gzungs kyi gsang sngags 4gzhi 'di rnams brjod par bgyi'o/ /'di lta ste/ aste / brte/ nanye/ ku narte/ pu ka se 5)/ ku pu ka se/ ka se/ a na 67ka se/ nā ma ka se/ a nu ta/ pā nu ta/ kha dze/ ma hā kha dze/ sa da pa phe/ta ḍa phe/ tu ḍa phe / hi li mi li/ ti le swā hā/ de (8)nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag zung 9 shig /long khoshig /chongs shig /97—217

lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston cig /kun dga' bo sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed par dka'o1/ /gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag rnyed par dka'o/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag 'dzin pa yang shin tu rnyed par dka'o/ /kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag 'dzin pa dang / len pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang /kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston pa de ni tshe rabs bcu gnyis su tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /tshe 'di nyid la yang sngon gyi las ma gtogs par gzhan gyi gnod pa thams cad las (5yang dag par 'da' ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad dang rjes su mthun dzodapar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu ri rirtsa gnyis kyis gsungs te/ gang gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag las 'da' bar byed pa ni de dag thams cad la 'khus pa yin no/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 5logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang sems can rnams kyi don dang / sman pa dang / bde ba dang / mdangs dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / gzi brjid dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / grags pa dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / yon tan dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / stobs dang ldan par bgyi ba cadang / mdog dang ldan par bgyi ba dang / bsrung ba dang / sba ba dang / bskyab pa'i slad 97—218

du gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di rnams brjod par bgyi'o/ /1'di lta ste/ ak+ṣe / pak+ṣe / na dzi 3te/ nā 4gā sa re/ na hi le/ dza hi le/( dza hi la ba te/ tsaṇ+ḍi la ba te swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag zung 7shig /long 8shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston cig /kun dga' bo sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed par dka'o/ /gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag rnyed par dka'o/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag 'dzin pa yang shin tu rnyed par dka'o/ ci /kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la 9gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di 1 dag 'dzin pa dang / len pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston pa de ni tshe rabs bcu gsum du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /tshe 'di nyid la yang sngon gyi las ma gtogs pa gzhan gyi gnod pa thams cad las yang dag par 'da' ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad dang rjes su mthun 11par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags 12gzhi 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu 1 rtsa gnyis kyis gsungs te/ gang gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di 1 dag las 'da' bar byed pa de ni de dag thams cad la 'khus pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngas kyang sems can rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba dang / mdangs dang ldan par bya ba dang / gzi brjid dang ldan par bya ba dang / grags pa dang ldan par bya 97—219

ba dang / yon tan dang ldan par bya ba dang / stobs dang ldan par bya ba dang / mdog dang ldan par bya ba dang / bsrung ba dang / sba ba 1dang /bskyab pa'i phyir gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi rnams bshad do/ /'di lta ste/ ar+bhe / bar+bhe/ nañca/ ku naḥn/ ṭa ke/ e na ḍa ke/ ta ta be/ tu ṭa be/ra ṭa ke/ lo le/ hu le/ hi le/ mi le/ ti le/ shī le/ shī la/ a snye/ba snye/ na nye/ ku na nye/ a ḍa ba tī/ ba ṇa ba tī/ ka se ka se ka se/ pha se pha se pha se/ ma hā pha se pha se swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag zung 4shig /long tshor shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston cig /kun dga' bo sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed par dka'o/ /gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 6'di dag rnyed par dka'o/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags 'di dag ston pa yang shin tu rnyed par dka'o/ /kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag 'dzin pa dang /len pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston pa de ni tshe rabs bcu bzhir tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /tshe 'di nyid la yang sngon gyi las ma gtogs par gzhan gyi gnod pa thams cad las 'da' ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad dang rjes su mthun 7par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu nartsa bzhis gsungs te/ gang gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag las 'da' bar byed pa de ni de dag thams cad la 97—220

'khus pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la dag 1gis gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag shing skam po gsher nanobag med pa la bsrung ba byas te/ yongs su bskyab dpa dang / yongs su gzung cab dang / bcing ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba byas na shing de las lcu gu dang /lo ma dag kyang skye bar 'gyur te/ me tog dang 'bras bu rnams kyang mngon par 'grub par 'gyur na/ mir gyur pa lta ci smos/ na maḥsarba burnye bh+yaḥ5sidh+yan+tu dhā ra tī/ man+t+ra pā 6da ni swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sems can rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba dang / mdangs dang ldan par bya ba dang / gzi brjid dang ldan par bya ba dang / grags pa dang ldan par bya ba dang / yon tan dang ldan par bya ba dang / stobs dang ldan par bya ba dang / mdog dang ldan par bya ba dang / bsrung ba dang / sba ba dang / bskyab pa'i phyir gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi gzhan dag kyang bshad par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ adhe/mnye(7sku / pa ke/ pā ra ke/ pe ke ḍā/ dra ma ti/ ta ra ma ti/ ṭu naḍa 9ma ṭi'i / ṭu 11ḍa 12ma ṭi na/ ṭu ḍa ṭu 1 re/ su re/ hi le/ mu le/ ti le swā hā / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa / kun dga' bo khyod kyis gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag zung 15shig /long 9shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston cig /kun dga' bo sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed par dka'o/ /gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag rnyed par dka'o/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag 'dzin pa yang shin tu rnyed par 97—221

dka'o / /kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag 'dzin pa dang / len pa dang / 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston pa de ni tshe rabs nyi shu rtsa gcig tu tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /tshe 'di nyid la yang sngon gyi las ma gtogs par gzhan gyi gnod pa thams cad las 'da' ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad dang rjes su mthun 1par 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig la bsrung ba byas na de la yang 'byung po thams cad kyis mi tshugs so/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs so/ /sbrul dang / srin bu dang / srin bu lu ta dang / sbrang bu lcags phye thams cad kyis mi tshugs so/ /rims rlung dang /mkhris pa dang / bad kun dang / 'dus pa dang / dus tshigs 'gyur ba las byung ba thams cad kyis mi tshugs so/ /zhag gcig pa'am/ zhag gnyis pa'am/zhag gsum pa'am/ zhag bzhi pa'am/ zhag bdun pa'am/ zla ba phyed pa'am/zla ba gcig pa'am/ lo gcig pa'am/ nad rgyun rings saman/ skad cig pa rnams kyis mi tshugs so/ /'bras sam/ phol mig gam/ rkang shu'am/ lhog pa'am / me dbal lam/ shu ba'am/ khyi rngo'am/ g.yan pa'am/ mdze thams cad dam/ lhog dpa 4thams cad dam/ gshed byed thams cad dam/sgyur ba'i las thams cad dam/ byad thams cad dang / ro langs thams cad kyis kyang mi tshugs so/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus gsungs te/ gang gzungs kyi gsang 97—222

sngags 1tshogazhi 'di dag las 'da' bar byed pa de ni de dag thams cad la 'khus pa yin no/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag ni rgyal po'i pho brang na 'dug na yang yid la bya'o/ /chom rkun gyi nang na 'dug na yang yid la bya'o/ /srin po'i nang na 'dug na yang yid la bya'o/ /gcan gzan 2khro bo'i nang na 'dug na yang yid la bya'o/ /'brog dgon pa'i nang na 'dug na yang yid la bya'o/ /klung dang bgrod dka' ba na 'dug na yang yid la bya'o/ /me'i nang na 'dug na yang yid la bya'o/ /chu'i nang na ca'adug na yang yid la bya'o / /de yid la byas pa de rnams las 'jigs pa de dag thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /des dug zos pa thams cad kyang kha zas nyid du 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag 'dzin pa ni 'byung po thams cad kyis mi tshugs so/ /yi dgas 5thams cad dang / srul po thams cad dang /gshed byed thams cad dang / sgyur ba'i las thams cad dang / byad thams cad dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs te/ kun dga' bo mdor can de la gzhan gyi gnod pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs so/ /kun dga' bo gsad pa'i rigs pa ni chad pas bral bar 'gyur ro/ /chad pas gcad pa'i rigs pa ni brdegs pas/ brdegs pa'i rigs pa ni brgyad pas/ brgyad pa'i rigs pa ni bsdigs pas/ bsdigs pa'i rigs pa ni mig tshugs su bltas pas thar bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag gis gang la bsrung ba byas pa'am/ yongs su bskyab 7pa byas pa'am/ yongs su bzung 8ba'am/ bcings pa'am/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba byas pa gzhan du 'gyur ba de ni gnas med de/ lha dang bcas/ bdud dang bcas/97—223

tshangs pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin gyi nang na yang ngas ma mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag ni gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa thams cad las nges par 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rdzogs pa'i rjes la rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rgya cher rgyas par bgyi ba dang / chos smra ba de dag rjes su yongs su gzung ba dang / dam pa'i chos ci nas kyang yun ring du gnas pa dang / bdud thams cad tshar gcad pa'i slad du gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di rnams rjes su stsal bar 'tshal na/bcom ldan 'das kyis de la legs so zhes bgyi ba gnang bar mdzad du gsol/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po 1bzhi la thugs brtse ba'i phyir cang mi gsung bar gyur pas gnang ste/ rgyal po chen po bzhi po de dag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bar gyur pas gnang bar rig nas ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do/ /de ni 'di lta ste/ da naṇ+ḍi/ de naṇ+ḍi/ ma hā naṇ+ḍi2 / dzam+bha ne/ stam+bha ne/ ṭa ṭi/ ṭa ṭa /rine/ ma hā ṭa ṭa 4ne/ kuṭi/kuṣ+ṭa 5ne/ ma hā kus tshine/ dharma le/ tsarma le swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di dag ni gzungs 'di'i 'khor gyi tshig lta bur gda' ba lags te/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la gzungs kyi gsang 7sngags gzhi 'di dag 'dzin pa dang / bzlas te bton nas 'chang ba de ni sngon gyi las ma gtogs par gzhan gyi gnod pa thams cad las 'da' ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad dang 97—224

rjes su mthun 1par 'gyur ro/ /de la ni dam pa'i chos thams cad yongs su gzung ba la yang bar chad 'byung bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag la grogs po dag khyed bstan pa yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo khyod kyis de dag rdzu 'phrul che bar 'gyur ba dang / phan yon che ba dang byin che bar 'gyur ba'i phyir gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di zung 2shig /long 55shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston cig /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rgyas par bgyi ba'i slad du bdag gis gzung 4lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di nyid rgyas par bstan pa'i phyir de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /gzungs sngags kyi ni mdo sde 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa ste/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /de ni ngas kyang bshad pa yin/ /gang zhig gzungs sngags mdo sde 'di/ /'dzin tam yang na klog byed pa/ /tshe rabs nyi shu rtsa gcig tu/ /de ni tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ /gzungs sngags 'di rjod byed de la/ /mi min gang yang rung ba dang / /gnod sbyin grul bum srin po dag / nams kyang rabar chad mi byed do/ /gzungs sngags 'di rjod byed de sgyu la/ /'dod khams dbang phyug gang yin pa/ /sdig can bdud de nam du yang / /bar chad byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzungs sngags 'di 'dzin byed de yi/ /pha ma dang ni phu nu dang / /sring mo mdza' bshes gnyen dag kyang / /log par ltung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir gzungs 97—225

sngags mdo sde 'di/ /'jigs med gang gis thos gyur nas/ /gzungs sngags 'di rjod byed pa des1/ / nams kyang 2'jigs par mi bya'o/ /gzungs sngags 'di 'dzin byed de yi / /bskal pa bye ba stong rnams su/ /sgrib pa'i las ni gang byas pa/ /zhag bdun gyis ni byang bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams gang / /bskal pa bye bar bsgrubs pa kun/ /gzungs sngags 'di 'dzin byed pa des/ /zhag bdun gyis ni zil gyis non/ /phyogs bzhi'i 'jig rten skyong ba po/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag /lus ngan dang ni yul 'khor srung / /mig mi bzang dang 'phags skyes po/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags dang ldan/ /'khor bcas blon bcas de dag kyang / /gzungs sngags 'di ni rjod byed pa/ /de la rtag tu srung bar byed/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang nyan thos chen po de dag dang / 'phags pa byams pa dang / 'jam dpal la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do4/ /'phags pa rig 5sngags kyi rgyal po sgron ma mchog gi gzungs rdzogs so( // //797—226

zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 1༄lda /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a bhi ṣiñca ni nā 2ma dhā ra tī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa dbang bskur rib zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na dge slong brgyad stong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa bye ba sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa rnams dang thabs cig catu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu khyod kyis 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i ma dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sngon gyi spyod pa dang / bden pa'i smon lam dang / byang chub sems dpas g.yongs su bzung 6ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos 'di dag sgoms 7shig /ston cig /97—229

'di lta ste/ gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs ni yul na mi gnas/ phyogs na mi gnas na bcom ldan 'das gzungs gzungs zhes 1bgyi ba la/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs zhes 2bgyi ba 'di'i tshig gi don gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu legs so legs so/ /shā ri'i bu khyod 'di ltar theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa dang / theg pa chen po la mngon par brtson pa dang / theg pa chen po la lhag par bya ba byed pa dang / khyod gzungs yul na mi gnas/ phyogs na mi gnas par ston pa yang legs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu gzungs ni chos nyid kyis 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba ma yin te/ shā ri'i bu gzungs ni 'das pa zhes mi 'chad/ ma 'ongs pa zhes mi 'chad/ da ltar byung ba zhes mi 'chad/ dngos por mi 'chad/ dngos po med par mi 'chad/mtshan ma dang / mtshan ma med par mi 'chad/ chos gang skye ba'i phyir ram/'gag pa'i phyir mi 'chad mod kyi/ shā ri'i bu 'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' la phan par bzhed pa'i phyir ston te/ gang 'di gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs kyi gzungs ni gzugs med pa / bya ba'i lam du gyur pa/ rigs pa'i stobs kyis gnas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan/ sangs rgyas kyi lhag par bya ba sgrub pa / sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims/ sangs rgyas kyi 4bsdus pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshams sbyor ba/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs 97—230

gang la gnas shing / gzungs de thob na byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba dang / dam bca' ba bzang ba dang / chos la mi 1gnas pa dang / bdag the tshom 2ma mchis pa dang / slob dpon ma mchis pa dang / rang gi lam la gnas pa bcom ldan 'das bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bshad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu legs so legs so/ /shā ri'i bu gzungs thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni sangs rgyas nyid du brjod do/ /shā ri'i bu gang la la zhig byang chub sems dpa' gzungs thob pa la bsti 3stang du byed dam/ bla mar byed dam/ rim gror byed dam/ mchod na des sangs rgyas thams cad la bsti 4stang 5byas par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag gis gzungs 'di thos pa dang / gang dag mos pa de dag kyang sangs rgyas rnams ji lta ba de bzhin du mchod pa'i 'os su 'gyur zhing byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu gzungs ni 'di yin te/ san+t+ra ra hā/ ud dhā ra tī/saṃ pra tiṣ+ṭha tane/ su ta ma/ su pra tikhri tā / bi dza 2ya ba wa9/ sarba 1 pra ti 711 / ā ro hā 12dz+nyā na pa ti/ uṅgā 15da nī/ bi 1 nā ma nī/ a bhi ṣiñca ni/a bhi bya dahā rā/ shu bha ba til/ a ni shri 1 ta/ ba hu kum+bha/ a bhi ba tsa/ shā ri'i bu 'di dag ni dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi ming rnams te/'das pa rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa rnams dang / da ltar byung ba rnams dang /legs par gnas pa rnams byang chub sems dpa' gang gis legs par bzung ste/'chang ba de myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i phyir bskal pa brgya dang / bskal pa stong dag smon lam gyis zad par byed par 'gyur/ de 97—231

la mtshon gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ me dang srog chags mi srun pa rnams kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar shā ri'i bu gzungs 'di ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 1kyi yum mo/ /shā ri'i bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las stong gsum gyi stong chen po nagrangs med pa bcu mthar chags su gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams la na bza' dang / zhal zas bzang pos bskal pa grangs med par gzung ba byas pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang gis gzungs 'di las tha na tshig gcig tsam bzung ba de bas ches bsod nams mang du skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu dbang bskur ba'i gzungs 'di ni/ sangs rgyas kyi yum yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs sol// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi lhun mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de neye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa// //797—232

༄zag /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ ta ra ta ra/ ti ri ti ri/ tu ru tu ru/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/bha ya bha ya/ ku ru ku ru/ sarba kurma ā nab ra ṇa dza ni me sha pra bha ya swā hā/ dz+wa la ni bi dha ni bai cig hā/ ku ru pañca 55li swā hā/ sā 56)ga ra saṃ bi re 7sā hā/sarba ta thā ga tā a dhiṣ+ṭha 8te swā hā/ gzungs 'di'i cho ga ni 'di yin te/ nang par langs nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas na zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig lon pa'i tshe las kyi sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur ro/ /spyan lnga yang rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /de la mig nad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lus la nad 97—248

༄༅gi /zla ba'i 'od de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ tsan+de tsan+de/ su tsan+d+ra /ma ti tsan+d+ra/ tsan+d+ra ki dar ṇa/ si ri si ri/ bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha te/ ki li ki li/dharma a tikhri te/ ki li ki li/ saṃ gha a dhiṣ+ṭha te swā hā/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis rtag tu nang par langs te/ zla ba'i 'od de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dran par byed pa de ni bskal pa bzhi khrir tshe rabs dran par 'gyur te/ de ni ngan song du ltung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zla ba'i 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pas yon tan de rnams thob par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba'i 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa rdzogs so // //97wa 253

bya ba'i gzungs/1༄༅ga /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bi ma la nā ma dhā ra ṇi / bod skad du/'phags pa dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na / bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la bzhugs te / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rnam par dag pa la bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rnam par dag pa tshul khrims yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa ting nge 'dzin yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa bzod pa yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa phan pa'i dngos po yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa byams pa yongs su dag pas de 97—259

bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros 1rnam par dag pa snying rje yongs su dag pa dang / dga' ba yongs su dag pa dang / btang snyoms yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa rnam par grol ba yongs su dag pa dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa stobs yongs su dag pa dang / mi 'jigs pa yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag go/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag pa la su zhig me tog dang / phreng ba dang spos dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa dang rol mo'i sgra dang byug pa 2rnams kyis bsti stang du byed pa de'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i mtha' rtogs par mi nus te/de'i mtha' ni theg pa gsum po las theg pa gang yang rung bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar 4thug pa ma gtogs par bsod nams kyi phung po de phyi ma'i mthar yang zad par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ blo gros rnam par dag pa ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos 5thams cad kyi tshad med pa de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 6yon phul ba yang tshad med do/ /mtha' yas so/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /mtshungs pa med do/ /grangs med do/ /dpag gis mi lang ngo / /brjod du med do/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa da ltar bzhugs te/ 'tsho zhing gzhes pa la bsti 7ltang du byed pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang ri mor byed pa dang mchod pa dang rjed 8pa 97—260

dang / phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya tha ma la su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i ring bsrel yungs 'bru tsam la bste 1stang byed pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang ri mor byed pa dang mchod pa dang rjed 2pa dang yang dag par sems nye bar bzhag ste/ byang chub tu gzhol ba'i sems bskyed pas phyag 'tshal ba dang / phyag byed pa dang bsti dastang byed pa dang bla mar byed pa dang / ri mor byed pa dang mchod pa dang rjed 4pa dang gsol pa dang bsngags pa dang / skor sgrub byed pa des phan yon lngar shes par bya ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / rtogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / ngo tsha shes 6shing khrel yod pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang /myur du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'gyur ba dang / mthong nas kyang dad pa skyed par 'gyur ba ste/ phan yon lnga po de dag tu shes par bya'o/ /de las gzhan yang chos bzhir shes par bya ste/ bzhi 7gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa'i tshig so sor 'dzin pa dang / de dag kyang ji skad bstan pa bzhin du sgrub pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nye bar 'gyur ba dang / myur du sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par skye bar 'gyur ba ste/ chos bzhi po de dag yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na bdud dam bdud kyi ris dkyi lha'i bu rnams kyis mi rdzi 9bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ rigs che ba dang / btsas ma thag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams yid la byed pa dang / phyi ma'i dus na dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dang / rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin 97—261

gyis brlab 1par 'gyur ba ste/ blo gros rnam par dag pa byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na bdud dam bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis mi rdzi 2bar 'gyur ro/ /blo gros rnam par dag pa byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten mthong nas dad pa bskyed de/ pus mo gnyis ku'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas phyag 'tshal te / de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu ri rtsa gnyis kyis sku legs par brgyan pa de ci 'dra bar bdag kyang de 'dra ba'i lus thob par gyur cig ces de ltar mos pa bskyed na/ blo gros rnam par dag pa bsod nams kyi phung po de'i mtha' brjod par mi nus te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la gnas pa'i 4phyir ro/ /bsod nams kyi phung po de ni rgyal po nyid dam/ brgya byin nyid dam/ tshangs pa nyid dam/ nyan thos nyid dam/rang sangs rgyas nyid dam/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis 5kyang zad par byar mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ blo gros rnam par dag pa rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo des bsod nams kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su bzung ba yin te/ blo gros rnam par dag pa 'di lta ste/ dper na de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa grong khyer du 'jug gam/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ grong du 'jug kyang rung / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du rgyu yang rung / 'chag kyang rung / 'greng yang rung / 'dug kyang rung /chos ston kyang rung / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can lha'am/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ dri za'am/ lha ma yin nam/97—262

nam mkha'i 1)lding ngam/ mi'am ci'am/ lto 'phye chen po'am/ mi'am/ mi ma yin pa'am/ shing ngam/ ri'am/ khung bu'am/ bya skyibs kyang rung ste/thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba de 5logs su 'dud pa dang / rab tu 'dud pa dang / kun du 'dud pa mi byed pa de gang yang med de/ ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang ldan pa la byed pa de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ yul 'khor ram/ pho brang 'khor na rgyu ba la sems can rnams 'dud / rab tu 'dud/ kun du rab tu 'dud par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a mi tā/ ma te pra bhe/ ma hā pra bhe/pra bha ba ti/ pra bha ba ti/ pra bha ba ti/ pra bha ba ti/ pra bha ba ti/ pra bha ba ti / pra bha ba ti/ pra bha ba ti/ pra bha ba ti/ pra bha ba ti/ bcom ldan 'das mthus bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das mthus bstan du gsol/tar+ya thā she/ ma ti ma ti/ ma ti ma ti/ ma ti ma ti/ ma ti ma ti/ ma ti ma ti/ smṛ ti/ smṛ ti/ smṛ ti/ smṛ ti/ smṛ ti/ smṛ ti/ smṛ ti/ smṛ ti/ smṛ ti/smṛ tiri / ma hā smri 5ti/ ma hā smri 6ti / ma hā smri nati/ chags pa mi mnga' ba gti mug bsal 9tu gsol/ so me/ so me/ so me so me so me so me / so me/ so me/ so me/ so me/ sau 1 ma na su mu pa na ya/ sau 11ma na su mu pa na ya/ sau 12ma na su mu pa na ya/ sau 1 ma na su mu pa na ya1 / sau 15ma na su mu pa na ya/ sau tsham na su mu pa na ya/ sau 1 ma na su mu pa na ya/ sau 18ma na su mu pa na ya/ sau 19ma na su mu pa na ya/ sau 2 ma na su mu pa na ya/ shi khi shi khi / shi khi shi khi/ shi khi shi khi/ shi khi shi khi/ shi khi shi khi/ zhi bar gyur cig /97—263

nad med par gyur cig1 /bgegs med par gyur cig /pra bha ba ti/ ma hā mkhye / rasmi/ rasmi/ rasmi/ rasmi/ rasmi/ rasmi/ rasmi/ rasmi/ rasmi/rasmi / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gi mtshan kyang gzung (5)bar bya zhing phyag bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung gnas dang /bcom ldan 'das rin chen nyi ma dang / bcom ldan 'das rin chen bla ma dang / bcom ldan 'das rin chen mkhregs cadang / bcom ldan 'das rin chen tog dang / bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'od 'phro dang / bcom ldan 'das rin chen mthu dang / bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med dang / bcom ldan 'das dbyangs dpag med dang /bcom ldan 'das thub dka' dang / bcom ldan 'das grags pa mtha' yas dang / bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'od dang / bcom ldan 'das bde chen brnyes dang / bcom ldan 'das skar ma'i 'od dang / bcom ldan 'das bden dbyangs dang / bcom ldan 'das nad kyi dri ma bral ba dang / bcom ldan 'das zla ba dkar dang / bcom ldan 'das dri ma med pa'i 'od dang /bcom ldan 'das nyi ma dkar ba dang / bcom ldan 'das nyi ma'i 'od dang /bcom ldan 'das 'od dag pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rin chen mtha' yas dang / bcom ldan 'das rin chen snying po dang / bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ba dang / bcom ldan 'das zla ba'i sgron ma dang / bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i sde dang / bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i sgra dang / bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i mchog dang / bcom ldan 'das yon tan mchog dang / bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dang / bcom ldan 'das tshangs pa'i dbang phyug rgyal po dang /97—264

lhun po dang / bcom ldan 'das ri rab lta bu'o/ /tar+ya thā/ pa ta pa ta/da ma da ma/ gha ma gha ma swā hā/ shar phyogs logs na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa gang dag bzhugs pa 'dren pa de dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag gis kyang bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la nad med pa dang / zhi bar bsrung du gsol/ lho phyogs logs na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs pa 'dren pa de dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag gis kyang bdag la nad med pa dang zhi bar bsrung 17du gsol/ /nub phyogs logs na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs pa 'dren pa de dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de dag gis kyang bdag la nad med pa dang / zhi bar bsrung du gsol/ byang phyogs logs na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs pa 'dren pa de dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag gis kyang bdag la nad med pa dang / zhi bar bsrung du gsol/ 'og gi phyogs logs na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs pa 'dren pa de dag la phyag 'tshal lo de dag gis kyang bdag la nad med pa dang / zhi bar bsrung du gsol/ steng gi phyogs logs na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs pa 'dren pa mide dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag gis kyang bdag la nad med pa dang / zhi bar bsrung du gsol/ phyogs mtshams logs na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs pa 'dren pa de dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag gis kyang bdag la nad med pa dang / zhi bar bsrung du gsol/ tar+ya thā/ bi ma le ri/bi ma lā ka re bi ma la saṃ bha be swā hā/ bi ma le/ bi ma le/ bi ma le/ bi ma le bi ma le bi ma le bi ma le bi ma le bi ma le bi ma le 97—266

bya ba'i gzungs/1༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bi she nag ba ti nā ma dhā ra tī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa khyad par can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das sprul gyi lo'i dgun zla ra ba'i 4tshes nyi shu la yul phug 5ron can na/ grong khyer sastso 6zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe dge slong tshe brjod ces bya ba don zhig gi phyir grong khyer gnas song zhes bya bar song ste/ dge slong de rgya yul gyi grong khyer nas dpag tshad brgya'i lam du phyin pa dang / dge slong des par der mi lus chen po khrun du mtho 7sum cu 8yod pa/ bzhin mtho bzhi pa zhig rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dge slong tshe brjod 9des mi de lta bu de la 'di snyam du bsams 1 te / kye ma mi 'di ni lus che ste/ 'di ni 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa yin 97—270

du nges so snyam nas/ des pus mo gnyi ga'i lha nga sa la btsugs 1te/ mi lus chen po ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ mi lus chen po de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ji khyod 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ste/ 'di na gda' 'aman/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ dge slong de de bzhin no/ /dge slong des smras pa/ 'jam dpal khyod ci'i slad du 'di na gda'/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas smras pa/ dge slong 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sems can rnams la nad rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung ste/ gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za rnams ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi ngos gcig la gnas so/ /des nyi 4zla'i 'od kyang mi mngon/ nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar 5rnams kyang nam mkha'i bar skabs na 6mi snang ngo / /de'i tshe lha dang / lha ma yin kyang g.yul 'gyed de/ g.yul bkye ba dang lha rnams ni pham/ lha ma yin rnams ni rgyal te/ de'i tshe 'byung po dang / yi dgas rnams bud med kyi gzugs kyis sems can rnams la nad gtong ste/'di lta ste/ lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang / 'brum phran dang / me dbal dang /lto na ba dang / rims nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / rlung las gyur pa dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa dang / bad kun las gyur pa dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa dang /klad pa na ba dang / phol mig dang / g.yan pa dang / tshad pa dang / mig nad la sogs pa nye bar sgrub bo/ /'di lta ste/ char che ba dang / than pa dang / dus ma yin pa'i char gyis lo tog phun sum tshogs pa'i 'ongs 'phrog /sems can rnams kyi mdangs 'phrog /tshe dang / stobs dang / mdog dang /97—271

gzugs 'phrog ste/ de'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling na sems can thams cad nad sna tshogs kyis yongs su nyen to/ /gtum po seng ge dang / spyang ki ( 17dang / stag dang / sprul la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis sems can rnams kyi mdangs 'phrog ste / 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams la dus ma yin par chud rinaza bar nye bar gnas pas sems can rnams nad las thar bar bya ba 90yang dka' pa ste/'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sems can rgan pa dang / bar ma dang / gzhon pa dag las dkrigs 5phrag sum cu 6'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir nga dge slong khyod kyi gan du 'ongs kyis/ khyod kyis 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad la chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sgrogs shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'dzam bu'i 7gling pa'i sems can thams cad ni 'di snyam du bdag cag ji ltar sdug bsngal gyis bcings pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur snyam du re ba'i phyir ro/ /de lta bas na dge slong khyod kyis sems can thams cad la mdo 'di sgrogs te/ sems can thams cad la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i phyir nan tan gyis shig /dkon mchog gsum la rtag par rgyun du dad par gyis shig /lha rinarjed cig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten rnams sam/ sku gzugs rnams la spos dang / me tog dang / bdug pa rnams kyis mchod par gyis shig /khyad par can gyi gzungs kyang lhogs shig /nyi ma bdun yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong la nye bar gnas par gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa blo yangs zab mo 'brug bsgrags rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ bi pu la gardzi te/ bi pu la swā re/ bi pu la yo ni she/ a na la se/ a na la saṃ bha be/a na la sa ga ti ga te swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa sgrib pa thams cad rnam 97—272

par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ he ma he ma/ ha ma ha ma swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ a mi tosgo 1be/a mi ta saṃ bha be/ a mi ta bi krurnyenano/ a mi ta bi krurnyi dzo dka re/ a mi ta ga ga na krirti ka re swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ ga ga na a ka ra/ ga ga na saṃ bha be/ ga ga na krirti ka re swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas spos mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ sa ma sa me swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug bsgrags gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ a sa ma sa me swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa nga rgyal gnon pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ma na (9bi shurnye/ pad+me shwa re/ pad+ma saṃ bha be/ kiṅka re/ hi tai ka rī 5yi swā hā/sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ shwe ta ka ra rnyitsi/dz+wa li ne ga kyiswā hā/ rdza bha ne/ s+t+waṃ bha ne/ mo ha ne swā hā/ poṇ+ḍa 8ri kā ya swā hā/ho me dharme(3)/ dharmā tsin+ta yi khog hā/ dha re bhi dha re/ ka la piṅka ru tā yi 11swā hā/shārnyeX / khrisne/ nir+bha pa khye 1 swā hā/ dhu ru dhu ru/ bi du ru dhi ye swā hā/ bi ma la pra botsun+t+ra yi skaswā hā/ a ba lo ki ta/ bi lo ke tā yi saswā hā/ ā dz+nyā n+ya 1 bi dha ma s+t+ya /ltaswā hā/ pad+ma swa re/ pad+ma saṃ bha be/ kiṅka re hi taṅka rī 19ye swā hā/sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā / tsan+d+ra pra bhe/ tsan+d+ra na gar+bhe/ tsan+d+ra na tsurje / ke kai 2nyal sa ba ti/ sarba bud+dha / a dhiṣ+ṭha 2ta a nu mo di te swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa 97—273

'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ dza ye dza ye/ dza ya la dhe(1)/ dza ya ma hā ma he swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ ga ga na arle/ ga ga na sa muṅga 2te/ ga ga na bi grwan+ta/ bi mādhe/ e dzi me dzi/ pad+mo dzi swā hā/byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ he bha dre/ma hā bha dre/ a 4ti bha dre/ sa man+ta bha dre/ gabi ga ta rā dza sene/ ma hā bi ga ta rā dza se/ a ti bi ga ta rā dza se/ he ma ba ti/ kurma ā 7ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo /tar+ya thā/ mi tri mi natri/ me 9 tri 1 ma na se swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ gar+bhe gar+bhe gar+bhe/gar+bha bi sho dha ne swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa blo gros mi zad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ a k+ṣa ye nu/ a k+ṣa ye phu/ a k+ṣa ya kurma 11bi sho dha ne phu swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med par grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ shīrti tā sarba dzi 1 ni1ri/ a bhi krirti 7ta/ sarba dzi rna'i/ badz+ra a ka re/badz+ra saṃ bha be/ badz+ra be dā ka re swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ sarba ā tshab ra ṇa bi sko bhe s+t+ya 1 swā hā/ dhā tu bi ka ra tram̐ swā hā/ me gha bi spo 1 ṭa me swā hā/ a pa rā 19dzi ta kā yi 2 swā hā/ ba la ge da da h+ye 25swā hā/ bo ṣ+ṭha da da s+t+ya na swā hā/ kurma nir+bha bi ta kā yi swā hā/ e kā rā mā yi swā hā/ yo gā mutsā rā yi swā hā/ sarba bud dhā bhi ṣik+ta 26yi swā hā/ bra d+mo pa ku tā 2 yi swā hā/ sarba dharmā bhi /ṣik+ta 29yi swā hā/sarba bud+dha a bhi ṣik+ta yi swā hā/ e ka 1thiṅgā yi naswā hā/ a ra shriṅgā yi swā hā/97—274

bhū hu)tā yi swā hā/ a saṃ bhū tā na yi sa swā hā/ sarba duḥkho pra la sha ma s+t+ya 5swā hā/ zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ tsan+d+ra pra rtse6/ su pra bhe/pra bhā 79ka re/ pra sgota nate/ pra ston te9/ pra bha ba ti/ pra bha ba ti /dharma bi shudhe/ kurmā 511bi shud+dhir+bha ba tu me 1ཿswā hā/ tshe brjod 1lhagang la la zhig rig 1byusngags 'dis nyin zhag bdun du nyin lan bdun mtshan lan bdun du byab pa byas na/ de'i las kyi sgrib pa ma lus par rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong bdun la zas sbyin no/ /me las me spel bar bya'o/ /mtshan mo mar me thogs te mchod rten la bsti stang lodu byas la bskor labar bya'o/ /dam pa'i chos bri ba dang / bklag 1 pa la brtson par bya'o/ /gal te yams kyi nad cher byung nas khyim nas khyim dang / grong nas grong dang / grong khyer nas grong khyer du gan dha ra sa'i bdug pa dang / gtor ma dang / lha bshos kyis mchod par bya'o / /nad pa gang yin pa des kyang cho ga 'di bzhin du byas na de myur du nad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas dge slong tshe brjod 18la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin tam/ klog gam/ yi ger 'dri 'am/ yi ger 'drir 'jug gam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston na de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ yang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas dge slong tshe brjod 19la 'di skad ces smras so/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ci nas skye bo thams cad kyi rna lam du grag 2 par 'gyur bar yul nas yul dang / grong khyer nas grong khyer dang / grong nas grong du bskur 1bar bya'o/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur 97—275

pas dge slong tshe brjod 1la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe brjod (5ririgs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la las chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lan cig 5)bklags (4non/ de bdag nyid thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sus lan gnyis bklags (5)na de bu dang chung ma dang lhan cig thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sus lan gsum bklags 6)na de rtsa lag gi skye bo dang bcas te thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sus lan bzhi bklags 7rin de yul 'khor thams cad kyang thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sus lan lnga bklags (5)na de nye 'khor gyi rgyal po dang bcas pa 9thar bar 'gyur ro/ /yang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas dge slong tshe brjod 1 la 'di skad ces smras so/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 11myur du yul gzhan dag 12tu bskur bar bya ste/ der yang yon tan 'di dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe brjod tu gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos la mi 'dzin tam/ mi klog gam/ yi ger mi 'dri 'am/ yi ger 'drir mi 'jug gam/ kun chub par mi byed dam/ gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par mi ston tam/ yul gzhan du mi 'byin tam/ sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ mi nyan tam/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su mi bsngo na mtshams 1 med pa lnga byed pa rnams kyi 'gro ba ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar de mngon par 'grub ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis smad pa'o/ /yang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas dge slong tshe brjod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe brjod 5su zhig 'di tshad mar mi byed pa tshede ni ngas thog ma nyid du dad par byas pa 1 ma yin no/ /'di ltar 'dzam bu'i 1 gling pa'i sems can thams cad bde bar 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir nga ri'i rgyal po ri rab la song ste/ lha dang dri za rnams la rjes su bstan pa dang mthun 3697—276

〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rjod/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gzung / (nya〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sto/ ri ni〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'a:rdo—/ ⑦〈〈co 〉〉bcad/ (8)〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 skar zhus/ 〈〈pe 〉〉 skar zhugs/bsdur 'bras re'u migagazungs 'dus/ (5༷༷)97wa 279

khug /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 1ra༄tshog /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das snying rje'i tsan+dan dri zhim po'i spos kyis byugs pa'i sku/ zhabs pad+ma lha dang lha ma yin gyi nor bu'i cod pan can gyis gtugs pa/ rang byung ltasel mdzad/ bla ma/ 'jig rten thams cad la phan par na mdzad pa/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa/ thub pa nyes pa dang bral ba/ zhi ba'i bdag nyid can/gzugs mdzes pa/ mtshan gsal ba'i gzi brjid can/ sku dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ yon tan thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma rgyas pa ltar zhal bzhad de/ tshems dkar zhing snyoms la thags bzang bas rab tu rgyas shing snang la nor bu dri ma med pa ltar 'od gsal zhing mdzes te/ spa zhing gsal ba/ nyi ma 4'od zer stong 'bar ba mang po'i 'od snang ba'i dkyil 97—280

'khor zil gyis gnon pa/ thub pa'i mchog stobs bcu dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dud do/ /rab tu 'dud do/ /bstod do/ o bho hūm̐ hūm̐/ ā ā/tī tī/ shi ba shi ba/ shārnyi shārnyi/ sha ma sha ma/ sha mā 1pa ya/ ta thā ga tā 2nu ga ta/ swa bhā ba/ a bhā dab/ sa mut+ta 4ya/ a sa ma pa la sa bi ra la ba la/ a mi ta ba la/ a ti ba la/ hūm̐ 55lha s+t+waṃ/ dhi kau/ bh+ri :/ sgre du sgre du / tī tī/ bha ga bān/ bha 6bān ta ka su ra ta bho ga ma hā shārnyi 7ka ra/ pā pa kilbi ṣa nā 58)sha ka swā hā/ de nas dpe byad mtshan gsal bas/ /yan lag thams cad rab brgyan cing / /nyi ma bzhin du gsal ba po 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyan mnga' ba/ /grags shing dri ma rab spangs la/ /dri med skyon bral chos kyi blo/ /khyab bdag chen po'i stobs bcur ldan/ /rdul bral dpal dang ldan pa po/ /rin chen sa gzhi chen po la/ /pho brang rtse mo rdo rje'i rtse/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams gnas gyur pa/ /nor bu du ma rab 'phro zhing / /'od zer dri med gsal bkod pa'i/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor pho brang na/ /thub bi'i 9longs spyod sa gzhi la/ /seng ge'i khri chen yangs la bzhugs/ /nor bu dbyig gi sa gzhi dang / /khri chen rab spa 1 de nyid la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes chen gyis/ /phun sum tshogs pa rgyan bkod lta11/ /thub pa me zla nor bu'i 'od//nyi zer non pa'i 'od ldan pa/ /bde blag shin tu bkra shis tshul/ /'od gsal skyil 32mo krung /lhabacas nas/ /sku 'od 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor can/ /'od gsal rgyas pa 'thub dbang gi/ /dri med 'od zer bkye ba ni/ /mi g.yo rdo rje can zhes bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs pa yi/ /rdo rje can dag rab btul ba/ /gang yin de kun dag byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor dri med skor bar 97—281

byed / /ngan song dam tshig dri ma kun/ /legs par shin tu dag byas nas/ /srid gsum dkyil 'khor rgya che ba/ /rnam pa du mar 'od gsal ba/ /'gro dang mi 'gro ma lus pa/ /bskor nas bde chen rdo rje can/ /rdo rje ral gri thogs pa de / /cod pan ma g.yos nang du zhugs/ /de nas 'jigs pa'i sgra skad kyis/ /'gengs shing mig ni glog 1ltar 'gyu/ /rig sngags hūm̐ zhes sgrogs pa po/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs byed pa/ /bzhin tsho mdzes 'dzum gyis rnam par brgyan/ / sdig med mig rtsa rgod gyur cing / /stan las langs te phyag 'tshal nas/ /legs par mchod byas smras pa ni/ /kye ma skye ba'i phyogs 'joms shing / /bskal pa du ma'i dri ma sel/ /rig sngags yon tan sgrub byed pa/ /thub mchog rnams kyis rab tu gsungs/ /de gzigs dge ba du ma brnyes/ /sangs rgyas blo gros rgyas par gyur ri/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros che/ /bskal pa gcig tu spyod pas kyang / /brgyud mar sangs rgyas kun 'byung zhing / /spyod pa du ma 'byung ba yi/ /yon tan brgya yi 55spos ldan 'di/ /thos pa 6)spro bar mi nus so//longs spyod rgya mtsho chen po can/ /byang chub sems mchog dkyil 'khor du/ /rgyal mchog rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i chos can ldan/ /'di thos sangs rgyas spyod pa yi/ /sems can kun gyi sdig pa rnams/ /ma lus rab tu bsal 7rinas ni/ /blo chen dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhi zhing dag byed bkra shis la/ /rdul med brgyan 8te zhi bar byed/ /dge zhing mya ngan thams cad sel/ /sdug bsngal thams cad nges par 'joms/ /dbang byed gsang sngags dam pa ste/ /sa stengs smyo sdig pa thams cad sel/ /ma smad 'bras bu nges par sbyin/ /bstan pa yin te sdang ba 'dul/ /nyes pa byas pa sel ba 97—282

yin / /gzungs 'di gang gis thos 91gyur de/ /sangs rgyas rnyed par 2dka' ba yang / /ring por mi thogs thob par 'gyur/ /sgrib pa thams cad rab zhi zhing / /khyab bdag nyon mongs kun sel ba/ /gang zhig nyon mongs zhi byed pa'i / /gzungs 'di 'chang bar byed pa yis/ /kun du bzang po nyid dang ni/ /lag na rdo rje nyid kyang 'thob/ /rig sngags 'chang gi bdag po yang / /'di thos pas ge ni thob par 'gyur/ /'jig rten kun na lam me ba/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad kyang / /dkyil 'khor dam pa gting med pa/ /'di ni ji srid ma gsan par/ /rab zhi nyon mongs 'dul ba yi/ /rang 'byung go 'phang ma brnyes te/ /rnam par dag phyir gsan gyur nas/ /gsan ma thag tu rnam par dag /de phyir phun sum tshogs pa dang / /legs par 'dod pas brjod par bya/ /gzhan gyis mi thub gzungs gsan nas/ /thub pa kun gyis gang brnyes pa/ /'khor ba 'dir ni nam du yang / /bdud kyi las dang 'khrug med dang / /mya ngan med cing 'thab med pa/ /gzungs la gnas pas thob par 'gyur / /gnas kyi dam pa thob nas kyang / /thub pa dri ma med pa'i blo/ /gzigs pa bzang rnams gar gshegs pa'i/ /bzang 'gro der ni 'gro bar 'gyur / /legs pa 'dod pa rnams kyis ni/ /tshig gi mdo 'di mnyan par gyis / /nyon mongs zad par bya ba la/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i gzungs 'di mchog ri /sdig pa byed cing dge la sdang / /sdig pa'i rang bzhin rab 'jungs pa / /gang gis thos nas de spong ba/ /nga yis 5mngon sum 'byor par 'gyur/ /sdig pa gzhan yang mi bya zhing / /snga ma rnams kyang bshags 6par bya/ /gzungs mchog 'di yi mthu stobs kyis/ /sdig pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur//97—283

tshe rabs gzhan ni stong dag dang / /tshe rabs bye ba phrag brgyar yang / /sdig pa mi dge gang byas pa/ /dag 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /yar gyi ngo yi (1)tshes brgyad dang / /de bzhin tshes ni bcwa 97lnga la/ /bsnyen gnas legs par lhur blangs la/ /cho ga bzhin du sangs rgyas mchod/ /de nas rmongs pa med par yang / /nyon mongs dgra ni rab 'joms shing / /shin tu thub dka' dpe med pa / /nyes pa zlog pa'i gzungs brjod na/ /thub pa'i zhal gyi zla ba'i 'od/ /'bar ba nges par mthong bar 'gyur/ / des na ( nitshogs rnams rdzogs pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i sras po nyid du 'gyur/ /'od dpag med la mnga' ba yi/ /yon tan mtha' yas rab rgyas pa/ /bskal pa bye ba stong du yang / /mtha' mi rtogs pa thob par 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin gyi tshig /dkyil 'khor dag na gnas rnams kyis/ /thos nas rgyan rnams sna tshogs pa/ /bcom ldan 'das la 'bul bar byed/ /rdo rje ral gri la sogs pa/ /lha bdag gsal ba thams cad dang /ri bo ti se'i ri rab la/ /gnas pa'i rig sngags 'chang rnams dang / /de bzhin dkyil 'khor chen po na/ /'khod pa'i rig sngags 'chang rnams dang / /ma la ya yi ri bo la/ /gnas shing rgyan 'bar thogs rnams dang / /khyab 'jug lha chen la sogs pa/ /lha yi bdag po rnams dang ni/ /lag na rdo rje la sogs pa / /byang chub sems dpa' stobs chen rnams/ /nor bu'i 4 dpung rgyan rna cha dang / /rgyan rnams rab tu g.yo ba'i lus/ /rab tu bskyod de langs nas ni/ /sdig bral mnga' bdag rgyal ba la/ /phyag 'tshal thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /kun gyis sa yi dbang phyug po/ /thub mchog dam pa de la ni/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dag gis bstod/ /mnyam nyid chos te de bzhin nyid/ /shin tu rtogs pa lam 97—284

me ba/ /dul ba brtan pa dri ma sel/ /dri ma med pa skyon bral ba/ /thub pa sangs rgyas shin tu zhi/ /'jig rten mgon po skye dgu'i bdag /de bzhin gshegs pa nyon mongs thul/ /de bzhin rgyal ba rdul bsal ba/ /ston pa ston mdzad brtan pa ste/ /sdig pa med pa rdul dang bral/ /'jig rten mgon mdzad snang mdzad pa/ /dag pa zhi ba zas gtsang sras/ /nyon mongs rab bcom phan 'dogs pa/ /ston pa po ste dri ma sel/ /spyod tshul dri med tshul bzang ba/ /zab pa rnam par gnon pa brtan/ /btsan 1po thugs brtse rnam par rgyal/ /mgon po de bzhin mgon mdzad pa/ /zhi ba'i bdag nyid zhe sdang bral / /bcings pa las grol nges par grol/ /'jig rten kun mchog 'khra ba'i sa / /bdag gir mi 'dzin dri ma med/ /ngan song sel nab dpal dang ldan/ /dpal mdzad de bzhin phan pa mdzad/ /mnyam pa med pa dpe med pa/ /khyab bdag nyon mongs las rnams spong / /khengs pa med pa dman pa med / /mnyam pa de bzhin mi mnyam mnyam/ /snang ba brnyes pa snang byed med/ /'jig rten snang mdzad sdig med pa/ /sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa ste/ /'jig rten kun la phan par brtson/ /dpa' bo zhi ba zhi mdzad pa/ /nyon mongs dgra rnams zad par mdzad/ /mnga' bdag thabs mkhyen 4thabs che ba/ /sems can kun gyi 'khya sa lags/ /don yod rnyed dka' blo dang ldan/ /rdo rje'i 55dkyil 'khor thub par dka'/ /skyob pa 'jigs sel tshangs pa ste/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas chos 'dzin pa/ /dpa' bo chen po 'jigs pa med/ /gzugs bzang mtshan rnams gsal ba ste/ /sum cu 6rtsa gnyis mtshan mnga' ba//chos kyi longs spyod rgya mtsho lags/ /dpe byad bzang po bkod pa yis/ /spras 97—285

pa'i bdag nyid ya mtshan ston/ /dka' 91)ba med pa'i ston pa po/ /de bzhin des pa bde sbyin pa/ /mthu can yangs pa rgya che ba/ /bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams sel mdzad pa/ /brtson chen spro ba che ba ste/ /dgyes rin pa chen po stobs po che/ /mthu brnyes brtan pa da chen po ste/ /gnas ldan dbang gis dar ba lags / /gsal ba gsung ldan dpe med pa/ /dge (4)ba stong pa nyid kyis rgyal/ /rab tu zhi ba mun pa med/ /blo gros chen po chos 'dzin pa/ /phun sum tshogs ldan sa chen brnyes/ /'dod pa rnams ni 'dul mdzad pa/ /dpal mdzad dpal mnga' dpal dang ldan/ /dpal gyis longs spyod shin tu rgyas/ /bcom ldan legs bsgos bsgo 5bar mdzad/ /gsung ldan bkra shis rgyal ba'i gnas/ /mnyam nyid mnyam pa nyid mkhyen pa/ /mnyam pa nyid kyis mtshan dpag med/ /rab tu dgyes pa longs spyod gsal/ /gzhi bcas sems pa mnyam pa lags/ /blo dag blo ldan dri ma spangs/ /gnas chen brtan par ldan pa ste/ /rgyas par 6longs spyod dri ma med/ /thub pa thugs rje'i rgyan mnga' ba/ / skal ba 77bzang po 'jigs pa'i skyabs/ /de bzhin 'jigs med nyon mongs sel/ /dri med skyon bral longs spyod can/ /sna tshogs 'od ldan dkyil 'khor mdzes/ /sku bzang dge ba'i rim pa mchog /thugs rje'i 'od ldan 'od bzang ba mi gnas longs spyod dam pa lags/ /chos kyi rgyu ste yon tan gnas/ /rjed 'os mchog gnas longs spyod che/ /nam mkha' mtshan te rnam dag blo/ /rin chen gzugs 'dra bkra shis pa/ /khyu mchog che spyan ba rdzi ma/ /rgyal ba skyon bsal 8shes rab can/ /shes rab thabs dang ldan pa ste/ /'jig rten mi dge kun las 'das/ /dag par longs spyod brtan 9)pa can/ /sa dang stobs dang ye 97—286

shes bzod/ /pha rol phyin pa kun la mnga'/ /ting 'dzin mnyam par longs spyod pa/ /rnam thar sgo la mngon sum pa/ /gtong ba sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam / /chos chen bde bar 'char ba lags/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i yul las 'das/ /spyod yul sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po rgyal/ /dam pa'i don te tshul che ba/ /shes bya'i yul rnams mtha' dag la/ /sgrib pa med par 'char ba brnyes/ /rigs chen mthun 1)par skyes pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i nadage ba'i gnas/ /khyad par brnyes pa mnyam nyid brnyes/ /mi mnyam sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /don chen shin tu mthar phyin pa/ /nyon mongs bral ba thub par dka'/ /dge sbyong sdig pa sbyong mdzad pa/ /gnod pa med par bde bar 'byin/ /blo rgya che ba thams cad mkhyen/ /thos pa'i mtshon cha ma lus gsan/ /dkon pa bde bar thob 'gyur ba/ /mnyam dpa khyad par yul dang ldan/ /'jig rten thams cad dar mdzad mgon/ /zhi gnas mtshon cha thub par dka'/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bsam yas yul/ /dpe med pa ste dper bya ba/ /'od bzang rab dgyes dpal dang ldan/ /legs gsung blo yi stobs kyis 'byung / /mkhas pa zhal bzang bde sbyin pa/ /rab dgyes 'das pa'i spyod yul can/ /gsung ba chen po ye shes che/ /gnas chen bkra shis chen po ste5ri/ /mchod par gyur pa yul las 'das/ /bya ba'i mtshan nyid med pa po/ /sangs rgyas yul du skyes pa ste/ /shes bya'i spyod yul rgya che ba/ /kun mkhyen longs spyod 'bras bu can/ /'jig rten dbang 'das spyod yul ba/ /kun mkhyen yul gyi snang ba ste/ /thabs mnga' phun sum tshogs ldan pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rol pa'i thabs dang ldan/ /chos kyi gar thabs ston pa po/ /rab ston 97—287

yon tan sgyur mdzad pa/ /spyod pa ma lus 'dul bar mdzad/ /yongs su rdzogs pa rnam par dag /sangs rgyas spyod yul rnam sangs rgyas/ /bgegs byed 1ma legs byed pa bcom/ /bdud kyi 2dregs pa sel bar mdzad / /g.yul ngor rnam par rgyal ba brnyes/ /dpa' bo chen po pham med stobs/ /theg pa chen po'i 4shing rta bcibs/ /blo chen rgal bar dka' ba yi/ /nyon mongs rgya mtsho'i pha 5rol gshegs/ /theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas/ /theg pa mchog la longs spyod pa/ /nyan thos 'das pa'i spyod yul can/ /rang rgyal las kyang 'das pa ste/ /sangs rgyas sa yi 'bras bur gnas/ /gong nas gong du khyad par mkhyen/ /khyod ni nam mkha'i gnas na bzhugs/ /bde 'byung sa dang zhing rnams kyi/ /mtsho chen dag la longs par spyod/ /sangs rgyas dbang po rgyas pa la/ /mtshan brgya 6rtsa brgyad kyis bstod nas/ /de la lha sogs tshogs rnams kyis/ /phyag byas mgo smad phyogs gcig 'khod/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po na/ /gnas pa ma lus chem mer 'khod/ /thod du rdo rje'i thod 'ching ba/ /langs nas cod pan rab tu g.yos/ /dkyil 'khor mthon po thams cad du/ /skad ber chen pos yongs bkang 7nas/ /nor bu'i rgyan ni rnam g.yo 8zhing / /ha ha grags pa'i sgra sgrogs te/ /kye ma sangs rgyas yon tan che / /bskal pa grangs med gsum bsags pa/ /byang chub sems sogs 9mchog rnams kyis/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad legs par brjod/ /kye ma rnyed dang bde 'byung ba/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad thos nas kyang / /gang zhig klog cing rgyal la bstod/ /'bras bu chen po 'grub par 'gyur/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags 1 bcas pa/ /bcom ldan 'das drung brjod na ni/ /sgrib dang kun nas 97—288

nyon mongs dang / /sdig pa thams cad dag pa 'thob/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad mchog bton na/ /sgrib pa kun las nges grol zhing / /nyon mongs mtha' dag rnam par spong / /shes rab chen po nyid du 'gyur/ /de ni longs spyod chen po dang / /bde ba las kyang nyams mi 'gyur/ /de ni 1tshe rabs thams cad du/ /blo ldan tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje'i thod 'ching ba/ /yon tan mtha' yas sras de la/ /bcom ldan bdud las rgyal ba yis/ /mngon sum gzigs nas bka' stsal pa/ /rgyal ba'i sa 'di zhi ba ste/ /nga rgyal la sogs nyon mongs 'joms/ /'jig rten bde ba kun las 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs bde mngon du phyogs/ /gzhan gyis mi tshugs gzungs dang ni/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad nyan byed pa/ /de dag rnam dag bdag nyid de/ /sems can kun la bde 'dod pa/ /lan cig thos pa tsam gyis kyang / /de dag sa chen 'bras bur gnas/ /ring por mi thogs dga' ri'agyur na/ /'chang sogs dzo ralta la ci zhig smos/ /de phyir rtag tu rab bsgrims la/ /gtan cadu bde ba 'dod pa yis/ /yon tan rgya 5mtsho ldan 6pa'i gzungs/ /mnyan par bya zhing bcang bar bya/ /gang zhig nang par langs nas brjod/ /bdag nyid kyis kyang bton na ni/ /de yi don kun 'grub 'gyur la/ /gnod pa dang yang phrad 7mi 'gyur/ /'di ni yon tan kun gyi snodan/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs sbyin pa/ /kun mkhyen bla med 'bras bu'i mchog /bde 'byung thob par byed pa yin/ /'bras bu 'byor pa ci yang rung / /thob par mi 'gyur dogs pa med/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang thob gyur nas/ /dpe med gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de ni dge zhing 'bras bur ldan/ /sangs rgyas sa yi 'bras bu sbyin/ /yid du 'ong 97—289

zhing yon tan ldan/ /snying rje dri ma med sbyin pa/ /'di ni mnyam pa nyid kyi mdo / /'jig rten kun nas dga' ba ste/ /'jig rten kun gyi bde 'byung ba/ /'di dang 'dra ba gang yang med/ /ston pa sangs ༄ga /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 1༄zag /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na maḥsarba bud+dha/ bo 95ridhi sa tā 3rna/ sa man+ta a mo gha/ a pra ti ha ta/ shā cas nā 5rimā/ na ma ri ri.ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ ma hā bo snyi satā ya/ badz+ra satā ya/ badz+ra bi pu lā ya / pad+ma sam+bha bā ya/ pad+ma yo na ye/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ hrīḥ7ka ra shrī ka ra pra bhā 8ka ra badz+ra satwa/ badz+ra sam+bha 9ba / pad+ma sam+bha ba/ pad+ma sā ga ra/ pad+ma go tsa ra / ba ra da/ ma 11hā kā ru ṇi ka /kā ru ṇi sam+bha ba/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dha ra dha ra/da ra da ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ma hā shud+dha satwa swā hā/ de nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste byang chub sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mgo bo la byugs nas 97—292

bka' stsal pa/ yon tan rin po che'i phung po chen po 1khyod kyis gzungs sngags 'di bshad pas sems can rnams la sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i chos bstan pa legs so legs son/ /'di ni thos pa tsam gyis kyang sems can rnams shin tu rnam par dag par byed pa'o/ /gang la la nyan pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa des ni yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / dag dpa'i mchog kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i dbang po dbang phyug chen po dpag tshad 'bum phrag du mar khyab cing / 'jig rten gsum po kun du rgyas ko lta ste/ 'khor dang bcas pa dang / rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis mgo bo btud canas/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la gsa'i dbang phyug dpa' bo rnam par rtse ba zhes bya ba'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas mngon par bstod pa/ sa yi dbang phyug rdo rje'i 6dkyil 'khor ba/ /srid gsum ma lus yon tan chen po'i bdag /dri med skyon bral gsal 7ba'i dkyil 'khor can/ /snying rjes khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya che ba/ /rab dga' rab dgyes rab tu ston pa po/ / skal ba 8bzang po rnam 9thar zhi ba'i mchog /shin tu rnam dag yon tan chen po'i bdag /rnam dag du mar grags pa'i me tog thod/ /rab mchog srid gsum dag gi 1 mig gcig pa/ /mchog sbyin 'gro ba kun gyi 'byor pa mdzes/ /dpag med pas kyang dpag med bskal par 'byung / /skyabs dang yid 'phrog dag cing gsal bar mdzad/ /nor bu'i thod can rdo rje las byung ba/ /srid gsum gcig pu 11dpa' bo pad+ma'i spyan/ /thos pa'i rgya mtsho sems can kun bas dpa' / /'gro ba thams cad rnam par grol mdzad mchog /snyan cha 'gul zhing 97—293

pad+ma dag pa bsnams/ /dbang phyug bde gshegs bzhugs pa'i thor tshugs can/ /tshul bzang yon tan rgyan 1du 'tsham pa'i gzugs/ /'jig pa'i rlung chen 'tshub pa'i mtshon cha can/ /dge ba'i rgyu ste dam pa stsol ba'i rgyu/ /tshul gyi longs spyod bde chen mchog gi rgyu/ /dkyil 'khor mchog gi spyod yul rgyu gcig pa / /srid gsum sgrol ba'i zam gepa gcig pu lags/ /dkyil 'khor mchog gi rgyan te sdig med pa/ /gser mdog 'od rgyan rten du gyur pa ste/ /mnyam pa nyid kyis mi mnyam mtshungs par 'gyur/ /sa brnyes 'od zer rgyas pa rgyan phreng mnga' / /chen po'i che ba thog ma med pa ste/ /snga ma mun pa bsal cing nyon mongs med/ /dge ba dag pa spyod yul rnam par dag /tshul gyis dkyil 'khor yangs shing rnam par dag /srid gsum dbang phyug pad+ma las byung ba/ /srid gsum bde can yangs pa'i dbang phyug ste/ /dbang phyug mi g.yo rnal 'byor mkhas pa po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chen po rab mchog yangs/ /nor bu'i rgyan gyi rdo rje rgyan du thogs/ /pad+mas brgyan pa lhun po las byung ba/ /dge snod yon tan chen po'i snod gcig pa/ /bde la longs spyod rnam 'dren chen po'i bdag /smon lam rgya chen rgya mtsho ldan pa ste/ /'gro ba srid par ltung 4rib grol mdzad pa/ /sa dang mnyam pa thams cad gzigs par mdzad/ /skal (5bzang bskal pa stong gi snang ba po/ /rdo rje mchog gis sgeg pa'i dkyil 'khor can/ /yon tan rnam grags 6khyab par dkyil 'khor ba/ /dge ba'i mtshan nyid dpa' bo'i rtsal mnga' ba/ /de bzhin nyid chos ro mkhyen spyod yul can/ /cod pan thig le dmar po'i dkyil 'khor ldan/ /lha chen brgya mnga' sum cu ri gsum bdag dbang / /lha dang lha min dbang byas rnams kyis btud/ /brtson 'grus 97—294

brgya dang ldan zhing rtsal stong mnga'/ /bsod nams brgya mnga' mtshon cha brgya 'chang ba/ /pad+ma brgya pa pad+ma nyid las byung / /dkyil 'khor brgya yi dbus na mdzes pa ste/ /chos brgya ldan pa mchog stong ston pa po/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag mang pos yongs bstod pa/ /bskal pa rab 'byam mang por mkhas pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor mang po dag na dpa' ba'i sku/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i mthu mnga' ston pa po/ /rgya chen dri med dkyil 'khor dbus tshon bzhugs2/ /rab dga' bsgyings 55)pa 'thor mdzad me tog thod/ /na bza' dar dkar la mnabs ca'od mdzad pa/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor thugs rjes brgyan pa las/ /cha phrar gser mdzad mtha' yas zad mi shes/ /dpa' bo nyi ma'i 'od zer brgya mnga' ba / /nor bu'i dkyil 'khor zla 'dra 'od gsal zhing / /nyi mas kha phye pad+ma mchog bsnams pa/ /me tog mtshon cha thogs pa'i lha zhes grags/ /gtsug pud ru gsum pa tshangs sras skye dgu'i bdag /btsun rigs mchog ste rigs chen nang du skyes/ /rang gi rigs gsal dbang chen dkyil 'khor ba/ /pad+ma bzang po'i rigs mchog thig les nematshan/ /spyan bzang dge ba'i lha rnams rten gyur pa/ /gsang sngags mang po 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug po/ /tshogs chen mdun 7ma 'dus pa'i mnga' bdag lags/ /spyan gsum dag gis dkyil 'khor mdzes gyur pa/ /ka la ping ma'i skad kyis sdang ba 'dul/ /mda' dang ru gzhu stobs chen mtshon cha bsnams/ /stobs kyi lha ste stobs dang brtson pas 'dul/ /rgyan rnams sna tshogs legs par spras pa ste/ /rgyal ba rig sngags 'chang ba mang pos bstod/ /tshogs mchod dag byed rnams kyis rab bstod pa/ /chu srin 'dzin khri'i 'jigs las narab grol mdzad/ /gzugs mang 9mnga' zhing bde skyid rab sbyin pa/ /97—295

lha yul 'gro ba'i khyad 1par dkyil 'khor can/ /mtshungs med pas kyang mtshungs med mthu rtsal mnga'/ /stabs na)gshegs yon tan che mchog 'od zer ldan / /'jig rten nang na mkhas pa spyan ras gzigs/ /sa gzhi'i ri nodakyil 'khor dbus kyi dkyil 'khor can/ /'od zer mang po stong phrag zad mi shes/ /nyon mongs rdul rnams thams cad sel mdzad pa/ /mtha' dang bral ba kun du gzigs pa ste/ /rab zhi kun las 'phags pa'i spyod yul can/ /don dang tshul la sems can gcig dpa' ba/ /theg pa bzang po 'dzin pa'i nyi ma lags/ /dul dang sbyin dang tshul la dad pa brnyes/ /skye dgu rnams kyi dri ma ma lus bcom / /blo gros bzang po rab dgyes ston pa po/ /bde ldan gos rgyan yang ba sna tshogs can/ /bcom ldan 'byung ba'i 'jigs pa med par mdzad/ /rtag tu dge ba kun mchog sbyin pa po/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i rnam thar brnyes pa'i blo/ /bde ba longs spyod cher 'byung dri ma med/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas shing dri med pa/ /mi dang sred med brgya byin lag pa'i mchog /'jig rten mang po gzigs pa'i dbang phyug po/ /stobs dang rigs dang mthu stobs che ba lags/ /sangs rgyas mtshungs shing chos mchog rin chen mtshungs/ /dge 'dun mtshungs shing chags bral thub par dka'/ /khyad par gsum 'phags rin chen mchog chen mtshungs/ /khyab bdag nyon mongs rnam gsum rdul bsal ba/ /rdo rje sems mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma dri med phyag gi dbus bsnams pa/ /thor tshugs can la gzugs ldan cod pan thogs/ /spyi bo 'od dpag med rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /de nas bcom ldan rang byung mun sel ba/ /rnga chen sgra ltar brtan pas bka' stsal pa/ /mchog chen rdo rje glu la bstod pa yi/ /ming brgya rtsa 97—296

brgyad skyon sel legs pa mang / /ji ste la la rtag tu dge mchog 'dod1/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang la ni stod 2byed pa/ /des ni ring por mi thogs yon tan gyi/ /longs spyod mchog chen chos ni thob par 'gyur/ /mi ni gang zhig rtag tu 'dis bstod pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dam pa sbyin par byed/ /sdig pa rnams kyang de la 'byung mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa gang yin bde blag de yis 'thob / /de ni sdig pa'i dri mas mi gos te/ /lam sung bzang por cadamigs te 'gro bar 'gyur/ /srid gsum skyabs 'os gcig pu pad+ma skyes/ /de 'drar chos kyi mchog la spyod par 'gyur/ /de ltar ming gi khyad par grub 5'dod cing //gang zhig rtag tu bde ba 'dod pa yis/ /'gro kun skye dgu'i bdag po spyan ras gzigs / /pad+ma las byung rtag tu bstod par gyis/ /bcom ldan 'das bla ma 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa rdzogs so6// //

rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 1 ༄zag /'phags pa byams pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gebyams pas rang gi snying po smras pa/ na mas yā dhī kā dzā / sarba ta thā ga tā 4 rna/ tar+ya thā/o sa ra sa ra/ su ru su ru/ dha ra dha ra/ ma hā dha ra/ tsa ra tsa ra ma hā tsa ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā bha ra/ gaspa gaspa/ ma hā gaspa hūm̐ ma hā s+pha 5cir ṇa/dharmā 'gra sā ga ra swā hā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye ma gzungs chen mo 'di ni yon tan che ba ste mtha' yas par khyab pa/ bskal pa bye ba phrag mang por yang 7shin tu thos par na dka' ba/sangs rgyas 'byung ba thams cad ston pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa grangs med pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 9 sted kyis bsnyen bkur mdzad mdzad pa/97—300

sgrib pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang /ltas ngan pa thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ sems can gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa yongs su thar bar byed pa ste shin tu dkon pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lha dang lha ma yin du bcas pa/ nor bu'i cod pan gyis bsgyings pa/ /rgyan phreng rab tu g.yo ba 17rnams kyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas byang chub sems dpa'i mchog 'phags pa byams pa la mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis mngon par bstod pa/ dpa' bo chen po thabs brnyes pa/ /rgyal tshab 2mi yi bdag po ste/ /'jig rten bdag po rnam par gsal/ /dar ba chen po mngon par rgyas/ /tshan chen stobs ldan che ba ste/ /de bzhin yangs shing rdul dang bral / /dbang chen rtse ltar 'od ldan pa/ /sa yi dbang phyug rnam par gnon/ /rgyal chen mtshon cha brgya pa ste/ /mtshon cha chen po rdo rje'i comatshon/ /yon tan 'od brgyas bsgyings pa ste/ /nor bu'i rna cha'i rgyan thogs pa/ /srid gsum dag na spa ba'i sku/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i spyod yul can/ /lhun po zla 'byin ti se yi//rtse nas dkyil 'khor 'char ba po/ /dkyil 'khor chen po longs spyod pa/ /rab tu dga' ba de bzhin des/ /yongs su dga' ldan chen po'i lha/ /che ba lha rnams kun gyi 5mchog /sangs rgyas gdung 'argyud rgyas mdzad cing / /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rgyan dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas longs spyod longs par spyod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ston pa po/ /ti se zla 'byin bzhin du yangs/ /sa yi dbang phyug bde mdzad pa/ /pad+ma 'dab stong rtse mo can/ /rdo rje'i pad+ma legs par skyes/ /chos kyi longs spyod longs par spyod/ /sa dang mnyam pa 7thub par dka' / /snang bar byed pa 'byung ba po/ /srid gsum ye shes nyi ma lags/ /97—301

gtso bo chen po cher grags pa/ /seng ge chen po stobs po che/ /cha lugs chen po zhal che ba/ /skye bo ngan dang sdug bsngal 'dul/ /rdo rje byi ru bai ḍūr+ya 1/ /nor bu'i dbu thod rgyan du thogs/ /byi ru gser gyi gcal 2bkram la/ /sku chen zhabs kyi stabs kyis gshegs/ /zhal mdangs nyi ma du ma'i gzi/ /lcang lo cod pan dbu thod can/ /rig sngags 'chang brgyas zhabs la btud/ /rjed par bya ba rnams kyis mchod/ /nor bu brgya 'gul 55)'od zer gyis/ /brang gi phyogs rnams dag par byas/ /cod pan can te 'od 'tsher ba/ /nyi ma bye ba brgya 'od ldan/ /rin chen sna tshogs mchog bkram zhing / /dri med dkyil 'khor rab tu 'phro/ /rlung gis ma lus bskyod pa yi/ /'bar ba chen po'i lta ba can / /'od zer mang pos phog pa yi/ /phan pa'i thabs ni rab ston pa/ /brjid pa'i tshul gyis bzhad pa yi/ /'od kyis zhal gsal rnga yab bskyod/ /dpung rgyan 'od zer spel mar bkod/ /tshon ri bris shin tu mdzes par 'tsher5ci/ /lhun po phrad cing 'khrugs pa ltar/ /ha ha zhes pa'i sgra chen sgrogs/ /rdo rje chen po rtsed 6mo can/ /shin tu dga' mdzad bde sbyin pa/ /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor go char bgos/ /btsan 57)pa kun las rnam par rgyal/ /snying rje'i stobs las byung ba ste/ /mtshon cha chen po shin tu 'bar/ /byams pa byams pa'i rtog pa can/ /kun nas spa ba'i dkyil 'khor ba/ /ma pham thub med dag pa ste/ /sangs rgyas cha lugs mnyam med che/ /byams pa'i snying po snying po che/ /byams pa'i pad+ma las byung ba/ /rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje can/ /rdo rje'i bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor pa/ /rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyis btud/ /de bzhin bsnyan 8cing bstod pa po/ /grub pa chen po rig sngags grub/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 97—302

mdzes par mdzad/ /thams cad grub mdzad grub pa po/ /sangs rgyas gdung gi sdong chen lags/ /gsang sngags chen po'i rnam par nges/ /mdo sde'i bkod pa 1mdo sdud pa/ /nges gyur nges pa'i 'od sgron gyi(nari/ /snang bas dri ma sel bar mdzad / /'bar ba rtsa dmar 'od snang ba/ /dkyil 'khor dkar po che ba ste/ /gzhung dang mthun 4pa'i chos dbyings dang / /nye bar gyur cing shin tu nges/ /swā hā swā hā'i bdag po mchog /'od zer bde legs bde legs 5mdzad/ /stobs chen 'chang ba bkra shis pa/ /nyi ma 'dra ste snyoms pa lags/ /stobs 6byed rgyal ba'i longs spyod ldan/ /mkha' ltar dri med spyod yul can/ /dpa' bo rdo rjes 'joms par mdzad/ /rdo rje chen po rab sgrub pa/ /sgrub pa po ste rtsod pa med/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa rdo rje ston/ /rlung chen shugs kyis bskyod pa yi/ /g.yo dang 'brug sgrog 7skra ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul pad+ma ste/ /de bzhin nyid kyi mtsho las skyes/ /mngon shes chen po mngon shes brnyes/ /khyab bdag sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de nas sa yi dbang phyug po/ /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor byams pa la/ /bstod nas kun mkhyen gnod bral ba/ /thub pa nyi mas bka' stsal pa/ /kye ma ming brgya rtsa brgyad mchog /ming gi yon tan 'od ldan pa/ /bde dang phun sum tshogs sgrub pa/ /thabs chen bla na med pa ste/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad 'di dag ni/ /'jig rten kun gyi bde skyed 8pa/ /'di ni bton pa tsam gyis kyang / /sdig pa thams cad dag par 'gyur/ /sdig pa dag las 9rgyal ba yi/ /byams pa 1 bstod pa'i gnas po la/ /ming brgya 11rtsa brgyad dam pa 'dis/ /mi ni la la gang bstod pa/ /de la lha la sogs kun dang / /lag na rdo rje stobs chen rnams/ /rtag pa nyid du sdug bsngal kun/ /97—303
