brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa (1)༄zag /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po zhal ras rgya che zhing spyan gyi 'od 'phro bas nam mkha'i dkyil dri zhim par mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /nam mkha'i spyod yul can sa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang bar mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ swa sti ka mā lā tshonak+ṣi bi pu la sam+bha ba/ dharma dhā tu 4rigo tsa ra swā hā/ gzungs 'di brjod ma thag tu ngan song dang ngan 'gro thams cad ni rab tu zhi bar gyur5/ sa yang g.yos par gyur/ rnga bo che dag gi sgra yang grags 6par gyur / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang legs so zhes bya ba byin no / /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis bka' stsal pa/ kye 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na 'khod pa'i sems can rnams nam mkha'i snying po'i snying po dkyil 'khor mngon sum pa rnams kyi swā hā'i 58rimachog gi gzungs 'byung bar 97—306

shin tu dka' ba/ bsod nams chen po/ sdig pa dang nyon mongs pa thams cad sreg pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ma/ rin po che'i phung por gyur pa 'di nyon cig dang 'di thos pas dri ma med par 'gyur zhing legs par khrus (1)byas par 'gyur la/ shin tu rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma lta bur 'gyur te/ 'khor ba'i 'dam gyis mi gos so/ /nyi ma lta bur 'gyur te/sems can thams cad snang bar byed do/ /zla ba lta bur 'gyur te/ sems can thams cad rab tu sim par byed do/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur 2te/ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad kyis mi gos so/ /sa gzhi lta bur 'gyur te/mtho (thudaman med do/ /lhun po lta bur 'gyur te/ sems can thams cad kyis bskyod par mi nus so/ /thar ba lta bur 'gyur te/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyis mi gos so/ /de la sogs pa yon tan stong phrag bgrang ba (5tshad med grangs med pa dag thob par 'gyur te/ nyan pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / brjod 56)pa dang / ston pa tsam dang / bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis gang ci yang rung ste/ de'i 'dod pa dang / smon pa dang / re ba de dag 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis kyang char ches pa dang /char mi 'bab pa dang / sdang bas dkrugs pa dang / mi nad dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / gnod pa 'byung ba dang / 'jigs pa'i dus dang / 'chi ba dang / chom rkun dang / dgon pa dang / g.yul 'gyed pa dang / gcan gzan medang / mu ge'i sdug bsngal rnams las yongs su srung bar byed la/bde ba dang / 'byor pa dang / ci 'dod pa dang / ci la dga' ba thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'khor de dag thams cad kyis ha ha 97—307

zhes ca co dang ga zha bton 91te/ sgra ring zhes byas nas gos dang / rgyan sna tshogs bskyod de/ snying nas phyag 'tshal nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dbang byed pa 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i bsngags pa rgya mtsho'i bstod pa yang dag par brjod pa/ nam mkha'i snying po (na srid gsum sems can mchog /'byor 5)ldan blo gros rin chen rgya mtsho mnga'/ /sems can dag pa bla med rin chen mchog /thar pa'i sa bon 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /kun mkhyen tshul mkhyen legs dang legs min mkhyen/ /thar mkhyen chos mkhyen bde dang mi bde mkhyen/ /lam mkhyen gces mkhyen dge dang mi dge mkhyen/ /dus mkhyen dge mkhyen stobs dang stobs min mkhyen/ /'gro mchog chos mchog sems can yon tan mchog /lam mchog sngags mchog tshul dang tshul min mchog /rgyan mchog chos mchog 'dzin dang 'dzin min mchog /dag mchog rtogs mchog mchog cadang mchog min mchog /zhi rab snying rje'i rab ste 'khor gyi rab/ /'od rab thar pa'i rab ste rten gyi rab/ /rgya rab sngags kyi rab ste thugs brtse'i rab/ /mnyam rab sems can rab ste gsum rig rab / /legs sgron mchog sgron stobs dang stobs min sgron/ /thar sgron rigs (5risgron rgyal dang rgyal min sgron/ /dge sgron gzi sgron nor bu'i 'od kyi sgron/ /rgyu skar zla ba'i rgyan las shar ba'i sgron/ /mchog 'od yon tan kun gyi 'od zer 'od / /legs 'od thar pa'i pho brang rten gyi 'od/ /'od chen gti mug rab tu 'byed pa'i 'od/ /rdo rje'i 'od 'bar bde ba'i 'od 'char ba/ /rdo rje'i dbang po 'dren dbang sems can dbang / /rin chen 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgyan dbang po/ /rgyal dbang rgyal ba'i stobs rgyun tshad med dbang / /dpa' bo 97—308

rig 0)sngags 'chang dbang srid gsum dbang / /rdo rje bzang po rdo 'od rdo rje 'bar / /rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje 'bar bas brgyan/ /rdo rje 'od can rdo 'dzin rdo rje drag /rdo rje rgya chen rdo rje rab mchog dbang / /na bza' sngo zhing sku yi cha lugs sngo/ /sku mdog sngo zhing sngo ba'i 'od kyis brgyan/ /ral gri rno 'jebs sngo zhing brtan pa bsnams/ /mkha' sngo gzhal med khang 'bar nang na bzhugs / /lha zhal dri med shin tu mi bzad 'bar/ /rab tu drag la 'od zer 'phro zhing 'gyu/ /sdig sel rdul ltar 'khrug byed phreng mchog can/ /glog 2gi stobs kyis snang bas sgeg smyo la brtan/ /ral gri mtshon thogs dbang ldan mthu stobs mtshon(4/ /rdo rje'i 5mtshon thogs mda' dang mdung thung 'jigs/ /'khor lo'i mtshon thogs bcibs pa ri dang 'khrul/ /gsal shing mtshon thogs bgegs kyi stobs 'joms pa/ /bde 'byung 'jig rten gsum bdag rdo rje'i dbyug /sku rnams thams cad nyi ma'i 'od kyis brgyan/ /grags pa'i rigs su byung (6chibs rgyal po mdzad/ /mu tig phreng bas sgeg 7cing mdzes par bgyis/ /sku mdzes brnyes shing phun sum tshogs pa brnyes/ /rab 'byam namachog brnyes sa la 'jug pa brnyes/ /mthu stobs lhag pa brnyes shing grub brnyes la/ /rig pa gsum gyi stobs brnyas 9mthu brnyes pa/ /bde 'dren zhi ba 'dren cing 'od 'dren pa/ /cha lugs gsal mchog dar ba chen po 'dren/ /byams 'dren nyi ma 'dren cing skye dgu 7'dren/ /legs 'dren zhing gi stobs 'dren snying rje can/dri med 17cha lugs gsal ba cha lugs 'bar/ /rnam grags sgeg 12pas grags pa'i ba dan can/ /'gro ba'i skabs 'byed 'jug dang ldog pa mkhyen/ /longs spyod gsal bar ston pa'i sems kyis 'jug /sku dmar sku mthon 1 sku mdzes sku 97—309

bzang ba/ /sku ser 19sku dkar dar ba chen po'i sku/ /sku rol rdo rje'i 92)sku mnga' spyan legs sku/ /rigs sku rig sngags 'chang ba rin chen bsnams/ /gtsug gi nor bu gtsug can cod pan mchog /cod pan can te chos 'dzin rdo rje mchog /dpal 'dzin rin chen dam pa 'chang ba'i mchog /sngags gzhi phyag rgya 'chang ba phun sum tshogs/ /rab mdzes mkha' la gshegs shing rab tu rgyu/ /srid gsum nyi ma gcig pu da'od stong mnga'/ /ri rtser 'char ba bdal legs bkra shis pa/ /yon tan mthu stobs khyad par rnam par grags/ /nor bu chen po nor sdug 4nor bu'i 'od/ /nyi ma'i nor bu tshul spyod 55nor bu 'bar/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'gro kun mgon gcig pu/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na nor bu nerigacig snang ba/ /sems can rnam dag yangs shing rnam par grags/ /srid gsum srung 7ma gcig pu rgyal sras mchog /zhi ba rab tu zhi ba skyabs 'os rtagan /skye dgu'i bdag po pad byung pad+ma skyes/ /kun nas 'od bzang legs bshad chos mnga' ba / /dar ba legs bshad rab dul legs bshad phyag /blo bzang 'od bzang bde ldan skye gnas bzang / /mkhas rab zhi rab mchog gi chos dang ldan/ /zhi mdzad rgyal 'byung bde ba 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'od kyi 'byung gnas bde mdzad dbang du mdzad/ /legs 'byung shes rab 'byung gnas stobs skyed pa/ /snying rje'i 'byung gnas blo bzang rnam grags 9mdzad/ /rnam grol nges 9grol shin tu grol ba'i blo/ /blo yangs rnam par bkram zhing 31rnam par grags/ /kun du longs spyod sgo ste blo yi mchog /blo gros brtan pa dkon mchog gsum las bsgrubs / /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'dab rgyas 'dra ba'i zhal/ /dag cing spyan yangs cha lugs yid du 'thad/ /snying po gsal ba'i snying po 12brtan 12zhing dul/ /ngo 97—310

bo nyid kyis rgyun brnyes tsho1tshorab gsal ba/ /spyan zur mda' ni rab tu gtad legs pa/ /'jigs med zhal ras ston gyi zla ba 'dra/ /mdung thung brgya yi mtshon mchog mtshon cha rdzogs/ /drag po 'jigs pa sdig sel gsum las skyes/ /rab dul mkhas pa 'grogs dga' 'dris par sla/ /rab tu drag pa gnyen rab gser mdog can/ /lha chen bde byed gsal shing phyag na bsnams/ /spyan gsum rig pa gsum ldan me gsum sel/ /'dod bzang me tog mtshon thogs me tog mda'/ /na bza' bzang mnabs tsho rigayas 'phen tshabs 2cher ca'aphen/ /legs bris sna tshogs mtshon cha sna tshogs mda'/ /na bza' sna tshogs sna tshogs rgyan gyi (5)dpal/ /zhal ras zla ba 'od zer rgyas pa 'dra/ /zhal mdangs bstan pas 'jig rten kun 'byor mdzad/ /bzhad 6pa nyi ma'i 'od zer rab 'jebs snyemanga' / /zhal mdangs rgya mtsho gsal mdzad lam me ba/ /dbang chen rdo rje'i thog lags 8)'jigs pa'i sgra/ /rdo rje drag po nor bu g.yo ba 'dzin/ /sgra 9snyan snang bar mdzad pa'i mthu dang ldan/ /blo gros chen po blo gros rno ba'i mchog /rgyan 'dzin dpal 'dzin rin chen zhal dang ldan/ /rgyu 1 dang mi rgyu 'gro ba kun gyi gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mgon sras phreng ba bzang / /stobs chen 'jig rten blo gros ngo bo nyid/ /skye dgu'i bdag po bka' lung mnyam zhing brtags / /mi yi mnga' bdag mtho ris skyed pa'i rgyu/ /sgyu 11'dra 'dod pa'i mda' dang rdo rje can/ /mthu stobs mnga' zhing spyan bzang sdug par ldan /ston pa 12bzang po stong nyid 1rilam gyi stegs/ /gces gsum 'phel ba'i rgyu la 'jug pa mdzad/ /brtan po rgyu la rab tu nges gyur pa/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa kun gyi 7slob dpon lags/ /gcig pu skye dgu'i dkyil 'khor cho ga mkhyen/ /97—311

rnam par snang mdzad zhing gi gnas nas skyes/ /dbang bskur brnyes 15shing sa bcur legs par gnas/ /gnas chen son pa mchog gnas gcig pu lags/ /skye dgu rnams kyi nyon mongs sel ba dang / /sdig 'joms mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad 'di thos nas/ /bde gshegs sras mchog su zhig 'don byed pa/ /'jig rten zla ba gcig shar bzhin du snang / /nam mkha'i snying po sems can gcig pu yi/ /mdun 'dug nang par bstod pa 'di brjod gang / /de ni srid gsum sems can mchog 'gyur zhing / /dri ma'i gnas kun las kyang thar bar 'gyur/ /g.yul dang 'thab rtsod shin tu mi bzad dang / /mu ge'i gnod pa mi nad byung ba na / /mkhas pa su zhig sngar langs dad bskyed nas/ /nam mkha'i snying po la ni stod 2byed pa/ /de ni 'jigs pa'i 'byung gnas thams cad dang / /sdug bsngal 'byung 'dren sdig pa rnams las grol/ /des ni zhi mchog mchog bde kun gnas dang / /bde ba rgya chen nges par thob par 'gyur/ /bde 'thob longs spyod 'phel bar bya ba 'am/ /rgyal srid 'thob dang byad gzugs nor 'thob dang / /rigs 'thob yon tan kun gyi gzhi bsgrub phyir/ /bton na 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom 4med/ /de phyir ji ste rtag tu 'dod bde kun/ /'dod na 'gro ba kun la gcig dpa' ba/ /nam mkha'i snying po srid gsum mgon po la/ /rtag tu bsten 5cing sngags 6kyang bsten 7par bgyi/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa rdzogs ston// //97—312

khug /'phags pa kun du bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 1༄༅na /'phags pa kun du bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa dkun du bzang po nam mkha'i dkyil kun du rab 'byam dam lus pa dang mnyam pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi chos kyi snang ba gsal 4ba brnyas 5pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor kun du 'phros pa'i sku tha dad pa med cing dus gsum gyi sku mnyam pa 6nyid brnyes pa/ gzugs sna tshogs can/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mchog dang / rab mchog dam pa sbyin pa/ yon tan chen po'i sku sa kun du mnga' mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mchog kun du bzang po gzugs sna tshogs can/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin rab 'byam 7sa'i dbang phyug chen po 8zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems 97—315

dpa' 1chen po kun du bzang po snyoms par zhugs ma thag pa de'i tshe stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sku rab 'byam sakun du yongs su rgyas par gyur 3te/ nam mkha'i khams kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i sku rnams sa'i dkyil 'khor du ma dag tu kun nas 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byam tsho thams cad kyi khongs su gtogs 5pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 6chen po kun du bzang po'i mgo bo la byugs nas bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba thams cad kyi snying po gzungs chen mo 7shed cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 785chen po'i mchog /lus 'od zer 'bum gyis snang bar byas pas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad g.yo bar byas nas/ gzungs 'di bshad do/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ na mo na maste/ bhu ba ne shwa re/ ma hā bho gā ya/ a sa ma sa ma/ a mi 595ta sa ma/a nan+ta sa ma/ ga ga na sa ma/ tri bhu ba na sa ma/ a she ṣa sa ma/ be yog sa ma / pa ra ma arba sa ma/ swa bhā ba sa ma/ ta thā tā sa ma/ a ra dzaḥ1lhas ma/shudhi sa ma/ bud+dhi sa ma/ dharma ta thā tā sa ma/ a bhi ṣa 12ma sa ma sa ma sa ma / e kā 1 nā ya/ sā ga rang/ bi shud+dhim/ ā lo ka / tī tī/ lasta lastatsha/bi dza ya bi dza ya/ oṃ pra sa ga ta/ nyu na ya na ya/ hi 18ni ra a dhiṣ+ṭha nyurten/ saṃ bho ga /e a na la ya la ya/ dharma a gra/ dha ra dha ra/ dza ya dza ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐/dha ma dha ma swā hā/ de nas rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo 'jig rten thams cad kyi mgon po gcig pu/ sems can thams cad la phan par 'dod pa byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du bltas te/ sa'i 97—316

dkyil 'khor g.yo bar byas nas de skad ces smras te/ 'jig rten gsum po kun du gang bar byas so/ /de nas lha dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis gang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas (1)gser gyi 'od zer 'bar zhing snang la rab tu g.yo bas brgyan pa'i lus can sa steng kun gyi rdo rje me tog thod stan chen po las bskyod de/ dkyil 'khor nas langs nas ha ha zhes bya ba'i (2sgra phyung ste smras pa/ kye ma snying rje chen po dang yon tan grangs med pa'i rgya mtsho rab tu 'byam pa'i gzungs chen mo/ kye ma sangs rgyas 'byung ba chen mo/mtha' dang pa dbus med pa'i sa gsum dang mnyam zhing sems can gyi khams grangs med pa yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir gnas pa/ chos kyi dkyil 'khor gnas pa med pa'i gzungs chen mo/ kye ma bskal pa mtha' yas pa nas 'phangs pa'i sdig pa'i bag chags sel cing nyon mongs pa'i rgya mtsho skems la lta ba'i ri bo 'thor bar byed pa'i gzungs chen mo/ bskal pa mtha' yas par dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs 'byung ba yang dag par ma bsags 5shing / bde bar gshegs pa 'bum phrag du ma mngon sum du mthong bas byang chub kyi sa bon ma bsgrubs la/thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa'i khyad par gyi yon tan rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs pa rjes 6su thob pa ma yin pa gzhan ni sus kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po gzungs chen mo 'di mnyan par yang mi nus na/ gzung ba'am/ bklag 7pa'am / kun chub par bya ba lta ci smos/ gzungs chen mo 'di'i ming tsam yang bskal pa bye ba phrag stong gi bar du thos par dka'o/ /kye ma gzungs chen mo 'di ni sems can gang dag gi lag na 'dug pa de dag ni rnyed 8pa legs par rnyed 9pa'o 'tsho ba bzang pos 'tsho ba'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyi gzhi 97—317

bzang po'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul la gnas pa'o/ /yon tan thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'o/ /'di lan cig brjod pa tsam gyis ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /lan gnyis brjod pa tsam gyis sdig pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /lan gsum brjod pa tsam gyis nyon mongs pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na brjod pa tsam gyis gong nas gong du yon tan 1)rnams 'thob 5par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa yang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'chag bzhin du bzlas brjod byas na sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro / /shing gcig na'agreng gi drung du bzlas brjod byas na grub pa thams 4)cad 'thob 5par 'gyur ro/ /'gro bzhin du bzlas brjod byas na sems can thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /nags tshal chen po'i nang du skyil mo krung 6 bcas te 'dug 7la lan bdun brjod na bsam gtan chen po 'thob par 'gyur la/nyon mongs pa dang yang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa kun du bzang po'i sku gzugs kyi drung du skyil mo krung 2bcas te 'dug la me tog la sogs pa ji snyed pas mchod nas/ lus ngal bar gyur ri9)gyi bar du gzungs chen mo 7'di brjod la / ngal bar gyur nas de nyid du nyal na rmi lam du byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po mthong bar 'gyur te/ phyag g.yas pas de la byugs nas yang dag par dbugs 'byin par mdzad de/ chos kyi snang ba chen po yang gsol bar mdzad do/ /'di skad du rgyal ba'i sras legs so legs so/ /khyod ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs pa yin te/ khyod tshe brjes 1lhanas sa chen po 'thob 12par 'gyur ro zhes kyang gsungs so/ /de nas lus bde ba dang /97—318

sems bde ba dang / dga' ba chen po dang / dang ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba chen po dang ldan bzhin du sad par 'gyur ro/ /mthu che ba dang /dbang che bar grags par yang 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams kyang de la blta ba'i phyir 'ong ngo / /nang par langs nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yang dag par bsdus 3)pa'i mdo sde rnams bklag (2)par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la yang phan pa dang / bde ba'i sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing sdig pa thams cad dang bral te/ nyon mongs pa'i phyogs rnams bcom la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang bsngags par 'gyur ro/ /lha la sogs pa yang de la bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang /sba ba'i phyir brtson par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar ji skad bstan pa bzhin du byed pa'i rgyal ba'i sras de ni ring po mi thogs par kun du bzang po'i sa chen po la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje gtsug phud la sogs pa stong gsum gyi bdag po rig sngags 'chang chen mo /rnams dang / spyan chen mo la sogs pa rig 4sngags 'chang chen mo rnams dang / rdo rje snying po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / rdo rje zhags pa la sogs pa rig sngags kyi lha chen po rnams dang / rin chen dra ba can la sogs pa rig sngags kyi lha mo chen mo rnams dang / lha mo sgrol ma la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang / dar chen dang / gzugs bzang dang /shin tu blta na sdug pa la sogs pa gzhon nu rnams dang / gzhon nu ma rnams dang / bran rnams dang / bram 5mo rnams dang / mi 'khrugs 6pa la sogs pa log 'dren chen po rnams dang / lus mchog la sogs pa srin po'i dbang po 97—319

rnams dang / ma mo la sogs pa srin mo ca1)rnams dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa /nalha'i dbang phyug rnams dang / rdo rje me tog thod la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen por 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa thams cad langs nas / byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i mchog 'phags pa kun du bzang po la mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad bla na med pa'i yon tan gyi snang ba zhes bya bas bstod 5)pa/kun du bzang po kun gyi mchog /sna tshogs kun gyi 'byor pa che/ /dkyil 'khor chen po rdo rje mchog /sna tshogs gzugs can phyogs kyi bdag /rdo rje chen po dgyes pa che/ /gzi brjid chen po stobs po che/ /gnon dang rab gnon dpal gyi rab/ /khyab bdag rgyal ba'i blo gros rgyal/ /rdo rje chen po rab tu bzhad/ /bsgrub dka' chen po sgrub mdzad pa/ /rol mo chen pos rnam par rol / /rab dga' chen 4po 'dul ba po/ /lha chen dbang phyug chen po ste/ /btsan po khyab 'jug skye dgu'i bdag /sa steng sa 'og sa la dgyes/ /de bzhin sa 'dzin sa gsum pa/ /dul dang sbyin pa'i go rims 5thabs rab mkhyen stong gi mnga' bdag lags/ /shes nyen can te bzod la dgyes/ /brtson 'grus 'byung ba 'byor pa che/ /brtson 'grus bcu dang thabs bcu pa/ /stobs bcu'i sras chen thu 6bo ste/ /mthu stobs stong gis 7spro ba dang / /yongs su ldan zhing bcu sel 8ba/ /rdul sel rgyal po chen po ste/ /rgyal po dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho ba/ /rdul rnams rab tu zhi ba'i thabs/ /cho ga mkhyen pa 9blo mnga' ba/ /mkhas pa mdzes pa skal ba khobazang / /shin tu sdug pa dga' skyed pa / /snying po chen po las byung dpal/ /nyon mongs bral ba thub par dka'/ /sa dang mnyam pa mkha' dang mnyam/ /rlung dang mtshungs pa'i spyod yul can/ /97—320

gzi brjid nyid de gzi brjid mtshungs/ /rgya mtsho bzhi yi 1chu dang 'dra/ /rmugs dang smyo ba zhi bar mdzad/ /thub par dka' ba'i nyon mongs 'jil/ /g.yul sel g.yul la dgyes pa ste/ /g.yul gyi nyes pa rab 'joms pa/ /gsung bzang ngang pa'i gdangs su bzhad/ /dbang po nye dbang dbang chen sras//dbang po las lhag thub dang mnyam/ /chos 'dzin 'byor dang ldan par bstan/ /rab dga'i bun long ( nizhi mdzad pa/ /nyon mongs 'dam rdzab skems par mdzad//dpa' du bo rgyags pa'i rims nad sel/ /khro bo'i dregs pa rnam par 'joms/ /gsung snyan 'jam pa nyid dang ldan/ /mnyam pa mi mnyam mnyam pa dang / /mnyam med yul las rnam par 'das/ /sangs rgyas kun dang spyod yul gcig /byang chub snying por rgya cher rol/ /rim pa rab ston dge ba ste/ /spyan bzang phun sum tshogs pa dge/ /gtsang ma lam bzang sbyin mdzad pa/ /dag mdzad sreg 8)sbyin mchog sbyin po/ /'joms byed bgegs rnams rnam par 'joms/ /'thob (dzomadzad dpe med gsung ba po/ /rdo rje'i 6'jig rten gcig snang ba/ /skyes pa bud med tshogs kyi bdag /nges par yon tan 'byor mdzad pa/ /sems can 'khor ba zhi mdzad pa/ /brtan po sdig pa rnams dang bral/ /kun du (7rnam rgyal snang ba pon/ /kun du rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor can/ /kun du rgya mtsho'i snang ba mdzad/ /kun du nyes pa sel ba lags/ /mi bzad sa 'og rnam par dkrugs/ /de bzhin zad mdzad thug par mdzad/ /nyon mongs rgya mtsho rnam par dkrugs/ /nyon mongs phyogs rnams zad par mdzad/ /'bar ba'i dka' ba 9'phro mdzad pa/ /rgyags shing bdo ba zhi bar mdzad/ /rdo rje chen po stobs skyed pa/ /sdang ba thams cad nges par 'joms/ /pha rol bzhugs pa 97—321

sdig sel ba/ /dag pa nam mkha'i spyod zhi)yul can/ /dag pa sbyin zhing yon tan sbyin/ /'bras bu sbyin zhing kun sbyin pa/ /ye shes sbyin zhing bsod nams sbyin / /longs spyod sbyin zhing rgyal sbyin pa/ /dbang phyug sbyin zhing tshig sbyin la / /nor sbyin tshogs ldan rdo rje can/ /gzugs sbyin dpa' bo rnam par rgyal / /dag cing dge ba'i tshul sbyin pa/ /bde 'byung gtsug na nor bu thogs/ /sa 'dzin gzung bar dka' ba po/ /dkyil 'khor mgu (5)bar sgrub mdzad pa/ /'bab cing de bzhin 'bebs par mdzad/ /rin chen dra ba rin chen mnyam/ /sgron ma mun sel rgyal ba can/ /yon tan ye shes theg chen ldan/ /brtan mchog che ba'i chos nyid can/ /gsung ba chen po shes rab che/ /sangs rgyas tshul ni rab ston pa/ /mchod pa chen po theg chen gyi/ /theg pa bla na med par ldan / /mchod pa chen po'i chos shes pa/ /'bras bu chen po chos kyi mchog /ston mdzad 'dul mdzad ston pa po ri/ /zhi ba de bzhin zhi mdzad pa/ /bzang po bzang dang mtshungs pa nyid/ /kun du rab 'byam sel mdzad pa/ /snying rje 45ye shes snying po mkhyen/ /snying rje'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can/ /snying rje chen po yongs su rdzogs/ /dus chen rnam par dag par mdzad/ /mtsho rine mchog dang ba rab mtho 7ba/ /rtsod chen 'das pa'i spyod yul can/ /skye dgu srung zhing spyan yangs pa/ /rnyed par dka' ba'i 'byor 58)ba can/ /kun du spyod pa khong dge ba / /dga' ba'i dam pa 9sbyin pa po/ /kun du yul kun mnga' ba ste/ /zhes bzang po rtag tu mnga'/ /dul ba sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i pad+ma lags/ /zla ba lta bur sim mdzad thabs/ /mkhas pa rgyags spangs cho ga mkhyen/ /spyod yul gcig la gnas pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs 97—322

pa'i ye shes mnga'/ /dam tshig chen po de nyid mkhyen/ /slob dpon chen po grags pa che/ /dam pa nyid de bla na med/ /gsang sngags rlabs ni rgyas par mdzad / /de ltar khyab bdag chen po ni/ /yon tan brgya yi spos kyis rgyas/ /dag cing byang la mkhas la sogs/ /yon tan 'byung la rig sngags rgyal/ /gtsug na nor bu thogs la sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bstod nas kyang / /sdug bsngal chu bo bcom pa yi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshig 'di gsungs/ /kye ma bstod pa chen po brgya/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa yin/ /mi 91rnams la la gang zhig gis/ /sdig bsal kun du bzang po la/ /snying nas 'di yis bstod (gebyas na/ /des ( ni sangs rgyas nyid kyang 'thob/ /gang zhig ming brgya rtsa brgyad 'don/ /mi de yon tan yongs rdzogs shing / /de bzhin gshegs tshul che ba yi74༄/ /ye shes ma lus smra bar nus/ /de ltar thub mchog sras po yon tan brgya yi spo sbyoraralas nges par byung gyur cing / /yon tan sna tshogs 'byung dang 'jig rten yan chad dag gis yon tan rgyas rnams la/ /bstod pa chen pos snang byas rgyal ba'i sras la bstod pas nyin re bstod byas na/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i skur 'gyur snang ba thob cing rnam dag yon tan 'byung gnas 'gyur/ /'phags pa kun du bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa rdzogs so(6 // //97—323

rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 71༄༅lda /'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje nyanasal phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes rang gi snying po smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭi 5ta ka /ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas gzungs sngags 'di bshad ma thag tu sa chen po g.yos par gyur 45te/ bgegs 5skudang log 'dren thams cad kyang skrag nas nyam thag pa'i skad byung ne ngo / /dkyil 'khor chen por 'dus pa thams cad kyang ha ha zhes 'dzer to/ /lha la sogs pa rig sngags 'chang chen po rnams kyis kyang rgyan gyi char chen po phab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang zhal 'dzum bzhin du rdo rje 'chang la gzigs nas bka' stsal pa/ sdang ba sel ba 'khor 'di dag ha cang skrag par ma byed cig /rdo rje 'chang gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi gzungs 'di ni mchog 97—326

tu gsang ba lags 1)so/ /rig sngags thams cad kyi mchog dang / bgegs thams cad zlog pa dang / sdang ba thams cad sel ba dang / dam pa 465 ba dang / 'byor pa stsol ba dang / sdang ba rnams dga' bar bgyid pa dang /thos na don mchis pa dang / brjod na don mchis pa dang / bsnyen bkur bgyis na don mchis pa dang / stobs bskyed napa dang / gzugs bzang bar bgyid pa dang / spobs pa skyed dpa dang / dbang phyug thob par bgyid pa dang / nor dang ldan par bgyid pa dang / dbang 4bgyid pa dang / sdang ba 'joms pa dang / sdang ba 'jig par bgyid pa dang / dug sel ba 5dang /rgyal bar bgyid pa dang / dga' bar bgyid pa dang / mchog tu dga' bar bgyid pa dang / dang bar bgyid pa dang / nga rgyal 'joms pa dang / pha rol pham par bgyid pa dang / sdig pa zhi bar bgyid pa dang / nongs pa bgyis 6)pa sbyong ba dang / 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa zhi bar bgyid pa dang / mtshams ma mchis pa zlog pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa zhi bar bgyid pa dang / bkra mi shis pa zhi bar bgyid pa dang / dpal skyed 7pa dang /skal ba bzang por bgyid pa dang / sems can thams cad dga' bar bgyid pa dang / gzhan 8la dbang bgyid pa dang / ci 'tshal ba stsol ba dang / yon tan thams cad phun sum tshogs par bgyid pa dang / char ches pa dang /char mi 'bab pa dang / dus kyi gnod pa rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa lags te/g.yul chen po dang / mi nad chen po dang / rtsod pa chen po dang / mi ma lags pa la sogs pa 'jig pa dang / sdang ba dang / byad stems 9dang / ro langs kyi sbyor ba chen po dang / skrod pa dang / srog 'jig pa'i tshe dang /97—327

'jigs pa chen po byung ba na/ nang par langs nas lus khrus bgyis la/ gos dkar 1po 'tshal te/ kha shar shar rinaphyogs su bltas la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi gdong du lta zhing lan bdun brjod na/ brjod pa tsam gyis 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur zhing / grub pa chen po yang thob par 'gyur la / thams cad du yang rgyal bar 'gyur te/ sems can rnams la srung snerab dang / skyob pa dang / sbed 4)pa ni gzungs chen mo 'di las lhag pa ma mchis so / /de nas 'khor thams cad ngo mtshar 5)du gyur nas/ rdo rje 'chang la mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis snyomangon par bstod pa/ /rdo rje sems dang/'a sems dpa' che / /rdo rje rgyal po bde ba che/ /rdo rje 'jigs pa dgyes pa che/ /rdo rje snying po stobs po che/ /rdo rje 'khrugs pa zhags pa che/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad/ /rdo rje hūm̐ gi hūm̐ lags te/ /rdo rje sa 'og 'jigs pa po/ /chags pa'i rdo rje chags pa che/ /chags pa'i zhags pa mgyogs pa che/ /phyag dmar phyag ni ring ba ste/ /spyan dmar spyan dang ldan pa lags/ /rdo rje mthon ka mthon 7ka che/ /mthon mthing 8dbu skras brgyan pa lags/ /ral gri sngon po ral gri che/ /dkyil 'khor sngon po'i dkyil 'khor can/ /mthon ku'i spyan te dbu sngo ba/ /'od chen mthon ku'i 'od dang ldan/ /rdo rje sngon po stobs mi mtshungs / /rdo rje spro ba'i stobs po che/ /khro bo'i rdo rje khro bo che/ /sel mdzad khro bo'i rgyags pa sel/ /khros pa'i spyan ni rab tu bstod/ /khro bo bgegs rigs sel bar mdzad/ /gzhu 9ribasnams zhags pa bsnams pa ste/ /rdo rje'i mdas ni nges par 'gums/ /dbyig thogs rdo rje'i ral gri bsnams/ /rdo rje'i zhags pas rab tu 'joms/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo 'khor lo che/ /'jigs pa'i 97—328

sgra sgrogs rab tu khro/ /sna tshogs sku ste thig les bris/ /gzi brjid skyed pa grags mdzad pa/ /bzod par 1dka' ba reg mi bzod/ /sdig dang bgegs rnams gcod mdzad pa/ /drag po chen po rdo rje khro/ /skyel byed drag po sgyel bar mdzad / /gting dpag dka' ba ring du gshegs/ /rin chen rgya mtsho rab tu dga' / /rgya mtsho lhun po'i dpung dang ldan/ / dam pa'i nati se lhun po'i rtse/ /gad rgyangs chen pos bzhad pa po/ /spyod yul bskal pa grangs med gsum/ /rig sngags 'chang mchog rdo rje can/ /rig sngags 'chang chen mnga' bdag lags / /na bza' lcang lo rtsa dmar gsol/ /mthon ka na bza' mthon la dgyes / /srin po srung ba drag po ste/ /me tog phreng ba'i rgyan la dgyes/ /nyi ma chen po nyi ma'i 'od/ /'od zer brgya phrag rab tu 'gyed/ /grol mdzad mgon po ston pa po/ /rab mchog rab mchog rnams kyis rimachod/ /mgrin chen mgrin pa'i mdog sngo ba/ /mgur bzang zhal bzang dam pa lags/ /cod pan chen po rdo rje'i 'od/ /phun sum tshogs ldan sems dag pa/ /ye shes che ldan srung ba che/ /rlung dmar lags 4te spyod yul ring / /gtso bo sgrol mdzad pha rol gshegs/ /'jigs las grol ba rab 'jigs pa/ /rgyal chen gtsug na nor bu thogs/ /mtshon cha chen po sna tshogs mtshon/ /'jig rten gsum gyi tshul chen gcig5 /gsum gzigs rtse gsum gtsug pud 6gsum/ /'dod pa'i lha ste snang chen mtshan/ /za ba po ste 'jigs par mdzad/ /mtho ba sku mchog zhal gsum pa/ /tsham tshom med de srid las byung / /rtag pa skar dgyes dus 'byor pa/ /rgyu skar rgyal rigs 'phel bar mdzad/ /rgyal po sngags 'chang chen po ste/ /bgegs kun dbang phyug mkhas pa lags/ /be+e ḍūr+ya 7ltar 97—329

dri med sku/ /mdzes shing stobs skyed 1)sna tshogs stobs/ /dga' ba skyed pa dga' bar mdzad/ /dkon mchog gsum po 'dzin pa'i mchogaci ni /lha chen dpa' bo chen po ste/ /brtan chopo dpa' bo lham me ba/ /bde ba chen po 'ching ba gcod/ /dam du 'ching ba'i rtsal mnga' ba/ /mtshon cha che tshogs cod pan can / /rig sngags 'chang ba'i tshogs dga' ba/ /pad+ma chen po'i phyag ring ba/ /pad+ma las byung pad+ma'i mchog /nag po chen po 'byung po che/ /gtum chen thog thog chen po ste/ /rlung chen bzhad mo 'byung ba dang / /rdo rje'i mtshon cha brgya rdzogs pa/ /rtul phod thub dka' brtson pa ste/ /'byung po chen po'i tshogs kyi rje / /zhi ba dbang po rdo rje'i mtshon/ /brag gi rtse mo rnam par 'gems/ /rgyal ba'i sras po gzugs che ba/ /rdo rje yis 547ni dkyil 'khor brgyan/ /rdo rje'i (5)lcags mdas sreg mdzad pa/ /rdo rje'i mdas nyani rnam par sbyangs47)/ /rdo rje don yod rdo rje'i rinanodabang / /rdo rje bzang po rdo rje'i rtsal/ /ye shes dag pa theg pa che/ /thabs brnyes 59snying rje chen po lags/ /rdo rje chen po rtsed mo can/ /spyan bzang rnam par gzigs pa po/ /rdo rje dril bu rnam dag spyan/ /mdza' tu tshobo sdug pa dam tshig mkhyen/ /rdo rje chen po mgon po pa/ /rdo rje sa 'og 'jigs par mdzad/ /rdo rje chen po gad rgyangs sgrogs1lha/ /me tog chun po 'od gsal ba/ /dag pa zas gtsang tsho)sras kyi sras/ /des pa skal bzang gtsang ba lags / /sna tshogs can te lha kun mchog /rdo rje'i dpung gi dkyil 'khor ldan / /rdo rje'i gtsug sdug shes rab can/ /rdo rje'i bkod pa rab tu mdzes/ /mdzes pa shin tu rnam par dag /bskal pa'i rlung chen lta bu lags/ /dpa' bo gsang /2ba chen po 'chang / /rig sngags 'chang gi mchog gis rjedami/ /97wa 330

gsang ba po ste gsang ba gsung / /skyes pa bud med tshogs dga' ba/ /rdo rje thog thog sgra chen sgrogs/ /rdo rje'i sgrog ste rnam par 'joms/ /rdo rje'i lcags kyu dgyes pa che/ /rdo rje 'bar ba cher 1'bar ba/ /nor bus spras napa'i na bza' gsol/ /spos dang me tog phreng gis brgyan/ /dbu yi snyan cha gdub kor ri btags/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ston pa po/ /rgyal po sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /dbang phyug chen po grags pa che/ /dkyil 'khor slob dpon dkyil 'khor can/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ston pa po/ /dbu rgyan cod pan kun nas bcings/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa lags/ /de ltar rdo rje dbang phyug mgon/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dag gis bstod/ / de nas chirdo rje don yod pas gsungs pa/ rdo rje gsang bas brgyan pa yi/ /rdo rje mtshan rtsa brgyad pa 'di/ /ming 5ni rdo rje don yod 'byung / /sdang ba thams cad zlog byed pa/ /ming ni brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'di/ /dad pa gang zhig 'chang byed pa/ /grub pa thams cad thob 'gyur zhing / /nges pa kun las rnam par grol/ /lag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur/ /lag na rdo rje'i yon tan che/ /gang zhig nang par langs nas brjod/ /de ni sdig pa kun las grol / /ngan 'gro 6kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /gsang sngags thog mar smos pa 'di / /su zhig nang par langs nas 'don/ /rgyal po blon 7po grong khyer ba/ /gnyen rnams kyang ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /bstod pa'i mchog 'di 2su 'don pa//'jig rten thams cad de dbang 'gyur/ /sdig pa thams cad zad pa dang / /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'dod pa dam pa yi9 bde ba de yis 'thob 1 par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nang par langs nas ni/ /lag na 97—331

pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa ga 1ri༄༅ga /'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ phyogs bcu'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shes bya mtha' dag ma lus par khyab 2cing / mchog tu rmad du byung ba rnam par dag pa'i blo mnga' ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa thugs dri ma dang skyon thams cad dang bral ba/ yon tan 3dri ma med pa'i tshogs kyi 'od zer gyis brgyan pa'i sku zhabs rten gyi pad+ma la lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / klu dang / rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi thor tshugs dang cod pan gyi rtse mos gtugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngan song gi 'gro ba sna tshogs rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ oṃ bho 4ma hā ma ṇi ru tsi ra ka lā pa bi tsi ratra/ muk+ta dā ma/ a lam̐ kṛ tsita sha rī 7ra/ pa ra satwa mo 97—334

tsa ka /ta thā ga ta ma hā dharma ko ṣa dha ra/ pra ba ra dharma/ lasna༄1)/ bi dza ya/su ra ta/ sasto rinarig u pa de sha ka /kle sha ga ra pra sha ma ka /shu n+ya tā swa bhā ba/a nu swa ri/ ma hā bo rdo nidhi sa twa ba ra/ ba ra ta/ ba ra ṇa rin da da/ oṃ ma hā pā 56)sha pra sa ra/ a sa ma sa ma/ a nan+ta sa ma sa man+ta bha dra/ sa man+ta saṃ dha 7ra / sa man+ta ā 587ka ra/ sa man+ta pra sa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ he he mañju ra ba/ma hā badz+ra ma hā khan9/ tshin+da tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+dahu )/ bi ra dza bi ra dza/ kurma a ba ga ma ka /ku ru ku ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru/ dha dha dha dha/ dhu dhu dhu dhu/ ma hā ma hā/ ma hā ma hā/ mo ha ya mo ha nilhaya/ bho bho/ bhā ma dhī 12ma/ na da na da/ sa ra sa ra/ ma hā bo 1 dhi 1 satwa/ mo tsa ya/ma ma nā lotha ma nu sri 7ta/ a ba ya duḥkha na/ su khaṃ 1 da/ ma hā kā ru ṇi 18kā / a nā tho /9lha / duḥ21khri to haṃ/ sa ra dzo haṃ/ u pa na dru to haṃ/a bi bisto 2 rta/ ku si dho haṃ/ mā ra ṇa 3 /dharmo haṃ/ traṃ bha ga bān/ duḥkhri tā 354/ su khaṃ 20da da/ a nā māṃ 2 māṃ/ sa nā tha naka ra/ sa ra dza r+sā 'o/ bi ra dza ska ra/ u pa dru tā māṃ 1/ swa ra u pa dra ba pra sha ma ka /a bi bi ga tā 52māṃ / ku sha la saṃ bha ra/ pa ri pū rir yi tā/ ku si dhā māṃ/ ma hā bīr+ya rdo dha tsitā / mā ru ra ṇa /dharmi ṇa/ ma mi ta pa dā dā tā/ ma ma bi bha ga bān/ nā tho bha ba / sha ra rdezhuge/ pa rā ya ṇi 1/ tra tā/ sarba duḥkhā ni me pra sha ma ya/ sarba kle sha ra rdzu si mi/ a ba na ya/ sarba saṃ sā lhar u pa dra ba/ duḥkhā 4lhani me/nā sha ya/ sarba ku sha la dharma pa ri pū ra me ku ru/ sarba kurma ā chib ra ṇa/ kle sha pa ra ba ta me bi ka ri smi/ ma hā bo tsidhi satwa si bi dhi/ bīr+ya pā /ra mi tā/yo gi me saṃ ni yo dza ya 9/ a ra ṇa dharma/ bi rā ga 5 bi ra dza/ sañja 51ha/97—335

pra dza ha/ dha ri khyi1/ sa ma kha sa ma/ dza la ni dhi kyis ma/ me ru sa ma/ ma hā bo dhi satwa ba ra da swā hā/ rig sngags don kun sgrub pa 'di/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bshad pa na/ /de ma thag tu sems can rnams/ /skye dang rga ba zad par 'gyur/ /ngan 'gro thams cad zhi gyur nas/ /bdud kyi sde rnams rab tu 'dar/ /lha rnams thams cad rab tu dga'/ /log 'dren rnams ni skrag par gyur/ /sdig pa zhi bar byed pa yi/ /gzungs 'di bshad pa'i mod la ri riyang / /grangs med phrag ni dung phyur snyed ri/ /'khor ba'i btson 5 ra dag nas thar / /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa yis/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni rab bsgrags 6shing / /gang tshe rig sngags bshad pa na/ /brag dang nags dang tshal du bcas/ /rgyu ba dang ni mi rgyu ba'i/ /sa gzhi 7de yi tshe na g.yos/ /sangs rgyas 'od kyi snang ba yis/ / sa yi 8steng yang khyab par gyur/ /bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad dang / /srin po mi bzang gzugs can rnams/ /stobs bcu ldan la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /skad phyung tshig ni mthun 9par smras/ /lha rnams zhi ba'i cha lugs can/ /thams cad yid ni dga' gyur nas/ /gang na rdo rje ⑩ ral gri che/ / de yi 11drung lhags smras pa ni/ /phyag 'tshal mchog sbyin rdo rje'i mchog /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni stobs chen 12la/ /shugs stong ldan pa rgyal ba can / /bgegs kyi yul 'khor rab 'joms pa/ /sngags 'chang gsang sngags chen po 'chang / /sna tshogs gzugs can mi yi bdag /shin tu stobs ldan gzugs mdzes 'jigs/ /drag po drag po rab 'joms pa/ /gzi brjid gzi brjid mnga' ba'i dpal/ /dpal ldan mnyam pa med pa'i dpe/ /rdo rje can te snying sbyong ba/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib sel/ /sgeg pa'i cha lugs mchog 97—336

mnga' ba/ /skye dgu'i bdag po sgeg par dgyes/ /gzhu stobs can la phyag ring ba/ /nyon mongs dgra rnams sel bar mdzad/ /mdzes pa na bza' sna tshogs gsol/ /me tog phreng rgyan sna tshogs can/ /spyan bzang dbu ni mdzes pa ste/ /dgyes shing na bza' mdzes par gsol/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs de rab tu bzhad/ /dkar nag 'byes pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ /ha ha'i sgra ni grags par bsgrags1 / /rab tu dang 2bas bstan pa dga'/ /rgya chen gser gyi mdog dang ldan/ /rgya mtsho'i /snying po'i spyod yul can/ /tshul mkhyen tshul ldan 'jigs pa ste/ /sdang ba'i snying ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /cha lugs sngo la sa skyong ba/ / lha yi 4bdag po dga' bar mdzad/ /'dod pa'i lha ste 'dod sel bstan / /rgyal po'i 'jig rten sa 'dzin pa/ /brtan po rnams la brtan par grags / /yon tan dag 5gis phyogs su zhibazhad/ /btud pa yis btud phyag bgyis pa/ /rtag tu mchod cing rjed 7pa lags/ /stobs po che la shugs che ba/ /phyag ring g.yul chen mnga' ba po/ /sgeg 8chen rdo rje dam pa ste/ /'dzem shes rab srung ngo tsha shes/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i snying po'i mchog /dkyil 'khor chen po ston pa po/ /dkyil 'khor chen por 'grags pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mdzad pa lags/ /dkyil 'khor slob dpon dkyil 'khor can/ /zhabs la rjed pa'i tshogs dang ldan/ /ha ha swā hā'i bdag che ba/ /mchod pa chen po sa dang mnyam/ /hūm̐ gis 'jigs mdzad 'jigs pa ste/ /'jigs pa'i 'od kyis gsal ba po/ /lha dang lha min rnams kyis btud/ /de bzhin mchod cing ri mor bgyid/ /zham ring gad rgyangs chen po can/ /rlung drag mun pa sel mdzad pa/ /'jig rten gsum du snyan par grags/ /gnod sbyin srin 1 pos 97—337

bsnyen bkur ba/ /drag po dkar mdzad bde 'byung ba/ /mnga' bdag gtsug gi nor bu can/ /'dzum zhing sgeg par kun du ston/ /spyod pa sa ltar brtan pa lags/ /nor bu'i dkyil 'khor 'od mdzes pa/ /nyi ma gsal ba lam 6)me ba / /nyi ma'i 'od 'dra 'ja' khugs 2)bzhin/ /tha ler zhugs shing rgya cher bzhad / /mthong na dga' zhing dga' bar mdzad/ /nor sbyin de bzhin gsang sngags sbyin/ /dbang phyug sbyin zhing rgyal srid sbyin/ /gzugs sbyin de bzhin stobs sbyin pa/ /dpal ldan dpal mdzad bgegs gnon ri/ /kun du rmongs pa sel bar mdzad/ /'dus pa'i nang du gdan gshegs pa/ /zhabs la mchod pa'i tshogs bsags pa/ /dpung rgyan snyan cha gdub kor can/ /nor bu'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu 'gro ba'i sgron/ /rab rib sel bar mdzad pa po / /ston pa ston mdzad skyong mdzad pa/ /dbang po mnga' bdag dmag gi mchog /'jigs pa sel bar mdzad pa ste/ /'jigs pa med pa'i gnas sbyin pa / /dkar ba sngo ba 'od bzang ba/ /mgrin sngon gyi ni ston pa lags/ /ji ltar 'dul ba 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin cha lugs rab tu ston/ /shes rab ral gris 'debs par mdzad/ /stong nyid chos ni lhur 'dzin pa/ /byams pa mchog dang tha ma mkhyen/ /rnam par grags pa gsan pa des/ /rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyis bstod/ /rig sngags 'chang ba stobs po che/ /shin tu rnam rgyal 'khor los sgyur/ /'jigs med blo gros shes rab can/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos 'dzin pa/ /mgur bzang 'dul mdzad zhi ba ste/ /zhi ba'i lam ni ston mdzad pa/ /lha dang lha gemin bcas pas bkur/ /sems can thams cad 'jigs med mdzad/ /sems can kun la rab ston pa/ /brtan po 97—338

sems can kun gyi mchog /sems can rnams kyi blo la mkhas/ /srid med bu ste drag shul stobs/ /me yi 'od dang 'dra ba ste/ /byis 14)pa sku mchog mchog sbyin pa/ /rtsed mo rol mo ston par mdzad/ /phyag rgya mdzad cing (2rdzogasang sngags mdzad / /bdag gir 8)mi 'dzin rdul med brtan/ /mkha' 'dra dpe med smra mkhas pa/ /bdud dpung nges par 'joms pa po/ /mi mchog brtson pa 4bskyod du med/ /de bzhin thub med rnam par rgyal/ /brtan po sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /mya ngan med cing gnas pa med/ /'joms med tshig bzang chu lugs bzang / /dpa' bo dgra rnams rab 'joms pa/ /tshan chen nges 'joms rnal 'byor par/ /'dod pa gnod pa khyab par gshegs/ /mgon po rgyal ba'i sras kyi mchog /gshin rje pham mdzad skye dgu srung / /las dang nyon mongs rab sreg pa/ /ston mdzad nyon mongs sel ba lags/ /legs pa khyod kyi mchog gi mtshan/ /brgya rtsa brgyad pa rab gsal zhing / /dad pa skyed phyirapar byed pa 'di/ /lha 7mchog rnams kyis rab tu bshadan/ /bgegs chen dang ni log 'dren dang / /gnod sbyin lha min srin po dang / /mdangs 'phrog gtum po rgod rnams kyis/ /de ring legs par bstod par gyur//'jam dpal rdo rje mchog gis 9rab/ /bsgyings pasaphyo bltas pa'ang bde bar gyur / /de dag kun la bltas nas kyang / /'di skad du ni tshig smras pa/ /khyed kun rtag tu bgegs med cing / /nges legs thar pa thob gyur la/ /'jigs med bkra yang shis par shog /nga la 'jigs par ma sems shig /de nas rab tu cher bzhad cing / /'brug chen sgra ni sgrogs pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zhal gsal bas11/ /shar phyogs gzigs nas bka' stsal pa/ /kye 12ma gsang 97—339

sngags mchog gi yul/ /sems can gti mug bsal ba'i phyir/ /sems can rnams kyi bsod nams tshogs/ /shin tu rgyas pa byung bar gyur/ /kye ma bsod nams cher byas pa'i/ /sems can rnams ni (1)rab sbyang phyir/ /dam pa (nasasbyin pa'i grub pa'i gzungs/ /'jam pa'i klog gis rab tu bshad/ /la la gang zhig mnyam bzhag nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba yi/ /grub pa'i gzungs 'di 'don pa'am/ /yang na nyan tam sems kyang rung / /de yi don kun 'grub 'gyur zhing / /sdug bsngal kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam dag pa/ /de yis nges par thob par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa chen yang / /ring por mi thogs de riyis 'thob/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sa/ /rab dga' shin tu dri ma med/ /'od byed pa dang 'od 'phro can/ /sbyang dka' de bzhin mngon du gyur/ /ring du song dang mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ /sa chen dam pa de dag kyang / /gang zhig nges gnas 'dod pa yi/ /sems can chen pos mi thogs par/ /tshe zad nas ni thob par 'gyur/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam dag dang ca/ /sems can kun la sdug pa dang / /spros pa thams cad zhi ba yi/ /byang chub bla med thob par 'gyur/ /rig sngags 'chang kun bskyed 5pa dang / /sdig pa thams cad zhi byed pa/ /bkra shis mchog tu dge ba yi/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad yid 'ong 'di / /sor mo bcu yi 6thal sbyar nas/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mdun 'dug la / /shin tu dang ba'i sems kyis su/ /nang par langs nas su brjod pa/ /de la rig 7sngags 'chang kun dang / /de bzhin lha yi 8bdag po rnams/ /gnod sbyin srin po mang po dag /rtag tu yang ni srung bar byed/ /de bzhin 97—340

gshegs pa'i sras kun dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid rnams dang / /de bzhin rdo rje'i mtshon 'chang rnams/ /de la nges par srung bar byed/ /de ni sangs rgyas skur bzhugs shing / /mnyam par gzhag 17par snang bar 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin lha yi (2bdag po rnams/ /bgegs dang log 'dren chen po dag /dga' zhing bsam pa dam pa yis/ /rgyang ma dag nas phyag kyang 'tshal/ /de phyir bgegs rnams dga' gyur pas/ /'tshe bar byed kyang mi nus so/ /lan cig bklags na tsho4)tshangs chen dang / /bsod nams mnyam pa thob par 'gyur/ /shes rab chen po gang zhig gis/ /nyin re mtshan mchog brjod byas na/ /dri ma med cing rab dag la/ /rab tu 'od gsal sgra snyan dang / /sems can thams cad dga' ba yi/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gnas kyang 'thobasku/ /mtshungs pa med cing stobs bskyed 56lam mchog 'gro ba dang / /'od gsal dam tshig can gyi lha rnams kyis bstod cing / /yid 'phrog lha dang lha min tshogs te 'dun pa yi/ /gzungs 'di rgyal ba rnams kyis legs par gsungs pa yin7/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa rdzogs theṭan / / //97—341

bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sku gdung dang ldan pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du zla ba yar gyi ngo / tshes brgyad dam/ tshes bcwa 1lnga la smyung bar 'dug cing gso sbyong nadang ldan par byas te/ spos dang / bdug pa dang / mar me dang / me tog dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa la sogs pas mchod la/ bskor ba byas nas bzlas brjod byas na/ dam pa ci 'dod pa thob par 'gyur te/ sdig pa thams cad dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la spos la sogs pas mchod de/ bzlas brjod byas na rmi lam du ston par 'gyur te/bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed cing / nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed do/ /de nas rdo rje me tog thod chen po sa gsum gyi /nodabang phyug dang thabs cig tu 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de'i nang nas stan las langs ter/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la btud nas/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis mngon par bstod pa/sems can kun gyi gtso bo che/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul che ba/ /nyon mongs dri ma kun las 'das/ /chos dbyings khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrib pa kun las nges par grol/ /nyon mongs dri ma kun sel cing / /nyes pa kun las rnam par grol/ /skyon bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam srang gcig pu'i tshul ston cing / /theg pa gcig pu'i tshul gcig pa/ /theg pa chen po'i tshul brnyes te / /theg pa dag pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /snang ba chen po snang ba brnyes6/ /yon tan dkyil 'khor 'jig rten bdag /zla ba bzhin du 'od dkar ba/ /'jig rten 'das pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /theg pa chen po dag pa che/ /sangs 97—345

rgyas theg pa rtogs gyur cing / /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rnam grags pa/ /rdo rje chen po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dpa' bo chen po bdud las rgyal/ /dar ba chen po nyon mongs choms/ /bgegs thub gshin rje thub pa ste/ /rin chen dra ba khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zla ba chen po nyi ma che/ /lhun po chen po dbang phyug che/ /lha chen mgon po chen po ste/ /'byor pa chen po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sgrib pa thams cad gcod mdzad cing / /sgrib pa thams cad sel mdzad pa/ /kun mkhyen yon tan bdag nyid che/ /rnam sel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul zhugs pa ste/ /chos kyi spyod yul gshegs pa lags/ /ye shes dbang phyug ye shes che/ /sred bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku 1rimadzes yon tan snying po mkhyen / /rdo rje yi ni dkyil 'khor brgyan na/ /sangs rgyas lam ste don yod che/ /ye shes dag pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bstan pa gnas pa dbang bdag po/ /bde mdzad thugs kyang zhi ba ste/ /yangs pa dri med shes rab can/ /snang ba dag pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zab cing brtan skul rnam par gnonarig/ /zhi la 'jig rten dag par mdzad/ /ston pa skyabs 'os srid gsum na/ /dpa' btsan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skal rab chen po nyon mongs bcom/ /'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor 'joms pa ste/ /zhi ba zhi mdzad bde 'byung ba/ /chu bo zhi mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /thar pa'i rgyu ste chos lugs che/ /bde 'gror gnas pa dri ma med//rnam dag thugs mnga' zhi ba mkhyen/ /nyes sel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo rtse mo yangs par rnam par grags/ /sngags chen mang pos 'dul mdzad pa/ /snying po chen po dkyil 'khor mchog /dkyil 'khor mkhyen pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sdug bsngal gsum sel gsum gyi mchog /dkon mchog gsum dang spyod yul 'dra/ /97—346

rnam gsum mkhyen pa rnyed 1pa'i bdag /rnam thar gsum khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i (5yon tan gyi ri/ /'byor pa brnyes 47shing mnyam nyid brnyes / /bskal pa dag ni grangs med par/ /tshogs chen bsags pa khyod phyag 'tshal / /sa la gnas pa sa chen brnyes/ /sa yi 'bras bu phun sum tshogs/ /yang dag sa 'dzin las byung ba/ /ye shes sa khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pa/ /nyes gsum spong zhing sdig pa sel/ /ting 'dzin mkhyen cing rgya che ba/ /mnyam pa nyid mnyam khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mgon po chen po snang ba che/ /sdug bsngal chen po'i dri ma sel/ /zhi gyur ma lus zhi mdzad pa/ /yon tan pha mtha' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun mtshungs gsung ldan pa/ /chos kun zhi ba phun sum tshogs/ /dkon mchog gsum rigs dpe med pa/ /rin chen mtha' yas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje chen po dri med mchog /rdo rje'i mtshon bsnams sdig mi mnga'/ /nam mkha' ma lus yul dang ldan/ /ye shes spyod yul rgya mtsho mnga'/ /de bzhin gshegs dang yul gcig pa/ /sel ba po ste dri ma sbyong / /shes rab chen po rgyal ba'i sras/ /srid gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje'i mchog /rdo rjes pa'adul ba rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje 6rtsal can rnams kyi rtsal/ /rdo rje snang ba khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rin chen chen po rin chen blo/ /rin chen rdo rje 'od che ba/ /rin chen 'od mdzes rin chen 'byung / /rin chen bstan pa srung mdzad pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi yul brnyes pa/ /ye shes stong pa nyid kyis ston/ /stong nyid longs spyod yul dang ldan/ /stong nyid mchog khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab mtshungs med shes rab can/ /dge ba rnam dag sa dang bral/ /chos gcig las byung snang ba po/ /97—347

rog /'phags pa sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/91)༄༅na /'phags pa sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ susta ni sum+bha/ ha ra tsa ra / ma hā ( pā sha /ma ru tā/ a mo gha badz+ra satwa swā hā/ de nas yon tan sbyin dpa yi/ /gzungs 'di bshad ma thag tu yang / /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /ti se'i gangs bcas g.yos par gyur/ / sa yi 4snying po tshogs dbang la/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis smras/ /skal ldan chen po legs so legs / /sa steng khyod kyis yangs par byas/ /khyod 5kyi gzungs ni rnam 6grags shing / /yon tan dpag med mchog bskyed 7pa/ /sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal dang / /nyes pa zlog byed thos pa ni/ /'khor bar rab tu rgyu ba na/ /nyes pa kun gyis mi gos te/ /ji ltar 'dam gyi pad+ma dag /'dam gyi 8nyes 97—351

pas mi gos bzhin/ /lus can dag las su yang rung / /khyod kyi (1)gsang sngags 'chang byed pa/ /de dag las ni gcig tsam yang / /byang chub las ni ldog mi 'gyur/ /mkhas pa gang zhig gzungs sngags mchog /thos nas mos par byed pa ni/ /nges par yon tan thams cad kyang / /thob par 'gyur te the tshom med/ /de nas thams cad ldan pa'i 'khor/ /langs rir te sa yi dbang phyug po / / sa yi na snying po sa mchog la/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad smras pa ni/ /sa yi snying po gtso bo che/ /glag la'agyu lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba/ /cod pan can te sa brnyes pa/ /phun sum tshogs ldan 'byor pa mchog /rig ldan rig mdzad mchod pa'i gnas/ /gtso bo dge sbyong ston pa po/ /gzhi bcas ldan pa'i rlung gi tshul/ /swā hā'i blo ldan snying rje'i rab/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i nyi ma'i mchog /snying po snying 5po mkhyen par grags/ /gsang sngags rol cing rgya cher rol / /sa yi dbang phyug gar thabs can/ /sgeg po zhal bzang gar mkhan ldan / /'bras bu mngon sum ston pa po/ /rab 'byor blo gros snying po mkhyen/ /snying po brnyes pa 'jigs pa med/ /mgon po sangs rgyas gzugs mnga' ba/ /shes rab kyis ni ma lus gzigs/ /'dod chags la sogs skyon bsal tsho6cing / /gar thabs chen po ston pa po/ /ston pa dpag 7bsam shing dang 'dra/ /nam mkha'i dbang phyug gsung snyan pa/ /nyi ma chen po nyid yin te/ /dbang phyug chen po 'bar bas bskor/ /yon tan mtha' yas longs spyod pa/ /sa yi dbang phyug spyod yul can/ /chos kyi longs spyod longs spyod che/ /yon tan rgya mcho'i gang 8chen mtsho/ /yon tan sna tshogs longs spyod pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mchog /thabs tshul zab la mkhas pa ste/ /theg pa 97—352

chen po 'jigs pa med17/ /mchod pa chen po sgra che ba/ /zla ltar grags pa'i dkyil 'khor can/ /rdo rje 'chang chen mtshan brgya pa/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor me tog thod/ /blo gros chen po phyag ring ba/ /pad+ma chen po stobs po che/ /gsang sngags chen po tshogs chen po/ /sa gzhi 5)chen po lhun po lags/ /lag na rdo rje yon tan des/ /nor bu'i me tog thod kyis dbargyan/ /mnyam nyid 'byam calongs spyod pa yi55ri/ /rgya chen zhing gi rgya mtsho can/ /rdo rje'i 'od mnga' 6rdo rje ldan / / sa yi 7ribadag po lhun po bzhin/ /sa la longs spyod longs spyod bzang / /mtshon cha g.yo ba phun sum tshogs/ /rab 'byam skusnod ni rnam par grags / /smra mkhas rdo rje rab 'joms pa/ /spyan rtsa yid tsam dmar ba ste/ /me tog sngon po'i thod kyis bcings/ /spro ba chen po phyag ring ba/ /brtan po brtan la bde sbyin pa/ /ded dpon dpal bzang chen po ste/ /gangs can lhun po lta bu lags/ /dbang po gshin rje'i rgyal chen dang / /btsan po khyab 'jug stobs dbang phyug /'jig rten mchog rigs sangs rgyas tshangs/ /de bzhin nyid tshul spyod yul can/ /rin chen tog ste cher bzhad pa/ /dgyes pa na bza' sna tshogs gsol/ /gzigs pa ring ba spyan yangs pa/ /nam mkha' bzhin du thogs pa med/ /thogs pa mi dpogs rin chen gtsug /srid gsum 'dod pa med pa'i rgyu/ /dul ba nyon mongs dri ma bsal9/ /dag pa gtsang ba gso sbyong can/ /rnam par gnon pa'i g.yul 1 las 'das/ /ljang mdog skyabs mdzad snying rje che/ /stobs kyis 11grags pa rgya che ba/ /bsams na shes pa'i spyod yul can/ /dpa' bo seng ge 'jigs par byed/ /sdang ba rnams kyi snying 'joms pa/ /mnga' bdag grags pa yul dang ldan/ /dga' ba rgya chen 97—353

rab 'byung tsho17ba/ /rigs mkhyen rigs kyi snying po mkhyen/ /rigs kun du ni mchod pa lags/ /rgyal po rigs mchog skyed (5)pa'i rten/ /rdo rje yi ni dkyil 'khor brgyan / /rdo rje sa 'og rab grags pa/ /rig sngags 'chang ba stobs po che / /mngon par 'phags pa khyab pa mchog /mgrin bzangs charand dang bral ba lags/ /skyong mdzad ston pa dag pa ste/ /sangs rgyas lam ni rab ston pa/ /grol ba smin mdzad 'dud par mdzad/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus rnams kyis brgyan//rab zhugs dkyil 'khor rnams la mkhas/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon yon tan rten/ /grub pa sbyin pa rnam dag mchog /tshul dang tshul min rtogs pa po/ /dkyil 'khor rtsa ser mnga' ba ste/ /'od zer ljang gu'i 5sku'od dang ldan/ /ser la na bza' ser po mnabs6/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus kun gyis 97)brgyan(8༄/ /spyan rtsa dmar ba zla ba'i dpal/ /nor bu sna tshogs 'od 'byung ba/ /rdo rje brgya yi stobs kyis spro/ /mnyam nyid mnyam pa dri ma med/ /sku yang dag cing na bza' dag /dag pa mkhyen cing dag par ldan/ /dag pa'i chos mnga' 79༄snang ba ste/ /'byung ldan srid 1 pa sel mdzad pa/ /'khor ba zad mdzad shes rab can/ /tshul shes tshul la spyod yul ba/ /rdo rje rgya mtsho'i snying po lags/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dge ba che/ /'byung ldan rab 'byam 11shes rab can/ /ma lus grags pa'i 'od bzang ba/ /sa yi snying po snying po che/ /rdo rje'i snying po rnam par 'dren / /dpag tu med pa dpag med rdzogs/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i yul la gnas / /zab cing gsal ba'i gtso bo ste/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer bsil12 / /dga' dad dang ba skyed pa ste/ /ye shes rgya chen spyod yul ba/ /rlung gi drag shul lta bur drag /drag po lags te drag sel gtsang / /rgyal bar 97—354

byed cing rgyal ba zhi/ /rgyal ba'i dpal mdzad dga' bar mdzad/ /lhun po ti se ma la yas/ /spyod yul zab mo non pa ste/ /rin chen rdo rje snying po che/ /sa gzhi'i 1)spyod yul mnga' ba lags/ /rin chen brag las byung ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dag gis brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs la lhur 2dgyes pa/ /shugs drag dpal gyi gzhi rten lags/ /rab gsal dpal mdzad gtsang ma ste//phyogs bcu'i dbang phyug dbang phyug che/ /de ltar rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad mchog rnams kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpas bstod nas ni/ /rdo rje sa gsum dbang mchog smras/ /yon tan snying po shes rnams kyis/ /ming ba rgya 5rtsa brgyad mchog brjod 6cing / /nyes pa zlog pa 'di las gzhan/ /sa yi steng na ngas ma mthong / /ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa 'di/ /thams cad 'grub byed dga' ba ste/ /sdig pa thams cad sel ba dang / /dri ma kun bral yon tan nges / /de phyir sgrim 7pa thams cad kyis/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa'i mis / /ming brgya rtsa brgyad dge ba 'di/ /rtag tu yang ni brjod par gyis/ /mi 8brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa 'di/ /bsam pa kun dang 'byor pa yi/ /gnas mchog bla na med pa ste/ /dpal yon rgya 9chen sbyin nyu pa yin/ /yid ni shin tu dang ba 11yis/ /sa yi snying po'i mtshan gsal ba/ /'dod pa thams cad rab sgrub pa'i/ /yon tan mchog ni gang brjod 12dang / /dpal yon rgya chen 'dzin pa yi/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa 'di/ /mi 1 ni gang zhig rjod byed pa/ /sdug bsngal kun las myur du 'grol/ /'phags pa sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa rdzogs so1 // //1597—355

bsdur 'bras re'u migagazungs 'dus/ (5༷9)

rog /'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1༄༅ga /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya aṣ+ṭa maṇ+ḍal ka nanā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ri gru 'dzin na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi caganas na byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang thabs cig 5tu bzhugs te/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen snying po zla ba snang ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur nas 'dug pa de stan las langs nas chos gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 6logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas 97—358

zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/bcom lda na 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen snying po zla ba snang ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rin chen snying po zla ba snang ba khyod ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / ngas dris pa de dang de'i lung bstan pas khyod kyi 915sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen snying po zla ba snang bas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig dkyil 'khor brgyad pa bgyid par 'tshal na des ji ltar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod skye bo mang po la shin tu phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / dus gsum du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes bsgrub pa'i phyir rigs kyi bu khyod spobs pa skyes pa ni bzang ste legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir snying po gang brjod pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga 'byang zhing / dngos grub thams cad kyang thob par 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi snying po nyon cig /oṃ ma hā hūm̐ ma hā bī ra swā hā/ snying po 'dis 2ni dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das mchod do/ /o hrī /rtsu pad+ma pri ya swā hā/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po'o/ /oṃ mi lahā rā ṇa swā hā/ byams pa'i snying po'o/ /o ā kā sha gar+sā 5ya swā hā/ nam mkha'i snying po'i snying po'o/ /oṃ swā hri 6rā dza ya swā hā / kun du bzang po'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ku ru bha na ra ha swā hā/ lag na rdo 97—359

rje'i snying po'o/ /oṃ shrī saṃ raṃ tsho1rig swā hā/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ni swā 2ro bha swā hā/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i snying po'o / /oṃ k+ṣi ti ha 3'o dza swā hā/ sa'i snying po'i snying po'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi snying po de bzhin gshegs pa dang ldan pa 'di rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du lan cig brjod na de'i don thams cad 'grub 4par 'gyur te/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag yi 55rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs theṭa6 / / //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi 7na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de 8yi shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad 9kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa// //1 97—360

tshog /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi snying po gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog ces bya ba'i gzungs theg pa chen po'i mdo/1༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sarba ta thā 2ga ta a dhiṣ+ṭha na ṣ+ṭṛ da ya gu h+ya dhā tu 4ka raṇ+ḍa sbrunā ma dhā ra tī ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis 6 brlabs kyi 7snying po gsang ba 8ring bsrel gyi za ma tog ces bya ba'i gzungs theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga dhā 9na dri ma med pa'i kun dga' ra ba na rin po che sna bdun gyi rdzing na/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang / nyan thos kyi dge 'dun chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa bye ba mang po rnams dang / yul gyi mi 'bum phrag du ma rnams kyis yongs su bskor 97—362

cing 6)mdun du byas nas thabs cig (5)tu bzhugs so/ /de nas 'khor gyi nang de na bram ze chen po shing sā (5)la chen po lta bu mkhas pa/ mdzangs ril pa/ gsal ba/yid gzhungs pa/ mthong na dga' ba/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yongs su bzung ba (5)dri med legs snang zhes bya ba zhig yod de kyi/ de yang gcig tu dkon mchog gsum la dad cing gus la phyag byed pa'i dge ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pa/zhib mo brtags pa/ sems can thams cad dang dge ba'i don la brtson pa/nor che ba/ longs spyod che ba/ phyug pa/ rdzas mang ba/ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /de nas bram ze chen po dri med legs snang bcom ldan 'das ga la der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan bdun bskor ba byas nas / bcom ldan 'das la me tog dang / bdug pas mngon par mchod do/ /na bza' rin 'bum ri ba yang gsol/ bcom ldan 'das la mu tig gi do shal (1)'bum ri ba yang 8rigasol nas/ zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/bcom ldan 'das kyi (9)spyan sngar 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sras tshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas pa bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren na/ de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang bar mdzad par ci gnang 1 / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze chen po dri (1med legs snang gis spyan drangs par thugs su chud nas cang mi gsung bar gyur pas gnang ngo / /de nas bram ze chen po dri med 12legs snang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ de rings pa rings par rang gi khyim du song ste/ de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das pa dang /zhal zas dang / yo byad dang / zhal zas ro brgya pa mang po bshams nas 97—363

bkod pa chen pos bkra shis kyi gzhal med khang 1tshodang / gzhal med khang chen po sna tshogs dang / me tog dang / bdug pa khyer te 'khor mang po dang /sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das la dus la bab par gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la bram ze chen po dri med legs snang gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni gshegs pa'i dus lags te/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa'i dus kyi tshod la bab na bdag la gnang bar mdzad par 2ci gnang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze chen po dri med legs snang dbugs phyung nas nyid kyi 'khor la gzigs te bka' stsal pa/ 'khor ji ltar lhags pa thams cad deng don chen po mdzad par 'gyur gyis tshur sheg /de nas bcom ldan 'das gdan de las bzhengs nasadzol/ bcom ldan 'das gdan de las bzhengs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las 5'od zer tha dad pa sna tshogs byung ste/ 'od zer gyi snang ba des phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad snang bar byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la yang dag par bskul te gzigs nas gshegs par shes so/ /de nas bram ze chen po dri med legs snang gis mchod pa dang / bkur sti chen pos mchod cing bcom ldan 'das kyi gshegs shul mdzes pa cher byas so/ /'khor mang po 'dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / sred med kyi bu dang / rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang gshegs shul mdzes par byas so/ /de nas 97—364

bcom ldan 'das dang ha cang yang mi ring ba'i lam gyi bar gyi nang zhig na skyed mos tshal bde byed ces bya ba zhig yod do/ /skyed mos tshal de'i nang na mchod rten rnying pa chen po zhig yod de1/ zhig pa tsher mas gang ba/ rtswa 2dang /shing dang / gyo mos kun du gang ba phyag dar gyi phung po lta bu zhig yod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de'i drung du gshegs pa dang / mchod rten rnying pa phyag dar gyi phung po lta bu de yang kun nas 'bar zhing 'od zer 'bar ba kha dog sna tshogs pa dag byung ngo / /phyag dar dang 4gyo mo'i phung po de las kyang legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa legs so legs so/ /deng ni (5ragashegs pa'i ltas bzang po'o/ /bram ze chen po de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs pa na 6yang khyod legs so/ /deng khyod la don chen po mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas mchod rten rnying pa phyag dar gyi phung po lta bu de la yan lag lngas 7phyag mdzad nas lan gsum bskor ba mdzad nas nyid kyi sku las na bza' gsil 9nas mchod rten rnying ba phyag dar gyi phung po lta bu de la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mchi ma byung ba chen po phyung bas bshums pa mdzad nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa bstan te/'dzum pa 1 bstan pa des phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad lag mthil na bzhugs pa bzhin du mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang spyan mchi mas gang zhing bzhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang 'od zer bkye ste/ mchod rten rnying pa'i phung po chen po 11der zhugs so/ /de nas 'khor mang po 'dus pa de dag ya mtshan chen por gyur cing yi chad de 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde 12dpon chen po lag na 97—365

rdo rje (1)lus ni 'dar/ snying ni 'gul/ rdo rje ni gsor zhing rings pa rings nga/cir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom/ ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bshums pa'i snga ltas chen po gda' ba gang gis nan / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan mchi mas gang ba bstan pa'i snga ltas gda' ba bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ci'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor rina'adi'i nang du zhu ba 'di skabs dbye bar ci gnang ri sna/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' gyur stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje ring bsrel gyi phung po de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba til gyi gang bu snyed thams cad kyi snying po'i gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i mchod rten gyi chos kyi rnam grangs yod de/ lag na rdo rje chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gang na gnas pa der de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba til gyi gang bu snyed gnas shing / de bzhin gshegs pa khar yas khar yas zhes bya ba snyed kyi sku gdung ring bsrel rnams gnas so/ /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gnas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba til gyi gang bu ji snyed 6)pa dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i gtsug tor dang / spyi bo yang de bzhin du gnas so/ /lag na rdo rje gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gnas pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten du lung bstan to/ /lag na rdo rje chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni 'di ltar 7phan yon che zhing mthu che ba yin no/ /lag na rdo rje chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni phan yon che ba yin no/ /lag na rdo rje chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni bkra shis thams cad rdzogs par byed pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 97—366

las 'khor mang po 'dus pa de dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral la de nas (1)nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang bral lo/ /kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /kha cig gis ni dgra bcom pa nyid do/ /kha cig gis ni rang byang chub kyi 'bras bu'o / /kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /kha cig gis ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /kha cig gis ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa la gnas so / /kha cig gis ni byang chub tu lung bstan pa thob bo/ /kha cig gis ni sa dang po'o/ /kha cig gis ni sa gnyis pa'o/ /kha cig gis ni sa gsum pa'o/ /kha cig gis ni sa bzhi pa'o/ /kha cig gis ni sa lnga pa'o/ /kha cig gis ni sa drug pa'o/ /kha cig gis ni sa bdun pa'o/ /kha cig gis ni sa brgyad pa'o/ /kha cig gis ni sa dgu pa'o/ /kha cig gis ni sa bcu pa la gnas par gyur to/ /kha cig gis ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs so/ /bram ze chen po de yang mngon par shes pa lnga thob cing dri ma dang bral ba dang / ser sna dang phrag dog dang bral bar gyur to/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes cho 'phrul chen po 'di lta bu mthong nas ngo mtshar dang rmad du byung ba chen por gyur te(5kyi / /bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs kyi mtshan thos pas kyang phan yon gyi yon tan gyis brgyan pa 'di lta bu thob na/ bcom ldan 'das gang gi /slad du phu dud dang / bkur ste 4shin tu mang po bgyid par 'gyur ba lta ci smos te/ bcom ldan 'das de bsod nams kyi phung po ji lta bu yang mthong bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje nyon cig /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/97—367

dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen 1)nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la las 5chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dri bar byed na/ lag na rdo rje dkodes de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig til gyi gang bu snyed dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang ldan par 'gyur zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis rjes su gzung cabar 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig klog par byed pa de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs pa'i mdo sde rnams bcangs par 5'gyur ro/ /gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu 'dzin pa de dag phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig til gyi gang bu snyed dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang / phyogs re re'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gzung 6bar 'gyur zhing / nyin gcig bzhin gzigs par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mchod pa byed pa dang / khong du chud par byed pa dang /me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / me tog phreng rgyud 7dang / byug pa dang / na bza' dang / lhab lhub dang /8 rgyan gyis mchod pa byed pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma des phyogs bcu dang / phyogs re re'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig til gyi gang bu snyed dgu bcu rtsa dgu la lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / me tog phreng rgyud 9dang / byug pa dang / na bza' dang /lhab lhub dang / rgyan gyis mchod par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs re re'i de bzhin gshegs pa la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i ri rab chen po tsam gyi phung po'i yon tan 1 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de 97—368

nas lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang 1/ mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang /mi ma yin pa rnams dang / sems can gyi tshogs chen po de rnams kyang ya mtshan du gyur nas/ gcig la gcig 'di skad du/ mchod rten rnying pa phyag dar dang / gyo mo'i phung po de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs dkyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'di ni rdzu ca'aphrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po ston pas mthu che ba yin no zhes zer ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di sus phyag dar gyi phung por bgyis pa las rin po che'i mchod rten du gda' bar bgyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje 'di phyag dar gyi phung po ma yin gyi / 'di ni rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i rin po che'i mchod rten chen po yin no/ /lag na rdo rje 'on kyang sems can rnams kyi las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ston pas nub par gyur 5gyi/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po'i mchod rten rnams ni 'jig pa'am/ 'gyes par mi 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i snying po'i sku ji ltar 'gyes par 'gyur/'on kyang sems can rnams kyi las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa snang ba las kyang nub par gyur to/ /lag na rdo rje gzhan yang phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe sdig pa kun du spyod pa dang / sdig pa can dang / dmyal ba la gzhol ba shin tu tshabs cher 'byung bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas ma yin/ chos ma yin/ dge 'dun tshol ba ma yin zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba dag kyang skyed par mi byed de/ rgyu de dang rkyen des dam pa'i chos nub bo/ /lag na rdo rje de'i phyir nga'i mig gnyis mchi mas gang la 97—369

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang mchi ma byung ngo / /dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu ni nub par 'gyur gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod 1)rten ni ma gtogs te/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bris te/ mchod rten gyi nang du 'jog na dge ba'i rtsa ba ci zhig skye bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bris te/ mchod rten gyi nang du bzhag pa de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i snying po'i ring bsrel gyi mchod rten du 'gyur ro//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzungs kyi snying po (5)gsang bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rten du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa til gyi gang bu snyed dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i mchod rten du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor dang / spyan gyi mchod rten du byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro / /gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan nam/ mchod rten thams cad kyi nang du 'jog par byed na de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo'i phreng ba dang / dril bu g.yer ga'i dadra bar sbrel ba dang bcas pa dang / bkra shis dang char khab kyi gzugs dang dril bur bcas pa rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs 4par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang 5/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i mthu dang / byin gyis brlabs (6)dang /bden pa dang / dam tshig gis 75byang chub kyi snying po la (8)thug gi bar du byin 97—370

gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag mchod rten de la phu dud dang / bsti zhi)stang byed pa de dag nges par phyir mi ldog par 'gyur zhing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal ba gcig dang / bskor ba gcig gis mnar med pa la thug pa la sogs pa rnams las yongs su thar bar 'gyur zhing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang na mchod rten namatshonasta/ gzugs brnyan 'di lta bu gnas pa'i sa phyos/sa de yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs der klu mi srun pas kyang mi tshugs par 'gyur/ sad dang ser bas kyang mi tshugs par 'gyur/ gnas der srog chags mi srun pa'am/ gdug pas kyang mi tshugs par 'gyur/ gcan gzan dzo gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ bya mi srun pa dang / ne tso dang / ri skegs dang / byi ba dang / sre mo dang / sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu dang / bye ba dang / sbrang ma mchu gsum pa dang / mchu rings 'byedang / rta bla ba'i 'jigs pa yang mi 'byung bar 'gyur/ sbrul gdug pas tshugs par mi ra 'gyur ro/ /phyogs der yams kyi nad dang / nad 'go neb dang / 'khrug pa yang mi 'byung 75bar 'gyur/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / yi dgas dang / 'dre dang / brjed 85byed kyi 'jigs pa yang mi 'byung bar 'gyur/ gdon thams cad kyis kyang mi tshugs par 'gyur/ rims thams cad kyis kyang mi tshugs par 'gyur/ nad thams cad dang / 'bras dang / phol mig dang / lhog pa dang / mtshan bar rdol ba dang / rkang shu dang / g.yan pa dang / mdzes kyang mi tshugs par 'gyur 97—371

zhing / mchod rten de 17mthong ba tsam gyis thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /phyogs der ba lang gi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas rnam pa mang po gzhan dag gi nad dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang /khye'u dang / bu mo'i nad kyis kyang 2tshonam yang mi tshugs par 'gyur/ dus ma yin par 'chi dbas kyang dus ma yin par 'chi bar mi 'gyur/ dug gis ma yin / mtshon gyis ma yin zhing / me dang chus kyang nam yang mi tshugs par 'gyur / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi ca'ajigs pas ma yin/ lo nyes kyi 'jigs pas kyang nam yang mi tshugs par 'gyur/ rgyal po chen po'i dmag gi 5'jigs pa yang mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi'ang 6rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par 7sa phyogs der srung bar byed/ yongs su skyong bar byed do/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad po de dag kyang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par srung ba dang / skyob pa dang / sbed pa na byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / mjug rings chen po yang nyin mtshan mthun par byed par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i rgyal po thams cad kyang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par mdangs mi 'phrog 95cing / legs pa kho nar char 1 gyi rgyun 'bebs par 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad kyang mchod rten chen po de la phyag 'tshal ba dang / bkur sti 11bya ba dang / mchod pa bya ba'i phyir gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis nas dus gsum du 'ong ngo / /yul na gnas pa thams cad kyang mchod rten dang gzugs brnyan de'i drung du dus gsum du 'ong ngo / /stod 1 par byed/skor 1 ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams kyi ri1 dbang po brgya byin kyang lha'i bu mo dang / lha'i tshogs rnams dang lhan cig tu rgyun mi 'chad par mchod rten nam sa97—372
