byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sde snod yin par rig par bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin brgya 1stong rnams rtag par mngon sum du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni nam mkha'i mdzod yin par rig par bya ste/ rtag par stong pa nyid kyi shes rab kyis nasems can la blta ba'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni 'jigs pa med pa'i mdzod yin par rig par bya ste / lha dang / klu dang / dge ba'i lha rnams rtag par yongs su srung ba'i phyir ro / /gang zag de ni dam pa'i tshig gi mdzod yin par rig par bya ste/ kha nas gzungs kyi sgra 'byung ba la rgyun chad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni rtag par gnas pa'i gter yin par rig par bya ste/ 'jig pa gsum gyi bskal pa cadag gis gzhig par 5mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni rnam par grol ba'i mdzod yin par rig par bya ste/ lha'i bu'i bdud dang mu stegs can rnams kyis gshol (6)bar mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni sman gyi rgyal po'i mdzod yin par rig par bya ste/ rtag par gzungs kyis sems can nad pa rnams kyi nad gso ba'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni rdzu 'phrul gyi gter yin par rig par bya ste/sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su rgyu ba la rang dbang thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na gang zag de'i yon tan gyi bsngags 7pa brjod na nams kyang namathar thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gang la la zhig 'jig rten pa'i sdug bsngal gyis 9yongs su skyo 1 nas tshe ring ba'i sman yongs su tshol bar 'dod pas 11dben pa'i gnas su 'dug nas mtshams yongs su dag par bcad de/ gos la sngags kyis btab nas bgo bar bya'o/ /chu dang / zas dang / spos dang / sman rnams la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste spyod par byed na gdon mi za bar tshe 97—527

ring bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te chos bzhin du mtshams bcad de chos bzhin du yongs su 'dzin par byed na thams cad mngon par 'grub par 'gyur te/ de la mtshams gcad 1pa'i cho ga ni ral gri la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab sten / sa la ri mo bris nas mtshams gcad 5)par bya'o/ /yang na chu gtsang ma la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas phyogs bzhir gtor nas mtshams gcad 4par bya'o/ /yang na yungs kur 5)la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste 6phyogs bzhir gtor nas mtshams gcad par bya'o/ /yang na 'du shes kyis gang du phyin pa tshun chad mtshams su 'gyur ro/ /yang na thal ba gtsang ma la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste mtshams gcad par bya'o/ /yang na tshon sna lnga'i skud pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste (7)phyogs bzhir bskor nas mtshams gcad par bya'o/ /de ltar chos bzhin du 'di yongs su 'dzin par gyur na rang gi ngang gis 'bras bu 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 'di'i ming thos pa tsam gyis kyang bskal pa tshad med pa snyed kyi 'khor ba'i kha na ma tho ba'i lci ba rnams yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur na/ 'don pa dang 'dzin pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ rig sngags 'di 'don pa'i gang zag gang yin pa de dag ni sangs rgyas tshad med pa snyed pa la mchod cing rim gro byas nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher bskyed pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /gang dag sems can sdug bsngal gyi bgegs la yongs su 'dren pa'i ched du chos bzhin du 'don pa gang yin pa de dag ni snying rje chen po dang ldan pa yin pas ring por mi thogs par mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bar rig par bya'o/ /ci tsam du sems can snang ngo cog gi ched du bzlas brjod byas te/ de dag gi rna lam du 97—528

grag ri1)par byas nas byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur bar byed na/ gang zag de dag yon tan tshad med dpag tu med pa dag 'thob par 'gyur bas brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /gang la la zhig sems rtse gcig tu sems dang lus gso sbyong dang tshul khrims la gnas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi sngon gyi las kyi kha na ma tho ba rnams bshags nas bdag nyid kyis bskal pa tshad med pa nas byas pa'i sdig pa'i las rnam pa sna tshogs mthol rin bshags te/ kha nas gzungs 'di myur du bzlas brjod byas nas sgra rgyun chad pa med par byas na/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi po de dag tshe 'di nyid la 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /dbang po rnon po shes rab dang ldan pa sgom pa'i thabs la mkhas pa zhig yin na ni sa bcu'i 'bras bu yang dka' ba med par 'gyur na/ 'jig rten gyi bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa phran tshegs 4)yongs su gnyer ba tsam mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po dang smon lam gyi mthu shin tu zab pa'i phyir dang / gzungs 'di'i byin gyi brlabs 5shin tu rgya che ba'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/yul gang dag na gnod pa byung bar gyur na 6de'i tshe yul de'i rgyal pos yang dag pa'i chos kyis yul 'dzin cing / mi rnams bag yangs 7su bkod de/ sems can stangs 8las mi gcod cing / nyes pa byung ba rnams yongs su bskyabs nas / nyin mtshan bdun gyi bar du lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus bskyed de/thugs rje chen po'i sems kyi gzungs sngags 'di 'don par byed na/ yul de'i gnod pa dang / bgegs thams cad yongs su bsal bar 'gyur/ 'bru rnams legs shing mi mang po bde bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang phas kyi rgol ba'i dgra 97—529

dag yang nas yang du 'ongs te gtses pas 'bangs 7)mang po mi bde bar gyur tam / blon po chen pos rku bshams nas log par gyur tam/ rims nad byung bar gyur tam/ than chen byung bar gyur tam/ nyi (5)zla rgyu ba nor bar gyur tam/de lta bu la sogs pa'i gnod pa byung bar gyur na/ de'i tshe snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i mig stong pa'i gzugs byas nas de'i phyogs su kha bstan te/ spos dang / me tog dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rin po che'i bla re rnam pa sna tshogs dang / ro brgya dang ldan pa'i zas dang skom gyis sems rtse gcig tu mchod par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rgyal po des nyin mtshan bdun gyi bar du lus dang sems kyis brtson 'grus bskyed de/ gzungs kyi tshig gya rnam pa 'di 'don par byed na/ phas kyi 3dgra rnams rang dul bar gyur nas slar log ste (4riso so nas tshul bzhin du yul skyong zhing yul yang 'dre bar gnas par byams pa'i sems kyis phan tshun gcig la gcig lta sgrubar 'gyur/ rgyal bu dang blon po rnams kyang srid zhu dang drang dkan spyod par 'gyur/ btsun mo dang sras (phyirarnams kyang rgyal po la sri 7zhu dang bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur/ lha dang / klu dang / 'dre srin rnams shākyang yul de srung zhing skyong bar 'gyur/ char chu dus bzhin du 'bab cing 'bru rnams legs pas mi mang po rnams kyang rab tu dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang khyim du nad chen ma rungs pa dang phrad par gyur tam/ ltas ngan sna tshogs byung bar gyur tam/ 'dre srin dang log pa'i bdud rnams kyis khyim dkrugs 9par gyur tam/ mi ma rungs pa dag gis klan 7skur btab nas rku 11bshams te gnod pa byas par gyur tam/ khyim mi che chung rnams phyi nang mi 'dum par gyur na/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i mig stong 97—530

pa'i gzugs byas pa'i mdun du dkyil 'khor byas nas sems rtse 1gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid la byas nas gzungs sngags 'di lan stong tshang bar bzlas na/ gong du smos pa'i dngos po ngan pa de dag thams cad yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags 'di'i ming ci lags/ ji ltar yongs su gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo rig sngags 'di la ming rnam pa sna tshogs yod de/ rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /thogs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po zhes kyang bya'o/ /sdug bsngal rnams las yongs su skyob pa'i gzungs zhes kyang bya'o/ /tshe bsring ba'i gzungs zhes kyang bya'o/ /ngan 'gro yongs su sbyong ba'i gzungs zhes kyang bya'o/ /las kyi sgrib pa rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs zhes kyang bya'o/ /smon pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i gzungs zhes kyang bya'o/ /sems kyi (2rjes su rang dbang du gyur pa'i gzungs zhes kyang bya'o/ /sa gong ma rnams las myur du 'da' ba'i gzungs zhes kyang bya ste / de ltar yongs su gzung bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di'i ming ci lags na/ 'di lta bu'i gzungs bstan pa la mkhas par 'gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/byang chub sems dpa' 'di'i ming ni spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces kyang bya'o / /don yod pa'i zhags pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /'od stong pa'i mig can zhes kyang bya ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 97—531

'di'i ming dang gzi byin dang mthu stobs ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ 'das pa'i bskal pa tshad med pa'i snga rol nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas mtshan yang de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag pa'i chos kyi snang ba zhes bya bar gyur pa yin yang / thugs rje chen po dang smon lam gyi mthus sems can bde bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i lus mngon du bstan pa yin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor mang po khyed dang / tshangs pa dang /brgya byin dang / lha dang / klu rnams kyis gus pas bkur sti byas nas brnyas par mi bya'o/ /lha dang mi thams cad kyis rtag par mchod par byas te/sems rtse gcig tu ming nas rjod 1par byed na bsod nams tshad med pa snyed 'thob par 'gyur/ kha na ma tho ba tshad med pa snyed yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur/tshe 'das nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi zhing khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gal te rin po che sna tshogs phun sum tshogs shing phyug por 'gyur bar 'dod na yid ri bzhin gyi nor bu'i lag la mchod par bya'o/ /mi bde ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gtses par gyur na zhags pa thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /khong par nad rnams yod par gyur na rin po che'i lhung bzed thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /'dre gdon thams cad gdul bar 'dod na rin po che'i ral gri thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /lha'i bu'i bdud thams cad 'dul bar 'dod na rdo rje thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /phas kyi 4rgol ba'i dgra gzhom par 'dod na rdo rje tho ba thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /'jigs shing bag tsha ba'i gnas thams cad las thar bar 'dod na 'jigs pa med pa 5sbyin pa'i lag la mchod do/ /mig 97—532

mi gsal te 'od dang mi ldan par gyur na me shel gyi nor bu thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /tsha ba'i rims kyis thebs te bsil 19bar 'dod na chu shel gyi nor bu thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /blon 2thabs mthon dpor 'dod na rin po che'i gzhu thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /grogs po mdza' bshes dang myur du phrad par 'dod na rin po che'i mda' thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /lus la nad sna tshogs kyis thabs sgyu par gyur na lcug ma thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /lus kyi bgegs ma rungs pa bsal bar 'dod na rnga yab dkar po thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /thams cad mthun 55pa'i 'khor du gyur par 'dod na bum pa thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /stag dang / 'phar ne spyang dang / dom dred dang / gcan gzan 7rim rungs pa thams cad spang 87bar 'dod na phub 9thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /gnas dang dus thams cad du rgyal po'i bgegs las thar bar 'dod na dgra sta ⑩thegs 11pa'i lag la mchod do/ /bu dang / bu mo dang / g.yog 'khor gyi phyir ni shel gyi gdub 'khor thogs pa'i lag la mchod do / /yon tan rnam pa sna tshogs kyi 1 phyir ni pad+ma dkar po thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing yongs su dag pa dag tu skye bar 'dod na pad+ma sngon po thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /shes rab chen po dang ldan par 'dod na rin po che'i me long thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mngon sum du mthong bar 'dod na pad+ma dmar po thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /sa'i gter 'byin par 'dod na rin po che'i za ma tog thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /drang srong gi lam mngon par 'grub par 'dod na sprin sna lnga thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /tshangs par skye bar 'dod na ril ba 97—533

thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /lha'i gzhal med khang du skye bar 'dod na pad+ma le brgan thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /phyogs gzhan gyi dgra phyir rgol ba bsal bar 'dod na ral gri dang mdung thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /dge ba'i lha 'dre thams cad dgug par 'dod na rin po che'i dung thogs pa'i lag la mchod do / /lha 'dre thams cad 'khol bar 'dod na thod pa'i 'khar 91)ba thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas myur du gshegs nas phyag gis byug par 'dod na bgrang phreng 'dzin pa'i lag la mchod do/ /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs mchog dam pa thams cad mngon par 'grub par 'dod na rin po che'i dril bu thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /tshig gi spobs pa gya rnam pa dang ldan par 'dod na rin po che'i phyag rgya thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /dge ba'i lha dang klu rnams rtag par 'ongs te srung zhing yongs su skyob par 'dod na lcags kyu thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /byams pa dang snying rjes sems can thams cad yongs su skyob par 'dod na 'khar gsil 2thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /sems can thams cad kyis rtag par phan tshun gus pas bsnyen bkur byed cing brtse bar sems par 'dod na thal mo sbyar ba'i lag la mchod do/ /skye ba'i skye gnas thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang mi 'bral bar 'dod na sprul pa'i sangs rgyas thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /skye ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du rtag par de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang du gnas nas mngal gyi snying por skye bar mi 'gyur bar 'dod na sprul pa'i gzhal med khang thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /mang du thos pa'i shes pa rgya chen po dang ldan par 'dod na rin po che'i mdo sde'i glegs barme thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /da ltar gyi lus 'di nas sangs rgyas 97—534

kyi sku la thug pa'i bar du rtag par byang chub kyi sems las ldog par mi 'gyur bar 'dod na phyir mi ldog pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i (1)de bzhin gshegs pa rnams myur du gshegs nas spyi bo nas naphyag gis byugs te lung bstan par 'dod na spyi bo na sprul pa'i sangs rgyas thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /shing thog dang 'bru rnams grub par 'dod na rgyan da'abrum thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /de ltar mngon par sgrub pa'i cho ga stong yod kyang deng mdor bsdus nas mdo tsam zhig bstan pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis shin tu yongs su dang ba'i sems kyis gzungs 'di zung la 'dzam bu'i gling du rgya cher yongs su spel nas rgyun mi 'chad par bya'o/ /gzungs 'di khams gsum gyi sems can nad kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad la rgya cher phan 'dogs par byed pas gzungs 'dis yongs su gsos na mi 'tsho ba gang yang med do/ /rig sngags chen mo ca'adis shing skam po la btab na yang yal zhag dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu skye bar 'gyur na rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa'i sems can lta smos kyang ci dgos te6/sems can nad kyis thebs pa rnams gsos na mi 'tsho ba'i gnas nges par med do / /rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di'i byin gyi brlabs 7dang mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsngags 8pa brjod kyang mthar thug par mi 'gyur ro / /sngon 'das pa'i dus yun ring po nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher bskyed pa ma yin na tha na 'di'i ming tsam yang thos par mi 'gyur na mngon sum 9du mthong ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ lha dang / mi dang / klu la sogs pa'i 'khor mang po khyed rnams ngas gzungs 'di'i bsngags pa brjod pa thos nas 1 thams cad kyis 1197—535

rjes su yi rang bar bya'o/ /gang la la zhig gis rig sngags 'di la skur pa btab par gyur na gang gā'i klung gi bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas de dag la skur pa 1btab par 'gyur ro/ /gal te gzungs 'di la the tshom dang yid mi ches pa skyes par gyur na gang zag de ni phan yon chen po dang gtan du 'bral bar 'gyur bas bskal pa brgya stong snyed du ngan 'gror 'khor zhing 'byung ba'i dus med de/ rtag par sangs rgyas kyang mi mthong / chos kyang mi thosan / /dge 'dun yang mthong bar mi 'gyur bar rig par bya'o/ /'khor der 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje dang / tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / lha dang / klu dang / 'dre srin thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis gzungs 'di'i bsngags pa brjod pa thos nas/ thams cad kyis rab tu dga' zhing mgu bas bka' yang dag par blangs nas mngon par sgrub par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nyi 'od kyis thugs rje chen po'i gzungs 'dzin pa dag yongs su bsrung ba'i ched du rig sngags chen po 'di smras so/ /na mo bud+dha gu lar be/ na mo dharma ma ha 5)te/ na maḥsi gha ṭa yā ṇidzi/tri pu bi sā ta rta na maḥ// rig sngags 'di bton na kha na ma tho ba thams cad yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur/ bdud spong bar byed/ bgegs rnams sel bar 'gyur bas lan re bton nas sangs rgyas la phyag lan re bya'o/ /de bzhin du nyin re bzhin dus gsum du rig sngags bzlas nas sangs rgyas la phyag byas na ma 'ongs pa'i dus na skye ba thams cad du yid du 'ong ba'i mtshan shin tu mdzes pa re re'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' 97—536

zla 'od kyis kyang rnal 'byor pa dag yongs su bsrung ba'i phyir gzungs 'di smras so / /sirnyi te du soṣ+ṭa/ a dz+nyā 1 mi te na o tuṣ+ṭa/ si ni skukhri ta pa li tiṣ+ṭa/ ya mi dz+nyā rtsita o dhuṣ+ṭa/ ku la ti maṣ+ṭa/ khiṣ+ṭa 55swā hā/ rig sngags 'di lan lnga bzlas (6)nas tshon sna lnga'i skud pa la sngags mdud byas te/ gang du na bar gdags par bya'o/ /rig sngags 'di ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung bzhi bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis gsungs pa yin pas/ deng bdag gis kyang rnal 'byor pa dag yongs su bsrung ba'i phyir dang / bgegs thams cad yongs su bsal (7)ba'i phyir dang / nad ma rungs pa thams cad yongs su bsal ba'i phyir dang / dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang /'jigs shing skrag pa thams cad yongs su spang ba'i phyir bstan pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bstan pa'i rig sngags 'di ni yang dag par bden te mi bden pa ci yang med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di drung du 'ong bar 'dod na gu gul la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste 8bsregs na byang chub sems dpa' 'ong bar 9'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig byi la'i gdon gyis zin par gyur na byi la'i mgo rus bsregs pa'i thal ba sa gtsang ma dang bsres te/ 'jim pa la byi la'i gzugs byas nas/ mig stong pa'i gzugs kyi 10mdun du ur mo'i gri gtsang ma la brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste11/ dum bu brgya rtsa brgyad du bcad nas sngags lan re gdon cing de'i ming nas lan re brjod na gtan 12du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /byad stems kyis phog par gyur na gu gul dang ga pur cha mnyam par byas te1 / khron pa'i chu gtsang ma bre gang dang 97—537

bsres nas bskol 1te phul gang tsam lus pa blangs nas/ mig stong pa'i gzugs kyi mdun du lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste ②'thungs na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te sdig pa dang sbrul gyis zin par gyur na bca' sga'i phye ma la lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste rma khar bskus na 'phral du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro//gal te mi ma rungs pa dag gis rku bshams nas gnod pa byas par gyur na sa gtsang ma'am/ bag zan nam/ spra citshil la pha rol po'i gzugs byas te mig stong pa'i gzugs kyi mdun du ur mo'i gri la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab nas 4sngags lan re brjod de lan re gtubs nas pha rol gyi ming nas brjod de/ bsregs zin nas dum bu brgya rtsa brgyad du byas na pha rol po dga' zhing nam 'tsho ba'i bar du gus pas bkur zhing 5 byams par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag mig nad kyis btab ste/ mig gi 'bras bu nyams par gyur tam/mdongs par gyur tam/ mi gsal bar gyur tam/ ling tog dkar po dang /dmar po dag gis khebs te 'od dang mi ldan par gyur na/ a ru ra dang / ba ru ra dang / skyu ru ra 'brum bu 5re zhib 75tu btags te/ 'thag pa'i tshe gtsang sbra bya dgos pas bud med gsar du bu btsas pa dang khyi dang phag rnams bsnyen par mi bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nas brjod de/ sbrang rtsi dkar po dang / mi'i 'o ma dang sbyar nas mig la bsku bar bya'o/ /'o ma de yang bu khye'u btsas pa'i nu zho rung gi bu mo btsas pa'i nu zho ni mi rung ngo / /sman de 58)sbyar zin nas kyang mig stong pa'i gzugs kyi mdun du lan stong rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste9/ mig la bskus nas zhag bdun gyi bar du khang pa dben par rlung bsrungs na/ mig gi 'bras bu skye bar 'gyur bas ling tog sngon po dang dkar 97—538

po bsal te gsal ba rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag gdon rnams kyis btab ste myos par gyur na stag dang / 'phar ba dang / spyang ki'i pags 1pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis 5)btab ste lus la bgos na sos par 'gyur ro/ /gal te sbrul gyis zin par gyur na gang zin pa'i mi de'i rna spabs blangs nas lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste rma khar glan cin sos par 'gyur ro/ /gzer thabs ma rungs pas snying la gzer te 'chi la thug na ka byi ta lag pa tsam chu gtsang ma phul gang dang sbyar te/ bskol nas phul phyed lus pa cal lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste 5cig car blud na sos par 'gyur ro/ /sman de yang bud med kyi drung du bskol bar mi bya'o/ /ro langs kyi gdon gyis btab nas rgyun ring du can bar gyur na gu gul la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste bsregs te snar 7bdug par bya'o/ /yang na ri bong gi rtug pa'i ril bu 8bdun blangs te lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas mid du bcug na sos par 'gyur te/ sha dang / chang dang / dku 9ba rnam pa lnga dang / tshig ngan pa rnams bsrung dgos so/ /yang na ba bla dang / yungs kur 1 dang /lan tshwa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste nad pa'i khri'i drung du bsregs na / gdon de'i lus 'jig par 'gyur bas 'dug pa'i thugs mi thub ste 'byer bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te gzhogs 11phyed na zhing rna ba dang sna subs par gyur tam / rka 12lag sdud mi nus par gyur na ru rta til mar gyi nang du 1 bskol te lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas lus la bskus na gtan du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na ba'i mar la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste lus la bskus na yang sos par 'gyur ro/ /gal te bu btsa' dka' bar gyur na til 97—539

mar la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste91/ bud med sbrum ma'i lte ba dang mo mtshan la bskus na myur du btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med sbrum ma gang dag mngal du bu shi bar gyur na gi'u 2mi sung gcig chu phul do'i nang du bskol te phul gang lus pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas blud na/ sdug bsngal zhi zhing na ba med par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sha ma 'byung du mi btub par gyur na yang sman 'di 'thungs na phan par 'gyur ro/ /glo bur du snying (5rigazer te mi bzod par gyur na de ni ro nyul gyi gzer thabs zhes labya ba yin pas kun tu ru dang pog dkar po ma grugs pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste ci tsam 'byor pa byin nas blan 5༄du bcug dzin 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /sha chang dang / dku ba rnam pa lnga bsrung dgos so/ /mes tshig par gyur na ba lang gi lci ba dron po la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste rma khar 57 bskus na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /srin bu khong par zhugs te na bar gyur na rta dkar po'i gcin phul phyed la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste blud na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /tshabs che ba la phul gang blud na srin bu thag pa gcus 8pa bzhin du rang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shu chen byung ba la leng se'u hwa dzo9brdungs pa'i khu ba la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste shu ba'i steng du blugs na rtsa bar dbyung 1 bar 'gyur bas mod la 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /mig tu sbrang ma zhugs te na bar gyur na bong bu'i rtug pa btsir ba'i khu ba la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste mtshan mo mig tu blugs na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /lto na bar gyur na khron pa'i chu gtsang ma'i nang du lan tshwa ma grugs pa 'brum bu nyi shu rtsa gcig bor te 11lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas phul phyed 'thungs na phan par 97wa 540

'gyur ro/ /mig tshag por gyur tam/ mig tu sha lhag byung bar gyur tam/ling tog byung bar gyur na ke'u khi 67che'i shing gi lo ma brdungs te btsir ba'i khu ba la lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste/ de'i nang du khar (2ba'i dong tshe gcig mtshan gcig spangs danas yang lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste mig tu blugs na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mtshan mo 'byung 'jug gi tshe 'jigs dngangs 4nas mi bde bar gyur na skud pa dkar po la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste/ mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig byas nas mgul du btags na 'jigs shing dngang ri5)ba dang 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa dang bral ba kho nar ma zad kyi bsod nams kyang thob la sdig pa rnams kyang 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te khyim 'khor du ltas ngan byung bar gyur na bal po 56)se'u'i shing gi yal ga blangs nas dum bu stong rtsa brgyad du gtubs te/ mgo mjug 7gnyi gar mar dang zho bskus nas sngags lan re bzla zhing re re bsregs te stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar byas na gdon bgegs thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur te tsho/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar bya dgos so/ /shu dag dkar po blangs nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste/ dpung pa g.yas pa la btags na g.yul ngor 'thab pa dang 'bel 59riba'i gtam smra ba'i gnas thams cad du rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /ke'u khi tshe'i shing gi lo ma'am yal ga yang rung 1 ste dum bur gtubs nas mgo mjug 11gnyi gar ba mar yang dag pa dang / sbrang rtsi 12dkar po dang ba zho bskus te sngags lan re bzla zhing dum bu re re sreg 1 pa stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bya'o/ /nyin gcig la dus gsum du bya zhing dus gcig la yang lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te zhag bdun tshang bar gyur na sngags mkhan de rang gis mngon par shes pa thob 97—541

par 'gyur 1ro/ /gdon mthu bo che gdul bar 'dod na lung tang la lan bzhi bcu rtsa dgu sngags kyis btab ste/ mar dang sbrang rtsi bskus nas 'phags pa snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i gzugs byas pa'i mdun du bsreg par bya'o/ /gi'u (nasawang sung gcig be+e ḍūr+ya'i bum pa'i nang du bcug ste/ 'phags pa snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i gzugs byas pa'i mdun du bzhag nas sngags lan stong rtsa brgyad kyis btab ste lus la bskus sam dpral ri bar thig le byas na/ lha dang /klu dang / 'dre srin dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad rab tu dga' (5bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te la la zhig btson rar chud par gyur na phug ron dkar po'i rtug pa la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste ri lag pa la bskus nas btson cha 7la byugs na btson cha na rang grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te khyo shug chu dang me bzhin du mi 'dum par gyur na bya ngur pa'i mjug 9ram blangs te/'phags pa snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i gzugs byas pa'i mdun du sngags lan stong rtsa brgyad kyis btab nas lus la btags na/ de dag nam 'tsho ba'i bar du gcig la gcig dga' zhing byams pa dang bkur bar 'gyur ro/ /lo tog dang 'bras bu rnams la srin bu zhugs te za bar gyur na sa'am thal ba'am bye ma gtsang ma blangs te/ lan stong rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab nas zhing gi phyogs bzhir gtor na srin bu rnams 'gyes par 'gyur ro/ /chu gtsang ma la sngags kyis btab ste 'bras bu'i ljon shing la gtor na srin bu 'bras bu la za ba'i thug 'imi thub po/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ sha ra ma hā sha ra/ tu lu ma hā tu lu/oṃ ku me ha ni sha pa/ oṃ ku me 15ha ni sha pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / gang la la zhig 'bru dkon pa'i gnas su phyin te/ mu ge byung nas zan 97wa 542

chad par gyur na khyed 1)kyis mig btsums nas lus drang por bsrang ste/ sems rtse gcig tu gzungs sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas mig phye 2shig dang / lha rnams kyis lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa snod bkang nas khyer te 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te khyim na gnas pa'i tshe dgos par gyur na snod gtsang ma stong pa mdun du bzhag nas mig btsums te kha chus bkang nas lcang ma'i lcug ma dang rnga yab dang lhung bzed la gtor bar bya'o/ /chus gtor zin nas mig btsums 4te gzungs 'di lan bzhi bcu rtsa dgu bzlas na rang gi ngang gis ro brgya dang ldan pa'i zas snod kun gang ba 'byung bar 'gyur bas blangs nas zhag bdun gyi bar du bza' bar bya ste/ de ltar na 'di'i mthu stobs ni bsam gyis mi khyab par rig par bya'o/ /zas zos zin nas mig btsums te sa ra kha zhes brjod nas zas kyi lhag ma yang spang bar bya'o/ /zas zos te stor mid nas kyang myur du 'ju bar 'gyur bas stobs dang ldan zhing bde ba 'thob par 'gyur / thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa 'thob par 5'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo thos pa 'dzin par 6'gyur ba'i gzungs ni 'di yin te/ na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥ7se ghā ya/ na maḥ ā 9dan ni ya/ ug tsi du ug tsi du/ma ti la li la/ la lu te na ma ni mi ti na ma swā hā/ gzungs 'di 'dzin pas phyogs bzhi nas rgyun chad pa'i ri'i rtse mor dkyil 'khor byas nas mtshams bcad de lus bsrungs nas/ khar 1 ba'i lhung bzed chung ngu cig khron pa'i chu gtsang mas bkang ste mdun du bzhag nas gzungs sngags bzlas nas/ gdon mi za bar skar ma gsal ba gcig 'ong bar 'gyur bas/ 'ong ba'i tshe 'jigs pa mi bskyed par sems bde bar mnyam par bzhag 11nas sems rtse gcig tu gzungs 97—543

sngags 'don par byed na/ dbang po rno zhing shes rab dang ldan par 'gyur bas mi shes pa ci yang med par 'gyur/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi chos kyang mi rtogs pa ci yang med par 'gyur ro/ /thos pa rgyud pa'i tshe skar ma mchog tu gsal ba gcig lhung bzed kyi chu'i nang du 'ong bar 'du shes bskyed par bya'o// //byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzungs/ bam po gnyis pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gus pas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni sngon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsod nams bsags pa'i rgyu dang rkyen gyis/ deng bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la lung bstan par mdzad pa dang 41/ bdag snying rje chen po bskyed nas sems can thams cad la sman par bgyi ba dang / bcing ba mtha' dag gcad 5)pa dang / 'jigs pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur bar bzhed pa lags pas/ deng bdag gis yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs bshad par 'tshal te/ dus tha ma'i sems can rnams yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs 'di thos pa'i byin gyi brlabs 8)kyi mthus de dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral nas bde ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur lags so//bcom ldan 'das dus lnga brgya tha ma la yul lam/ grong ngam grong khyer ram/grong rdal gang yang rung ba dag tu dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo la sogs pas rtag par gdugs mtshan lan drug tu chos bzhin du yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs sngags kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di klog cing 'don pa dang / yongs su 'dzin par bgyid na/ bdag de bzhin gshegs 97—544

pa'i bka' drin rjes su dran zhing gzo ba'i slad du rtag par rjes su 'brangs nas / gang zag de dag yongs su srung bar bgyid cing spong bar mi bgyid pas 'dre srin thams cad kyis gnod par bgyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang tshe rabs kyi sgrib pa lci ba thams cad kyang dus gcig tu yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur / gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya'i chos kyi sgo thams cad kyang myur du yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das la yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i dus lnga brgya tha ma'i sems can rnams ni phal cher (15sdig pa'i dri ma lhun stug nacing bsod nams chung bas yongs su 'dzin par bgyid pa zhig mchis na yang 'dre srin dag gis gnod pa bgyid pas/ deng bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyi brlabs dkyis sems can rnams la rgya cher sman par bgyi ba dang / sems can rnams la bde bar bgyid pa dang / lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa'i ched du gzungs kyi chos bshad par 'tshal te/ bdag gis sngon 'das pa'i bskal pa tshad ma mchis pa snyed kyi bar du gzungs kyi chos 'di la bsten cing mchod pa bgyis lags so/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bar dag kyang yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i rgyus bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par brnyes 5pa lags pas rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig sems rtse gcig tu yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'don cing 7klog pa dang / yongs su 'dzin par bgyid na de dag tshe 'di nyid la tshig gi spobs pa myur zhing thogs pa ma mchis pa dang / shes rab dang spobs pa mngon par rtogs par 'gyur 97—545

bas / lha dang mi'i 1'khor mang po'i nang na mchog tu 'gyur/ gang dag thos pa rnams kyang rab tu dga' zhing thams cad kyis spyi bo btud de phyag bgyid par 'gyur / skye ba thams cad du sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun mthong bar 'gyur/ gang ci smras kyang rung ste/ thams cad kyis yid ches pas nyen dpar 'gyur lags te/ de dag thams cad kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byin gyi brlabs dkyi mthu lags te no/ rang nyid kyi mthu ni ma lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la khyod kyis 'di ltar lha dang mi dang lha ma yin la sogs pa de dag thams cad la phan pa dang / bde bar bya ba dang / las kyi lam yongs su sbyang ba'i ched du smras pa legs so legs so zhes bsngags pa brjod nas/ngas kyang deng ye shes kyi phyag rgyas btab nas/ khyod byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po la sogs pa'i sems rnam pa sna tshogs las gtan 5du ldog par mi 'gyur bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag mngon par dran lags te/ 'das pa'i bskal pa tshad ma mchis pa nas yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yongs su bzung bas ri bo po ṭa 6la la mchis pa'i tshe bdud kyi rgyal pos bdud kyi 'khor mang po dang 'grogs nas bdag gi chos dkrug cing / sngags kyi tshig rnams mngon 7par mi 'grub par bgyi bar bshams pa las/ de'i tshe bdag gis yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs 'dis bdud mang po rnams btul nas thams cad so sor gyes par gyur pas/ gzungs 'di'i mthu bsam gyis mi khyab par rig par bgyi 97—546

lags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug byams pa dang / snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad la phan gdags shing / lha dang mi rnams bde ba thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das dang 'khor 'dus pa chen po'i mdun du byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa'i yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs lus po che'i sngags 'di smras so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo rat+na 1dra yā ya/ na mo3mi 'atā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+sā 4ba lo ki te gshwa rā 6)ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 7ru ṇi dkā ya/ na mo ma hā sbra ma/ prabhā (tsho)ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 1 ru ṇi kā ya/na mo bi pu la bi ma na su pra tikhri 11ta saṃ ghā ya/ srur+ya sha ta sa ha sra a ti 12re 1 ka pra bhā a ba bhā skesi ta mūrta yitsha/ ma hā ma ṇi ma ku ṭa 7kuṇ+ḍa lā 1 lo kā ra 1 d+mā ra tsā rte / bha ga ba shu 7te pad+ma pā ṇa 21ye/ sarba lo ka u pā 2sha ma nā ya/ bi bi dha mu so kha sa ma be ṣa 2 dībiṣ+ṭa lhasarba satwa pa ri mo tsa kā 27ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ byurgyu 7ba/ma hā lo ka ka ra ṇa nā tha 22ma sid+dhi mi ra bha dra bi nā na sha nā ka rā ya/ rā ga dwo ṣa mo ha dz+wa la sha ri )ma ka /sha sa ka sa mā shā sa na ka ra ka 21sarba pā pa durga te pra sha ma na tshonaka rā ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sasba da rin ka ra/ he he/ ma hā bo dhi satwa ba ra da pad+ma 45lo ka saṃ bhū ta/ ma hā kā pharu ṇi ka dza ṭa mu ku ṭā 7lo kṛ ta sha rī sa)re/ ma ṇi ka na ka 9sha ta/ badz+ra be+e ḍūr+sha lam̐ kṛ ta sha rī raṃ 1/ a mi tā bha si 4 na ka ma lā lo kṛ ta pra bha ra ṇa/ la ri tsa na ma hā du na/ na ra na ri sha ta sa ha sra/ a bhi la ṣ+pe 5ta kā ya/ ma hā bo dhi satā ya/ bi dha ma bi dha ma/bi nā sha ya bi nā sha 0ya/ ma hā yan+ti kle sha ka ba dha/ a ba ba dha bi bi dha satwa 97wa 547

saṃ sā ra tsā ra ka pra 1ma thā na/ pu ru ṣa pad+ma (5)pu ru ṣa nā ga( /pu ru ṣa sā cirag ra/ pu ru ṣa si ha/ bī ra bī rā shā 15)ya/ su yan+ta su yan+ta/ ba ra ba ra/ dha ma dha nem/ sa ma sa ma/ dhu ru dhu 575ru/ pra shā (8)sa yalas/ pra shā ngos ya/(1 gi ri gi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ tsi ri tsi ri/ mu ru mu ru/ mu yu mu yu/ mu ya mu ya / muñca muñca na/ dhu na dhu na/ bi dhu na bi dhu na/ dhu ru dhu ru/ gā ya gā hurteyang / gā dha ya gā dha 5ya/ ha sa ha sa/ pra ha sa pra ha sa/ bi bhi tsodha makle sha bā 1nas na/ 19bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i 7/ ha ra ha ra/ saṃ ha ra saṃ ha ra/du ru ti du ru ti/ ma hā man+t+ra du ru ti/ gaṇ+ḍi zhunyasha ta pa ra si ka bha ba bi sa na/sha ma ka ma hā bo dhi satwa 2 ba ra da swā hā/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ bcom ldan 'das la pad+ma chen po'i phyag rin po che'i bkod pa'i khar riba'i yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di smras na 2 thag tu/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi lha'i gnas kyi bar dag rnam pa drug tu g.yos/rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /lha rnams kyis kyang rin po che'i me tog gi char mngon par phab na bo/ /'og min gyi lha dang / dbang phyug chen po zhugarnams kyang g.yo zhing mi bde bas shin tu 'jigs shing dngangs 2 par gyur to/ /gnod 28sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'dre gdon ra/ rungs pa thams cad kyang sdug bsngal chen po myong ba'i sgra skad chen po (phyung nas shar nub tu 'byer zhing bros ni kyang gang du 'gro ba'i gnas kyang rig cing rnyed ri par ma gyur to/ /de nas sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'khor mang po rnams dang / 'dre srin ma rungs pa thams cad la gang gis bdag gi ri rig sngags las 'da' zhing rjes su 'brang bar 97—548

mi byed na/ de dag gi lus kyi yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad rab tu na zhing 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'dis ni ri rnams 'joms shing rgya mtsho chen po skems par byed do/ /lha ma yin gyi dmag rnams rnam par bcom nas pham par byed do/ /yul 'khor rnams dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang /grong rdal rnams yongs su srung bar byed do/ /'dre gdon dang / nad dang /sman gyi dug dang / srin bu'i dug dang / log pa dang/ ma rungs pa'i mi rnams pham zhing rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /sum cu 1 rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams btul nas rab tu dul bar byed do zhes smras pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chen po'i pho brang rab tu dga' ba na bzhugs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu btsun pa dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / mi'am ci la sogs pa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi chos la gnas pa tshad med pa thams cad kyis kyang dus gcig tu bsngags pa brjod par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags 'dis ni sgrib pa'i ri bo shin tu rgya che ba dag kyang rnam par 'joms par bgyid napas gang la la zhig nyan tam/ klog gam/ 'don tam/ yongs su 'dzin par bgyid dam/ mthong bar gyur na/ de dag la nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa nag po ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag thams cad zhu byang bar ca'agyur lags so/ /gzhan yang gang la la zhig rtag par nang par langs nas gus pa'i sems kyis yum gyi gzungs 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig klog gam/ 'don par bgyid na/byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid rtag par de'i rjes su 97—549

'brangs nas yongs su bsrung ba bgyid cing / yongs su skyob par bgyid do/ /gang la la zhig smon lam rgya chen po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo chen po thams cad myur du 'grub par 'tshal na/ gcig pu gnas dben par mchis nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid la dran par bgyi zhing /gzhan yid la mi bgyi bar rtag par gzungs 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na smon lam rnams mi 'grub pa gang yang ma mchis lags so/ /gzhan yang sems can thams cad kyi snying drung du sdug par 'gyur/ ngan 'gro'i sgo thams cad du ltung bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /mchis kyang rung ma mchis kyang rung ste/ rtag par sangs rgyas mdun na bzhugs par 'du shes nye bar bzhag par gyur na/ gang zag de skye ba'i gnas bye ba brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa kun du bsags pa'i sdig pa'i las ci mchis pa de dag thams cad zhu byang bar 'gyur/gang zag de 'khor los sgyur 1ba'i rgyal po stong gi bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa dag la longs spyod par 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang dus gcig tu skye bar 'gyur/ btsun pa nakhyim dag tu skye bar 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig rtag par spos narisam/me tog snyim pa gang tsam byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs kyi mdun du mngon par gtor nas/ gzungs 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 'don par bgyid na/ stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi yon tan dang snying rje chen po'i chos nyid 'thob par 'gyur/ gang zag de 'jig rten na mthar gyis mthu chen po myur du mngon par 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig rtag par byang chub sems dpa'i gdong dang 4/ mig dang / mtshan dang /97—550

dpe byad la rnam par bltas te/ gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad 'don par bgyid na byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug myur du lus mngon sum du bstan nas rnal 'byor pas mthong bar 'gyur bas dri ma dang bral nas sa dang po dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob par 'gyur bas 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams tsho1gsal bar bgyid par 'gyur/ 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe bsam gtan dang ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa bzhin du 'chi bar 'gyur bas tshe rabs thams cad du sngon nagyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i shes rab 'thob par 'gyur/ kha na ma tho ba'i sdig pa ci mchis pa thams cad kyang zhu zhing byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /gzungs 'di yongs su 'dzin par 'tshal ba des rtag par dpyid zla ra ba dang / dbyar zla 'bring po dang / ston zla tha chungs 555tshes gcig nas tshes bcu'i bar du gso sbyong dang / tshul khrims la gnas nas gos dkar po gtsang nem bgos te/ zas dkar gsum 'tshal nas ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten nam/ ring bsrel gyi mdun du tsan+dan 7dkar po'i 'jim pa las dkyil 'khor khru gang gru bzhi pa bgyis nas/ me tog dang spos rnam pa sna tshogs dkyil 'khor gyi nang du gtor nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi spyan ra sngar spos kyis bdugs te zhugs mar gtams smyonas/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gus pa'i sems bskyed de/rtag par gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad 'don par bgyid na/ tshes bcwa 1 lnga'i nub mo byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid dkyil 'khor gyi nang du mchi 11bar 'gyur bas/ rnal 'byor pas mthong ma thag tu mtshams ma mchis pa lnga'i kha na ma tho ba shin tu lci ba'i sgrib pa ci mchis pa thams 97—551

cad zhu 17byang nas/ lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi (milas thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur bas sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu dang / dbang bskur ba'i sa'i mthu dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i sa'i mthu dang / khyad par du 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis yang 'thob par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te dgung char dbab par 'tshal bar gyur na/ gnam du bltas nas gzungs 'di stong rtsa brgyad 'don par bgyid na zil dngar ri —gyi char dus bzhin du 'bab par 'gyur lags so/ /dog sa la bltas nas gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar 'don par bgyid na 'bru rnam pa sna tshogs legs par 'gyur lags so/ /gtsang 4po dang / chab mig skams pa'i drung du gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad 'don par bgyid na chab 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur lags so/ /bro nad kyis thebs pa thams cad kyi mdun du rang gi sug pa lag pa la sngags 'dis lan bdun bsngags 5te sug pas byabs na 'tsho bar 'gyur lags so/ /gang dran pa nyams pa'i mdun du gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis dzin yang dag pa'i dran pa 'thob par 'gyur lags so/ /gang dag bkres skom gyis 7nyen pa'i mdun du de'i gdong la bltas nas gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na bkres rin skom gyis nyen (9༄pa'i 'du shes ngan pa thams cad rab tu bsal bar 'gyur lags so/ /gang dag mtshams dgum par 'tshal na rdzing chab kyi nang du zhugs te/ chos bzhin du gzungs 'di yongs su rdzogs par bris 1 nas rgyal mtshan gyi khar btags na dpag tshad brgya tshun chad du gdon bgegs ci yang ma mchis te/ mtshams bkum /rtapa nyid du gyur nas yongs su bsrungs par 1 'gyur lags so/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs 97—552

kyi bu mo gang la la zhig rtag par gdugs gcig bzhin du gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad 'don par bgyid na/ gang zag de'i bsod nams brjod kyis mi lang bas rig sngags 'dzin pa de dag btsun zhing dbang phyug dang ldan par 'gyur/gzhan yang skye bo mang po kun gyis byams shing bsnyen bkur bgyid par 'gyur/smon lam rnams yid bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur lags so/ /gang dag bdud gdul bar 1)'tshal na yum gyi gzungs 'di bzlas te/ gu gul nal lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas sngags 'di lan re bzlas shing lan cig bsreg pa lan brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na yongs su bsal 4 bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te skye bo mang po thams cad dga' bar 'tshal na rtag par lcang ma'i lcug ma la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste/ g.yar khar bcas na thams cad kyis byams shing bkur bar 'gyur lags so/ /gang dag bdag nyid spobs pa dang / shes rab dang ldan par 'tshal na shu dag srang gcig phye mar btags te/ chab mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar nas ril bu 5bgyis te/ yum gyi gzungs 'dis mtshan ma gsum po 'di lta ste/ drod dang / dud pa dang /'od byung gi bar du sngags kyis gdab 6par bgyi'o/ /mtshan ma de dag thob nas gdugs re bzhin sman gyi ril bu 7tsam bdun bdun 'tshal nas snying gar yang byug (8par bgyi ste/ de ltar zhag brgya'i bar du 'tshal na thogs pa ma mchis pa'i spobs pa 'thob par 'gyur bas/ bdag nyid kyi lus bsrung ba'i slad du gdugs re zhing yum gyi gzungs 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas phyag rgya rnam pa bcu gnyis kyang bgyi'o/ /de la dang po byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i lus kun du sdud pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ sngar 97—553

langs nas 'greng ste/ lus drang por bsrang nas rkang pa gnyis gshibs te/rkang pa g.yas pa cung zad cig dgug par bgyi'o/ /sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa thur du brkyang 1nas gung mo dang srin lag gnyis bkug ste/ lag mthil (gedu bzhag la/ mthe'u chung dang mdzub rigemo dang / mthe (5)bong ni yan (6)par brkyang ste/ lag mthil bkan nas gyen du phyogs par bgyi'o/ /de'i (7)rjes la sug pa g.yas pa yang de bzhin du bgyis nas gung mo bkug ste/ phrag pa dang mnyam par bgyis nas lag mthil namadun du blta bar bgyi ste/ 'di ni lus kun sdud pa'i phyag rgya 10zhes bgyi'o/ /gal te bdud dang mu stegs can la 4lhalog par lta ba'i thibs po bcom nas yang dag pa'i lam du gzud 8par 'tshal na / phyag rgya 'di bgyis nas sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na gdon mi 'tshal bar smon pa 1 bzhin 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gzungs ni 8'di lta ste / na mo rat+na ritra yā ya/ na ma sa.ār+sā ba lo kyi te sna shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 1 ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya sna thā/ a bstag no/ a bstazhuskye/ pa ri brten / e hi e hi swā hā/ de la gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i kun 'dzin gyi gzungs kyi phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ snga ma'i lus kun sdud pa'i phyag rgya bzhin du thal mo sbyar te snying gar 82bzhag nas sor mo lnga bsnol 2 mar btang ste/ g.yon pas g.yas pa mnan nas mdzub mimo gnyis drang por bsgreng ste rtse mo phrad par bgyis la/ mthe bo gnyis mdzub 27mo gnyis kyi tshigs pa dang po la mnan nas cung zad cig dbye bar bgyi ste/ 'di ni kun 'dzin gyi gzungs kyi phyag rgya zhes bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya 'di bgyis par gyur na ri 8bskal pa tshad ma mchis pa tshun chad kyi 'khor ba'i sdig pa'i las 9ci mchis pa 97wa 554

thams cad dus gcig tu yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ slad ma'i dus kyi tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dag tu skye bar 1'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa mngon par rdzogs par byang chub tu nye ba'i tshe bdud kyi rgyal pos glags btsal ba dang / kun 'dzin gyi gzungs kyi phyag rgya 'di mdzad pas shin tu bde ba'i bsam gtan dang ting nge 'dzin brnyes par gyur na to/ /gzungs 5)ni 'di lta ste/ tar+ya thā/ sarba dhā ra khri / maṇ+ḍa la/e hi e hi/ pra bhā shud+dha/ satā 5ya swā hā/ de la gsum pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i 6rnam par thar pa dang / bsam gtan dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya 7ni 'di lags te/ slar 2bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs (9te/ spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas mdzub sna tshomo gnyis bkug ste rtse mo sprad la mthe bo gnyis mdzub 11mo'i tshigs gnyis pa'i steng du bkan par bgyi ste/ chos kyi phyag rgya 'di ni rnam par thar pa dang / bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya zhes bgyi'o/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang chos 'di mngon par bsgrubs pas bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par grol ba brnyes 12pa lags te / rig sngags ni snga ma dang mthun 1 lags so/ /gang la la zhig gdugs re bzhin du phyag rgya 'di bgyis te mchod pa bgyis na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams myur du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de la bzhi pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags teng/ langs nas 'greng ste rkang pa gnyis gshibs nas sngar gung mo dang / srin lag dang / mthe'u chung rnams rgyab sprad la mdzub 15mo gnyis bsgreng ste rtse mo sprad nas mthe bong 10gnyis mdzub 1 97wa 555

mo'i tshigs gnyis pa'i steng du mnan te/ lag pa gnyis kyi (1bar du tshon sna lnga tsam phye nas smin mtshams su gzhag par bgyi ste/ 'di ni mig stong dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya zhes bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya'i chos kyi sgo 'di bgyis par gyur na sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gya rnam pa'i bye ba phrag brgya stong snyed mthong bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams re re nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag bcu dang bzhi stong rnal 'byor pa de'i grogs bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /gang dag dkyil 'khor gyi chos kyi sgor lan gsum ma zhugs pa de dag gis ni phyag rgya'i na chos kyi kyisgo 'di mthong du yang mi rung la cho ga 'di yang bgyir mi rung lags so/ /rtags mthong ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chos dang ye shes kyi mngon par shes pa gsal ba cig lags na ni ci dang ci smon pa de dag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur lags so/ /gzungs ni 'di lta ste/ o sarba tsak+ṣuḥ ka rā 5ya/ dhā ra tī/ in+d+ra 6 ya swā hā/ de la lnga pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i lag stong kun sdud pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ langs nas sug pa rkang pa gshibs te/ sngar sug pa lag pa g.yas pa'i lag mthil bkang nas sor mo lnga so sor phan tshun du bsnyen te/de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i lag mthil g.yas pa'i steng du mnan nas snying gar 'jog 7pa gang lags pa 'di ni lag stong kun sdud pa'i phyag rgya zhes bgyi sten/ 'dis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bdud ji snyed mchis pa thams cad sdud cing 'dul bar bgyid lags so/ /gzungs sngags ni 'di lta ste/ tar+ya thā/ a ba lo ki te shwa rā 9ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭa ngo.o hā 11ya ni swā hā/ de la drug pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pas ting nge 'dzin 97—556

rtogs par 6)'gyur ba'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ 'greng ste rting pa gnyis sprad nas/ sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo bsgreng ste gung mo bkug rinas mdun du phul la/ de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa'ang /de bzhin du bgyis nas gung mo bkug ste nang logs su phul ba 'di ni ting nge 'dzin rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyag rgya zhes bgyi ba lags te/ 'dis ting nge 'dzin dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i (4bkod pa dang / chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong yang rtogs par 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang mngon du 5bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /rig sngags ni snga ma nyid bzla bar bgyi'o/ /de la bdun pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pas lha klu sde brgyad dang / 'dre srin rnams dgug cing sdud pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ 'greng dzinas rkang pa gnyis gshibs te/ sngar sug pa lag 7pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis mthe bo'i sen mo la reg par bgyis nas/ de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa yang de bzhin du bgyis te/ mthe'u chung dang gung mo gnyis drang por bsgreng nas rtse mo phan tshun phrad par bgyis la/ lag ngar gyi tshigs gnyis sbyar nas mdzub 8mo ni phan tshun rgyu bar bgyi'o/ /rig sngags ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ sarba de ba nā ga a na ri swā hā/ de la brgyad pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pas tshangs pa chen po dang / brgya byin lha'i dbang po g.yar drang nas chos 'dri ba'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ phyag rgya snga 9ma'i steng du lag ngar gyi tshigs gnyis phye nas/ sug pa lag pa'i zur sprad de/ lag mthil bkan la mdzub 7mo ni phan tshun rgyu bar bgyi'o / /rig sngags ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ ma hā prad+mā 11ya e hi e hi swā hā/ phyag rgya dang rig sngags 'dis ni gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i 1 sgo mo tshad ma mchis shing 97—557

grangs ma mchis pa thams cad yang dag par sdud cing 'du bar bgyi'o/ /gal te nyi zla la 1gza' zhugs par gyur na/ chab mar la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis gdab par bgyi'o/ /yang na lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags bzla bar bgyi'o/ / chab mar naphyag rgyas btab ste 'tshal na dbang po rno bar 'gyur bas gdugs gcig la sh+lau ka khri lobs par 'gyur lags so/ /phyag rgya'i chos kyi sgo mo 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i snying pos byang chub sems dpa' (ci )spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa lags so/ /de la dgu pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pa'i rab tu dga' ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/'greng nas snying gar 5thal mo sbyar te/ mthe bong gnyi ga 6lag mthil du bkug 7nas sor mo gzhan bzhi ni drang por bsgreng ste snying gar 58thal mo sbyar nas rig sngags snga ma 'don par bgyid na/ gdon mi 'tshal bar lha rnams kyi gzhal med khang dag tu 'jug par 'gyur/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su kun tu rgyu zhing 9rin po che brgyad stong bsams pa bzhin thob nas sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig chos kyi sgo 'di mngon par sgrub pa gang lags pa des nang par sngar langs nas khrus yongs su dag par bgyis te/ phyag rgya 'di bgyis na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gang gā'i 1 klung gi bye ma snyed mngon sum du mthong nas/ bskal pa tshad ma mchis pa snyed kyi 'khor ba'i las ngan pa'i kha na ma tho ba lci ba rnams yongs su byang bar 'gyur bas/de'i slad du yon tan 'di lta bu'i bsngags 11pa brjod par lags so/ /de la 12bcu pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pa'i smon pa rnams yid bzhin du mngon par 'grub pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ phyag rgya snga ma bzhin du bgyis pa las/97—558

mdzub (1mo gnyis bkug ste mthe bong gnyis kyi sen mo mnan nas mdzub 2mo'i sen mo ni rgyab sprad par bgyi ste/ rig sngags ni snga ma nyid bzla bar bgyi'o/ /de ltar bgyis na smon pa rnams mngon par 'grub cing gdon mi za bar byang chub kyi lam las ldog par mi 'gyur lags so/ /de la bcu gcig pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pa'i 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ phyag rgya snga ma bzhin du bgyis pa las mdzub 4mo lnga drang por bsgreng ste thal mo dbye bar bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bdag sngon rgyu'i sa la gnas pa'i tshe gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag la stsal bas / bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 5kyi lam mngon sum du gyur pa lags te/ rig sngags ni snga ma nyid bzla bar bgyi'o/ /de la bcu gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pas sangs rgyas spyan 'dren pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ phyag rgya snga ma bzhin du snying gar 6thal mo sbyar nas mdzub 7mo gnyis phan tshun rgyu bar bgyi'o/ /rig sngags ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ sarba bud+dha sa ma ya/ e hi e hi/ brah+ma 2shud+dha satwa swā hā / de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i cho ga ni 'di lags te/ bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa'i yum gyi dkyil 'khor dang / rig sngags dang / phyag rgya'i 9chos 'dis ni dus tha ma'i dus kyi tshe rig sngags 'dzin pa rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rig sngags kyi gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor mnyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad myur du gsal bar mthong bar 'gyur bar bgyid pas/ rig sngags 'dzin pa'i gang zag gang lags pa des rtag par ngag bsdams te/ bre 1 mo'i gtam 97—559

rnams smra bar mi bgyi'o/ /gzungs las 'byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / mtshan ma ya mtshan can rnam pa sna tshogs gang lags pa de dag ma brtags par bab col 1du brgyud par mi bgyi'o/ /yongs su dang ba'i sems kyis dran pa nye bar gzhag 2nas skad cig tsam du yang rnam par g.yeng bar mi bgyi'o / /gal te kho la gdu bas slad rol du gzhan dag la tha dad pa'i mtshan ma ston par bgyid na/ sdig pa'i las sbyong dbar 'tshal yang de dag 'grub par mi 'gyur lags so/ /gal te yang dag pa'i yongs su dang ba dang / chos kyi bsam pa gang lags pa des bsgom par mi bgyid na/ bgyis pa rnams chab 'tshal zhing don ma mchis par sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba tsam du bas kyi/nams kyang sgrub 5pa dag mngon par 'grub par ri nimi 'gyur bas rtag par nan tan brtson 'grus kyis tshul khrims yongs su dag par bsrungs nas dku (7rab rnam pa lnga dang / sha chang 'tshal bar mi bgyi'o/ /gal te dbyen tshig dang / g.yo sgyu'i tshig dang / phrag dog gi tshig smra bar gyur tam/ dkyil 'khor dang /phyag rgya dang / rig sngags kyi cho ga rku ba'i nongs pa 'di dag byung bar gyur na/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis spong bar mdzad pas/'di skad du ngas khyed spangs pa ma yin yang gzigs shing yongs su bsdu ba'i 'os ma yin no zhes gsung na bar 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das gang zag de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul khrims yongs su dag pa bshig pa dang /dkon mchog gsum dang / yang dag pa'i chos dang / dge ba'i mtshan nyid thams cad la skur cing 'jig par bgyid pa lags pas/ de lta bu'i gang zag de dag ni rtag par lha'i bu'i bdud dang / 'dre gdon thams cad dang / mu 97—560

stegs can rnams dang / byi nā 1)ya ka rnams dang / khams gcig tu bsdu ba dang ske/ las gcig la gnas pa dang / gtan du skyabs ma mchis par gyur pa lags pas/ 'phags pa rnams kyis yongs su skyob par mi mdzad cing / rtag par sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa dang / lha dang / drang srong thams cad kyis dmed rin par 'gyur bar rig par bgyi lags so / /lam sun 'byin cing chos 'jig par bgyid pa'i gang zag de lta bu de dag gdugs mtshan yi du rtag par gzungs 'di rjes su dran par bgyid kyang /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis gang zag de dag nams kyang ca'agrub par mi 'gyur bar mthong lags te/ de ltar mi 'grub pa de yang bdag gis nongs pa ma lags kyi/ bu/ de dag rang nyid kyis dzinongs skyon lags pas don de'i slad du gzungs 'di'i cho ga dang / glegs bam de dag gis mthong zhing thos par yang mi bgyi/ 'don cing 'dzin du stsal bar yang mi bgyi ste/ gang dag tshangs par spyod pa yongs su dag pa srung k+ṣ-i ba dang / byams pa dang / snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa dang / sems can la snying brtse zhing byang chub yongs su gnyer bar bgyid pa (8ridag gis yi ger bris nas klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / yongs su 'dzin par gyur na/ yum gyi gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor mngon par 'grub par 'gyur bas so/ /chos kyi cho ga 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis mchog tu gsang ba'i 9snying po lags pa'i slad du rig sngags 'dzin pas yang dag pa'i sems dang / brtson 'grus kyi sems kyis lus kyi yan lag dang / nying lag dang / rus pa dang / sha dang /rtsa rgyus dang / rkang skadang / mgo dang / mig la sogs pa yang yongs su 97wa 561

spangs nas gzhan dag la stsal te/ chos 'di yongs su gnyer nas rtag par nan tan brtson 'grus kyis 1mngon par sgrub par 'tshal na rin po che dang / 'bru dang / dar zab dang / gos dang / mal cha dang / sman dang / nor rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par grol ba'i yum gyi gzungs dang / dkyil 'khor dang /phyag rgya'i gzugs brnyan gyi chos kyi ched du gtong ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal nasate/slob dpon gyis bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems rtse gcig ritu bsgrub par bgyi'o / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ rnam par grol ba'i gzungs kyi chos 'di ni slad ma'i dus tha ma'i tshe sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bgyis nas/yang dag pa'i spyod pa dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i brtson 'grus dang / lta bas bgrod pa'i phyogs dang / rnam par grol ba'i lam mngon par 'grub par bgyid cing / de dag dus 'di nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i bar du nams kyang ri4ldog par mi 'gyur bar bgyid pas so/ /dkyil 'khor de yang gtsug lag khang gi nang ngam/ ri'am/ chab mig 'bab pa'am/ nags tshal gyi drung du yang rung ste/ nye 'khor 5kun du khru gang yan chad ni shing gi rtsa ba dang / dog sa ngan pa dang / gyo mo dang / gor 6rim dang / rus pa la sogs pa ci mchis pa brkos 7te bsal nas/ dog sa bzang po las rmang khru gang tsam du blangs te brdungs nas mnyam por bgyis la ba lang gi lci ba dang / spos chab dog sa ser po dang bsres 8nas 'jim pa bgyis te legs par byug cing zhal zhal bgyis nas gling lngar bgo bar bgyi'o/ /de la dbus kyi gling ni zheng du khru gsum tsam du bgyis te/ dbus kho nar khru do gru bzhi lham par mchis pa'i rin po che'i 'khor 97—562

lo rtsibs brgya rtsa brgyad dang ldan pa cig bri bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo'i dbus su rin po che'i pad+ma kha bye ba 'dab ma sum cu 1rtsa gnyis mchis pa khru gang ba cig (mibri bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo'i tha ma 'khor bar 'od 'bar ba bri bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la gling gi grwa bzhir pad+ma kha bye ba re re bri bar bgyi'o//gzhan yang pad+ma re re'i steng du yid bzhin gyi nor bu re re bris nas/ nor bu bzhi po'i steng du 'od 'bar ba bri bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang 'dab ma sum cu rirtsa gnyis dang ldan pa'i pad+ma de'i steng du byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs tsan+dan dkar po las bgyis pa cig cagazhag par bgyi'o / /de nas gling gnyis pa ni zheng du khru gang bar bgyis nas/ sngar grwa bzhir pad+ma kha bye ba re re bri bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang pad+ma de dag re re'i steng du ri rab lhun po'i stan rim pa gsum mchis pa gsum gsum bris nas byang shar mtshams kyi stan la ni dbang phyug chen po'i lha bri'o/ /shar lho mtshams kyi stan la ni lha mthu chen po bri'o/ /lho nub mtshams kyi stan la ni tshangs pa chen po bri'o/ /nub byang mtshams kyi stan la ni brgya byin bri bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang ngos bzhir ni rin po che'i me tog dang / phreng ba bcu drug bri bar bgyi'o/ /de nas gling gsum pa ni zheng 5du khru do par bgyis te sa gzhi yi sngon po la gser gyi thig bkye ba 'ba' zhig 7)bri bar bgyi'o/ /de nas gling bzhi pa ni zheng du khru gang bar bgyis te/ ngos bzhi spyi la bar chad nyi shu rtsa brgyad du byas nas bar chad du ma bu re re'i nang du yang pad+ma kha bye ba re re bri bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang go rims bzhin du pad+ma de dag re re'i steng du yang rdo rje tho ba dang / rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya nadang / dgra sta'i phyag rgya 9dang / gri'i phyag rgya khodang / ral gri'i phyag rgya 1197—563

dang / dung gi phyag rgya 1dang / chu gri'i phyag rgya rinanodang / zhags pa'i phyag rgya ④dang / dbyig pa thogs pa'i phyag rgya 4tshodang / gdugs kyi phyag rgya 5tshodang /yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya dang / gshin rje'i dbyig pa'i phyag rgya (6)dang / byi nā 57)ya ku'i phyag rgya dang / mtshon cha'i phyag rgya dang / 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang / sug pa nalag pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya rnams so sor bris nas/phyag rgya 9de dag kun la'ang 'od 'bar ba dag bri bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang lho phyogs kyi chab sgor 1 bar chad bgyis pa'i nang du ni 'thab bral gyi lha bri'o/ /nub phyogs kyi chab sgor bar chad bgyis pa'i nang du ni chu lha bri'o/ /byang phyogs kyi chab sgor bar chad bgyis pa'i nang du ni ku be ra bri'o/ /shar phyogs kyi chab sgor bar chad bgyis pa'i nang du ni lha gzhon nu bri bar bgyi'o/ /de nas gru bzhi'i gnas so sor ni rgyal po chen po bzhi khro gnyer can g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa bri bar bgyi'o/ /de nas gling lnga pa ni khru gang bar bgyis te/ ngos bzhi kun du 'bras bu'i ljon shing dang / me tog gi ljon shing dang / rin po che'i ljon shing rnam pa sna tshogs bri bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang grwa bzhi kun du rin po che'i ri rab lhun po re re bri bar 11bgyi'o/ /chab sgo bzhir ni rgya mtsho chen po'i chab bri bar bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi slad nang gi gling rnams kyi sa gzhi ni kha dog sngon por bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang slad nang gi gling rnams kyi nub phyogs kyi chab sgo'i lho'i ngogs 1 kyi zur la sngags mkhan 'byung zhing 'jug pa'i chab sgo gcig dbye bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i gzugs bgyis pa gcig dbus su dpyangs 1 rite kha shar phyogs su blta bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i 97—564

mdo sde glegs bam gcig pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu 91rtsa gnyis mchis pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag nas/ gzugs bgyis pa de'i mdun du gzhan yang tsan+dan dkar po'i dri chab zhal bu bcu drug dang / zhal zas rnam pa sna tshogs dang / zas dkar 52gsum dang / shing tog la sogs pas bkang ba'i gzhong bu nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / spos chab bre gang dang / bum pa dar tshon sna tshogs dang /me tog dang / ljon shing gi yal ga la sogs pas kha brgyan pa nyi shu rtsa lnga dang /me tog dang / phreng ba sna sna nas nyi shu nyi shu dang / mar me nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / byug (spos dang / spos kyi phye ma dang / de la sogs pa'i spos deb tshe nyi shu dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs bris pa'i ca'aphan dang / dar tshon (5)sna tshogs las bgyis pa'i 'phan spyir phreng nyi shu rtsa lnga bsham par bgyi'o/ /'di ltar mchod pa bgyid pa'i zhal sder 'chidang / snod spyad dang / bum pa la sogs pa de dag thams cad kyang gser dang / dngul dang / 'khar 7ba la sogs pa las bgyis pa las sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /gal te yang dag par ma mchis na brnyan ma yang rung lags so/ /'di ltar yo byad de dag thams cad kyang slad nang gi gling rnams ngos bzhir chos bzhin du bri zhing dgram par bgyi'o/ /gdan dang / me tog sna tshogs gzugs shing gtor bar bgyi'o/ /'bras sā lu'i me tog dang / yungs kur tshonadang / me tog rnam pa sna tshogs dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gtor bar bgyi'o/ /zhal zas de dag kyang gdugs gcig bzhin du gsar du bgyis pa bzang po las mchod par bgyi'o/ /sngags mkhan de yang 'byung 'jug gi tshe khrus yongs su dag par bgyis nas byug spos kyis byugs te9/ gos sar pa gtsang 1 tshom bgo bar bgyi'o/ /zas dkar gsum 'tshal nas tsan+dan dang /97—565

a ga ru dang / tu 1ruṣ+ka 2dang / ga pur la sogs pa bsres te gdugs gcig la dus gsum du byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i gzugs bgyis pa la mchod par bgyi'o/ /nang gi gling gsum pa'i nang du mig stong pa'i gzugs bzhag pa'i mdun du rang gis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gsum po dag yang dag par blang bar dam bca' bar bgyi'o / /gdugs mtshan du slad rol gyi gling gi nub phyogs kyi chab sgor skyil mo krung nadabacas te/ mchis nas gdugs gcig la yum gyi gzungs lan stong rtsa brgyad bar chad ma mchis par bzlas brjod bgyis nas gdugs nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du bsam pa gtugs 4te mchod par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang dus drug tu dkyil 'khor gyi nub ngos kyi zur gyi chab sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs nas / gling gsum pa'i nub phyogs kyi chab sgor 'greng ste/ sngar bstan pa'i phyag rgya dang po dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa nas bcu gnyis pa sangs rgyas spyan 'dren pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar gyi phyag rgya kun bgyis nas sngags lan bdun bdun bzla bar bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya bcu gnyis pa'i bar du bgyis lags nas kyang 5bdag nyid byang chub chen po'i smon lam shin tu brtan pa las phyir mi ldog par bgyi'o zhes smon lam btab nas g.yar 'dren par bgyid 6)na/thams cad nye bar mchi bar 'gyur bas lus drang por bsrang 7ste mchis nas/nges pa'i sems kyis lha 'dre thams cad bsgrib 85cing mchod 9pa ma mchis par mig sngar mchis so snyam du 'du shes nye bar bzhag ste/ tha dad pa'i yul la mi dmigs par lus po che'i sngags snga ma lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 'don par bgyid na/de'i mtshan mo gzugs bgyis pa de las 'od zer chen po byung nas byang chub 97—566

sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid gdon mi 'tshal bar 1mngon sum du lus ston par 'gyur te/ lus bstan nas mchi ba'i tshe kun dga' ba'i lus kyi byad gzugs su mngon par sprul nas/ dga' zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis rnal 'byor pa de la ci zhig dgos gang zhig smon ces 'dri bar 'gyur bas/de'i tshe sngags mkhan gyis 'di skad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang / gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi chos yongs su gnyer ba dang /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya na dang / sngags kyi cho ga thams cad mngon par 'grub pa dang / 'dre gdon ( thams cad gdul zhing ngag nyan par 'gyur bar 'tshal lo zhes lan gdab par bgyi'o/ /de ltar smon pa rnams grub nas kyang bdag nyid rig par bgyi'i gzhan dag la brjod par mi bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di ni bal ras sam/ btso ras la ri mo 5bris te bgyis na yang rung lags so/ /smon pa thams cad 'grub par 'tshal na chab kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bgyis la/ a ga ru bsregs te/ lus po che'i sngags snga ma lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ bcu pa smon pa rnams yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phyag rgya snga ma bgyis na/ smon pa thams cad bsams pa bzhin du 'grub cing yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te skye bo mang po thams cad dga' bar 'gyur bar 'tshal na 6rab tu dga' ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya snga ma bgyis nas/ lus po che'i sngags kyis til 'bru la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gdab par bgyi'o/ /yang na sngags 7lan re bzlas nas lan re zhugs kyi nang du dor ba lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na thams cad yid bzhin du dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /gnod sbyin rnams dga' bar 'tshal na gnod sbyin gyi kun 97—567

dga' ra 17ba'i ljon shing gi na yal ga blangs te/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas kun dga' ra bar bor na dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /mi ma rungs pa dgrar gyur pa gdul bar 'tshal na shing khong len 'bog la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas/ sngags lan re bzla 5)zhing lan re zhugs su dor ba lan brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na skyabs su mchi zhing thul bar 'gyur lags so/ /'dre gdon gdul dka' ba zhig mchis na gu gul dang / yungs gar 4la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ster/ sngags lan re bzla zhing lan re zhugs su dor ba lan brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na 'dre gdon thams cad rang dul bar 'gyur lags so/ /yul phyogs su rims nad byung bar gyur 4)na chab kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bgyis nas/ ba mar bzang po la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste / sngags lan re bzla zhing lan re zhugs su dor ba lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na rims nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na chab nyung zad cig blangs te rims kyis thebs pa 'tshal du stsal na 'phral du 'tsho bar 'gyur lags so/ /sngon yul ge dbyin zhes bgyi bar rims nad byung nas/ gang rims kyis btab pa de dag gdugs zhag gcig gam gnyis las mi 'da' bar 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par gyur to/ /de'i tshe bram ze tsin ti zhes bgyi ba zhig snying rje chen po skyes nas/ cho ga'i sgo 'di bshams nas yul khams gcig gi rims kyis thebs pa thams cad gsos pas/ thams cad zhi bar gyur te/ rims gtong ba'i 'dre gdon gyi rgyal po'ang de'i tshe yul nas byung bar gyur pa'i slad du sman yon che bar rig par bgyi lags so/ /gal te pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis gtses par gyur tam/ chom rkun dang / 'khrug pa 'byung 97—568

bar gyur na lus kun sdud pa'i phyag rgya dang po bgyis te/ rig sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na dgra dang chom rkun 1de dag thams cad rang gi ngang gis rab tu zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig las kyi rnam par smin pa'i dbang gis tshe rabs su nye ba'i tshe 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i phyag rgya 5snga dam bgyis te/ gdugs re bzhin du mchod pa bgyis nas/ a ga ru bsregs te/ rig sngags lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ sngags lan re bzlas nas de'i ming (4nas 55tsholan re 'don par bgyid na las kyi sgrib pa de dag yongs su 'byang ri bar 'gyur lags so/ /sngon yul bā rā ṇa sīr khyim bdag cig 7gnas pa las/ bu gcig las ma mchis pa de lo bcu drug las mi thub par gyur nas/ lo bcwa 8lnga lon pa dang /khyim bdag khyo shug mya ngan gyis rod nyams par gyur to/ /de'i tshe bram ze zhig sgo kun du rgyu zhing zas slong ba las/ khyim bdag de mthong nas ci'i phyir mi bde bar gyur ces smras pa dang / khyim bdag gis lo rgyus de dag rgyas par bshad do//de nas bram zes khyim bdag de la mya ngan ma byed par bdag gis bsgo ba bzhin du byos shig dang / khyod kyi 9bu tshe ring bar 'gyur ro zhes smras nas/ de'i tshe bram ze des cho ga'i sgo 'di nyid zhag bdun tshang bar bgyis pa dang / gshin rjes khyim bdag 7de la khyod kyi bu'i tshe'i tshad lo bcu drug las mi thub pas/ lo bcwa lnga lon te lo gcig la sa ma lus pa las/ deng dge ba'i rkyen dang phrad pas lo brgya thub par 'gyur ba'i phyir 'dir nga 'ongs nas bsgo ba yin no zhes smras pa dang / de'i tshe khyim bdag khyo shug rab tu dga' zhing mgu bar gyur pas/khyim gyi nor ci mchis pa bteg ste11/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 97—569

'dun la phul bas/ cho ga 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu chen po dang ldan par rig par bgyi lags so/ /sngar 'dus pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor dang /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por lan gsum zhugs pa zhig lags na/ dkyil 'khor mi 'tshal te/ phyag rgyas bgyis nas rig 1)sngags bzlas brjod bgyis pa tshonatsam gyis smon pa rnams mi 'grub pa gang yang ma mchis la/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par yang 'gyur lags so/ /bud med gang la la zhig bu btsa' ba'i tshe sdug bsngal chen po myong bar gyur na/ chab mar la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste 'tshal du stsal na nges par bde bar 'gyur zhing /khye'u dang bu mo btsas pa gang lags pa de dag kyang mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang ldan par 'gyur/ dge ba sna tshogs kyis brgyan nas sngon bsod nams bsags pa'i mthus skye bo mang po kun gyi snying du sdug 4par 'gyur/ rtag par mi'i nang du longs spyod khyad par du 'phags pa dag la longs spyod par 'gyur lags so/ /sems can gang la la zhig mig nad kyis thebs te sdug bsngal zhing mi bde bar 'gyur na/ sngags mkhan gyis byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya bgyis nas/ sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te mig la phyag rgyas btab par gyur na mig kyang 'tsho bar 'gyur la/ rgyu dang rkyen des gang zag de lha'i mig thob par 'gyur bas lha rnams gsal bar mthong zhing longs spyod rimachog la longs spyod par 'gyur lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i gzugs 'dri ba'i cho ga ni ras dkar po khru bcu drug pa'am/ khru nyi shu pa yang rung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de'i lus ni 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi kha dog 6can du bgyis 97—570

te / gdod la mig gsum mchis pa/ sug pa lag pa stong dang ldan zhing /sug pa lag pa stong po de dag re re'i mthil du'ang 6)mig re re na)bri'o/ /sug pa lag pa chen po yang dag pa 5)nyid ni ri nibacwa brgyad mchis te/ sngar sug pa gnyis kyis ni snying gar 95)thal mo sbyar bar bgyid do/ /sug pa gcig gis ni rdo rje'i tho ba thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni rtse gsum pa thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni 6glegs bam thogs so/ /yang gcig gis 7ni rin po che'i phyag rgya thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni 'khar gsil 8)thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni rin po che'i nor bu thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni rin po che'i 'khor lo thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni pad+ma kha bye ba thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni zhags pa thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni (94lcang ma'i lcug ma thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni 'od zer kha dog lnga 'byin par bgyid do/ /yang gcig gis ni bgrang phreng thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni ril ba thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni zil dngar 1 yongs su gtong ba'i lag tu ston to/ /yang gcig gis ni rin po che'i char sna tshogs 'bebs shing mi 'jigs pa'i lag tu ston to/ /yang gnyis ni lte ba'i thad kur g.yon pa g.yas pas mnan nas mthil 11bkan te mchis so/ /sug pa lag pa gzhan dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po de dag thams cad ni sprul pa'i sug pa lags te/ / sug pa de dag kun kyang so so nas mtshon cha dang / phyag rgya 1 rnam pa sna tshogs thogs pa'o/ /kha cig ni sug pa lag pa'i phyag rgya rkyang 7pa nyi tshe ba yang mchis te/ so so nas mi mthun pas snying po'i mdo las/ ji skad du byang chub sems dpa' de ni lha'i rin po che sna bdun gyi mgo rgyan thogs so/ /lag ngar la ni gdub kor bornam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan to/ /lus la ni phreng ba 97—571

thogs 3)shing lha'i rin po che'i gos gya rnam pa dag bgos pa yin no zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /tshon rtsi de dag gi nang du ko ba'i spyin stsal bar mi bgyi'o/ /kun du ru'i 92)khu ba dang sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /gang dag yum gyi gzungs kyi cho ga bgyid par 'tshal na sngar de'i gzugs ri mor bri'o/ /gzugs ri mor bri bar yang nges par chos bzhin du bgyi 'tshal bas/ ri mo 'dri ba'i gnas khang nyen 'khor kun du tsan+dan dkar po'i chab kyis dog sa la byugs te dkyil 'khor bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang ri mo mkhan 'byung 'jug gi tshe khrus bgyis nas gos sar pa gtsang ma bgos te/ nyin re bzhin sdom pa brgyad yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /chos bzhin du gzugs bris lags nas kyang / ri mo mkhan chos bzhin du ma bgyis par dogs par gyur na/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa gcig yid la ji ltar mos pa bzhin du bgyis te/ ba dan dang / me tog dang / zhal zas dang / zas dkar dgasum dang / me tog dang ( no/ phreng ba rigedang / spos chab dang / me tog sna tshogs kyis kun du khyab par bkram nas mchod pa rgya cher bgyis te/rnal 'byor pa dang / ri mo mkhan gang lags pa de gdugs gcig la dus gsum du gzugs bris pa'i mdun du nongs pa rnams mthol (6)bshags na/zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tshang ba'i mtshan mo mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i gzugs bris pa las 'od zer chen po byung nas/ nyi zla zil gyis mnan te/ 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' dang /tshad ma mchis pa thams cad thogs pa ma mchis par gsal bar bgyid pas/rnal 'byor pa dang / ri mo mkhan gang lags pa de dag dang / sems can gang dag 'od kyis reg pa de dag thams cad shin tu lci ba'i kha na ma tho ba ci 97—572

mchis pa dus gcig tu zhu byang nas yongs su dag par 'gyur lags so/ /cho ga 'di sgrub pa gang lags pa des sems rtse gcig tu ma bgyis pa ni ma gtogs lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag gis sngon 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs kyis kyang lag 0)stong dang spyan stong po 'di dag bstan nas/bdud chen po rnams 'dul ba mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das deng bdag gis kyang lag stong dang mig stong po 'di dag bstan nas bdud chen po rnams btul (5snab lags te/ sug pa lag pa stong po de dag kyang so so nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po re re mngon par sprul nas bskal pa bzang po rabs stong gi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bgyid par 'gyur la/ mig stong po de dag kyang so so nas sangs rgyas re re mngon par sprul nas/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong dang mtshungs par 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' 'di'i lus bdud 'dul ba'i nang na mchog tu gyur pa lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs so/ /ngas kyang byin gyi brlabs kyi (57mthus bskal pa mthar thug pa'i bar du khyod kyi yum gyi gzungs 'di byin gyis brlab (gepar bya'o// //byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzungs/ bam po gsum pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das kyis bsngags (37pa brjod pa thos nas rab tu dga' zhing mgu bar gyur pas thal mo 97—573

sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 1zhal du bltas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i gzungs kyi phyag rgya mngon par sgrub par bgyid pa mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngas kyang rjes su yi rang gis khyod kyis shod cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa dang / nam byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis rig sngags 'di smras pa na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi bar gyi lha'i gnas thams cad kyang rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /'og min gyi lha dang / dbang phyug chen po'ang (dmi bde bar shin tu skrag par gyur to/ /'dre gdon ma rungs pa thams cad kyang sdug bsngal chen po myong bar gyur pas/ ku co 'don cing shar nub tu byer nas 'gro ba'i gnas kyang mi rnyed par gyur to/ /de nas sprul pa'i lus kyis ca'akhor mang po rnams dang 5'dre gdon ma rungs pa rnams la khyed gal te bdag gi 6rig sngags kyi rjes su mi 'brang zhing 'gal bar byas par gyur na mgo tshal par 'gas par 'gyur ro zhes bsgo'o / /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags 'dis ni ri rnams 'joms par bgyid cing rgya mtsho chen po skems 8par bgyid do/ /rig sngags 'dis ni lha ma yin gyi dpung rnams bcom nas yul rnams bsrung bar bgyid do/ /rig sngags 'dis ni 'dre gdon ma rungs pa thams cad dang / nad thams cad dang / mi ma rungs pa thams cad tshar gcod par bgyid do/ /rig sngags 'dis ni sum cu 9rtsa gsum gyi 1 lha rnams 'joms shing dul bar bgyid lags so / /rigs kyi bu gang la la zhig rig sngags 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin 97—574

par bgyid na/ gang zag de'i mthu stobs brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /rig sngags 'di 'don pa dang / yongs su 'dzin pa de dag btsun zhing dbang phyug dang ldan pa dang / nam 'tsho'i 1)bar du rgyal pos byams shing yid du mchi ba dang smon pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par bgyid do/ /gang la la zhig phyir rgol ba'i bdud gdul bar 'tshal na spos gu gul (5bsregs te/ bdag gi lus po che'i sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /skye bo mang po thams cad kyis bdag la byams par 'tshal na lcug ma la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste sku/ g.yar khar bcas na byams shing bkur bar bgyi'o/ /bdag nyid spobs pa dang shes rab dang ldan par 'tshal na shu dag la lan stong rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste/ snying gar 4bskus na 5thogs pa ma mchis pa'i spobs pa thob par 'gyur te/ yum gyi gzungs kyi snying po'i phyag rgya bgyi'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thogs pa ma mchis pa'i spobs pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te6/ sug pa lag pa gnyis rgyab sprad de sbyar nas mthe bo gnyis mdun du brkyang bar bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya 'dis ni bdag kyang bsrung zhing gzhan yang bsrung bar bgyid do/ /phyogs gang dang 7gang du mchi yang rung ste / mtshams dgum par 'tshal bas chab gtsang ma'am thal ba gtsang ma la lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste/ gang du mchis pa'i gnas der chab bam thal ba snyim pa gang sngar rang gi lus la gtor nas/ de'i rjes la phyogs bzhir chos bzhin du gtor na/ de nyid mtshams su 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig 'dre srin ma rungs 8pa dang / log pa'i gdon mang po rnams kyis gcos 9par gyur na bal po se'u'i yal ga dang /97—575
