grib logs 91)kyi lcang ma'i yal ga blangs te/ rig sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis nas nad pa la gzhus na nad gang yang rung ste mi 'tsho ba ma mchis lags so / /rig sngags ni 'di lta ste/ na maḥ(gesarba bud+dha/ dharma saṃ bhā ya/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya(gu/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇa yel/ bo dhi satā ya(5 / tabya thā/ si bi si bi/ kā ya si bi/ pa la sha pa la ni swā hā/ rig sngags kyi phyag rgya 'dis ni log par lta ba'i mu stegs can rnams 'dul bar bgyid do/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig rtag par gdugs dang po 'char ba'i tshe dang / gdugs kyi gung dang / gdugs bas pa'i tshe lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis na/ rnam pa sna tshogs kyis sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bcu la mchod pa bgyis pa dang / bye brag (6)tu gyur pa ma mchis pas nam du'ang 7bud med kyi dngos po len par mi 'gyur/ tshe 'das nas kyang ngan song gsum po dag dang gtan du 'bral zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi zhing yongs su dag par skye bar 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i phyag gis spyi bo la byugs te/ khyod nga'i zhing du skye bar 'gyur bas ma 'jigs shig ces bka' stsal par 'gyur/ tshe 'di nyid la yang glo bur du 'chi bar mi 'gyur zhing / 'dre gdon dag gis kyang glags rnyed par mi 'gyur lags so / /de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi kha na ma tho ba yongs su sbyong ba'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ 'greng nas 'di ltar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa mdun du brkyang ste/sor mo lnga so sor phye nas mdun du phul te sor mo lnga char bsgreng ngo / /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bo lag mthil du bkug ste/ sor mo gzhan 97—576

bzhi ni khu tshur du bcangs nas rna ba g.yas pa'i thad shar bzhag ste/ lus po che'i sngags bzlas nas mdzub (1)mo ni phan tshun rgyu bar bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya 'di gdugs gcig la dus gsum du bgyi bar zhon)'tshal bas/ dus gcig gi tshe yang lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis na mtshams ma mchis pa lnga dang / shin tu lci ba bzhi'i kha na ma tho ba rnams kyang 'byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /sems can thams cad la byams pa dang / snying rje bskyed par gyur na kha na ma tho ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba bsregs nas/ tshe 'das pa'i rjes la'ang dzodasangs rgyas rnams dang mjal (gebar 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu'ang (5)'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bgyid par 'gyur/ gzhan yang bas pa ma mchis pa'i gter zhes 6bgyi ba'i gzungs dang / ye shes mnyam pa zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs thob par 'gyur / gzhan yang mtshan nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang ldan par 'gyur/ gzhan yang tshe 'di nyid la mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce la sogs pa bro 'tshal bar mi 'gyur zhing / lus kyi nad thams cad kyang yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur/sngon gyi las dang kha na ma tho ba rnams kyang zhu byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te than pa byung bar gyur na til 'bru 7yog po'i 'bras bu'i mar dang sbyar te/ ril bu 98)bgyis nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste chab rdzing du bor na/dgung char 'bab par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te char ches nas 'bras sā lu brngos 79༄pa'i me tog yungs 'bru'i mar dang sbyar te/ ril bu bebagyis nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste chab rdzing bur 11bor na dgung char 'chad par 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bdud rnams btul ba'i 97—577

phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ sor mo bsnol 51tshomar btang ste/ g.yon pas g.yas pa mnan te khu tshur dam du bcangs te spyi bor bzhag nas lus po che'i sngags bzlas brjod bgyis na 'khon pa'i dgra thams cad rang dul bar 'gyur lags so / /cho ga 'di bgyid pa gang lags pa des ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi mdun du tshes nyi shu dgu'i mtshan mo tsan+dan dkar po'i phye ma'i dkyil 'khor bgyis te/ me tog sna tshogs bkram nas yongs su dag par khrus bgyis te/gos gsar pa gtsang ma bgos nas sug par pog phor thogs te/ a ga 75)ru bsregs la kha shar phyogs su bltas te/ skyil mo krung ri bcas nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lag stong mig stong dang ldan pa'i spyi bo la mchis par 'du shes nye bar bzhag ste/ lus po che'i sngags lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na 'di dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang po mchog lags so/ /gzhan yang yungs kur 4 til gyi 'bras bu dang gcig tu bsres te brdungs nas phye mar bgyis te/ pho gsum gyis cung zad cig blangs nas lan cig 5sngags kyis btab ste nezhugs su dor ba dgung bdun tshang bar bgyis la/ gdugs re la yang lan brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na/ slad kyis ci bgyi'o 'tshal mngon par 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' 7spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 'jigs pa ma mchis pa chen po'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ 'greng nas sug pa rkang pa gnyis gzhibs 85te/sngar sug pa lag pa g.yas pa bkan te lag ngar g.yon pa bteg nas pus mo'i steng du bzhag par bgyis te/ sug pa lag pa g.yon pa yang de bzhin du bgyis nas rtag par ring bsrel gyi mdun du lus po che'i sngags lan smyo stong rtsa brgyad 97—578

bzlas brjod bgyis na/ myur du sems can la mi 'jigs pa stsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thob par 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang shing kun dang / yungs kur 0)dang / shu dag dang / ta ta pa'i ril bu (na)blangs te dngos po 'di dag zhugs kyi nang du bor te bsreg par bgyi'o/ /'di dag bsreg pa'ang nasangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar ram/ dkyil 'khor ram / gnas gtsang ma dag tu bsregs nas lus po che'i sngags bzlas te/ sngags lan re bzla zhing lan re bsregs 57pa brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis nas spos dang me tog dag gis rig sngags la mchod pa bgyis na/ ci dang ci smon pa rnams yid bzhin du mngon par 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te rig sngags gzhan gyis mi thub (6)pa dag sngags 'dis btab na thams cad thub cing 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te rmi ltas mthong bar 'tshal na sngags 'di 7bzlas nas phyag rgya bgyis te mig la btab na ci dang ci mthong bar 'tshal ba de dag thams cad rmi lam du mthong bar 'tshal lags so/ /bsod nams ma mchis pa gang dag ci bgyi'o 'tshal yid bzhin du grub 8par mi 'gyur na/ gdugs re bzhin rig sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad 'don pa dgung bdun du tshang bar gyur na ci dang ci smon pa thams cad 'thob par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag sngon klu'i rgyal po rgya mchoXre gnas su 9rgya mcho1re chos kyi 'dus sar chos ston pa na klu mang po rnams sdug bsngal chen po rnams myong bar mthong ba dang / klu mang po rnams la snying brtse nas de dag sdug bsngal las yang dag par bzla ba dang /sems can mang po rnams sdug bsngal dang bral zhing 'khon pa'i dgra ma mchis par bgyi ba'i slad du chos bstan pa las/ de'i tshe klu'i bu mos chos 'di gnyer 97—579

ba'i slad du nor bu rin po che mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams ri ba gcig zhi)phul ba dang / bdag gis ni de la yum gyi gzungs 'di rgya cher bstan pas sdug bsngal gyi bgegs rnams dang bral bar gyur lags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chu shel gyis rig sngags 'di yongs su 'dzin pa dag la phan gdags shing bgegs yongs su bsrung ba'i phyir sngags 'di smras so/ /bi ma le/ ma hā bi ma le / u ha le/ ma hā u ha le/ hu ma le/ ma hā hu ma le/ sa hā ( le/ ma hā sa hā le/ tsi li 4te swā hā/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig phyogs gang du gnas kyang rung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang lag stong dang ldan pa'i chos kyi cho ga 'di yongs su 'dzin par bgyid na/bdag kyang rtag par de dag gi rjes su 'brang ste/ yongs su bsrung bar bgyid pas bdud kyi 'khor rnams kyi bar 5dag gis gtse 56)bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig brel zhing phongs 7ripar gyur tam/ pha rol gyi dgras gtses sam/chom rkun dag gis gnod pa bgyid par 'gyur na/ tshon sna lnga'i skud pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste/ sngags lan re bzla zhing mdud pa re re mdud nas dpung pa g.yon pa la mdud par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang sug pa g.yon pa'i srin lag dang / gung mo dang / mdzub 8)mo rnams khu tshur bcangs te / mthe bos steng du mnan nas mthe chung chom rkun gyi phyogs su kha bstan te/sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na thams cad rang gyes nas gnod pa bgyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /sngon byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gangs 9ri la gnas te chos ston pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po'i yul na gnas pa'i skye bo rnams sems can gyi sha khrag 'ba' zhig 'tshal zhing /97—580

dge ba'i sems ci yang ma mchis pa mthong ba dang / de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' de thabs la mkhas pas phan gdags shing sems can gdul ba'i ched du rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus/ de ma thag tu yul de dag tu mchis nas/ mig stong dang lag stong dang ldan pas zhi)bdud 'dul ba'i lus mngon par bstan te/ yum gyi gzungs mngon par 'grub pa'i phyag rgya bgyis pa dang / de'i tshe (nasrin po'i yul gyi rgyal po bdag gi (5)thad du mchis nas nongs pa mthol (4)bshags te/ phyag bgyis pa dang / bdag gis kyang mngon par 'grub pa'i tshos)phyag rgyas 6btab pas / de bla na ma mchis pa'i lam mngon par grub par gyur 7lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mngon par 'grub pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ 'greng nas sug pa rkang pa gnyis gshibs te/ snying gar (8)thal mo sbyar te/ mthe'u chung gnyis bsnol 3)mar btang zhing / g.yon pas g.yas pa mnan nas lus po che'i sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas nas/cho ga rnam pa sna tshogs gang bgyid kyang rung ste/ thams cad mngon par 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'gro ba drug po dag sdug bsngal gyi bgegs las yongs su skyob pa'i 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ 'gro ba drug gi sems can sdug bsngal las yongs su skyob par 'tshal na 'khor lo'i phyag rgya 7spyad par bgyi ste/ 'di ltar sor mo bcu'i rtse mo phan tshun phrad par bgyi ste/ lag ngar gyi tshigs dang lag mthil ni dbye bar bgyi'o/ /sor mo rnams kyi bar yang tshon 1lhagang tsam mchis par bgyis te/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' de 'gro ba drug po dag tu gnas nas sdug bsngal 32gyi bgegs las yongs su 'das 12pa zhes bgyi ste/97—581

'di ltar phyag rgya'i 'khor lo 'di'i 917dbang gis thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur pas so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i mngon par rdzogs par byang 2chub pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ skyil mo krung (gyibacas nas sngar sug pa g.yon pa brkyang ste/ sor mo lnga car bkan nas pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag go/ /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste/sor mo lnga car kha sbub nas pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du mnan par bgyi'o/ /'di ni 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i phyag rgya dang 'dra ste/ 'das pa dang /ma byon pa dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang mtshungs par phyag rgya 'dis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'gyur ba lags pas/phyag rgya 'dis ni las kyi sgrib pa thams cad sel bar bgyid do/ /rnal 'byor pa bsam gtan sgom pa gang dag ting nge 'dzin mngon sum casadu ma gyur nas5sku/gdugs mtshan bdun gyi bar du dgon pa'i gnas su mchis nas gzungs 'di bzlas te phyag rgya 'di bgyis nas/ sems rtse gcig tu sangs rgyas rnams mig sngar mngon 6sum du bzhugs par yid la bgyis te/ gdugs mtshan gcig la dus drug tu mthol bshags bgyis na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyang mngon sum du 'gyur zhing bsod nams kyi phung po chen po tshad ma mchis/ dpag tu ma mchis/brjod du ma mchis pa rnams kyang 'thob par 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pas sum cu nam gsum pa'i lha rnams dgug pa'i phyag rgya 9ni 'di lags te/ sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo bzhi khu tshur bcang bar bgyi'o/ /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i mthe bo khu tshur bcangs pa bzhin bcangs khonas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bo lag 97—582

pa g.yas pa'i chang pa'i gong du rtse mo phyung nas sug pa lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub 1mo ni phan tshun du rgyu bar bgyi'o/ /sngags ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ ku tsi ku tsi/ ku tsi ri ya ri ri/ tsa ri tsa ri/ tsa ri 4le swā hā/ gzungs kyi phyag rgya dang sngags 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig mchis nyal kur phyag rgya 'di bgyis te/ sngags 'di lan re bzlas shing 5/snying gar 567phyag rgya lan re bgyi ba lan brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar gyur na/ sems la ci dang ci 'dod pa rnams rmi lam du rig cing mthong bar 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig rtag par phyag rgya 'di bgyis nas sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis na sdig pa thams cad byang nas byang chub kyi sems stong 7par mi 'gyur bas/gang zag de mtshan mo mchis nyal ba'i tshe g.yar lam na rgya cher 'phel zhing bkra shis par 'gyur/ g.yar lam na de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs nas lung ston pa dang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba'i bar nadag kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang /lha rnams kyang rtag tu nye bar mchis nas/ rim gro bgyid cing yongs su bsrung bar 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pas 9lha dang / klu dang / 'dre gdon sde brgyad po dgug pa'i phyag rgya 1 ni 'di lags te/ 'greng nas sug pa rkang pa gnyis gshibs 11te/ sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe 12bo lag mthil du bkug nas sor mo bzhi khu tshur bcangs te snying gar / bzhag go/ /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa yang de bzhin du bgyis te/ lag pa g.yas pa rna drung du gtad nas/ mdzub 1 mo phan tshun du rgyu bar bgyi'o/ /sngags ni 'di lta ste/ na mo nī la kuṇ+ḍas/ na ma ār+ya tshesha pa ta 97—583

swā hā/ na ma ri 1)ār+ya sha la swā hā/ e (9nyi e hi swā hā/ rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gzungs dang phyag rgya 'di ①len tam/ 'dzin tam / klog gam/ 'don par bgyid na/ myur du tshe rabs bdun tshun chad kyi sngon gyi gnas kyi dngos po rjes su dran par 'gyur/ sprul gdug pas zin par mi 'gyur/ dug gis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ mtshon gyis gnod pa bgyid par mi 'gyur/ rgyal pos gshe (4)bar mi 'gyur/ nams kyang (snyesems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig gdugs re bzhin du rig sngags 'di 'don par bgyid na 'dre srin sde brgyad po rnams rig sngags 'don pa'i drung du nye bar mchis nas rig sngags 'don pa nyan par bgyid do/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig 'dre gdon gyis zin par gyur na/ skud pa dkar po la sngags kyis btab ste/ sngags lan re bzla zhing mdud pa re re mdud de mdud pa bzhi bcu rtsa dgu tshang bar bgyis nas/de'i mgul du btags snyon de'i nad sel bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te yul gang du ltas ngan dang / rims nad byung ste ri/ yul mi mang du gum par gyur na / rgyal po'i kun dga' ra ba dang rdzing dag tu pad+ma stong rtsa brgyad blangs te/pad+ma re re la sngags lan re btab nas zhugs kyi nang du bor te bas par bsregs na rims nad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i rnam par grol ba'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ skyil mo krung 8bcas nas sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i gung mo mthe bo'i rtse mo dang sbyar te bkan la/ sor mo gzhan gsum ni brkyang 99rinas pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag par bgyi'o/ /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa yang de bzhin du 97—584

bgyis nas/ sug pa lag pa pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du kha sbub tu gzhag 1par bgyi'o / /gang la la zhig rtag par phyag rgya 'di bgyis nas lus po che'i sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis na/ smon lam rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhing sdug bsngal rnams kyang rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig mi dge ba tshon bcu dang mtshams ma mchis pa lnga la sogs pa'i dngos sdig rnam pa sna tshogs pa dzo cibagyis pas 'dzam bu'i 5gling gis ci mchis pa de dag thams cad rdul 6phra rab tu bgyis la/ rdul 7mo rab de re re yang bskal pa re re la mngon par byung bar gyur na/ gang zag de dngos sdig rnam pa sna tshogs bgyis pa'i dbang gis bskal pa'i grangs de snyed kyi bar du sems can dmyal bar lhung nas sdug bsngal myong zhing gtan du 'byung ba'i dus ma mchis pa zhig lags na yang / rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis ring bsrel 58dang bcas pa'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar zla ba dkar po'i ngo tshes bcwa lnga la gdugs mtshan gcig zas bkum ste phyag rgya mdud nas/rig sngags stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bzlas na gong du bstan pa'i sdug bsngal de dag thams cad zhu byang bar 'gyur te/ gal te byang bar mi 'gyur ro zhe na/de lta bu'i gnas ma mchis lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mig stong dang ldan pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la rang dbang thob pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ langs nas 'greng ste sngar sug pa g.yon pas sug pa rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bo la btsir nas khu tshur bcangs pa bzhin du bgyi'o / /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i lag ngar gyi steng du btsir nas lus po che'i sngags lan bdun 'don par bgyis na/ dpag tshad 97—585

brgya stong du mar mchi 'tshal na'ang 1dka' ba (gem mchis par 'gyur lags so/ /sngags 'don pa'i tshe sgra 'byung bar mi bgyi'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pas rdzu 'phrul la rang dbang thob pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung gi sen mo'i steng du reg par bgyi'o / /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa'ang( de bzhin du bgyis nas/sor mo gzhan gsum ni so sor yan par bsgreng 54)ste/ lag ngar gyi tshigs sbyar nas spyi bo'i steng du bzhag ste/ lus po che'i sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad 'don par bgyid 5na drang srong 'phur te mchi ba dag dang 'dra bar rang dbang du mchi (gebar 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems rtse gcig tu spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ sug pa gnyis nam mkha' la thal mo sbyar te 7lag ngar gyi tshigs sbyar nas mdzub 8)mo gnyis ni phan tshun rgyu bar bgyi'o / /sngags ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ a ro li ka dzo9༄te le51 tsho/ lo ki (1glebe do ya/sarba ya 1 dru/ pra man+ta na ka rā 1 ya pu ru swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ nyan thos chen po de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / tshangs pa chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten k+ṇi thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sems rgya cher geyongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs cho ga dang bcas pa rdzogs sol// //zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje 1 chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur te gtan la phab 97—586

gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa'i yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/1༄zag /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa'i 2yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa /dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das drang srong gi ri la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs mang po dang thabs cig catu bzhugs te/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te/ gos tshags bcos nas pus mo sa 5la btsugs te thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la pad+ma du ma 6chen po'i tsan+dan gyi snying po'i 'khor lo zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs chen mo smon cing bgyi ba thams cad mngon par 'grub par bgyi ba mchis te/ gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen pos bdag 97—599

gis bshad par gnang na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyi brlabs 6)kyi mthus sems can thams cad la sman par bgyi ba'i slad du bshad par 'tshal lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs 'di ni gzi byin chen po'i mthu dang ldan pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che chen po dang /yid bzhin gyi ljon shing bzhin du smon pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so legs so zhes ( bsngags pa brjod nas/ khyod kyis snying brtse ba'i phyir sems can gyi ched du 'di ltar zhugs pas na khyod thogs pa med pa'i gzungs 'di bshad par gnang bar bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de ltar bkas gnang ba dang / langs nas thal mo sbyar te phyag byas nas slar stan la 'dug ste/ sems rtse gcig tu 'khor 'dus pa dag la rnam par bltas nas snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i sems kyis sngags 'di smras so/ /na mo rat+na rin tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ ma hā sa tā ya/ ma hā kā (peru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tsakra pa ti tsin+ta (snyem ṇi ma hā pad+me 6ru ru tiṣ+ṭha ri note(3)/ badz+ra bha ra/ ā ka rā ya 5)rgyu swā hā/ 'di ni lus kyi sngags lags so/ /oṃ pad+me/ tsin+ta ma ṇi'i/ ma hā badz+ra bha ra ju/'di ni snying po'i sngags lags so/ /oṃ bha ra ta pad+me 6)rtsu/ 'di ni snying gi snying po'i sngags lags so/ /12de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gzungs 'di smras pa dang / sa chen po yang rnam pa drug tu rab tu 1gegayos par gyurasko/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am 97—600

ci dang / lto 'phye 6)chen po la sogs pa'i khang khyim rnams kyang rab tu g.yos par gyur/ bdud kyi rgyal po dang bdud kyi 'khor rnams kyang shin tu skrag cing 'jigs pa chen po skyes par gyur/ bdud kyi rgyal po'i gzhal med khang yang rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ gnod sbyin dang / 'dre srin ma rungs pa gzhan rnam pa sna tshogs kyang dngang zhing skrag pas gdong bkab ste sa la 'gyel bar gyuran/sems can dmyal ba'i sgo thams cad kyang phye nas sdug bsngal ba'i sems can rnams thar te/ lha'i bde ba mchog myong bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe lha rnams kyis kyang rin po che'i me tog dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyi yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyi char ①mngon par phab par gyur/ lha'i rol mo rnams kyang bar snang la sgra sna tshogs phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa ( byas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis (getshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis tshigs su bcad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la/rigs kyi bu khyod sems can la snying brtse ba'i phyir gzungs 'di bshad pa nyid kyis sems can rnams kyis phan yon chen po thob par 'gyur ba legs so legs so zhes bsngags ⑥pa brjod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu sems can rnams kyi phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi rgyal po chen po'i gzungs 'di'i cho ga shod cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/dge bsnyen ma'am/ khye'u'am/ bu mo gzhon nu gang la la zhig gis tshe 'di nyid 97—601

la rnam par smin pa mngon du myong bar 'tshal na/ gdugs mtshan sems rtse gcig tu nan tan brtson 'grus kyis gzungs 'di mi bskyud par bgyis te gdugs dang dus mi 'dam 17bar gtsang yang rung / mi gtsang yang rung ste/g.yar ston nadu bzlas par gyur ri rin bgyi ba rnams don dang ldan par 'gyur lags so/ /ci yang rung ste54/ don du bgyi zhing gnyer ba zhig mchis na lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na don brgya stong du ma 'grub par 'gyur bas/rig sngags rigazhan gang yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs 'di dang bskrun par bzod pa gang yang ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du (6)zhe na/ 'das pa dang da ltar gyi las ngan pa dang / sgrib pa lci ba rnams rab tu 'joms pas so/ /gang la la zhig gzungs 'di bzlas brjod bgyis na mnar ma mchis pa'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ba'i rigs dag kyang thar bar 'gyur la/ mtshams ma mchis pa lnga la sogs pa'i sdig rnams kyang 'byang bar 'gyur na/ las ngan pa dang gdon bgegs dang bro nad gzhan thams cad lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags/gang dag rims snyand nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / nyin mtshan du bro 'tshal ba'am/ rlung dang /mkhris pa'am/ bad kun la sogs pas bro 'tshal ba dag la rig sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis par gyur na thams cad 'byang zhing sos par 'gyur lags so / /gang zhig dug dang byad stems kyis naphog par gyur tam/ lhog pa dang /g.yan pa dang / mdze nad dam/ phol mig gam/ rlung nad dam/ smyos pa'am / klad pa bro 'tshal ba'am/ rna ba dang / sna dang / mchu dang / lce dang / mid pa dang / kha dang / gdong dang / gtsug dang / klad rgyas 97—602

dang / brang dang / rtsib logs dang / snying dang / lto ba dang / rked pa dang / rgyab dang / rkang pa dang / lag pa la sogs pa thams cad bro 'tshal 1bar gyur na yang thams cad sos par bgyid/ ji tsam du lus kyi bro nad ci mchis pa thams cad kyang sos par bgyid lags so/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / bi nā ya ka dang / bdud sdig can dang / 'dre gdon dag gis kyang gnod (na)pa bgyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /mtshon cha dang / dmag tshogs dang / chab dang / zhugs dang / rlung dang / char pa dang / ser ba ma rungs pa dag gis kyang 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /dgra dang / chom rkun lde)dang / rgyal po ma rungs pa dang / rkun 4po ma rungs pa dag gis kyang gnod par bgyid par mi 'gyur ro/ /glo bur du 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur / rmi lam ngan pa rmi bar mi 'gyur/ rtsangs pa dang / sprul dang /sdig pa dang / srin bu gyi med dang / rkang mang 5dang / gcan gzan 6gdug pa ma rungs pa dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / spyang ki dag gis kyang gnod pa bgyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /g.yul ngor 'thab pa'i tshe thams cad du rgyal bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te bla'i bgyi ba dag gis rtsod 7par gyur na yang 'dum par 'gyur te/ gzungs 'di lan cig 8bzlas na gong du bstan pa de dag thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig gis gdugs re gzungs 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis 9na / byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad du/rigs kyi bu khyod ma 'jigs shig /ci zhig smon cing 7ci zhig yongs su gnyer bar byed/ thams cad khyod la sbyin no zhes bgo bar 'gyur/ de bzhin 97wa 603

gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyang sku mngon du ston par 'gyur/ mdo las gsungs pa bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi bkod pa'i dngos po dag kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas ri po ṭa (1)la yang mthong bar 'gyur/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyang yongs su dag par 'gyur bas rtag par rgyal po dang blon po rnams kyis bkur zhing rim gro ②bgyid par 'gyur/ skye bo mang pos byams shing bkur bar 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du ma'i mngal du mi skye zhing pad+ma'i steng du skye bar 'gyur/ bkod pa mchog dang ldan par 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran par 'gyur/ 'di nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i bar du nam yang ngan 'gro rnams su mi ltung zhing rtag par sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar skye bar 'gyur lags te/ 'di ni sdig pa'i las thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs zhes gebagyi ba lags so/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sems can la snying brtse ba'i phyir yang yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po'i gzungs gsang ba'i cho ga bstan pa su yang rung ba gces pa'i don grub pa zhig mchis na/ thams cad rang zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ 'di lta ste/'jig rten gyi nor dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nor gang lags pa'o/ /de 97—604

la 'jig rten pa'i nor ni gser dang dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che rnams so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i nor ni bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi bkod pa rnam pa gnyis dang ldan zhing lus dang sems rab tu bde ba dang / skye bo mang pos byams shing bkur ba dang / sdug bsngal ba'i sems can thams cad yongs su skyob pa dang / byams pa'i sems rgyas nas blo dang ldan pa rnams bde ba stsol ba dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad 'phel zhing mthu stobs rtag pa gang lags pa'o/ /gsang ba'i mdzod kyi spyod yul 'di ni gzhan dag la brjod par mi bgyi'o/ /gang la la zhig bdag gi (1)yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs kyi dngos grub mchog thob par 'tshal na/ sems rtse gcig tu dus thams cad dang / gnas thams cad du gtsang yang rung mi gtsang yang rung ste(kyi/ rtag par bzlas brjod bgyis 5na nongs pa ci yang ma mchis pas bzlas brjod bgyi ba'i grangs tshang bar bgyis nas / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ming dang / yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs kyi ming dang / gang zag de'i 4ming nas brjod de(snye/ gal te rgyal po'am/ rgyal bu'am/ btsun mo'am/ slas phyisam / rgyal po'i bu mo'am/ bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ dmangs rigs sam / gdol pa'am/ skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ khye'u 'am/ bu mo gzhon nu ma'am/ mu stegs sna tshogs dag la bsten cing mdza' 7bar 'tshal na de dag gi zhu)ming nas brjod de rtag par tho rangs kyi tshe bzlas pa'i grangs tshang 9bar bgyi'o/ /gal te dngos grub mchog gnyer zhing rgyal po la bsten 7par 'tshal na dgung zhag bdun gyi bar du rtag par tho rangs kyi tshe lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas na mjal bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te btsun mo la bsten 17par 'tshal 97wa 605

na lan dgu brgya bzlas par bgyi'o/ /rgyal bu la bsten (1)par 'tshal na lan brgyad brgya bzlas par bgyi'o/ /slas dag mthong bar 'tshal na lan bdun brgya bzla bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal po'i bu mo la bsten na par 'tshal na lan drug brgya bzla bar bgyi'o/ /bram ze la bsten dpar 'tshal na lan lnga brgya bzla di bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal rigs la bsten 5par 'tshal na lan bzhi brgya bzla bar bgyi'o/ /dmangs rigs la ni sum brgya'o/ /gdol pa la ni nyis brgya'o(6/ /dge slong dang /dge slong ma la ni lan brgya'o/ /dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma la ni lan dgu bcu'o/ /khye'u gzhon nu dang bu mo gzhon nu ma la ni lan drug cu'o / /'di ni bsten cing mdza' bar bgyi ba'i cho ga zhes bgyi ste/ nor dang / bran dang / rta dang / bde ba'i yo byad thams cad 'byor par bgyid nalags so/ /gang la la zhig snying du sdug cing mdza' ba dag ring po na 9mchi ba dang mjal bar 'tshal na yid la bsams pa bzhin du rlung bzhin du mchi 1 bar 'gyur lags so/ /ci bgyi'o 'tshal bzlas 11brjod bgyi ba'i grangs tshang bar gyur nyu na don de dag 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong bar 1 'tshal na lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis 1 na de'i lus yang dag pa nyid mthong zhing bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par bgyid lags so/ /gal te lag na rdo rje mthong bar 'tshal na bzlas brjod lan khri bgyis na lus mngon sum du bstan nas/ de la brtse zhing phas bu la byams pa bzhin du sems kyi smon pa rnams 465 bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te sangs rgyas dang 'khor 'dus pa mang po mthong bar 'tshal na lan khri sum stong bzlas brjod bgyis bon de bzhin du mthong bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te gdugs 97—606

mtshan bdun gyi bar du rgyun chad pa ma mchis par bzlas brjod bgyis na rig 1sngags 'chang rnams mngon sum du ston cing / so so nas rang rang gi sngags kyi mthu ci mchis pa gang zag de la stsol nas yongs su srung 5)bar bgyid de/zhag bdun pa la ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dbang po dang / brgya byin lha'i dbang po rnams 'khor dang bcas te mchis nas/ de'i smon pa rnams stsol bar bgyid do / /bzlas brjod kyi cho ga gong du bstan pa bzhin du bgyis 5non smon pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par bgyid de/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod las thams cad byams shing mos par 'gyur ba'i cho ga zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod las thams cad byams shing mos par 'gyur ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gzhan yang sems can rnams 56la snying brtse ba'i phyir gang gis mthong ba dag byams shing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i sman sbyar nas lus la thogs te 'gro na mchog tu mngon par 'grub cing bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i cho ga bstan pa/gi'u 7wang dang / tsan+dan dkar po dang / gur gum dang / ga pur dang /gla rtsi dang / dza nati pha la dang / li shi dang / ka ko la dang / pad+ma dang /ut+pa la sngon po dang / gser gyi gyim pag rnams cha mnyam par bgyis te brdungs 9nas sbrang rtsi dkar pos sbrus te/ snga ma'i sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas lus la bdugs sam/ gos la bdugs 1 sam/ mig la bskus sam/97—607

dpral (1)ba la thig le bgyis sam/ lus la byugs na rgyal po dang / btsun mo dang / blon po rnams dang / bran ( rnams dang / skyes pa dang / bud med la sogs pa byams shing dga' ba dang / lam gyi chos la bkur zhing byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ lus kyi zho sha dang / nor rdzas dag phangs pa ma mchis par gtong zhing rim gro darabagyid par 'gyur te/ brjod kyis mi lang lags so/ /ji ltar nyi zla thams cad kyis mthong bar mos pa bzhin du sgrub ④pa'i don rnams 'byor cing 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig sman 'di thogs par 'gyur na kha na ma tho ba'i sgrib 95)pa (6)rnams zhu byang nas bgegs thams cad las thar bar 'gyur lags so/ /rgyal po'i mthus nan gyis 'phrog pa dang / chab kyis ded pa dang / zhugs kyis tshig (7pa dang / mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs dang / dug dang / 'ching 58)ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur lags so/ /bsam pa thag pa nas sman a ka ta sbyor ba'i cho ga 'di bgyis na thams cad kyis byams shing dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /sman 'dis bdugs ri95pas bab chol du g.yar khar stsal bar bgyi ste/ 'di ni spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gzhan dag la byams shing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i sman gyi cho ga zhes bgyi lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi nyu riyid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs las gzhan dag la byams shing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i sman a ka ta sbyar ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ gzhan yang sems can rnams la snying brtse 17ba'i phyir thams cad kyi yid du 'ong zhing dga' 97—608

bar 'gyur ba'i sman khar mur ba'i cho ga bstan pa ga bur dang / gla rtsi dang /gur gum zhib mor btags te0)/ gi'u (miwang dang bsres (gun gong du bstan pa'i sngags rnam pa gsum re rer (gi)yang lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ chab gtsang mas sbyar nas ril bu zhu)che chung shing mgo stong gi 'bras bu tsam du bgyis te/yang sngags gong ma gsum lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas grib ma la bskams pi te/gdugs dang / rlung gis ma phog par bgyis nas/ ril bu (77re re la yang gong ma'i sngags rnam pa gsum lan bdun bdun gyis btab ste(8)/ ril bu (gcig khar mur nas rgyal po'am/ blon 7po nye phan nam/ skye bo'i tshogs mang po dag la gtam bgyis par gyur na bkur ste bgyis nas/ nor dang rin po che dag phangs pa ma mchis par ci dang ci 'tshal ba thams cad stsol bar 'gyur/tshig tu smras so 'tshal thams cad kyis yid ches shing nyan 17par 'gyur/ bsgo ba zhig mchis na yang thams cad nyan cing bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /khar sman mur ba'i tshe rtag par sngags bzla 'tshal te/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smon pa rnams 'grub par bgyid lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs kyi sna mdun du spos chab kyis dkyil 'khor gru bzhi chu zheng khru bzhis 'khor ba cig 1 bgyis te/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du rtsi shing gi me tog rnam pa sna tshogs ci 'byor pa bkram zhing / tsan+dan dkar po bsregs nas sman gyi ril bu 6snga ma blangs te dkyil 'khor gyi nang du bzhag nas/ rgyal mtshan bzhi gzugs chashing / yol ba dang / bla re tshadakar po bres 1 te/dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pad+ma dkar po bzhi yang bris te/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa bgyis lags 18pa'i rjes la snying po'i 97—609

sngags dang / snying gi snying po'i sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzla bar bgyi'o/ /lus kyi sngags kyang lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas tsan+dan dkar po bsregs te/me tog gtor na de'i tshe smon pa thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang na mchis pa'i sman blangs te lus la btags na phyogs gang du mchi yang rung ste/ ci dang ci gnyer ba thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ tshig tu smras pa thams cad kyis yid ches shing nyan par 'gyur/ don du sgrub 93pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /sems rtse gcig tu ma bgyis pa ni ma gtogs te/'di ni yid bzhin tsan+dan gyi 'khor lo las sman mur ba'i cho ga zhes bgyi lags so / /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo las sman mur ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ gzhan yang sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir skye bo mang po thams cad kyis mthong na byams shing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i cho ga bstan pa/ sman 5shi ri ka ku shu dang /pad+ma le brgan dang / pad+ma sngon dpo dang / rgya mtsho'i chab kyi dbu ba dang /nya rkun mnag po'i rus pa dang / ba bla cadang / ka kun ban su dang / gi'u 5wang dang / gur gum dang / rgya'i gur gum dang / pi pi ling dang / na le sham dang / bca' sga tshornams cha mnyam par bgyis te brdungs 7nas zhib mor btsags te sman snga ma srang gcig namachis na gla rtsi dang / ga bur srang phyed stsal nas zhib tu bdar te/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs kyi mdun du sbyar ba bgyis lags pas/ snga ma'i sngags rnam pa gsum re re yang lan stong rtsa 97—610

brgyad bzlas te/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang / snying brtse ba'i sems 6)bskyed nas sman de dag byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rkang pa'i drung du gzhag par bgyi'o/ /de'i rjes la reg par bgyis nas khar ba'i thur mas blangs te (gemig tu stsal na mig dang / klad pa bro 'tshal ba dang ling tog lagis bsgribs pa thams cad dang / sprin dkar dang / mchi ma 'dzag pa dang / sprin dmar dang / long nad dang / klad capa bro 5'tshal ba thams cad sos par 'gyur lags so/ /rtag par gdugs re bzhin du sman 'di mig tu stsal na mig nad thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /gdugs gnyis stsal na lus kyi bro nad thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gdugs gsum stsal na smyo ba'i bro nad rnam pa brgyad cu 6rtsa bzhi 'byang bar 'gyur lags so / /gdugs bzhi stsal na phyi nang gi sgrib 7pa thams cad kyis sgrib par mi 'gyur ro/ /gdugs lnga stsal na dgra dang 'thab pa na thams cad du rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /gdugs drug stsal na sdig pa'i las dang / nyon mongs pa dang /lci ba bzhi dang / mtshams ma mchis pa lnga dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / byad stems thams cad rnam par 'joms shing / ngan 'gro rnams su nam yang ltung bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /gdugs bdun stsal na rgyal po dang / blon po chen po dang / skye bo mang po thams cad rjes su 'brang zhing bkur sti bgyis nas yid ches shing byams par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag gnyis kyi 8bar du stsal na rang dbang chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag gsum gyi bar du stsal na rgyal po dang / blon po chen po dag dang mdza' bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bzhi'i bar du stsal na gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rim gro bgyid 97—611

par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag lnga'i bar du stsal na lha ma yin dang / klu dang gnod sbyin dang / srin po rnams g.yog bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag drug gi bar du stsal na nam mkha' lding dang srin po mthu chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i bar du yongs su bsrung bar bgyid pas byad stems ti dang 'dre gdon rnams kyis tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du stsal na lha nag po chen po dang 'dre srin sde brgyad rnams nye bar lhags nas rjes su 'brang zhing g.yog bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag brgyad kyi bar du stsal na an+t+rad nar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag dgu'i bar du stsal na gter thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu'i bar du stsal na lha ma yin gyi khang khyim gyi sgo rang bye nas de na ci mchis pa thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ 'byung zhing 'jug pa la thogs pa ma mchis ②par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu gcig gi bar du stsal na sman zhugs ①ltar 'bar ba ji snyed pa thams cad mngon sum du dga' bar 'gyur bas/ tshe ring bar 'gyur 'tshal lam/ mthu chen po dang ldan par 'tshal na yang de bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu gnyis kyi bar du stsal na drang srong mang po rnams kyis rin po che'i gter rnams phye ste nye bar bstan nas yid bzhin du longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu gsum gyi bar du stsal na klu'i ri rigazhal med khang rnams sgo rang bye paranas blta ba dag la thogs pa ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu bzhi'i bar du stsal na 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha rnams kyi gzhal med khang dag sgo rang bye bar 'gyur bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcwa du/lnga'i bar du stsal na mtshan mo 97—612

mun nag gi nang na yang gdugs bzhin (1)du gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu drug gi bar du stsal na sa'i 'og gi rdo rje'i sa gzhi (gedang rlung gi dkyil 'khor yang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu bdun gyi bar du stsal na gling bzhi po rnams su sems can dmyal ba'i sems can ji snyed mchis pa yang thams cad mthong bar 'gyur la/ de'i mthu'i dbang gis sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can de dag thams cad kyang thar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcwa sabargyad kyi bar du stsal na gang zag de nyi ma lta bu'i mthu thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu dgu'i bar du stsal na lag na rdo rje'i lus yang dag pa nyid mthong bar 'gyur bas smon pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par bgyid do/ /zhag bdun phrag nyi shu'i bar du stsal na spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje chen po dang ldan pa mthong bar 'gyur bas smon pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid do/ /zhag bdun phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du stsal na rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa thob par 'gyur/ /gzugs kyi khams kyi lha rnams kyi gzhal med khang gi sgo rnams rang bye nas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur jotsho / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa rnams kyang mthong (snyebar 'gyur ro/ /lo gcig gi bar du stsal na yongs su dag pa'i mig lnga 'thob par 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig spyod pa'i cho ga 'di mngon par 'grub par 'tshal ba gang lags pa des bstan pa 'di la shin tu mngon par yid ches par bgyi zhing / sems can la snying 6brtse 7bar bgyi ste/the tshom ⑧ma mchis na gong du bstan pa bzhin du thams cad 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te the tshom 59༄'tshal bar 'gyur na cho ga rnams grub par dka' 97—613

ste / 'di ni spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi tsan+dan nor bu'i 'khor lo las mig sman gyi cho ga zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sems kyi 'khor lo las mig gi sman gyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gzhan yang sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir sgrub 1)pa'i don thams cad grub dun)par byed pa/ nyon mongs pa dang kha na ma tho ba'i sgrib pa dang / las ngan pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa/ dgra thams cad 'dul ba/ bi nā )ya ka khro ba'i sems nye bar zhi nas skye bo mang po la gnod pa mi byed cing byams pa'i sems skye /4ribar 'gyur ba/ sbyin sreg raho bkra shis kyi cho ga bstan pa/ dog sa brkos te zhugs thab khru gang gru bzhi pa cig bgyis nas me tog ma len tsa su dang / yungs kur cadang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi 7skudang / chab mar cha mnyam par bsres te/a ga ru dang / tsan+dan dang / shing dri can so so nas srid du sor bcu gnyis zheng du sor gcig mchis pa gtubs te/ thab tu bsreg 8par bgyi zhing sman nyung zad cig blangs nas lan cig 9sngags kyis btab ste/ zhugs kyi nang du dor ba 1 lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na/ las 11kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'joms shing 15tshe lo brgya nyi shu thub par 'gyur lags so/ /zhag bdun gyi bar du rgyun chad pa ma mchis par lha gyi cho ga bzhin bgyis na tshe lo stong thub cing lus kyang yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag gnyis kyi bar du cho ga bzhin du bgyis na rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang / blon po chen po nye phan dang / skye bo phal pa rnams kyang skyabs su mchis nas bsnyen bkur 97—614

bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag gsum gyi bar du cho ga bzhin du bgyis na sum cu rtsa ༅cigasum gyi lha rnams 'khor dang bcas pa dang / nyi zla'i lha dang rgyal po chen po bzhi na 'khor dang bcas pa yang nye bar lhags nas yongs su bsrung ribar 'gyur/ lag na rdo rjes kyang dngos grub chen po stsol bar 'gyur/byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis kyang smon pa chen po rnams yongs su skong bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te yul khams su char dkon par gyur na yungs kur 5dang chab mar la sngags 'dis btab stene/ gdugs 7gsum gyi bar du zhugs kyi nang du bsregs na char pa 'bab par 'gyur/ gal te char che ste mi khums na thab de'i thal ba blangs nas sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis btab ste/ gnam du gtor na char pa khums par 'gyur ro/ /gal te ser ba ma rungs pa 8chibabs sam/ rlung drag po glo bur du langs par gyur na yang thal ba de blangs nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste / sprin mchis pa'i phyogs su gtor na zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /sngags 'di rtag par bzlas brjod bgyis na mthu stobs 1 mthu bo che dang 'dra bar 'gyur bas/ lus 'di spangs nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i bar du skye ba thams cad sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa thob par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tsan+dan gyi snying po'i 'khor lo'i gzungs 'di bdag gis bstan pa bzhin du dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ skyes pa'am / bud med gang la la zhig gis lan cig 11'chang bar bgyid na gdon mi 97—615

za bar 'grub par 'gyur bas the tshom gyi bsam pa bskyed par mi bgyi'o/ /yid la bsams (1 pa'i don thams cad thob par 'gyur bas shin tu mngon par yid ches par bgyi zhing the tshom (gubaskyed par mi bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la khyod snying rje chen pos yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs kyi cho ga gya rnam pa 'di yang dag par bshad de/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde bar byas pa legs so legs so zhes bsngags pa brjod do/ /gang la la zhig gis sems bskyed de kha nas bzlas brjod byas na dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yin mod kyi ngas bstan pa bzhin du sems can rnams la yang nas yang du nan tan brtson 'grus kyis rjes su bstan nas dngos grub thob par bya ba'i ched du lus nye bar ston la/ nga'i tshig dang 'gal bar ma byed cig dang nga yang rjes su yi rang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni bskal pa nadapag tu ma mchis pa nas byams pa dang brtse ba'i sems kyis sems can la rjes su ston cing / rtag par yongs su bsrungs nas dngos grub stsal ba (deni bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis ga mkhyen cing dbang du gyur pa lags so/ /sems can rnams kyi slad du yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs 'di bshad pa lags pas / gang la la zhig gis len cing 'chang ba dang / rtag par bdag nyid bzlas brjod bgyi ba'i grangs tshang bar bgyis na smon pa rnams grub par 'gyur te / bdag ni de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyi brlabs 6)kyi mthus sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams yongs su bskyab par bgyid pa lags so/ /de'i tshe 97—616

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs 'di smras pa dang / 'khor 'dus pa chen po thams cad rab tu dga' nas mngon par yid ches pas yang dag par blangs te spyod par gyur to/ ci /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs las sbyin sreg 51)ho gyi cho ga sman sbyor ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi nagasang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa'i yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs sol// //zhu chen gyi mkhan po dang lots+tsha ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa ban+de chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa57// //97—617

༄ga /'phags pa sngun ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/17༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya na a ba lo ki te shwa ra e ka da sha mu kha nā ma dhā ra tsā sta/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rig 4sngags 'chang du mas yongs su bskor te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song nas bcom ldan 'das kyi gzhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das snying po gdong bcu gcig pa zhes bgyi ba 'di ni sangs rgyas 6bye ba phrag bcu gcig gis gsungs 57pa lags te/ de sems can thams cad la sman 8pa dang bro nad 9thams cad tsharab tu zhi bar bgyid pa dang sdig pa dang bkra mi shis pa dang rmi lam 97—621

ngan pa thams cad bzlog 1par bgyi ba dang / dus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad bzlog par bgyi ba dang ma zhugs pa rnams dad par bgyi ba dang /bgegs dang log 'dren rnams rab tu zhi bar bgyi ba'i slad du bshad par bgyi'o / /bcom ldan 'das snying po 'dis bsrung bar bgyi ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung 2bar bgyis dzodapa dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyis pa dang / chad pa spangs pa dang / mtshon cha spangs pa dang / dug gzhil ba ri bgyis pa dang / gang la la zhig 'gal bar bgyid pa de ma mchis te/ de ni 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa bdud dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang bcas pa dge sbyong 5dang bram zer bcas pa na bdag gis ma mthong ste/ sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ni ma gtogs lags so/ /snying po 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis bstod cing dgongs pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rjes su thugs rangs par mdzad pa 6rilags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dran lags te/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi snga rol na de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma brgya'i spyan gtsug gis chags pa'i dus 'joms pa'i 'od zer gyi rgyal po zhes bgyi ba byung ste/ bdag drang srong du gyur pas de bzhin gshegs pa de las 'di mnos lags te/ thos ma thag tu phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon du gyur/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa yang thob ste/ de ltar bdag gis snying po 'di ni gces spras bgyid pa lags so/ /de lta 7lags pas rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi 8mo dad pa dang ldan pas gus par bgyis la snying po 'di brjod par bya'o/ /gzhan yid la mi bgyid par rtag 97—622

tu brjod par bgyi'o/ /nang par langs nas brgya rtsa brgyad bton 1na tshe 'di la yon tan bcu yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur te/ bcu gang zhe na/ bro nad ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ba dang / des bsgrim mi 'tshal bar nor dang 'bru dang dbyig rnams rnyed par 'gyur ba dang / dgra thams cad khugs shing thul bar 'gyur ba dang /rgyal po'i tshogs dzonarnams gsong por smra bar sems dpar 'gyur ba dang / lus la dug gis mi tshugs pa dang dbyig dug gis mi tshugs pa dang rims kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ba dang / mtshon chas mi tshugs par 'gyur ba dang / chab kyis 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / zhugs kyis 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / dus ma lags par 'gum pas 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba lags so/ /gzhan yang yon tan bzhi yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur te/ 'gum 4pa'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ba dang / ngan song rnams su skye bar mi 'gyur ba dang / ya nga ba ma spangs pas 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 5'gyur ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dran lags te 'di nas bskal pa gang gā'i 6klung bcu'i bye ma snyed dag gi snga rol gyi 75yang ches snga rol na de bzhin gshegs pa man dā ra ba'i bsung nazhes bgyi ba byung ste/ de na 9bdag khokhyim par gyur pas 'di bzung nas bskal pa bzhi khri'i 'khor ba phyir bsnyil lags so/ /bdag gis snying po 'di bton pas byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rgyal ba thams cad kyi snying rje 'jug pa ye shes kyi snying po zhes bgyi ba thob lags so/ /gang dag 97—623

bcing bas bcings pa rnams dang / gang dag bcing ba la thug pa rnams dang /chab dang zhugs dang / sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyis nyen pa'i sems can thams cad la bdag gi snying po 'dis gnas pa dang / bskyab pa dang skyabs hunyedang / dpung gnyen bgyi'o/ /gnod sbyin dang srin po sdang ba rnams kyang snying po 'dis bkug la byams pa'i sems dang snying rje'i sems su bgyi ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dgod par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po 'di ni de ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba lags so/ /lan cig ②brjod pas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi po dag kyang byang bar 'gyur/ mtshams ma mchis pa lnga po dag kyang ma lus par 'byang bar 'gyur na/ ji skad bstan pa bzhin du nan tan bgyid pa lta cismos kyang ci 'tshal/ de dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 4)'gyur ba lags na bzlas brjod bgyid pa dang sgrub pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /su zhig bdag gi slad du tshes bcu bzhi'am / bcwa 5lnga la smyung ba bgyis na de bskal pa bzhi khri'i 'khor ba bsnyil bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi (6)ming 'dzin pa ni don mchis te/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag (7)'bum gyi bas lhag lags so/ /bdag gi ming 'dzin pa'i sems can thams cad ni phyir mi ldog pa nyid la gnas par 'gyur / bro nad thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur/ sgrib 58༄pa thams cad dang lus dang ngag dang yid kyis tshoninyes par spyod pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig cho ga bzhin du sbyor ba bgyid khon de dag gi sug par sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 97—624

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod sems can thams cad la de ltar snying rje che ba legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu thabs (1)'dis sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dgod par nus te/ngas kyang snying po 'di bzung zhing rjes su yi tshon)rang ba byas kyis rigs kyi bu khyod smros shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te snying po 'di smras so/ /na mo rat+na ④dra yā (5)ya/ na ma ār+ya rine dz+nyā (7)na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byu ha narā dzā ya/ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyakle bud dhā ya she kyi/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ar+ha te bebh+yaḥ17/ samyakle nya budhe sna bh+yaḥng/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ ma hā sa tā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi /lokā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/rnyi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ar+bhe bar+bhes/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma 3 ba re/ i nyanali mi li/ tsi 17ti dz+wa 3 )la ma pa na ya 1swā hā/'di'i cho ga ni bsgrub mi dgos par las thams cad byed de/ rims nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang /'byung po dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / 'dre dang / lus srul po dang /brjed (2byed dang / lba na ba dang / 'bras kyi phreng ba dang / bas bldags la sogs pa dang / dug dang / phol mig dang / g.yan pa la sogs pa la 'jim pa la bsngags 2 te bsku'o/ /lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis na las kyi sgrib pa sbyong bar bgyid do/ /byis pa gdon gyis zin pa la ni 'bru mar ro/ /rna ba bro 'tshal ba la ni ru rta dang 'bru mar ro/ /sna 22bro 'tshal ba la gro ba 97—625

sngag /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+sā 2mo gha pā sha ṣ+ṭṛ 4da yo nā ma ma hā yā na sru sku tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das po ṭa phyol ma'i 7ri'i rtse mo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas sa ma nal dang / ta ma la dang / tsam pa ka dang / mya ngan med pa dang / a ti mug ta 9ka la sogs pa mang po dang / sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i sdong pos yang dag par brgyan par/dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po stong phrag bcwa 1 brgyad dang / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang / gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun du byas nas mang po dang 97—635

'gyur ro/ /de bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' gang 'dir don yod zhags pa'i snying po thos pas bdag gi 0)dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed ( par 'gyur ro/ /gang kha cig bcom ldan 'das sdig pa'i skyon byed pa/ sdig pa'i chos thams cad la yang dag par spyod pa/ 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ dam pa'i chos la smod ①pa/ mnar med pa la gzhol ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas la smod 94pa po de/ gal te 'gyod par gyur cing slan chad gcod cing sdom par gyur na/bcom ldan 'das des re zhig (5)de nyid smyung (7)bar gnas pa gcig gis de bzlas na de'i skye ba 'di'i las yongs su dag cing (7)yongs su zad par 'gyur ro/ /phyir bzlog (kyepar 'gyur ro/ /rims nyin gcig pa'am/ nyin gnyis pa'am/nyin gsum pa'am/ nyin bzhi pa'am/ de'i phyir khrag tu 'khru 5)ba'am/ tshad tshapa'amal/ lag pa na ba'am/ rkang pa na ba'am/ mgo na ba'am/ ha la ha la yis btags 47pa'am/ mdze'am/ rkang shu'am/ 'brum bu phra mo'am/ lhog pa'am / 'bras sam/ bye'u 'bras sam/ g.yan pa'am/ mtshan ma rdol ba'am / 'brum tsobu'am/ brjed (/rtebyed dam/ khyab ⑩par na ba'am/ gsod pa'am / 'ching ba'am/ rdeg pa'am/ bsdigs 8pa'am/ mi snyan par brjod pa'am/ mdor bsdu na bcom ldan 'das lus kyi na tsha'am/ sems kyi sdug bsngal lam/ rmi lam ngan pa mthong bas de'i las yongs su dag cing zad par 'gyur ro/ /sngar nyid nas dag pa'i sems can dad cing lhag par mos pa rnams shin tu yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi po dang / rigs bzhi pos ji snyed yodu bdag la sgyu dang g.yos 7kyang 97—637

mchod par byed/ gang 'dir don yod zhags pa'i snying po nyan par byed pa dang / don 'dzin par byed pa/ 'chang bar byed pa/ klog par byed pa/'dri 1bar byed pa/ 'drir 'jug par byed pa/ kun chub par byed pa/sems can nagazhan rnams nyan du 'jug par byed pa'am tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa'i rna bug tu gtugs te zlos par byed/ sngags kyi tshig 'di sems par byed pa dang / dor ba med pa/ gzugs med pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa/ yang dag par 'byung ba med pa/ yun ring du 'byung ba med pa/sgyu 4med pa/ gos pa 5med pa/ mnyam pa'i sems g.yeng ba med pa/ phung po lnga dang bral ba'i 6sbyor ba 'dis ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran par bya'o/ /de dag la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas brgya 7 stong gis zhal ston par 'gyur ro/ /khyod rinakyis bzlas pas sdig pa bshags 9par 'gyur ro/ /ji snyed po tir bri ba byas nas khyim du bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mang pos ci bya ste/phan tshun 'gran 1 pas nyan pa'am rje dpon gyis 'jigs pas sam/ gzhan gyi rjes su 'jug pas sam/ gzhan smad 11par bya ba'i ched du nyan pa ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi byin gyis brlabs su mkhas pas shes par bya'o / /de dag gi rna bug tu de'i sgra grag 12par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ gang la la'i skyes bus tsan+dan nam/ ga pur ram/ gur gum mam1ri / gla rtsi gnur zhing brgyad cing rdo ba'am sa la gzhibs 1 nas bdag nyid la byugs na de la tsan+dan nam/ ga pur ram/ gur gum mam15/ gla rtsi gnur gluba'am / brgyad pas de ltar dri 'pho bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yang dri zhim po'ang 1 de nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar 1 kho nar bdag gi 19don yod zhags pa'i 97—638

snying po 'di la yang gang la la zhig gis 'phya zhing smod 91pa dang / snga ma ltar ji snyed bdag la sgyu /midang g.yos mchod pa byed pa de dag ni bcom ldan 'das dmu rgod kyi sems can de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /'dod pas dka' bar 'dzin par brjod cade phyi ma la'ang 5ngo / /gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang de ru tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi 6)dri dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi dri zhim po nyid du byed do/ /gang yang bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/de las gzhan pa kha cig don yod zhags pa'i snying po ched du byas nas dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad la smyung 7bar gnas par 8byas te/ lan bdun du don yod zhags pa'i snying po tshig 9tu mi brjod par yongs su bzlas na/ de la bcom ldan 'das mthong ba'i chos nyid la phan yon nyi shu tham pa so sor 'dod par bya'o/ /nyi shu po gang zhe na/ gang de'i lus la nad mi 'byung ba dang /las kyi dbang gis nad byung ba yang myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /snum zhing yid du 'ong ba'i lus dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /skye bo mang po'i yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ro//dbang po sbubs 1 su nub pa dang / nor rnyed par yang 'gyur ro/ /nor yod pa yang rkun pos khyer bar mi nus so/ /mes mi 'tshig go/ /chus mi khyer ro/ /rgyal po'i yid kyis 11kyang 'phrog par mi nus so/ /de'i las kyi mtha' rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de'i lus la chu'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rlung dang char 12pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lan bdun du don yod zhags pa'i snying po chu'am thal ba la yongs su bsngags 1 te/ phyogs dang mtshams dang 97——639

steng dang 'og gi zhing la bcing ba byas na nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mdangs za bas mdangs 'phrog par mi nus so/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra yis ①'jigs pa byung ba yang myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /me (0yis 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /khyab par na ba'i 'jigs pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa drag po'ang (5)'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /me dang chu dang mtshon gyis 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /lhas kyang rgyun du nye bar bsrung ba dang /skyob pa dang / sbed par byed par 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang de ru byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang 'bral (4)bar mi 'gyur ro/ /phan yon nyi shu po 'di dag so sor 'dod par bya'o//gzhan yang chos brgyad so sor 'thob (zheste/ brgyad po gang zhe na/ 'chi (yiba'i dus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dge slong gi gzugs kyis (7zhal yang dag par ston par 'gyur ro/ /bde bar che'i (8)dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba 'khrul pa med do/ /lag pa g.yob pa med do/ /bshang ba med do/ /gci ba med do/ / rlung gi rnam pa med do/ /sgyurashin tu legs par gnas shing dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /kha 'og tu bltas yinas che'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba'i dus su nyon mongs pa med par rab tu brjod par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang du smon lam btab pa de dang de ru skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'bral 'dzobar mi 'gyur ro/ /nyin re zhing dus gsum du lan gsum du bklag tshepar bya'o/ /chang dang / sha dang / btsong /snyedang / sgog skya dang / bde byed la byin pa'i lhag ma khyad par 97wa 640

ghā ya snga hā/ bklags 15pas las thams cad 'grub pa yin no/ /dus gsum du bzlas na mtshams med pa lnga rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur rogan / /a ga ru'i bdug spos dang / thal ba dang / chu dang / yungs kur dang / seng ldeng gi phur bu la sogs pas mtshams bcing ngo / /rims nad 4thams cad la srung 55niskud bcing bar bya'o/ /nad thams cad la mar ram/ mar nag gam/ chu la yongs su bzlas te sbyin par bya'o/ /lus la 6khyab pa'i nad la mtshon chas gcad 7cing srung 8)skud kyang bya'o / /lto ba na ba la tshwa chus nyams par byed pa'am/ 'jim bag gam/ chus kyang bya'o/ /mig gi nad la skud pa dkar po rna ba la bcing bar bya'o/ /so'i nad la ka ra bī 9 ra'i so shing gis so/ /mtshams bcing ba la tshon sna lnga'i skud pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi 1 bar du yongs su bzlas nas seng ldeng gi phur bu bzhi 'a/ bcings te phyogs bzhir gdab 11pa byas na mtshams bcings pa 12yin no//thams cad du srung 1 skud dam/ chu'am/ thal bas bya'o/ /gza' thams cad la tshon 1 sna lnga'i skud pas bya'o/ /rims thams cad la skud pa dkar pos bya'o/ /sbrul dang / srin bu dang / ba spu byi ba dang / lhog pa dang / gre ba 'gags 15pa rnams la sbrang rtsi pi 7pi ling dang ldan pas bya'o/ /mig gi nad la dri zhim po'i chu'am/ rgya skyegs kyi chu'am/ sbrang rtsi'am/ shing mngar gyis bya'o/ /rtsod nga/'i dus thams cad du rtsod pa dang / mi snyan par brjod pa la chu la yongs su bzlas te gdong bkru bar bya'o/ /yul gzhan gyi rgyal po'i 'tshe ba la yul 'khor du bum pa gang ba yang dag par bzhag nas gtsang mas gos gtsang ma gyon te mchod pa chen po byas shing bklags 1 na zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /de'i 97—646

chus kyang gtor bar byas na sems can thams cad bsrung ba yin no/ /nye bar 'tshe (1)ba thams cad dang / yams rnams zhi ba yin no/ /phyag rgya tsan+dan gyi thig le la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du yongs su bzlas na mtshams med pa thams cad zad par byed do/ /rtag tu bzlas na khyim bsrung ba'o/ /pad+ma'i sbyin sreg (5gis sems can thams cad kyi bsrung ba'o/ /tsan+dan gyi sbyin sreg gis gza' dang / 'byung po dang / rgyu skar thams cad las bsrung ba'o/ /rgyal ba dang / rnam par rgyal ba dang / gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / na gu li dang / dri'i na gu li dang / dha ra ni dang / mi 4'jigs pa'i lag pa dang /dbang po'i lag pa dang / dri'i pri 5yang ku cadang / ta ka 7ra dang /'khor lo dang / 'khor lo chen po dang / rnam par gnon pa dang / so ma rā 8dzi dang / su nasta ri9zhes bya ba ste/ de dag gang yang rung ba la brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du yongs su bzlas nas nor bu lta bur byas nas mgo bo khodang dpung pa la bcing bar bya'o/ /byis pa rnams kyi ni mgul du'o/ /bud med rnams kyi mdoms su 11bcangs na rang nyid mchog tu skal ba dang ldan par byed do/ /g.yang med pa nyams nas bu yang ster ro/ /nor bu 'di bcangs pas thams cad du bsrung ba byas pa yin no/ /dug dang mes mi tshugs so/ /dug gis byas pa yang skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nad byung ba yang mi skye zhing myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro / /gza' rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung dang / sprin dang / thog ni chus rengs par byed do/ /ka ra bī 1 ra'i lcug mas ni las thams cad byed do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po mchog tu grub pa 'dis ma bsgrubs par yang las 'di rnams byed do/ /de nas sgrub 1 par 'dod na thang 97—647

sku'i cho ga ni tshon sna ma lus pas sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs mnyam par bri bar bya ste / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ral pa'i cod 6)pan 'chang ba ri dgas kyi pags rin pas smad dkris byas shing phyugs bdag gi cha lugs 'chang ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bya'o/ /lha bzo 55)mkhan gso sbyong dang ldan pas ri mo bri bar bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa pos sku gzugs de'i mdun du ba lang gi lci bas dkyil 'khor byas la me tog dkar po bkram ste/ dri zhim po'i chus bkang ba'i bum pa brgyad gzhag capar bya'o/ /nye bar spyod pa brgyad dang / nye bar mkho 5ba drug cu 6rtsa bzhi dang / khrag med pa'i gtor ma sha dang bcas pa bya'o/ /a ka ru'i bdug spos bsregs la rig pa stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /nyin zhag gcig tu smyung 7ribar gnas pa'am/ dkar gsum za zhing / dus gsum du khrus byas nas gos gtsang ma gyon par gyur pas bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas sku gzugs kyi mdun du rang nyid bris pa bltas te de mthong bas dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /ji srid du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug byon te bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /ldong ros sam mig sman la yongs su bzlas te mig la bskus 8na de nas mi snang bar 'gyur zhing nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par rmongs pa med pa'i tshogs zhes (9)bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu 'thob bo/ /sgrub pa po gang 'dod pa de 'dis byed do zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / dge slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar 97—648

'bru tsam gyi sbyin pa yang byin te dran pa tsam gyis lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na mchod sbyin chen po rnam par 'phrul pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ a mo gha shrī 6)la/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shud+dha sa twa pad+ma bi (12 (mi'i (geta/ bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'di gso sbyong gi yan lag 5brgyad bzung nas smyung 6bar gnas pa byas te mi smra bar lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu dran pas 7ribarjod par bya'o/ /de nas don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po bzlas brjod bya'o/ /bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyi (8)mdo (9ral tshul khrims dag pa chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi dri zhim po mang po lus la 'byung bozhing / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du grags par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig nyi ma re re zhing gzungs 'di dran par byed na de ni rtag tu tshul khrims yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gang la la zhig tshul khrims zhig cing nyams par gyur pas smyung 11bar gnas pa byas te/ gzungs 'di bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyi 12mod la tshul khrims yongs su dag par 'gyur zhing / tshul khrims tsho mang po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ a mo gha lak+ṣarnyi skasarba bo dhi sa twa k+ṣa mi ṇi/ k+ṣa ṇa k+ṣa ṇa ma hā 97—665

'grus nyams par mi 'gyur/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang nam yang mi 'bral 1)bar 'gyur/ brtson pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum gyi 5de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rinasarje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 4ma hā a mo gha kā 5ru ṇa/ dh+yā phyin/sa mā dhi/ sarba bi mok+ṣa/ a pra kusbya ka /tsu ru tsu ru hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'di 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi drung du yid la byed pas rtse gcig tu dran par byas na dran pa tsam gyi 7mod la bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin stong phrag brgya so sor rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyi mod la ting nge 'dzin thams cad la dbang byed par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ a mo gha nam hā pradz+nyā pā 9rir mi tā 1 a ba bhā sa swa bhā ba11/ sa me ta s+pha ra ṇa/ bud dhi/12 sra sa ra pra sa ra/ sa man+ta bud+dhi/ a ba lo ki te/ bha ga bān pradz+nyā a ba lo ki te tsak+ṣu ṣi 1lham hā pradz+nyā/ ba ra da ma 1 ṇi 15ma hā pradz+nyā/ pad+ma dhā sari ṇi 1 bhu sna dze hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'di dran pa tsam gyi 19mod la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /thabs dang shes rab sna tshogs kyi dge ba'i blo chen po rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i blo dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin 97—667

zhes bya ba'i gzungs/1༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sa man+ta bha dra nā tshonam dhā ra hā/ bod skad du / 'phags pa kun du bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig /rin/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod phung po'i ri la / dge slong brgyad stong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang thabs cig catu bzhugs 5te/gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas nas chos ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 6logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces 97—671

gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das deng bdag 1ni bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba bla ma'i 'od las blangs pa kun du bzang po'i gzungs yang dag par ston par 'tshal te/ gzungs de thos ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa rnams phyir mi ldog cing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang sel to/ /longs spyod chen po phun sum tshogs pa yang yongs su 'dzin to/ /lus rnam par dag pa yang 'thob 2bo/ /ngag rnam par dag pa yang 'thob bo/ /sems rnam par dag pa yang 'thob bo/ /pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho thams cad kyang yongs su rdzogs par bgyid do / /gzungs rgya mtsho thams cad kyang 'thob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba thams cad kyang mnyes par bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis gzungs 'di thos ma thag tu mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob/ rin chen phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob/ 'bar ba'i sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob/rgya mtsho phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob/ rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin kyang thob/ /mi zad pa'i za ma tog gi ting nge 'dzin kyang thob/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob/ /phyogs bcu rgyas par 'gengs pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyang 'thob 4ste/ bcom ldan 'das de la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bdag la mngon sum du gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das des na bdag da ltar dran pa 'di lta bu dang ldan/ blo gros 'di lta bu dang ldanar/ chags pa ma mchis pa'i ye shes 'di lta bu dang ldan zhing / mthong ba dang thos pa dang bsnyen bkur bgyis pa'i 'don mchis par gyur te/ bcom 97—672

ldan 'das bdag thos pa don mchis/ gzungs 'di thos pa don mchis na/bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang bar mdzad cing / 'khor bzhi po de yang yongs su dgod du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems can dag pa de'i dus la bab par shes na smros shig /de bzhin gshegs pas 'khor bzhi po 'di byin gyis brlabs zin to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis skad cig thang cig yud tsam de nyid la rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gzungs 'di smras so/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ kha ga me kha ga me/tsak+ṣu / kha 9)byebe/ shri natra kha be/ ṭī riṇa 4kha be/ dzi hwa 5kha be/ kā ya kha be/ma na kha 296)/ sa ra kha be / sa ra kha be/ sa ra kha ben/ shu na tra kha be/a na mi ta ri9)kha be/ a pra ṇi hi ta 7kha be/ sa mā dhe kha be/1 pā 12ra mi tā kha be / bo dhi kha be〉 / sa ra sa ra sa ra/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha sates/ bha ra bha ra bha ra/ dharma a dhiṣ+ṭha tes/ ka la ka la ka la/ sad+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha te1 / na mo dā 1 na ba tī rmāḥ// budha ko ṭī ṭ+wāṃ / a dhiṣ+ṭhan+tu māṃ 1/ tsa ta sra bsgo 2do ā 2 yur ba lañca 3༄da dan+tu ge/ tabya thā/ su ra bhi su ra bhi/ ma hā su ra bhi/ mu ni mu ni/ma hā mu ni/ ma ti ma ti/ ma hā ma ti/ na mo rat+na 2dzitra yā ya/ na ma :ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi 29ka ya/sa mṛ dān+tu māṃ / sa man+ta 21bha dra dhā ra tī rinaswā hā/ gzungs 'di thos ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po de dag gis dpa' bar 97—673

'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dag ni gzungs sna tshogs thob par gyur to/ /gzungs 'di'i cho ga ni 'di lags te/ nang par langs nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /phongs par gyur pa'i tshe lan bdun yid la bgyis na thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rims nad thams cad la rna bar bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /rlung gis zin na mar dang 'bru mar la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te bsku bar bgyi'o/ /so na na so shing la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas te bca' bar bgyi'o/ /rna ba na na ras bal gyi sa bon 'bru mar dang lhan cig tu bskol ba la lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis te zangs kyi snod kyis rna bar blugs par bgyi'o/ /klad pa na ba la 'bru mar ro/ /lto na ba la byab par bgyi'o/ /gdon gyis btab pa la tshon 1 skud sna lnga la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te (gemagul du gdags so/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon gyis btab na 'bru mar la lan bdun bzlas te gshis thams cad du byug go/ /nad thams cad la byab par bgyi'o/ /'di ni sgrub pa ma mchis pa'i cho ga'o/ /ji ste sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba dang / gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin 'thob pa dang /rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba dang / mi snang bar bgyi ba dang / mig bsku ba dang /ldong ros la sogs pa bsgrub par 'tshal na/ des sku cagadung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten dang sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar dkyil 'khor bgyis te/ bum pa gang ba brgya rtsa brgyad bzhag la/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bres te/ me tog sna tshogs kyis chal par bkang la/ tsan+dan dang a ka ru dang kun du ru'i 597—674

bdug pas bdugs te/ mar me brgya rtsa brgyad bud cing mchod pa chen po bgyis te / tshangs par spyod pa gtsang bas gos gtsang ma bgos 1)la gzungs kyi gsang sngags 'di dag gis mtshams gcad rdon par bgyi'o/ /na mo rat+na natra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya (3)a ba lo ki te shwa rā (5)ya/ bo ( dhi 7nasatā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya(9/ tabya thā/ ti li ban dhā 9)mi/ mi li ban dhā 1 mi/ tsi li mi li ban dhā 37mi/ sī mi ban dhā 12mi/ bdag gi mtshams las su yang 'da' bar ma gyur cig swā hā/ chu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas te phyogs bcur mtshams gcad par bgyi'o/ /gang gis 'gugs 15par 'gyur ba'i gzungs 'di dag kyang thog mar brjod par bya'o/ /na mo rat+na 〉tra yā ya/ na ma da.ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā 7ya/ ma hā satā 1 ya18/ ma hā kā 19ru ṇi kā ya/tar+ya thā/ tsi li tsi li/ mi li mi li/ tsi le ri li/ e hi bha ga bān 1/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra tsho geya swā hā/ 'di ni bdag gi na snying po bshad pa ste/ des bdag 'gugs 2 )par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu zla ba yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad nas bzung ste nya'i bar du lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te 5dus gsum du bzlas brjod bgyi/ dus gsum du khrus bgyi/ dus gsum du gos brje 'olhabar bgyi'o/ /de nas tshes bcwa 2 lnga la mchod pa chen po bgyis te bzlas brjod dpag tu ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /'on tang nam gyi gung thun la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gser gyi kha dog gi lus dang ldan pa/ mtshan dang dpe da byad bzang pos legs par brgyan pa/ lus las 'od zer bye ba stong 'byin cing mchi 'obar 'gyur ro/ /de la rig sngags 'chang gis skrag par mi bgyi zhing brtan par bgyis na mthong ma thag tu sa thob par 'gyur ro/ /97—675

gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /shar phyogs su de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /lho phyogs su rin chen tog dang / nub phyogs su 'od dpag med dang / byang phyogs su de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa grangs med dpag tu med pa dag rigs pa'i tshul gyis mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nas shi 'phos nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa rnams su skye bar 'gyur te1/ thams cad du yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mnyes par bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang /byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris 5kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod lado/ /'phags pa kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs cardogs sog// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi yin mi tra dang / dā 7na 8)shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de 9ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar 1 tshochad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa1 // //1297—676
